src: Vantima va endla ntsena 14.4% ya vurhangeri bya le henhla.4 Loko ku langutisiwa xilaveko xa xihatla xa ku cinca ikhonomi na ku tiyisisa ku kula ko katsa hinkwavo, leswi a swi kahle ku ringanela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukuphasiswa kweNqubomgomo Kazwelonke YoMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo ephathelene neGciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV), iZifo Ezithathwelana Ngokocansi (ama-STI) kanye neSifo Sofuba (i-TB).Ngowe-1999 inqubomgomo yayigxile ezinyathelweni ezisetshenziswa emhlabeni wonke jikelele zokuvimbela ukusuleleka ngegciwane, futhi ingazibhekisisi ngokwanele izimo zenhlalo nokuziphatha kwabantu ezibhebhezela i-HILe nqubomgomo iphakamisa ukuthi kube noguquko olunohlonze kwindlela okusetshenzwa ngayo, ngokuthi i-HIV ibhekwe ngasohlangothini lodaba lokuphatha olungumongo ngokusebenzisa indlela egxile empilweni yomphakathi futhi kusenjalo kubandakanywe ne-TB kulokho okuzogxilwa kukhona ezikoleni, phakathi kokunye.

src: Khabinete yi amukela xitiviso hi Holobye wa Vatirhi leswaku ndzawulo ya yena yi ehleketa ku teka magoza yo tika eka lava nga landzeleriki.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo izokwelulwa ibandakanye abafundi, othisha kanye nabasebenzi ezikoleni zikahulumeni kanjalo nasezikoleni ezizimele.

src: Macron ku hlanganisa tipolotiki, ikhonomi na nxaviselano leswi se swi tiyeke exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Furwa.2 Khabinete yi hoyozela khale ka meyara wa Joni, na mutshamaxitulu wa Nhlangano wa Mfumo wa Muganga wa Afrika-Dzonga, Parks Tau eka ku thoriwa ka yena tanihi mutshamaxitulu wa Nhlanganelo wa Phanele yo Tiyimela hi yoxe ya Xiyimo xa le Henhla ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ku langutela ku pfuna ka Habitat III.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukwethulwa ePhalamende kweSichibiyelo Somthetho Wenkampani Elawula Izikhumulo Zezindiza, wezi-2017 kanye neSichibiyelo Somthetho Wokundiza Ngamabhanoyi.

src: Phurogireme yi amukeriwile hi UN ku antswisa ku tiboha ka matiko hinkwawo eka nhluvukiso wa nkarhi wo leha.3 Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki (dti) yi vuyile na sagwadi ra mukombisi wa matikomambe wo antswa eka Nkombiso wa Bindzu wa matiko hinkwawo eZimbabwe wa vu 58.Leswi swi kombisa matshalatshala ya xiyimo xa le henhla hi Xipanu xa Afrika-Dzonga ku tiyisisa leswaku ku tiboha ka tiko eku akeni vutirhisano na Zimbabwe ku tswarile mihandzu eka ikhonomi loku a ku languteriwile.4 Khabinete yi hundzisele ku chavelela eka mfumo na vanhu va Riphabuliki ra Tanzania eka nghozi ya nhlomulo ya bazi leyi vangeke mafu ya 36 wa vanhu, 33 wa vona ku ri vana.
tgt: Izichibiyelo ezikule Mithethosivivinywa emibili zihlinzekela ukusungulwa koHlaka Lokulawula oluzosebenza unomphela.

src: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ya hi ku tiyisisiwa ka mithwaso na ku basisiwa loku faneleke.1 Xirho xa Bodo eka Bodo ya malawulelo yi tiyimela hi woxe ya Vakambatinkota:a) Man.
tgt: Futhi zihlinzekela nokusungulwa kwamakomidi okudluliswa kwezinqumo, azolekelela ekuxazululweni kwanoma yimuphi umbango okungezeka uqubuke.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 24 Mudyaxihi 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu mhla zingama-24 kuNhlaba 2017, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa khabinete eka timhakankulu.
tgt: Izindaba ezisematheni.

src: Khabinete yi na ku vilela hi ku tlakuka ka makhombo ya ku xanisiwa na ya madzolonga eka vamanana laha tikweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngokudlondlobala kwezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kanye nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ezweni lakithi.

src: Khombo ra madzolonga leri nga ha ku humelelaka exikarhi ka varhandzani ri kombisile vamanana va xivindzi na vurhena ku va va vulavula ehenhla ka ku onhiwa ka timfanelo ta vona.
tgt: Izigameko zakamuva ezibandakanya udlame olubhebhezelwa ngamasoka abo seziholele ekutheni abesifazane abaningi abanesibindi baphumele obala bazwakalise ukukhathazeka kwabo mayelana nalokhu kwephulwa nokunyathelwa kwamalungelo abo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela leswaku tanihi tiko hi ya emahlweni na ku va na rixaka lexi tshikilelaka vamanana naswona leswi swi lava hi lwa na ntungu wa ku hlaseriwa ka vamanana na ku ngungumerisiwa ka vanhu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuthi njengezwe sisalokhu siyizwe elilawulwa ngamadoda futhi elibeka amadoda phambili, ngokunjalo-ke inxusa ukuba kwenziwe imizamo ethe xaxa ukulwisana nesihlava sokubulawa nokushushumbiswa kwabesifazane.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba swiyenge hinkwaswo swa tiko ku khomana hi swandla ku herisa ntungu lowu, ku alelana na tinxaka hinkwato ta madzolonga leti endliwaka ehenhla vamanana na vana, na ku tirhisana na maphorisa na sisiteme ya vululami ku kota ku tisa emahlweni ka huvo vaendli va milandzu leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa yonke imikhakha yomphakathi ukuba ibambisane ekunqobeni lesi sihlava, ilwisane nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane, futhi isebenzisane namaphoyisa kanye nohlelo lwezobulungiswa ukuze kuboshwe futhi kugwetshwe abenzi bobubi.

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u vurile leswaku a ku vi na ku herisiwa ka ku xanisiwa ka vamanana na vana.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma usenxuse ukuba kuphele ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane okulokhu kuqhubekile njalo.

src: Khabinete yi lerisile Nhlangano wa Nsirhelelo wa Vanhu, Vaaki na Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu ku endla nongonoko wa migingiriko lowu nga ta fambisa tiko eku lweni na ku herisa ku xanisiwa ka vamanana na vana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalele iQoqwana Lezokuvikelwa Komphakathi Nokuthuthukiswa Kwabantu ukuba liqalise uhlelo lokusebenza oluzohola izwe empini yokuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo ya Nkambisiso wa Rihanyo na Xiyimo xa Tinhlayohlayo ta MaAfrika-Dzonga wa 2016 hi Nhlangano wa Tinhlayohlayo wa Afrika-Dzonga, lowu pimaka xiyimo xa rihanyo ra MaAfrika-Dzonga, na mfikelelo na nkoka wa minongonoko ya rihanyo.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyayithokozela imiphumela yoCwaningo lowezi-2016 Lwesimo Sempilo Nenhlalo Yabantu Abahlukahlukene BaseNingizimu Afrika olwenziwe wuPhiko Lwezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA), olucubungula futhi luhlole isimo sempilo sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, nezinga lokufinyelela kwezinhlelo zezempilo kubona kanye nekhwalithi yalezo zinhlelo.

src: Eka swin’wana leswi nkambisiso wu nga swi vika i ku ya ehansi hi 20% eka ku lova ka tincece na ku ya ehansi hi 11% ka vamanana na vatatana lava dzahaka fole.
tgt: Umbiko wocwaningo ubonisa ukuthi, phakathi kokunye, sehle ngama-20% isibalo sokushona kwezingane futhi lehle nge-11% inani labesifazane kanye nabesilisa ababhema ugwayi.

src: Mivuyelo yi kombisa leswaku ku nghenelela ka pholisi leyi vekiweke hi vufambisi bya Phuresidente Zuma ku le ku tswaleni ka mihandzu.
tgt: Le miphumela iyakhombisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokungenelela eziqaliswe nguhulumeni kaMongameli Zuma seziqalile ukuvuna izithelo ezinhle.

src: Hambiswiritano, khabinete yi na ku vilela hi nhlayo ya MaAfrika-Dzonga lava ya ka emahlweni va ti nghenelerisa eka swa masangu va nga tisirhelelangi na varhandzani vo hlaya.
tgt: Kepha-ke, iKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngesibalo sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abasalokhu beqhubeka nokuya ocansini olungaphephile nabalingani abaningi.

src: Kwalomu ka 32% na 42% wa vamanana na vavanuna hi mukhuva walowo va kombise leswaku a va si tshama va kamberiwa HIV hambileswi mfumo wu nga le ku tirheni hi matimba ku tisa ndzemukiso wa ku kamberiwa ka HIV.
tgt: Abesifazane abangama-32% kanye nabesilisa abangama-42% batshele abenzi bocwaningo ukuthi bona abakaze bahlolelwe igciwane lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) nakuba uhulumeni enza imizamo yokuqwashisa ngokubaluleka kokuhlolelwa i-HIV.

src: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku teka vutihlamuleri bya vona n’winyi eka rihanyo na ku hlayiseka ka vona, va ti toloveta ku endla swa masangu va tisirhelerile na ku kambela HIV na vuvabyi lebyi tlulelaka na lebyi tluleriki hinkwabyo nkarhi na nkarhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqikelele impilo nenhlalakahle yabo, bazivikele uma beya ocansini futhi njalo baye kohlolelwa i-HIV kanye nazo zonke izifo ezithathelwanayo nezingathathelwana.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vatswari na vahlayisi ku tiyisisa leswaku vana va vona va tlhaveriwa eka mavabyi ya vana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abazali kanye nabalondolozi bezingane ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zigonyelwa izifo ezihlasela izingane.

src: Khabinete yi tshama yi tiyimiserile ku tiyisisa leswaku vana va sawutisiwa ku herisa mavabyi yo tlulela lawa ya xungetaka vutomi bya vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isalokhu izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izingane ziyagonywa ngenhloso yokuqeda izifo ezithathelwanayo eziyingozi kakhulu empilweni yezingane.

src: Khabinete yi tiyisisa nakambe vatswari na vahlayisi leswaku mirhi leyi nyikiwaka hi Ndzawulo ya Rihanyo yi hlayisekile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuqinisekisa abazali nabalondolozi ukuthi iphephile imithi esetshenziswa nguMnyango Wezempilo ukugoma izingane zabo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela xiyenge xo sungula xa ku pfuxetiwa ka Vulindlela Heights Industrial eMthatha eKapa-Vuxa.
tgt: IKhabinethi isamukelile isigaba sokuqala sesizinda sezimboni esivuselelwe kabusha i-Vulindlela Heights Industrial esiseMthatha, eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Lexi i xiphemu xa tiko xa Phurogireme ya Mpfuxeto wa Tindhawu ta Tifeme.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yoHlelo Lokuvuselelwa Kabusha Kwamapaki Ezimboni.

src: I ya vumbirhi ya muxaka wa yona eKapa-Vuxa na yin’we eka ntsevu wa tindhawu leti pfuxetiweke laha tikweni.
tgt: Leli paki lezimboni liyisizinda sesibili salolu hlobo eMpumalanga Kapa futhi lingelinye lamapaki ezimboni ayisithupha avuselelwa kabusha njengamanje ezweni lonkana.

src: Mfumo wu le ku pfuxeteni ka tindhawu ta tifeme ku engetela ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na ku tiyisisa ku kula loku angarhelaka.
tgt: Uhulumeni uvuselela amapaki ezimboni ngenhloso yokukhuthaza ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokuqinisekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke.

src: Ku susiwa ka migingiriko ya ikhonomi ku suka exikarhi ka madoroba na kona i xiphemu xa matshalatshala ya mfumo ya ku tisa ku cinca ka ikhonomi.
tgt: Ukufuduswa kwemisebenzi yezomnotho isuka ezizindeni ezisemadolobheni nakho kuyingxenye yemizamo kahulumeni yokuletha uguquko lwezomnotho olunohlonze.

src: Vuxokoxoko hilaha mi nga nghenelelaka hakona eka swivandlanene leswi nga kona eka tindhawu ta tifeme ta hina, ku fikelela nseketelo wa mfumo na tiphurogireme ta swinavetisi, na swivandlanene swa vuvekisi eka swiyenge swo hambanahambana byi kona eka WEBTOKEN kumbe hi ku tirhisa Senthara ya Tiqingho ta Vatirhisi eka 0861 843 984 ya Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki (dti).
tgt: Ulwazi mayelana nokuthi abantu bangawasebenzisa kanjani amathuba akhona emapaki ezimboni akuleli futhi bafinyelele nasezinhlelweni zosizo nemihlomulo-nkuthazo ehlinzekwa nguhulumeni kanye namathuba okutshalwa kwezimali emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, luyatholakala WEBTOKEN noma eSikhungweni Sokuxhumana Namakhasimende soMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (i-dti) ngokufonela le nombolo: 0861 843 384.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke hi ku nyama xiboho xa General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd xa ku herisa ku endliwa na ku xavisiwa ka mimovha ya Chevrolet laha tikweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiphawule ngokudabuka nokukhathazeka isinqumo senkampani yezimoto i-General Motors South Africa (i-GMSA) (Pty) Ltd sokuvala umsebenzi wayo wokukhiqiza nokuthengisa izimoto zohlobo lwe-Chevrolet kuleli.

src: Leswi swi na switandzhaku swo vavisa ngopfu eka lava nga ta lahlekeriwa hi mitirho na le ka ikhonomi ya hina.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omubi kakhulu kulabo abazophelelwa yimisebenzi yabo kanye nasemnothweni wezwe lakithi.

src: Mfumo wa ha tinyiketerile ku seketela sekithara ya timovha ya tiko, leyi nga ya nkoka eka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu ezibophezele ekusekeleni umkhakha wezimoto, okuwumkhakha obaluleke kakhulu emnothweni wezwe nasekuvulweni kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Dti yi ya emahlweni yi tirha na lava khumbhekaka ku hunguta nkhumbho.
tgt: I-dti iyaqhubeka nokusebenzisana nabo bonke abathintekayo ukunciphisa umthelela walokhu.

src: Ku engetela ka vumaki, ku tumbuluxa mitirho na ku tiyisisa ku rhumela ematikwenimambe, ha ha ku simeka xiyenge xa vu kaye xa Kungu ra Migingiriko ya Pholisi ya Tifeme (IPAP) ku letela migingiriko ya hina.
tgt: Ngenhloso yokukhulisa umsebenzi wokukhiqiza, ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokuqinisa ukuthunyelwa kwempahla emazweni angaphandle, esikhathini esifushane esedlule sethule isigaba sesishiyagalolunye soHlelo Lokusebenza Lwenqubomgomo Yezimboni (i-IPAP) ukuze ihole izinyathelo zethu.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Isuzu, leyi a yi tirhisana na GMSA eka malembe lawa ya nga hundza eAfrika-Dzonga, yi ta yisa emahlweni na ku fambisa GMSKhabinete yi lemuke ku nyanya ka xiyimo xa dyandza eKapa-Vupeladyambu na le Kapa-Vuxa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphawulile ukuthi inkampani yakwa-Isuzu, ebilokhu ibambisene nabakwa-GMSA eNingizimu Afrika kule minyaka edlule, izothatha izintambo iqhube umsebenzi obewenziwa ngabakwa-GMSIKhabhinethi isiphawulile isimo esibi kakhulu esidalwe yisomiso eNtsonalanga Kapa kanye naseMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku seketela swipimelo swa mati leswi tivisiweke hi swifundzankulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi ukuba isekele imikhawulo ebekwe yizifundazwe yokusetshenziswa nokongiwa kwamanzi.

src: Xipano lexi nga na vatirhi va Ndzawulo ya Mati na Mbhasiso, Komiti ya Vufambisi bya Mhangu ya Rixaka va tirhisana na swifundzankulu na mfumo wa muganga, va le ku tirheni hi matimba ku tiyisisa leswaku swintshuxo swa nkarhi wo lehanyana swa endliwa hi xihatla ku tiyisisa leswaku mati ya kona eka xifundzankulu eka nkarhi wo leha.
tgt: Ithimba elihlanganisa izikhulu ezivela eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle, neKomidi Likazwelonke Lokuphathwa Nokulawulwa Kwezinhlekelele, ngokusebenzisana nohulumeni bezifundazwe nabezindawo, basebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu ukuqinisekisa ukusheshiswa kwezixazululo zesikhathi esifushane kuya esikhathini esimaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala kwamanzi anele ezifundazweni esikhathini eside esizayo.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku katsa vatirhisi va le makaya, mabindzu, sekithara ya migodi, eneji na vurimi ku va va tirhisana na ku tirhisa mati hi vukheta swinene.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kubandakanya nabasebenzisi bamanzi basemakhaya, amabhizinisi, umkhakha wezimayini, owezamandla kanye nowezolimo ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana futhi basebenzise amanzi ngokucophelela, futhi bawonge.

src: Khabinete yi amukele ku humesiwa ka tsalwa ra nkanelo ra Qhinga ra ku Lwisana na Manyala, leri nga letela Qhinga ra Tiko ro Lwisana na Manyala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukukhishwa kombhalo wokuxoxisana weSu Lokulwisana Nenkohlakalo, ozoholela ekusungulweni kweSu Likazwelonke Lokulwisana Nenkohlakalo.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba mani na mani ku endla swibumabumelo leswi tsariweke hi ku ya eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo wa Matirhelo eka: www.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema umphakathi ukuba uthumele iziphakamiso nemibono yawo ebhalwe phansi, ngokusebenzisa i-webhusayithi yoMnyango Wezokuhlela, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola ku: www.

src: Ku lwa na manyala ku tshama ku ri swirhanganankulu swa mfumo.
tgt: Impi yokulwisana nenkohlakalo isalokhu ingenye yezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini nguhulumeni.

src: Manyala na ku tsandzeka ka ku xiximeka eka sekithara ya mabindzu na le ka mfumo ya khumbha tiko hi ndlela yo ka yi nga ri kahle eka nhluvukiso wa tiko.
tgt: Inkohlakalo kanye nokungasebenzi ngobuqotho emikhakheni yomibili, okungumkhakha ozimele kanye nomkhakha kahulumeni, kunomthelela omubi kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwezwe lethu.

src: Khabinete yi kombise ku vilela eka ku hlaseriwa ka swa inthanete emisaveni hinkwayo loku ka ha ku va kona, leswi nga vikiwa tanihi nhlaselo lowukulu wa inthanete ku fika sweswi.
tgt: IKhabinethi izwakalise ukukhathazeka ngesigameko sakamuva sokuhlaselwa kohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi emhlabeni jikelele, okubikwe njengesigameko esikhulu kunazo zonke kuze kube manje sokuhlaselwa kohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku va na vukheta swinene loko va tirhisa tindlela ta xitironiki ku tihlanganisa na ku fambisa bindzu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezidingekile ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwemininingwane yabo ngenkathi bexhumana noma benza ibhizinisi ngohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi.

src: Ku tirhisiwa ka sofuwere ya antivhayirasi leyi pfuxetiweke leyi kambelaka xiyimo hi mikarhi hinkwayo na swona swa bumabumeriwa.
tgt: Kunconywa futhi nokuthi abasebenzisi bohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi basebenzise uhlelo-kusebenza lwekhompyutha lwakamuva olulwisana ngokuqhubekayo namavayirasi ahlasela izinhlelo-kusebenza zamakhompyutha.

src: Khabinete yi na ku vilela hi timhaka leti nga le ku humeleleni eka Eskom.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngezigameko zakamuva ezenzeke kwa-Eskom.

src: Khabinete ya amukela mhaka ya leswaku ku thoriwa nakambe ka Tat.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi udaba oluphathelene nokuqashwa kabusha kukaMnu Brian Molefe njengoMphathi Omkhulu (i-CEO) wakwa-Eskom njengamanje luphambi kwezinkantolo kanye nePhalamende, ngakho-ke izozihlonipha lezo zinqubo zize ziphothulwe ngokufanelekile.

src: Brian Molefe tanihi Mufambisinkulu wa Eskom swi le khoto na le Palamende, naswona yi ta xixima tiphurosese leti.
tgt: Kepha-ke, uMongameli usesungule iKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene (i-IMC) elihlanganisa uNgqongqoshe Wezamabhizinisi Kahulumeni, Owezamandla, Owezezimali kanye Nowezobulungiswa Nokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo.

src: IMC yi komberiwe ku hlengeleta timhaka ku kota ku letela Khabinete ku tirhana na timhaka leti eka nkarhi lowu taka.
tgt: Leli Komidi lijutshwe ukuba lenze umsebenzi wokuqoqa ulwazi namaqiniso azonikeza iKhabhinethi umhlahlandlela wokuthi kumele ibhekane kanjani nezindaba ezinjengalezi esikhathini esizayo.

src: Muhlanganisi i Holobye wa Vululami na swa Makhotso, Tat.
tgt: Umhlanganisi waleli komidi nguNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo, uMnu Michael Masutha.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Ntwanano wa ku Kambisisa ku Nyika Matimba eka Vantima hi ku Angarhela eka tifeme ta Migodi na Swicelwa ta Afrika_Dzonga hi 2017.Holobye wa Swicelwa Mosebenzi Zwane u ta nyika mbulavulo loko ntwanano wu gazetiwile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa kukaSomqulu Obuyekeziwe wezi-2017 Wokufukulwa Nokuhlonyiswa Kwabantu Abamnyama Kwezomnotho oqondiswe embonini yeZimayini Nezimbiwa yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Rixaka xa 2017 hi Holobye wa Vuhlanganisi bya swa Tiqingho na Vukorhokeri bya Poso.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezimbiwa u-Mosebenzi Zwane uzohlinzeka ngolwazi olufanelekile uma lo somqulu usushicilelwe kusomqulu kahulumeni.

src: Ku nyikiwa ka ndhawu hi Khonferense ya Matiko ya Misava ya Vuhlanganisi bya Xiyanimoya swi ta khumba swinene ku kula ka ikhonomi eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugunyazile uHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya lowezi-2017 oluvunywe yiHhovisi LikaNgqongqoshe Wezengqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi.

src: Kungu ra Xihondzo ra Xiyanimoya ra Rixaka ra 2017 i xitirhisiwa xo angarhela xa xiyanimoya eka ku nyikiwa xihondzo hikuya hi vukorhokeri bya vuhlanganisi bya xiyanimoya byo hambana.
tgt: Umthamo wokusakaza ngomoya owabelwe leli lizwe eNgqungqutheleni Yomhlaba Yezokhuxhumana Ngamagagasi Omoya unomthelela omkhulu ekukhulisweni komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kungu ra Xihondzo ra Xiyanimoya ra 2017 leri pfuxetiweke ri tiyisisa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ra ti xaxameta na Swipimelo swa Xiyanimoya swa Matiko ya misava leswi amukeriweke hi Khonferense ya Nhlangano wa Vuhlanganisi bya swa Tiqingho bya Matiko ya Misava hi 2015.
tgt: UHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya lowezi-2017 luwumthombo obanzi futhi ophelele wokwabelwa kwezinsizakalo zokuxhumana ngamagagasi omoya umthamo wokusakaza ngomoya.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Vuhlayiseki bya Tindlela ta mati ta Matikweni ya le Ndzeni ka tiko.
tgt: UHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya olubuyekeziwe lowezi-2017 luyaqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyahambisana neMithethonqubo egunyaziwe Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokusakaza Ngomoya eyamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kwiNgqungquthela yowezi-2015 yeNhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo.

src: Qhinga leri, hi ku landzelela Vulawuri bya Vuhlayiseki bya le Lwandle eAfrika-Dzonga leri vekaku swipimelo na ku hluvukisa maendlelo eka ku pfumelela na ku lulamisa ku nyika mpfumelo eka swikwekwetsu leswi fambaka etindleleni ta mati ya le ndzeni ka tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iligunyazile iSu Lokuphepha Kwemifula Emaphakathi Nezwe.

src: Leswi swi ta tiyisisa vuhlayiseki bya swikwekwetsu leswitsongo eAfrika-Dzonga etindleleni ta mati ya le ndzeni ka tiko.
tgt: Lelisu, ngokusebenzisa uPhiko Lwezokuphepha Olwandle LwaseNingizimu Afrika, lubeka amazinga okumele athotshelwe futhi luphucula izinqubo zokuhlinzekwa ngezimvume namalayisense kwezikebhe ezisebenza emifuleni emaphakathi nezwe.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra ku Rhwala Tinhundzu ra Magondzo.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezikebhe ezincane emifuleni yaseNingizimu Afrika emaphakathi nezwe.

src: Xikongomelo xa qhinga leri i ku hlanganisa vulawuri na rimba ra matirhelo, leswi nga ta pfuna Afrika-Dzonga ku fikelela swipimelo swa misava hinkwayo swa matirhelo ya ku rhwala tinhundzu hi magondzo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iligunyazile iSu Lokuthunyelwa Kwempahla Ngezinto Zokuthutha Ezihamba Emgwaqeni.

src: Swibumabumelo swa qhinga leri swi ta yisa emahlweni vuswikoti bya ku landzelela nawu, ku tlakusa ku seketela vuhlayiseki emagondzweni, ku tlakusa ku sirheleriwa ka switirhisiwa, ku hunguta ku khumbheka ka mbango, na ku ku endla rimba leri hlanganisiweke ra mphikizano wa nkoka lowu lawuriwaka laha sekithara ya ku rhwala tinhundzu ta le magondzweni wu nga ha ya ka emahlweni ku tirhela swilaveko swa ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Lelisu kuhloswe ngalo ukwakha uhlaka lokulawula nokusebenza oludidiyelwe, oluzokwenza ukuba iNingizimu Afrika ikwazi ukufinyelela emazingeni aphuma phambili emhlabeni jikelele aphathelene nomsebenzi wokuthunyelwa kwempahla ngezinto zokuthutha ezihamba emgwaqeni.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Khamphani yo Endla Mali ya Nsimbhi ya Afrika-Dzonga ya 2017 na 2018 eka ntirho wo tsundzuka nhlengeleto wa mali ya nsimbhi na ku yi hangalasa.
tgt: Izincomo zalelisu zizoqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kangcono kwamazinga abekiwe, zigqugquzele ukuphepha emgwaqeni, zenze ngcono ukuvikelwa kwengqalasizinda, zinciphise umthelela ongemuhle ongakhahlameza imvelo futhi zakhe uhlaka oludidiyelwe lokuncintisana okulawulwa ngokwekhwalithi yomsebenzi oluzovumela ukuba umkhakha wokuthunyelwa kwempahla ngezinto zokuthutha ezihamba emgwaqeni ukwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wokubhekelela nokuhlinzekela izidingo zomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Hi ku tirhisana na Khabinete, nongonoko lowuntshwa wu endliwile lowu kombisaka mfuwo, ntshuxeko na xidemokirasi ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Ku Tlangela Afrika-Dzonga”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwagunyazile amadizayini eNkampani Ekhiqiza Izinhlamvu Zemali yaseNingizimu Afrika, owezi-2017 nowezi-2018 ezinhlamvu zemali ezizoba yisikhumbuzo kanye nalezo ezizosetshenziswa emphakathini nsukuzonke.

src: Ku tlangela malembe xidzana ya ku tswariwa ka Mulwela Ntshuxeko Oliver Reginald Tambo ku hlawuriwile ku va nhlokomhaka yo sungula ku va yi kombiwa.
tgt: Ngokubambisana neKhabhinethi, sekwakhiwe olunye uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zemali eziwuphawu olumele amasiko, inkululeko kanye nombuso wentando yeningi labantu ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sibungaza iNingizimu Afrika”.

src: Ku tivisiwa ka R50 leyintshwa (1oz, sterling-silivhere) mali ya nsimbhi, R500 (1oz, 24-wa kharente wa nsuku) mali ya nsimbhi na R50 (base metal alloy) mali ya nsimbhi ya ku tlangeriwa ka dzana ra malembe ya siku ra ku tswariwa ka OR Tambo.
tgt: Umbungazo weminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa ingqalabutho yomzabalazo u-Oliver Reginald Tambo uqokwe njengomfanekiso wokuqala ozoboniswa kulezi zinhlamvu zemali.

src: 2017 ku hangalasiwa ka mali ya nsimbhi: R5 leyi kombaka Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kohlamvu olusha olungama-R50 (oluyisiliva soqobo olusinesisindo esilingana ne-awunsi elilodwa), uhlamvu olungama-R500 (olwakhiwe ngamakharethi egolide angama-24, olusinesisindo esilingana ne-awunsi elilodwa) kanye nohlamvu olungama-R50 (olwakhiwe nge-sterling silver), okuyizinhlamvu okuhloswe ngazo ukugubha iminyaka eyi-100 kwazalwa u-OR Tambo.

src: 2017 mali ya nsimbhi ya Phurothiya: Vutomi bya Nhenha – Nelson Mandelad.
tgt: Sekwakhiwe izinhlamvu zesikhumbuzo ezilandelayo zowezi-2017 nowezi-2018:a. Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zowezi-2017: Umgubho Yeminyaka Eyikhulu ka-Oliver Reginald Tambob.

src: 2017 R1 mali ya nsimbhi: Swikokovi swa Afrika-Dzonga – Mhirie.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu olungu-R5 lowezi-2017 oluzosetshenziswa nsukuzonke emphakathini: uhlamvu olungu-R5 olubonisa i-Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.

src: 2018 Nhlangano wa UN waswa Dyondzo, Sayense na swa Mfuwo (UNESCO) Mali ya nsimbhi ya Munhu na xibakabaka: The Waterberg Biosphere Reservef.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu lwe-Protea lowezi-2017: Impilo Yengqalabutho – u-Nelson Mandelad.

src: 2018 mali ya nsimbhi: Tiko ra Mbango ra Rixaka ra ‘Qhinga ra Swimanga Leswikulu’ – Nghala.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu olungu-R1 lowezi-2017: Izilwane Ezihuquzela Ngesisu zaseNingizimu Afrika – iBululue.

src: g. 2018 mali ya nsimbhi: Khapu ya Matiko ya Misava ya FIFA eRhaxiya™ Mitlangu leyi taka.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu lowezi-2018 lweNhlangano Yezemfundo, Ezesayensi Nezamasiko engaphansi kweNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UNESCO) Umuntu Nemvelo Aphila Kuyo: Isiqiwu Semvelo sase-Waterbergf.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku seketela Vhiki ra Nsirhelelo wa Vana ku sukela hi ti 28 Mudyaxihi ku fika hi ti 4 Khotavuxika ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Hinkwerhu a hi sirheleleni vana ku yisa Afrika-Dzonga Emahlweni”.
tgt: Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zowezi-2018: Inhlangano Kazwelonke Yezejiyografi ‘Umklamo Wamakati Amakhulu Asendle’ – IBhubesig.

src: Ku sirheleriwa ka vana va hina i ntirho na vutihlamuleri bya MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo vatswari, vahlayisi, munhu un’wana na un’wana na vaaki.
tgt: Ukuvikelwa kwezingane zethu kungumthwalo wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abazali, abalondolozi, umuntu ngamunye kanye nemiphakathi.

src: Tanihi vaaki hi na ntirho wa ku endla swo tala ku tiyisiwa leswaku lava nga le khombyeni eka rixaka a va xanisiwi.
tgt: Njengezwe, sinomthwalo wokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi mabangahlukunyezwa nakancane labo abangakwazi ukuzivikela ngokwabo emphakathini wethu.

src: Swi le mavokweni ya hina ku herisa ku honisa, nxaniso, madzolonga na ku tirhisiwa ka vana hi ndlela yo ka yi nga ri kahle.
tgt: Kusezandleni zethu ukuqeda isihlava sokunganakwa, ukuhlukunyezwa, udlame kanye nokuxhashazwa kwezingane.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza tisekithara hinkwato ta vaaki ku tirhisana ku tumbuluxa miganga leyi hlayisekeke na ku va na rihanyo lerinene leswaku vana va hina va kota ku humelela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza yonke imikhakha yomphakathi ukuba isebenzisane ukwakha imiphakathi ephephile futhi engumqemane ukuze zikhule kahle izingane zethu.

src: Eka ku tlangela malembe xidzana ya OR Tambo, Afrika-Dzonga ri ta tsundzuka N’hweti ya Vantshwa hi Khotavuxika ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Lembe ra OR Tambo: Ku Yisa Emahlweni ka ku Nghenelela ka Vantshwa eka Ikhonomi.”Eka n’hweti leyi mfumo wu ta rhurhela mimbhurisano leyi katsaka mikombiso ya vantshwa, min’wangulano na tisenthara ta mabindzu ya vantshwa ku kombisa swivandlanene leswi nga kona eka vantshwa, na ku va hlohlotela ku tiyisisa nkoka wa swa dyondzo na vurhangeri bya OR Tambo.
tgt: Ngenhloso yokugubha iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa u-OR Tambo, iNingizimu Afrika izoqopha iNyanga Yentsha ngoNhlangulana wezi-2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Lona Ngunyaka ka-OR Tambo: Siqhubekisela Phambili Ukubandakanywa Kwentsha Kwezomnotho.”Ngokuqhubeka kwenyanga kaNhlangulana uhulumeni uzosingatha imicimbi ehlukahlukene kubandakanya imibukiso eyenzelwe intsha, izinkulumo-mpikiswano kanye nezizinda zamabhizinisi entsha ngenhloso yokubonisa amathuba akhona enzelwe abantu abasha kanye nokubafaka ugqozi lokuba bamukele futhi bagxile kumagugu-mgomo ka-OR Tambo obuholi nemfundo.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza lavantshwa ku fikelela nseketelo wo hambanahambana na tiphurogireme ta dyondzo leti mfumo wu nga endla ku ri ti va kona ku antswisa vumundzuku bya vona na ku ya emahlweni ka vona va nghenelela eka ikhonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabakhuthaza bonke abantu abasha ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi bayafinyelela ezinhlelweni zosizo nezemfundo ezahlukahlukene ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni ukuze baphucule futhi baqhubekisele phambili amathuba abo okubamba iqhaza emnothweni.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vathori ku hoxa xandla eka pfhumba ra Teka N’wana wa Nhwana u ya na yena entirhweni hi ti 25 Mudyaxihi na ti 26 Mudyaxihi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abaqashi ukuba nabo balekelele emkhankasweni obizwa nge-Take a girl child to work mhla zingama-25 kuNhlaba kuya kumhla zingama-26 kuNhlaba.

src: Xikongomelo i ku endla leswaku vanhwana va ka Giredi 10 ku fika ka 12 va vona tikhariya to hambana leti va nga ti hlawulaka.
tgt: Inhloso yalo mkhankaso wukuhlinzeka amantombazane afunda iBanga le-10 kuya kwele-12 ngethuba lokuzibonela ngamehlo awo imisebenzi ehlukahlukene angayifundela uma esephothule isikole.

src: Phuresidente Zuma hi Ravumune, 25 Mudyaxihi 2017, u ta rhurhela ku tlangela Siku ra Afrika ra rixaka ra 2017 eNdlwini ya Phuresidente ya Vaendzi ya Sefako Makgatho ePitori.
tgt: NgoLwesine mhla zingama-25 kuNhlaba 2017 uMongameli Zuma uzosingatha umgubho kazwelonke woSuku lwe-Afrika wezi-2017 endlini yezivakashi zikaMongameli i-Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli.

src: Leswi i makumu ya migingiriko na tiphurogireme leti funghaka N’hweti ya Afrika ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Lembe ra OR Tammbo: Ku Aka Afrika ro Antswa na Misava yo Antswa”.Ku tsundzuka ka lembe na lembe ka Siku ra Afrika ku fungha ku sunguriwa ka Nhlangano wa Vun’we bya Afrika hi 1963.Loko ha ha gimeta N’hweti ya Afrika, Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku endla xinakulobye na MaAfrika van’wana lava tshamaka laha Afrika-Dzonga na ku n’wana laha tikweninkulu ku tiyisisa leswaku ku humelela eka muganga wa hina na Afrika hinkwaro.
tgt: Lo mgubho wuvuthondaba lwemicimbi nezinhlelo okuqoshwe ngazo iNyanga ye-Afrika ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Lona Ngunyaka ka-OR Tambo: Sakha i-Afrika Engcono Kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono”.

src: Swi le ka hinkwavo lava tshamaka endzeni ka mindzilekana, MaAfrika-Dzonga na vaaki va matikomambe ku landzelela milawu ya laha tikweni.
tgt: Umgubho waminyaka yonke woSuku lwe-Afrika uqopha ukusungulwa kweNhlangano Yobumbano Lwamazwe ase-Afrika (i-OAU) ngowe-1963.Njengoba sesiphothula iNyanga ye-Afrika, iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babambisane nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika abahlala eNingizimu Afrika kanye nalabo abahlala kwezinye izingxenye zaleli zwekazi ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuchuma nokuphumelela kwesifunda sethu kanye ne-Afrika yonkana.

src: Hinkwerhu hi fanele hi lwisana na ntungu wa ku ngungumerisiwa ka vanhu, ku tlhakisiwa, na ku xanisiwa ka vamanana na vana.
tgt: Futhi kungumthwalo osemahlombe abo bonke abantu abahlala kuleli, okungabantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanjalo nabantu abavela emazweni angaphandle, ukuba bathobele imithetho yezwe.

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka Yunivhesiti ya Stellenbosch na Xibedlhele xa Dyondzo xa Tygerberg xa xipano xa swa vutshunguri lexi katsaka Phurof.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela ithimba lezokwelapha leNyuvesi yase-Stellenbosch kanye nesibhedlela sase-Tygerberg elihlanganisa uSlz Andre van der Merwe, uDkt Alexander Zuhlke, uSlz Rafique Moosa, uDkt Amir Zarrabi kanye noDkt Zamira Keyser.

src: Lava va ha ku endlaka vuhandzuri bya vumbirhi ku susa vununa byi vekeriwa eka wanuna un’wana, leswi endlaka leswaku ku va senthara ya vutshunguri yo sungula emisaveni hinkwayo ku endla vuhandzuri lebyi kambirhi byi va kahle.
tgt: Le ndondo iwumklomelo wokuhalalisela lesi siKhungo ngokuthola kwaso imibiko yocwaningo-mabhuku engenasici iminyaka emihlanu ilandelana.

src: Ku humelela ka vuhandzuri lebyi emavokweni ya xipano xa hina xa ku susa xirho i vumbhoni bya vutshila na vutivi bya xiyimo xa le henhla lebyi nga eka kona eka sekithara ya rihanyo ra vaaki eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: NgoZibandlela we-1999, iSimangaliso Wetland Park samenyezelwa njengeSizinda Esiyigugu Emhlabeni sokuqala saseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka iSimangaliso Wetland Park ku va yi nyikiwile Sagwati ra Vuswikoti bya Vukambatinkota eka Nhlangano wa Vativinkulu va Tinkota wa Afrika-Dzonga (SAICA) wa Masagwati ya Vuswikoti ya Sekithara ya Mfumo emasungulweni ya n’hweti leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela uhlelo lokulwisana nomlilo i-Working on Fire ngokuzitholela kwalo indondo yokubonga evela kuhulumeni wesifundazwe sase-Alberta e-Canada ewuphawu lokubonga usizo olwahlinzekwa yilolu hlelo ekulawuleni imililo yequbula esiFundazweni sase-Alberta ngowezi-2016.

src: Sagwati ri tekela enhlokweni ku va Phaka yi kumile vukambatinkota lebyi baseke eka malembe ya ntlhanu lawa ya hundzeke hi ku landzelelana.
tgt: I-Working on Fire iwuhlelo olungaphansi koHlelo Olunwetshiwe Lwemisebenzi Yomphakathi (i-EPWP) okuhloswe ngalo ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba etoho kubantu abasha besilisa nabesifazane.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 7 Khotavuxika 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-7 kuNhlangulana 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa khabinete eka timhakankulu.
tgt: Izindaba ezisematheni.

src: Khabinete yi vula nakambe xikombelo xa Phuresidente Jacob Zuma xo va MaAfrika-Dzonga ya va nyandza yin'we ku lwa na madzolonga na ku xanisiwa ka vamanana na vana, na ku kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku teka magoza ya xihatla ku herisa ntungu lowu emigangeni ya hina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelela ikhwela elihlatshwe nguMongameli uJacob Zuma lokuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babumbane baphikisane nodlame kanye nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane kanye nezingane, futhi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bathathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqedwe lesi sihlava emiphakathini yethu.

src: Leswi swi landzela riendzo ra Phuresidente Jacob Zuma ro ya Elsie’s River eKapa hi ku seketela Imbizo yo Lwa na Vugevenga.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela ukuhambela kukaMongameli e-Elsies River eKapa ngokweseka Imbizo Yokulwisana Nobugebengu.

src: Nakambe riendzo ri kombisile ku nga sirhelelekangi ka vamanana na vana emigangeni ya hina.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambela kuphinde futhi kwaqhakambisa ubuthakathaka babantu besifazane kanye nezingane ezweni lakithi.

src: Phuresidente u tshembhisile ku vuya eka ndhawu ku ta langutisa eka mitlhontlho yo tala ya vugevenga na ku dlaya, ngopfungopfu ka vana na hilaha vulawuri bya vulandzelerisi bya nawu byi nga ta antswisa hakona vukorhokeri bya vona emugangeni.
tgt: UMongameli uthembise ukuthi uzophinda abuyele kule ndawo ukuzobheka kabanzi izingqinamba eziningi zobugebengu kanye nokubulawa kwabantu, ikakhulukazi izingane kanye nokuthi iziphathimandla zengalo yomthetho zizoziphucula kanjani izinsizakalo zazo ezizenza emphakathini.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku humesiwa ka Mbalango wo Angarhela wa Mindyangu wa 2016, lowu yaka emahlweni wu komba nhluvuko eka ku simekiwa ka tiphurogireme ta mfumo ku antswisa vutomi bya MaAfrika-Dzonga, ngopfungopfu miganga leyi khale a yi pfumatiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukukhishwa koCwaningo Lwamakhaya Olujwayelekile lowezi-2016, oluqhubekayo nokukhombisa inqubekelaphambili ekuqalisweni ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ukwenza ngcono izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi imiphakathi eyayikhishwe inyumbazana phambilini.

src: Tinhlayohlayo ti kombisa leswaku mfumo wu le ku pfuneni eku nyikeni ka tindlu, ku ri na mindyangu ya MaAfrika-Dzonga lawa ya tshamaka eka vutshamo bya ‘RDP’ kumbe bya xipfuno xa mfumo leyi nga le ku tlakukeni ku suka eka 5% hi 2002 ku fika eka 13,5% hi 2016.
tgt: Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni unamagalelo amahle ekuhlinzekeni ngezindlu, nalapho amakhaya abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlala ezindlini ezazakhiwe ngoHlelo Lwentuthuko Nokwakha Kabusha (i-RDP) noma ezindaweni zokuhlala ezixhaswe nguhulumeni ekhuphukile kusuka ku-5% ngowezi-2002 kuya ku-13,5% ngowezi-2016.Ucwaningo luphinde lukhombise ukuthi izinhlelo zikahulumeni zosizo lwezenhlalakahle zikhombisa ukukhuphuka kusuka ku-12,7% ngowezi-2003 kuya ku-29,7% ngowezi-2016.Kunokukhuphuka okuphawulekayo esibalweni samakhaya afakelwe amanzi, axhunyelwa ugesi nathola izinsizakalo zokuthuthwa kwemfucuza, nokuwuphawu olusemqoka logqozi nofuqufuqu lukaHulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika lokulungisa izinto ezimbi zobandlululo bese ehlinzeka ngezidingo-ngqangi kubo bonke abantu.

src: Mbalango wu tlhela wu komba leswaku tiphurogireme ta mpfuno wa vanhu ta mfumo ti komba ku tlakuka ku suka eka 12,7% hi 2003 ku fika eka 29,7% hi 2016.Ku tlhela ku va na ku tlakuka loku vonakaka eka mfikelelo wa mati, gezi na nkululo, leswi ku nga xikombo xa nkoka xa ku navela ka Mfumo wa Afrika-Dzonga ku lulamisa swihoxo swa xihlawuhlawu na ku nyika vukorhokeri bya masungulo eka vanhu hinkwavo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, nakuba kunjalo, ikuqaphelile ukuthi yize isibalo sabantu ababhalisela imfundo ephakeme sikhuphukile, nakuba sikhuphuka ngonyawo lonwabu, abantu abamnyama abangu-3,3% kuphela abaneminyaka ephakathi kweyi-18 kuya kuma-29 ubudala abafundayo uma kuqhathaniswa no-18,8% wabantu abangamaNdiya/abase-Asia kanye no-17,5% wabantu abamhlophe abakuleli qoqo leminyaka.

src: Hambiswiritano, Khabinete yi lemukile leswaku loko ku titsarisa eka dyondzo ya le henhla ku ri eku tlakukeni, hambileswi ku nonokaka, ntsena 3,3% wa vantima va Afrika va vukhale bya 18 ku fika 29 wa malembe a va ri ku dyondzeni loko va pimanisiwa na vanhu 18,8% ya Ma-India/Ma-Asia na 17, 5% ya valungu eka ntlawa lowu wa vukhale.
tgt: Ngu-3,5% kuphela wabantu abangamakhaladi obufunda ngonyaka wezi-2016.Ucwaningo luphinde lwakhombisa ukwehla kusuka ku-23,8% kuya ku-11,8% wamakhaya abhekene nendlala, okukhombisa inqubekelaphambili ekubhekaneni nemiphakathi ephila nobubha obuseqophelweni eliphezulu.

src: Khabinete yi lemukile Mbalango wa Vanhu lava ringaneleke ku Tirha wa Kotara wa kotara yo sungula ya lembe lowu kombiseke ikhonomi yi engetela 144 000 wa mitirho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluqaphelile Ucwaningo Lwamakota Lwezabasebenzi lekota yokuqala yonyaka olukhombise umnotho wengeza imisebenzi eyizi-144 000.

src: Nhlayo leyi yi ringananisiwile hi ku tlakuka ka nhlayo ya valavi va mitirho hi vanhu va 433 000.Khabinete tiyisisa nakambe ku tiboha ka yona ku ya emahlweni yi tirhisana na xiyenge xo ka xi nga ri xa mfumo na vatirhi eku ringeteni ka yona ku lulamisa mitlhontlho ya vupfumalantirho etikweni.
tgt: Lezi zibalo zicekelwe phansi ukukhuphuka esibalweni sabantu abafuna umsebenzi ngabantu abayizi-433 000.IKhabhinethi iyasiqinisekisa isibophezelo sayo sokuqhubeka nokusebenzisana nomkhakha ozimele kanye nabasebenzi emizamweni yayo yokubhekana nezinselele zokungabibikho komsebenzi ezweni.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka ku pfuxetiwa ka Ndhawu ya Vumakelo ya Babelegi eHammanskraal tanihi xiphemu xa makungu ya mfumo ku hatlisisa nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho eka ndhawu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukwethulwa kweBabelegi Industrial Park eHammanskraal njengengxenye yamacebo kahulumeni okudlondlobalisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho kanye nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi kule ndawo.

src: Phurojeke ya R42-wa timiliyoni i xiphemu xa mfumo xa Mpfuxo wa Phurogireme ya Tindhawu ta Vumakelo na yin'we ya tiphaka ta tsevu leti nga le ku pfuxetiweni etikweni hinkwaro eka ikhonomi yo angarhela na nhluvukiso wa vumakelo.
tgt: Lo mklamo obize izigidi ezingama-42 zamarandi uyingxenye yoHlelo lukahulumeni Lokuvuselela Izizinda Zezimboni kanti futhi ungenye yezizinda eziyisithupha ezivuseleliwe ezweni lonkana ukuze kuthuthukiswe kabanzi umnotho kanye nezimboni.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vumaki na mabindzu ya laha kaya ku tekela enhlokweni ku ndlandlamuxa matirhelo ku ya eka tindhawu ta vumakelo ku fikelela tindlela ta nseketelo to hambanahambana leti nga kona ku yisa emahlweni nhluvuko wa mabindzu ya vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igqugquzela izimboni zalapha ngaphakathi ezweni kanye nabamabhizinisi ukuba bacabangele ukuvula amagatsha amabhizinisi wabo ezizindeni zezimboni ukuze bathole izindlela zokwesekwa ezinhlobonhlobo ezitholakalayo ukuze bathuthukise amabhizinisi abo ngokuthe xaxa.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Holobye wa Timali, Tat Malusi Gigaba, hi tinhlayo ta Swimakiwa Hinkwaswo swa Tiko swa Afrika-Dzonga (GDP) ta sweswi, leswi yeke ehansi hi 0,7% eka kotara yo sungula ya 2017.Mbuyelo lowu wo tika wa GDP eka lowu a wu languteriwile wu le hansi swinene ku tlula Nxopaxopo wa Mpimanyeto wa 2017, lowu bvumbeke GDP ya 2017 ku va yi ta kula hi 1,3%.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilunywe indlebe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, uMnu Malusi Gigaba, maqondana nezibalo zakamuva Zesamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe(i-GDP) waseNingizimu Afrika, ezinciphe ngo-0,7% ekoteni yokuqala yowezi-2017.Lo mphumela we-GDP omubi kunalokho obekulindelwe ungaphansi kakhulu kuneSibuyekezo Sesabelomali sowezi-2017, esaqagula ukukhula kwe-GDP yowezi-2017 sakubeka ku-1,3%.

src: Leswi swi vangiwile eka swin'wana swilo hi ku hunguteka ka vumaki, bindzu, ku lulamisa swakudya na tifeme ta vutshamo.
tgt: Lokhu kubangelwe, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukukhwantabala kwezimboni zemikhiqizo, ukuhweba, ukupheka kanye nezindawo zokulala.

src: Hambiswiritano ikhonomi yi seketeriwile hi ku kula ka migodi na feme yo cela leswi tlakukeke hi 12.8%.
tgt: Umnotho nakuba kunjalo wesekwe ukukhula embonini yezimayini kanye neyokuqwalwa kwamatshe ekhuphuke ngo-12.8%.

src: Feme ya vurimi, swihlahla na swa tinhlampfi swi vuyele ematshan'weni eka kotara yo sungula ya 2017 ku ri na ku tlakuka ka 22,2%.Ku na mifungho ya ku vuyelela ka ikhonomi leyi tiko ri nga ku kucetelaka ku antswisa xiyimo xa ku kula ka ikhonomi ya rona n'winyi.
tgt: Imboni yezolimo, ezamahlathi kanye nezezinhlanzi isimamile ekoteni lokuqala lowezi-2017 ngokukhuphuka ngo-22,2%.Kunenhlansi yethemba elokozayo izwe elingabambelela kuyona ukuze lisimamise ukububeka kokukhula komnotho walo.

src: Leswi swi katsa ku antswisa ku kula ka matiko hinkwawo, ku tshamisekisa mixavo ya swixavisiwa, swiyimo swa maxelo ya kahle swinene, mphakelo wa gezi lowu tshembekeke na ku cinca hi ku olova ka le hansi ka vuxaka bya vathori na vathoriwa.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya ukwenza ngcono ukukhula emhlabeni wonke, ukuzinzisa amanani ezimbiwa, izimo zesimo sezulu ezivunayo, ukuphakelwa kukagesi okwethembekile kanye nokwehla kobudlelwano nabasebenzi obuntekenteke.

src: Tanihimhaka ya xihatla, Khabinete yi rhamba van’wamabindzu, vatirhi na vanhu hi ku angarhela ku tirhisana na mfumo ku tikisa phurogireme ya ku kula ya hina na ku antswisa ntshembho leswaku ku ta yimisiwa ku ya ehansi na ku veka ikhonomi eka ndlela ya le henhla, ku fikelela ku kula ka ikhonomi ko katsa hinkwaswo.
tgt: Njengesimo esiphuthumayo kakhulu, iKhabhinethi inxusa abamabhizinisi, abasebenzi kanye nomphakathi ngobubanzi ukuba babambisane nohulumeni ukuze kuqiniswe uhlelo lwethu lokukhula komnotho futhi kwenziwe ngcono nokuzethemba ukuze kunqandwe ukwehla komnotho futhi kubekwe umnotho esikhundleni esiphezulu, ukuze kufezekiswe ukukhula komnotho okuhlanganisa zonke izinto.

src: Eka mhaka leyi Holobye wa Timali u ta hlangana na varhangeri va mabindzu eka matshalatshala yo vumba maqhinga yo sirhelela ku kayakaya ka ikhonomi na ku fikelela ku kula ko katsa hinkwaswo.
tgt: Maqondana nalokhu uNgqongqoshe Wezezimali uzohlangana nabaholi bamabhizinisi embhidlangweni wokusungula amaqhinga azophikisana nokuzika komnotho bese efezekisa ukukhula komnotho okuhlanganisa zonke izinto.

src: Khabinete yi seketele nhlengeletano ya vateki va mahungu yo helela hi Holobye wa Timali ku avelana na MaAfrika-Dzonga ku nghenelela loku mfumo wu nga ta ku sungula eka rimba ra mpimanyeto wa sweswi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze isithangami sabezindaba esigcwele esizobanjwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali ukuze abelane nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngezinyathelo zokungenelela uhulumeni azozithatha kulolu hlaka lokusebenza lesabelomali samanje.

src: Khabinete yi yisa emahlweni yi tiyisisa nakambe rimba ra mpimanyeto lowu amukeriweke wa tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqinisekisa uhlaka lokusebenza lwesabelomali sezwe olwamukeliwe.

src: Tikhamphani to pima swikweleti ta Fitch na Standard & Poor ti tiyisile mipimo ya xikweleti xa mali ya matikomambe ya nkarhi wo leha ya ‘BB+’.Leswi swi ta exikarhi ka ku nghenelela ka Holobye Gigaba na xiyenge xo ka xi nga ri xa mfumo ku tiyisisa leswaku ntirho wo hlanganela wa mfumo, bindzu, vatirhi na vanhu va tiko wu ya emahlweni, na leswaku switshembhiso leswi endliweke swa hetisisiwa.
tgt: Izikhungo zokuklelisa iFitch kanye ne-Standard & Poor’s zikuqinisekisile ukukleliswa kwezikweletu kweNingizimu Afrika ngemali yakwamanye amazwe kwesikhathi eside ngo-‘BB+’.Lokhu kuqhamuka phakathi nezingxoxo uNgqongqoshe uGigaba azibambe nomkhakha ozimele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi owenziwa ngokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abamabhizinisi, abasebenzi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi uyaqhubeka, kanye nokuthi izethembiso ezenziwe ziyafezwa.

src: Khabinete yi vula nakambe leswaku MaAfrika-Dzonga ya fanele ku ya emahlweni ya tirha hi ku twanana, ngopfungopfu hi mikarhi yo tika na ku tirha hi matimba ku tiyisisa leswaku tiko ri vuyisela xiyimo xa giredi ya vuvekisi bya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugcizelela ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kufanele baqhubeke nokukhuluma ngezwi elilodwa, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi ezinzima futhi basebenza kanzima impela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe libuyelwa yizinga lalo lesimo sotshalomali.

src: Khabinete yi amukela mivulavurisano eku pfuriweni ka Komiti ya Vulawuri bya Nhlanganelo ya Makete wo Fana wa Dzonga (MERCOSUR) na Nhlangano wa Mindzuvo wa le Dzongeni wa Afrika (SACU) leyi ya ha ku va kona etikweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela izingxoxo ezenziwe eKomidini lokuqala ngqa Lokuphathwa Ngokubambisana leNhlangano Elawula Izindaba Zentela Nohwebo Yamazwe AseMelika Eseningizimu (i-MERCOSUR) kanye neNhlangano Elawula Izindaba Zentela Yempahla Okuhwebelwana Ngayo Emazweni aseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SACU) ebezibanjwe kamuva nje kuleli.

src: Mihlangano yi twananile ku hlangana ku tekela enhlokweni mikateko yo tlakusa MERCOSUR-SACU Ntwanano wa Bindzu leri Rhandziwaka (PTA) hi ku katsa na vuyimeri bya ntlakuso wa bindzu ra vona, Mihlangano ya ndhawu leyi sirhelelaka ku navela ka van'wamabindzu, xiyenge xo ka xi nga ri xa mfumo, na tindlu ta vuyimeri bya vona venyi na matirhelo ya matikomambe.
tgt: Izinhlangano zivumile ukucabanga ngokubambisana ngamathuba okukhuthaza Isivumelwano Sohwebo Olukhethayo (i-PTA) se-MERCOSUR ne-SACU ngokubandakanya izikhungo zazo zokukhuthaza ezohwebo, izigcawu zohwebo, umkhakha ozimele, kanye nezindlu zazo zamanxusa ngokwehlukana.

src: Ntwanano wa MERCOSUR-SACU wu nyika varhumeri va le matikwenimambe va laha kaya nkateko ku nghena eka makete wa vanhu vo tlula 280-wa timiliyoni.
tgt: Isivumelwano se-MERCOSUR kanye ne-SACU sihlinzeka abahwebi balapha ekhaya abahwebela kwamanye amazwe ngethuba lokuhweba namazwe anabantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-280.IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abahwebi bakuleli abahwebela kwamanye amazwe ukuba benze i-PTA ibasebenzele njengoba imikhiqizo yalapha ekhaya isikwazi ukudayiswa emazweni angamalunga e-MERCOSUR futhi bakhokhe intela yokuhwebelana enesephulelo.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba varhumeri va le matikwenimambe hinkwavo va laha tikweni ku teka xipfuni xa PTA tanihileswi swimakiwa swa laha kaya sweswi swi kotaka ku nghena eka matiko lawa ya nga eka Nhlangano wa Yuropa MERCOSUR hi mipimo ya mindzuvo leyi rhandziwaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukudabuka ngesinqumo se-United States of America (i-USA) sokuhoxa kwiSivumelwano saseParis.

src: Ntwanano wa Paris, lowu nga ta sungula ku tirha hi ku hetiseka hi 2020, wu tiyisisiwile hi ku nghenisa xandla loku langiweke hi matiko hi woxe ku ya eka swikongomelo swa matiko hinkwawo leswi ku twananiweke haswona hi ku hlanganela.
tgt: Isivumelwano saseParis, esizosebenza ngokugcwele ngowezi-2020, sakhelwe phezu kwezinkokhelo ezinqunywe yiwona amazwe uqobo maqondana nezinjongo zamazwe omhlaba okuvunyelwene ngazo ndawonye.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri komberile USA ku tlherisela endzhaku xiyimo xa rona ku tiboha nakambe eka endlelo ra swiphemunyingi.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isinxuse i-USA ukuba isicabangisise kabusha isinqumo sayo iphinde izibophezele kabusha kulesi sivumelwano samazwe omhlaba.

src: Memorandamu ya Ntwanano exikarhi ka Novartis, Huvo ya Ndzavisiso wa swa Vutshunguri ya Afrika-Dzonga na Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji, yi pfula ndlela ku antswisa vukulu na nkoka wa miringeto ya tlilinikhali na ku aka vuswikoti bya ndzavisiso eka tikonkulu.
tgt: Isivumelwano Sokusebenzisana phakathi kwe-Novartis, Umkhandlu Wezocwaningo Lwezokwelapha waseNingizimu Afrika kanye noMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe, sichaba indlela yokusimamisa umthamo kanye nekhwalithi yezivivinyo zokwelapha futhi sakha amandla okwenziwa kocwaningo ezwenikazi.

src: Ntwanano wu ta pfumelela tiphurogireme ta Ndzavisiso wo hlanganela eka mavabyi lawa ya hlawuriweke yo ka ya nga tluleli na yo tlulela, swi antswisa mfikelelo wa vavabyi va Afrika-Dzonga eka mirhi yintshwa, na ku aka vuswikoti bya nhluvukiso na ndzavisiso wa tiko na wa tikonkulu.
tgt: Isivumelwano sizovumela ukwenzeka kwezinhlelo zocwaningo ngokubambisana ezifweni eziqokiwe ezithathelwanayo kanye nezingathathelwana, ukwenza ngcono ukufinyelela kweziguli zaseNingizimu Afrika emithini eqanjwe kabusha, kanye nokwakha amandla ezwe kanye nezwekazi okwenza ucwaningo kanye nokuthuthukisa.

src: Khabinete yi tshemba leswaku ku na ndlela ya vutirhisano byo ka byi nga ri bya mfumo na bya mfumo, naswona yi khorwisiwile leswaku leswi swi nga rhangela ndlela eku lulamiseni mitlhontlho yo tala yo tika leyi hi hlanganaka na yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakholwa ukuthi isekhona indawo yokusebenza ngokubambisana okuthe xaxa phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nomkhakha ozimele, futhi iyafunga iyagomela ukuthi lokhu kungachaba indlela ebheke ekubhekaneni nezinselele eziningi eziyinkinga esibhekene nazo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Xiviko xa 2017 ku suka eka Nhlengeletano ya Misava hinkwayo na Nhlangano wa Ntwanano, lowu yaka emahlweni wu pima Afrika-Dzonga tanihi ndhawu ya mikhuvo ya bindzu ya le henhla eAfrika na le Middle East.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamukela Umbiko wezi-2017 ovela Enhlanganweni Yenkongolo kanye Nemibuthano Yomhlaba, oqhubekayo nokuklelisa iNingizimu Afrika njengendawo eseqhulwini yokubamba imicimbi yamabhizinisi e-Afrika kanye naseMiddle East.

src: Xiviko xi humesiwile hi Mudyaxihi 2017 eFrankfurt, Germany.
tgt: Umbiko ukhishwe ngoNhlaba 2017 eFrankfurt, eGermany.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri tshama ri ri rin'we ra tindhawu ta vapfhumba leri tivekaka ngopfu emisaveni na ku ya emahlweni ri rhanga eka mipimo na le ka xikombo xa vuswikoti bya vupfhumba na ku endza ka matiko hinkwawo ka Foramu yo Endza ya Ikhonomi ya Misava hilaha yi humesiweke hakona hi Dzivamisoko 2017.Khabinete yi navela ku vona malokixi na madoroba lamatsongo yo tala ya Afrika-Dzonga ya kombela tinhlengeletano letitsongo laha ya nga ta fikelela swilaveko swo rhurhela.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isalokhu ingenye yezindawo ezihamba phambili emhlabeni ngokuthandwa ngabavakashi futhi iyaqhubeka nokubekwa endaweni ephezulu kwinkomba yokuncintisana kwezokuvakasha emhlabeni jikelele yeSithangamu Somhlaba Sezomnotho (i-WEF) njengoba ikhishwe ngoMbasa 2017.IKhabhinethi ingathanda ukubona amadolobhana amancane kanye namakhulu amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika efaka izicelo zokusingatha imihlangano emincane lapho ezokwazi khona ukuhlangabezana nezimfuno zokusingatha.

src: Leswi swi ta pfuna ku antswisa ku hangalaka ka vupfhumba hi ku ya hi ndhawu ku hundza eka tisenthara letikulu na ku hangalasa rifumo leri endliweke hi mikhuvo leyi hi ku ringana swinene.
tgt: Lokhu kuzosiza ukwenza ngcono ukusabalaliseka kwezokuvakasha ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene ezingale kwamadolobha amakhulu futhi kusabalalise nomnotho okhandwe yileyo micimbi ngokulinganayo.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga ku va na vukheta byo vona mahungu ya vuxisi, ngopfungopfu ku tlakuka ka ku ku rhumeriwa ka mahungu ya vuxisi eka swiyenge swa mabulu ya ku lahleka, ku tlhakisa na ku ngungumerisa vanhwanyana na vamanana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqaphele izindaba mbumbulu, ikakhulukazi ukukhuphuka kwezindaba ezingelona iqiniso ezibhalwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana mayelana nokulahleka, ukuthunjwa kanye nokuthwalwa ngenkani kwamantombazane kanye nabantu besifazane.

src: Ntungu wa madzolonga lowu wa ha ku va ka kona eKwaMashu, kusuhi na le Durban hikwalaho ka swiviko swa vuxisi swa ku va vana va tlhakisiwile eka ndhawu na ku kumbeteriwa ka ku ngungumerisiwa ka nhwanyana eNaledi, Soweto hi vanhu lava a va ri eka thekisi ya Toyota Quantum ku katsiwile na nomboro ya ntsariso swi vangile hoyihoyi eka swiyenge swa mabulu, leswi endzhaku swi kumeka swi nga ri ntiyiso.
tgt: Ukubheduka kodlame kwakamuva KwaMashu, eduze kwase-Durban mayelana nemibiko yezingane ezithwalwe ngenkani endaweni kanye nezinsolo zokuthwalwa ngenkani kwentombazane eNaledi, eSoweto ngabantu abebehamba ngemoto eyi-Toyota Quantum nezinombolo zayo ezazifakiwe kuthe chithi saka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, nokuthe ekuhambeni kwesikhathi kwatholakala ukuthi bekungelona iqiniso.

src: Vuxisi lebyi, mahungu ya vuxisi na ku hangalasiwa ka mahungu yo ka ya nga ri ntiyiso swi vanga ku chava eka miganga ya hina na ku tlangisa nkarhi na switirhisiwa swa maphorisa.
tgt: Lobu buqola, izindaba mbumbulu kanye nokusatshalaliswa kolwazi olungelona iqiniso kudala itwetwe emiphakathini yethu futhi kuchitha isikhathi kanye nezinsizakusebenza zamaphoyisa.

src: Hi kombela vanhu ku va va rhumeli nakambe na ku hangalasa mahungu ya vuxisi eka swiyenge swa mabulu, ku fikela loko va tiyisisile ntiyiso wa wona.
tgt: Siyacela kubantu ukuba bangadlulisi futhi basabalalise izindaba mbumbulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kuze kube sebekuqinisekisile ubuqiniso bazo.

src: Khabinete yi lemukile hi ku vilela swinene swiviko swa vuhangalasi bya mahungu eka ‘tiimeyili leti pfuteke’ leti kumbeteriwaka ku khumbheka ka Vaholobye, vatirhi na mabindzu yo ka ya nga ri ya mfumo eka ku kumbetela ku endla swo homboloka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiyiqaphelile ngokukhathazeka okukhulu imibiko yabezindaba maqondana ‘nokuputshuka kwama-imeyili’ okubikwa ukuthi achaya oNgqongqoshe, izikhulu kanye nabantu abazimele ezenzweni ezingalungile.

src: Khabinete yi tshama yi tibohile hi ku hetiseka eka mafumele lamanene naswona hinkarhi lowu fanaka, yi tlhela yi lemuka leswaku vanhu hinkwavo va tekiwa va nga ri na nandzu ku fikela loko va tiyisisiwa ku va na nandzu hi ku ya hi Vumbiwa ra hina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isazibophezele ngokugcwele ekuphatheni okuhle ngaso sonke isikhathi, iyakuqaphela futhi ukuthi bonke abantu bathathwa njengabamsulwa kuze kube batholwa benecala ngokoMthethosisekelo.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza hinkwavo lava nga na mahungu ya mayelana na ku endla swo homboloka kwihi na kwihi hi vatirhi va mfumo kumbe Vaholobye ku tivisa vuyimeri byo sindzisa nawu leswaku ku ta endliwa vulavisisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abanolwazi mayelana nezenzo ezingalungile ezenziwa yizikhulu zikahulumeni noma oNgqongqoshe ukuba bazise izikhungo zengalo yomthetho ukuze kuzokwenziwa uphenyo.

src: Ya swi tiva leswaku milandzu yin'wana se yi pfuriwile, naswona maphorisa ya le ku endleni ka vulavisisi lebyi faneleke.
tgt: Iyazi ukuthi kukhona amacala asevuliwe kakade, kanti amaphoyisa enza uphenyo olufanelekile.

src: Hinkwavo lava khumbiwaka hi tiimeyili va khutaziwa ku tirhisana na vuyimeri byo sindzisa nawu.
tgt: Bonke abathintekayo kula ma-imeyili bayanxuswa ukuba basebenzisane nezikhungo zengalo yomthetho.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u arile ku kumbeteriwa loku kandziyisiweke eka phephahungu ra Sonto leswaku u na yindlu eDubai eUnited Arab Emirates.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzichithile izinsolo ebezishicilelwe yiphephandaba langeSonto zokuthi uthenge indlu eDubai e-United Arab Emirates.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi swiviko swa matirhele ya nhluvuko swa kotara ya vu 4 ya 2016/17 (Sunguti-Nyenyankulu 2017) eka masimekelo ya mivuyelo ya swirhangana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ichazeliwe ngemibiko yenqubekelaphambili yomsebenzi owenziwe ngekota yesine yezi-2016/17 (ukusuka kuMasingana ukuya kuNdasa 2017) maqondana nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kwemiphumela eseqhulwini.

src: Vulanguteri bya Khabinete eka masimekelo ya Rimba ra swa Maqhinga ra Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi wa 2014 ku fika hi 2019, swi vanga ku antswisiwa ka mphakelo wa vukorhokeri.
tgt: Ukwengamela kweKhabhinethi maqondana nokuqaliswa ukusebenza koHlaka Lokusebenza Kwesikhathi Esimaphakathi lowezi-2014 kuya kowezi-2019, kuholele ekuhanjisweni kwezidingo-ngqangi okwenziwe ngcono.

src: Leswi swi hi tshineta ekusuhi na ku fikelela Xivono xa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka (NDP) xa 2030.Mfumo wu endlile nhluvuko lowukulu eku simekiweni ka mivuyelo ya swirhangana ya 14 na ku yisa emahlweni swikongomelo swa NDMitlhontlho leyi khumbhaka ku simekiwa na nghingiriko lowu lavekaka ku antswisa mphakelo na yona yi tlhele yi langutisiwa.
tgt: Lokhu kusithatha kusisondeze eduzane nokufezekiswa koMbono wezi-2030 woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).Uhulumeni usenze inqubekelaphambili ebonakalayo ekuqaliseni ukusebenza kwemiphumela yakhe eyi-14 eseqhulwini kanye nokuthuthukisa izinjongo ze-NDIzinselele ezithikameza ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukwenza ngcono ukuhanjiswa kwezidingqo-ngqangi nazo zahlonzwa.

src: GCIS yi hlanganisa tinhlengeletano ta ntlawa wa tinhlengeletano ta vuhangalasi bya mahungu, leswi languteriweke ku va kona ku suka hi ti 9 ku fika ti 18 Khotavuxika 2017.
tgt: Uphiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokudluliswa Kolwazi (i-GCIS) ludidiyela izithangami zabezindaba zamaqoqo eminyango, ezihlelelwe ukubanjwa kusukela mhla ziyi-9 kuya mhla ziyi-18 Nhlangulana 2017.

src: Xedulu leyi antswisiweke yi ta nghenisiwa eka WEBTOKEMitlangu leyi ta ka.
tgt: Uhlu olunemininingwane ngezikhathi nokunye okubalulekile luzofakwa WEBTOKEImicimbi ezayo.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u simekile N'hweti ya Vantshwa ehansi ka nkongomelo lowu nge “Lembe ra OR Tambo: Ku Antswisa ku Nyika matimba eka Ikhonomi ya Vantshwa”, na nhlengeletano ya Ntlawa wo Tirha wa Vantshwa wa Phuresidente.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma wethule Inyanga Yentsha ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Unyaka ka-OR Tambo: Siqhubekisela Phambili Ukubandakanywa Kwentsha Kwezomnotho”, ngomhlangano weQembu likaMongameli Lezindaba Zentsha.

src: Leswi swi hlanganisile mfumo na varhangeri va mihlangano ya vantshwa, lava langutiseke hi vukheta nhluvuko wa ku antswisa ka ikhonomi ya vantshwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlanganise ndawonye uhulumeni kanye nabaholi bezinhlangano zentsha, abayiqaphelile inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe ekuthuthukisweni kwenhlalo-mnotho yabantu abasha.

src: Vaholobye na Swandla swa Vaholobye va ta nghenelela eka migingiriko yo hambanahambana leyi kongomisiweke eka ku tlakusa nhluvukiso na ku nyika matimba eka vantshwa.
tgt: ONgqongqoshe kanye namaPhini oNgqongqoshe bazozibandakanya emisebenzini enhlobonhlobo ehlose ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwentsha kanye nokunikezwa kwayo amandla.

src: Ntirho wo tlangela Siku ra Vantshwa ra Rixaka wu ta va kona eVentersdorp, eN’walungu-Vupeladyambu hi ti 16 Khotavuxika 2017.Lembe leri ri fungha nkhuvo wo heta rin'wana lembe ra vu 41 ra Soweto Uprising naswona ku tlangela ku tirha tanihi xitsundzuxo xa leswaku vantshwa etikweni a va ri emahlweni eka Nyimpi ya hina.
tgt: Umcimbi wokubungazwa koSuku Lwentsha Lukazwelonke uzobanjelwa eVentersdorp, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga mhla ziyi-16 Nhlangulana 2017.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vantshwa hinkwavo ku nghenelela eka migingiriko ya Siku ra Vantshwa na ku tirhisa nseketelo na switirhisiwa hinkwaswo leswi mfumo wu endleke swi va kona ku antswisa swivono swa vona na ku antswisa ku nghenelela ka vona eka ikhonomi.
tgt: Lo nyaka uphawula ukugujwa kweminyaka engama-41 Wezibhelu zaseSoweto kanti umgubho wesikhumbuzo usebenza njengesikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu abasha kuleli zwe babesophondweni loMzabalazo wethu.

src: Nhlengeletano ya vantshwa ya mfumo wa mugangaHolobye wa Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu, Tat Des van Rooyen, u ta lulamisa Nhlengeletano ya Mfumo wa Muganga ku suka hi ti 19 ku fika hi ti 22 Khotavuxika 2017, ehansi ka nkongomelo lowu nge “Vantshwa va teka vulawuri bya nhluvukiso”.
tgt: Ingqungquthela yentsha yohulumeni basekhayaUNgqongqoshe Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana kanye Nezendabuko, uMnu Des van Rooyen, uzohlanganisa Ingqungquthela Yohulumeni Basekhaya kusukela mhla ziyi-19 kuya mhla zingama-22 Nhlangulana 2017, ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Abantu abasha bazibambela mathupha entuthukweni”.Ingqungquthela izokwethula Isigcawu Sokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha Sohulumeni Basekhaya.

src: Nhlengeletano yi ta simeka Foramu ya Nhluvukiso wa Vantshwa wa Mfumo ya Muganga.
tgt: Lokhu kuzovumela abantu abasha ukuba babuyekeze inqubekelaphambili yohulumeni basekhaya beyiqhathanisa nokufezekiswa kweNqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yentsha yezi-2020.

src: Leswi swi ta kotisa vantshwa ku xopaxopa nhluvuko wa mfumo wa muganga eka ku humelela ka Pholisi ya Vantshwa ya Rixaka 2020.
tgt: Izophinda futhi iqinise amaxhama okubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abamabhizinisi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi ekuthuthukiseni abaholi abasebasha kuhulumeni wasekhaya.

src: Swi ta tiyisa vutirhisano exikarhi ka mfumo, bindzu na vanhu va tiko eku hluvukiseni ka varhangeri va vantshwa eka ndhawu ya laha kaya.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo, uNks Faith Muthambi, uzohola ithimba lezithunywa zaseNingizimu Afrika elizohambela umcimbi woSuku Lwemisebenzi Kahulumeni e-Afrika ozobanjelwa eKigali, eRwanda kusukela mhla zingama-21 kuya mhla zingama-23 Nhlangulana 2017.Indikimba yalo nyaka ithi: “Ukugxilisa Kuhlelo Lokuhanjiswa Kwezidingo-ngqangi Olugxile Kwizakhamuzi: Sibambisene Nentsha ukuze Kuguqulwe i-Afrika.” Le ndikimba inikezela ngamathuba okuhlolisisa maqondana nokuthi Uhulumeni uluchaza futhi asabele kanjani ohlelweni lokuhanjiswa kwezidingo-ngqangi olugxile kwizakhamuzi oluchazwa yindlela izinto ezenziwa ngayo njengamanje.

src: Ku chavelela.
tgt: Amazwi endunduzo.

src: Khabinete yi hundzisela ku chavelela ka yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va mukhandziyi loyi a loveke loko switimela swimbirhi swa Metrorail swi chayisana hi le mahlweni ekusuhi na xitichi xa le Elandsfontein Ekurhuleni na ku navela leswaku lava va vavisekeke eka nghozi va hola hi ku hatlisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi ayo enduduzo emndenini kanye nakubangani bomgibeli oshone ngenkathi kungqubuzana izitimela ezimbili zakwaMetrorail eduzane nesiteshi i-Elandsfontein esise-Ekurhuleni futhi ifisela labo abalimale kule ngozi ukululama okusheshayo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela ku lavisisiwa ka xivangelo xa nghozi ku va ku hatlisisiwa ku sivela ku humelela nakambe ka tinghozi toleto to herisa vutomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ukuba uphenyo lwembangela yale ngozi lusheshiswe kakhulu ukuvimbela ukuphindaphindeka kwalezi zingozi ezibulala abantu.

src: Khabinete yi hlangana na matiko hinkwawo ya misava eka ku sola swinene ku hlasela ka vutherorisi loku ka ha ku va ka kona eUnited Kingdom (UK).
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengamazwe omhlaba ikugxeka ngokuqinile ukuhlasela kwakamuva kwabashokobezi e-United Kingdom (i-UK).

src: Ku hlasela, loku veke kona hi vusiku bya ti3 Khotavuxika 2017 eDorobeni ra London, ku koxile vutomi bya vanhu va nga ri vangani na ku siya van'wana va vavisekile.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlasela, okwenzeke ebusuku bomhla zi-3 Nhlangulana 2017 eDolobheni laseLondon, kudlule nemiphefumulo yesigejana sabantu kwashiya abanye belimele.

src: Ku hlasela eLondon ku vile kona endzhaku ka mavhiki mambirhi ya ku hlaseriwa ka le Manchester, laha vaakatiko vo tala, ngopfungopfu vantshwa na vana, va lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya vona.
tgt: Ukuhlaselwa kwaseLondon kwenzeke emasontweni amabili ngemuva kwalokho okwenzeka eManchester, lapho inqwaba yabantu, ikakhulukazi intsha kanye nezingane, balahlekelwa izimpilo zabo.

src: Khabinete yi hundzisela ku chavelela ka yona eka mfumo na vanhu va le UK, ngopfungopfu mindyangu na varhandziwa va lava va loveke, na ku navelela lava va vavisekeke ku hola hi ku hatlisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi ayo enduduzo kuhulumeni kanye nabantu base-UK, ikakhulukazi imindeni kanye nezihlobo zalabo abashonile, futhi ifisela abalimele ukululama okusheshayo.

src: Khabinete yi hundzisela ku chavelela ka yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va Phurof Babatunde Osotimehin, loyi a hundzeke emisaveni vhiki leri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi ayo enduduzo emndenini kanye nakubangani bakaSlz Babatunde Osotimehin, odlule emhlabeni kuleli sonto.

src: Phurof Osotimehin a ri Mufambisinkulu wa Nkwama wa Vanhu wa Nhlangano wa Matiko.
tgt: USlz Osotimehin ubenguMqondisi Omkhulu weSikhwama Sabantu Sezizwe Ezihlangene (i-UN).

src: A ri wa nkoka eku fambiseni timhaka ta rihanyo ra swa masangu na swirho swa mbeleko eAfrika eka malembe ya sweswi.
tgt: Ubezihola eqhulwini ekugqugquzeleni izindaba zezempilo yezocansi kanye nokuzala e-Afrika eminyakeni yakamuva nje.

src: U tirhile a nga karhali ku tlakusa rihanyo ra swa masangu na swirho swa mbeleko na timfanelo ta vamanana na vantshwa eAfrika na misava hinkwayo.
tgt: Usebenze ngokuzikhandla engakhathali ukukhuthaza ezempilo yezocansi kanye nokuzala kanye namalungelo abantu besifazane kanye nabantu abasha e-Afrika kanye nasemhlabeni jikelele.

src: U rhangerile hi nkhinkhi eka timfanelo ta Vavasati lava rhandzanaka, Vavanuna lava rhandzanaka, Rimbewumbirhi, Rimbewu leri munhu a nga beburiwangiki na rona, vavanuna lava tsakelaka vavanunakulobye na Timbewu timbirhi to hambana.
tgt: Ukhankase ngomfutho ekhankasela amalungelo Ongqingili, Izitabani, Abantu Abanobulili Obubili, Abantu Abashintshe Ubulili, Abantu Abayinqaba kanye Nabantu Abanobulili Obuxubile.

src: Mabubutsa ya le kapa na mindzilo ya le knysnaKhabinete yi xiyaxiyile mabubutsa lawa ya nga khumbha tindhawu to tala ta le Kapa-Vupeladyambu na ku onhaka loku landzeleke.
tgt: Iziphepho zasekapa kanye nemililo yaseKknysnaIKhabhinethi iziqaphelile iziphepho ezithinte izingxenye eziningi zaseNtshonalanga Kapa kanye nomonakalo owenzeke emva kwalokho.

src: Khabinete yi rhumela ku chavelela ka yona eka mindyangu ya lava va lahlekeriweke hi vutomi na hi nhundzu hi nkarhi lowu wa timhangu nhlayo yo hetelela leyi vikiweke i nhungu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi ayo enduduzo emindenini yalabo abalahlekelwe yizimpilo zabo kanye nempahla yabo ngesikhathi salezi zinhlekelele abantu abashonile ngokwesibalo sakamuva esibikiwe bayisishiyagalombili.

src: Senthara ya Mafambiselo ya Nxungeto wa Mhangu ya le Kapa yi khutaziwa ku endla hilaha yi nga kotaka hakona ku hlayisa vutomi na nhundzu, ku katsa na ndhawu ya le Knysna laha ku nga na malangavi ya ndzilo.
tgt: Isikhungo Sokuphathwa Kwezingozi Zezinhlekelele saseKapa siyakhuthazwa ukuba senze konke okusemandleni aso ukuphephisa izimpilo zabantu kanye nempahla, kubandakanya nendawo yaseKnysna lapho kunemililo yamadlelo esha ubuhanguhangu.

src: Hi rhamba vanhu ku landzelela tindlela ta vuhlayiseki.
tgt: Sinxusa abantu ukuba babambelele ezinyathelweni zokuphepha.

src: Ku hoyozele.
tgt: Siyanihalalisela.

src: Khabinete yi amukela xiboho xa Phuresidente Jacob Zuma ku thola Lieutenant General Lesetja Mothiba tanihi Khomixinara wo Khomela lontshwa wa Maphorisa ya Rixaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamukela isinqumo sikaMongameli uJacob Zuma sokuqoka u-Lieutenant General Lesetja Mothiba njengeBamba elisha likaKhomishana Wamaphoyisa Kazwelonke.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela vatsutsumi na van'wamitlangu va hina ku va va langiwile eka mitlawa ya nhungu ya Masagwadi ya Mitlangu ya Lembe na lembe ya Rhijini ya 2017, leyi a rhurheriwile hi Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela abasubathi bethu kanye nabadlali besilisa nabesifazane ngokuqokwa emikhakheni eyisishiyagalombili Yezindondo Zemidlalo Yesifunda Zonyaka wezi-2017, ebezisingathwe yiNingizimu Afrika.

src: Huvo ya Mitlangu ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Afrika ya Rhijini 5 hi yin'wana ya tirhijini ta ntlhanu leti tshembiweke hi vutihlamuleri byo hluvukisa mitlangu ehansi ka Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Afrika.
tgt: Isifunda 5 Somkhandlu Wezemidlalo Wenhlangano Yezizwe zase-Afrika (i-AU) singesinye sezifunda eziyisihlanu ezethweswe umsebenzi wokuthuthukisa ezemidlalo ngaphansi Kwenhlangano Yezizwe zase-Afrika.

src: Swirho swa rhijini i: Angola, Botswana, Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambiki, Namibia, Afrika-Dzonga, Swaziland, Zambia na Zimbabwe.
tgt: Amalungu esifunda yilawa: Angola, Botswana, Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, Ningizimu Afrika, Swaziland, Zambia neZimbabwe.

src: Wayde van Niekerk u hlurile eka N'wamitlangu wa wanuna wa LembeCaster Semenya u hlurile eka N'wamitlangu wa wansati wa LembeAnna Botha u hlurile eka Mudzaberi wa LembeMamelodi Sundowns yi hlurile eka Xipanu xa Lembe.
tgt: UWayde van Niekerk unqobe Umdlali Wesilisa WonyakaUCaster Semenya unqobe Umdlali Wesifazane WonyakaU-Anna Botha unqobe Umqeqeshi WonyakaIMamelodi Sundowns inqobe Iqembu Lonyaka.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela vanhu va le Lesotho eka mihlawulo yo rhula na ku ya emahlweni yi hoyozela Holobyenkulu loyi a hlawuriweke Tat Thomas Thabane na vandla ra yena eka ku hlula eka mihlawulo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela abantu baseLesotho ngokhetho olunokuthula iphinde futhi ihalalisele uNdunankulu oqokiwe uMnu Thomas Thabane kanye neqembu lakhe ngokunqoba ukhetho.

src: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ya hi ku tiyisisiwa ka mithwaso na ku basisiwa loku faneleke.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikeziwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Mufambisi-Jenerali (DG): Ndzawulo ya Makunguhatelo, Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo wa Matirhelo, Man Nompumelelo Zandile Mpofu.
tgt: Umqondisi-Jikelele (u-DG): Umnyango Wokuhlela, Ukuqapha kanye Nokuhlola, Nks Nompumelelo Zandile Mpofu.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 21 Khotavuxika 2017, eTuynhuys, eDorobeni ra Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-21 kuNhlangulana 2017, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.
tgt: Izindaba ezisematheni.

src: Khabinete yi ehleketile swinene hi ku tivisiwa ka sweswi hi tiejensi to pima swikweleti letikulu tinharhu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifakane imilomo mayelana nezimemezelo zakamuva zezikhungo ezintathu ezinkulu ezenza izilinganiso zeminotho yamazwe omhlaba.

src: Tiejensi to pima swikweleti hinkwato tinharhu ti vurile timhaka to yelana to fana na mpimo wo nonoka wa ku cinca ka ku tlakusa ku kula, matirhelo ya tikhamphani ta vun'winyi bya mfumo, (tiSOC) na mixungeto ya swa tipolotiki, eka timhaka tin'wana.
tgt: Zontathu lezi zikhungo zibalule izinkinga ezifanayo, njengesivinini esiphansi sokulethwa kwezinguquko ezizogqugquzela ukukhula komnotho, ukungasebenzi kahle kwamabhizinisi kahulumeni (ama-SOC) kanye nobungozi bezepolitiki, phakathi kwezinye izinkinga.

src: Khabinete yi kombisile ntshembho eka ku nghenelela ka yona ko pfuna ku lulamisa mitlhontlho ya ikhonomi ya tiko xikan'we na ntirho lowu sunguriweke ku tiyisa matirhelo ya tiSOMfumo wu tshama wu ri endleleni ya kahle eku hlayiseni rimba ra wona ra swa xibalo, ku tiyisisa ntshembho wa pholisi, na ku tirha ku tiyisisa ku kula ko katsa hinkwaswo na cinco wa ikhonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukuzethemba izinhlelo zayo zokungenelela ezisungulwe ngenhloso yokuxazulula izinselelo zomnotho ezibhekene naleli lizwe kanye nomsebenzi owenziwayo ukuqinisa indlela asebenza ngayo ama-SOC.

src: Yi kongomisa eku antswiseni ntshembho wa muvekisi na mutirhisi hi ku hatlisisa nsimeko wa ku lulamisa swivumbeko swa ku kula ka ikhonomi.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu eqhubeke njalo ohlakeni lwakhe lokuphathwa kahle kwezimali, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi alukho ungabazane nokudideka mayelana nezinqubomgomo ezisetshenziswayo, nokusebenzela ukuqinisekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke kanye noguquko lwezomnotho.

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u lulamisile Wekixopo ya Huvo ya Switsundzuxo ya ku Nyika matimba ya Ikhonomi eka Vantima (BEE) hi Ravumbirhi, 20 Khotavuxika 2017, leyi a yi kongomisile eka cinco wa ikhonomi ya vanhu wo hetiseka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela ukuthi kakade sesibekiwe isisekelo somgudu wokukhulisa umnotho ngezinga eliphezulu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho.

src: Wekixopo, eka swin'wana swa swona, yi lulamisile mitlhontlho yo pfuna na swivumbeko swa nsimeko wa Nawu wa BEE Endlelo-angarhelo, 2003 (Nawu wa 53 wa 2003) na ku ringanyeta swibumabumelo ku fikelela swikongomelo swa mfumo eka cinco wa ikhonomi ya vanhu wo hetiseka.
tgt: Lokhu kugxile ekuphuculeni ukwethenjwa komnotho wakuleli ngabatshalizimali kanye nabathengi, ngokuthi kusheshiswe ukuqaliswa kwezinguquko kwindlela asebenza ngayo uhulumeni ukuze kukhuliswe umnotho wezwe.

src: Vutirhisani exikarhi ka mfumo, bindzu, vatirhi na vaakatiko i bya nkoka ku antswisa mpimo wa ntshembho, leswaku ku tirhisana swin'we ku ta vuyisela na ku hlayisa mipimo ya mpimo wa vuvekisi.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma ubize isigcawu sokucobelelana ngolwazi soMkhandlu Wokweluleka Ezindabeni Eziphathelene Nokufukulwa Nokuhlonyiswa Kwabantu Abamnyama Kwezomnotho (i-BEE) esibanjwe ngoLwesibili mhla zingama-20 kuNhlangulana 2017, ebesigxile oguqukweni lwenhlalo-mnotho olunohlonze.

src: Tanihileswi N'hweti ya Vantshwa yi nga kusuhi na ku hela, Khabinete yi khensa tisekithara hinkwato leti ngheneleleke eka migingiriko etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: Lesi sigcawu, sicubungule, phakathi kokunye, izinselelo ezikhona eziphathelene nesimo nokuhleleka kokuqaliswa kokusebenza koMthetho Wokufukulwa Nokuhlonyiswa Kwabantu Abamnyama Kwezomnotho, wezi-2003 (uMthetho wama-53 wezi-2003) kanye nezincomo ezihlongozwayo zokufezekisa izinjongo zikahulumeni mayelana noguquko lwenhlalo-mnotho olunohlonze.

src: Ku nghenelela ka magidigidi ya vantshwa eka migingiriko yo hambanahambana yo nyika matimba eka N'hweti ya Vantshwa leyi a yi rhurheriwile hi tindzawulo, mihlangano ya mfumo na swiyenge swo ka swi nga ri swa mfumo ka khutaziwa.
tgt: Ubambiswano phakathi kukahulumeni, abamabhizinisi, abasebenzi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi wonkana lusemqoka kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwamazinga okwethenjwa komnotho wakuleli, ukuze ngokubambisana sikwazi ukubuyisela umnotho wezwe ezingeni lomnotho okulungele ukutshalwa kwezimali futhi siqhubeke nokuligcina lelo zinga lomnotho.

src: Lembe leri ri fungha lembe ra ku tsundzuka ra vu 41 ra Ku Lwa na mfumo hi Swichudeni swa le Soweto hi 1976 naswona ku tsundzuka ku tirha tanihi xitsundzuxo xa leswaku vantshwa va le tikweni a va rhangile emahlweni eka Nyimpi ya hina.
tgt: Njengoba kungasensuku zatshwala iphele iNyanga Yentsha, iKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi okubonga kuyo yonke imikhakha ebambe iqhaza emicimbini yokugubha le nyanga ezweni lonkana.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vantshwa ku tirhisa nseketelo na switirhisiwa hinkwaswo leswi mfumo wu swi endleke swi kumeka ku antswisa swivono swa vona na ku yisa emahlweni ku nghenelela ka vona eka ikhonomi.
tgt: Kuyinto ethokozisayo futhi ekhuthazayo impela ukuzibandakanya kwezinkulungwane ngezinkulungwane zabantu abasha ezinhlelweni ezahlukahlukene zokufukulwa nokuhlonyiswa kwentsha ebezisingathwe yiminyango nezikhungo zikahulumeni kanye nabomkhakha ozimele.

src: Khabinete yi sola madzolonga na ku chavisiwa ka vakhandziyi leswi swa ha ku va kona hi nkarhi wa ku kombisa ku vilela hi vinyi va mathekisi.
tgt: Lo nyaka uqopha ukuhlangana kweminyaka engama-41 yomBhikisho Wabafundi baseSoweto we-1976 futhi ukugujwa kwalo mbhikisho kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu abasha bakuleli babehamba phambili eMzabalazweni wethu.

src: Ntwanano lowu landzelaka exikarhi ka nhlangano wa Mathekisi wa Afrika-Dzonga na Vandla ra swa Timali ra SA i ku yisa emahlweni ku tiyisisa leswaku n'wangulano wo rhula wu nga lulamisa timhaka toleto handle ko khumbha vanhu lava nga ri ki na nandzu na ku kavanyetiwa ka ikhonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu abasha ukuba balusebenzise ngokugcwele lonke usizo nezinsiza ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni entsheni ukuze benze ngcono amathuba abo okubamba iqhaza kanye nokudlala indima ebonakalayo emnothweni wezwe.

src: Khabinete yi amukela xiboho lexi, leswi swi nga eka ntsakelo wa vakhandziyi na bindzu ra mathekisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazigxeka izenzo zodlame nokwesatshiswa kwabagibeli ezibonakale ngenkathi kuqhubeka imibhikisho yosomatekisi.

src: Khabinete yi amukela n'wangulano lowu nga ku endliweni exikarhi ka Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli na vurhangeri bya bindzu ra mathekisi eku kumeni xintshuxo xa nkarhi wo leha.
tgt: Isivumelwano esenziwe emva kwalokhu, esiphakathi kweNhlangano Kazwelonke Yamatekisi yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nenkampani exhasa ngezimali zokuthenga amatekisi, i-SA Taxi Finance Holdings, siyisiqinisekiso esicacile sokuthi ukuxoxisana nokubonisana ngokuthula kungazixazulula izinkinga ezinjalo, ngaphandle kokukhahlameza abantu abangenacala nokuphazamisa umnotho.

src: Ndzawulo yi ta va yi tihlanganisa na mavandla ya timali ya tindlela tin'wana ku lava ku kuma tindlela tin'wana to hakelela mathekisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isishayela ihlombe impela lesi sinqumo, esihle kakhulu futhi esizohlomulisa abagibeli kanye nemboni yamatekisi.

src: Khabinete yi hundzisela ku marito yo chavelela ya yona eka hinkwavo lava lahlekeriweke hi varhandziwa va vona hi nkarhi wa mhangu ya sweswi ya le Kapa-Vupeladyambu na le Kapa-Vuxa hi ku landzelelana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela izingxoxo eziqhubekayo njengamanje phakathi koMnyango Wezokuthutha kanye nabaholi bemboni yamatekisi okuhloswe ngazo ukuthola isisombululo sesikhathi eside.

src: Vaaki vo talanyana va tlhele va xaniseka hi ku sindzisiwa ku huma na hi ku lahlekeriwa hi nhundzu.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzobonisana nezikhungo ezixhasa ngezimali ngenhloso yokuqhamuka nezinye izindlela ezihlukile ezingasetshenziswa ukuxhasa osomatekisi.

src: Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela endlelo leri ra hlanganelo ro hatlisa na ku hlamula ku suka eka mfumo, bindzu na MaAfrika-Dzonga ya ntolovelo eku pfuneni mindyangu leyi khumbhekeke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi okuzwelana kwayo nabo bonke abashonelwe yizihlobo ezinhlekeleleni zakamuva nje ezenzeke eNtshonalanga Kapa kanye naseMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela ku tinyiketela ka nhenha ya mutimelandzilo, Bradley Richards na muchayeri wa lori John Blaaw loyi a pfuneke vatimelandzilo hi ku tleketla mati lava va hakeleke hi vutomi bya vona va karhi va ponisa muganga wa vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izishayela ihlombe izinyathelo ezisheshayo futhi ezididiyelwe ezithathwe nguhulumeni, abamabhizinisi kanye nabantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokulekelela nokuhlinzeka ngosizo emindenini ekhahlamezekile.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hundzisela ku khensa ko hlawuleka eka xipanu xa ku Tirha hi Ndzilo lexi lweke hi vurhena na mindzilo ya matimba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwathulela isigqoko amaqhawe ashone ngenkathi ezama ukuhlenga umphakathi wawo, okungumcimimlilo oyivolontiya, u-Bradley Richards, kanye nomshayeli weloli u-John Blaaw obelekelela abacimimlilo ngokubathuthela amanzi.

src: Khabinete yi navelela ku hola hi ku hatlisa eka vatimelandzilo vambirhi lava vavisekeke ku katsa na Ian Barnard loyi a vavisekeke loko a ri karhi a ringeta ku ponisa Bradley Richards.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa futhi amazwi akhethekile okubonga ithimba lwe-Working on Fire elilwe ngesibindi esikhulu nemililo yequbula ebibhebhetheka ngamandla asabekayo.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u endzerile miganga ya le Wit Lokasie na le Knysna Heights leyi khumbhekeke hi ndlela yo ka yi nga ri kahle hi mindzilo.
