tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuzwakalisa amazwi okuzwelana kwayo nabantu besifunda sase-Caribbean kanjalo nasezingxenyeni ezithile zase-Cuba kanye nase-United States kulandela umonakalo omkhulu odalwe yisiphepho esinamandla i-Hurricane Irma.

src: Marito yo chavelela ya rhumeriwa eka varhandziwa lava lahlekeriweke hi vutomi na tinhundzu ta vona eka mhangu leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi enduduzo kwizihlobo zalabo abalahlekelwe yizimpilo zabo kanye nempahla yabo kule nhlekelele.

src: Khabinete yi yima na tiko ku hoyozela Kevin Anderson ku va a fikelerile eka tifayinali ta US Open.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo, njengesizwe, ihalalisela u-Kevin Anderson ngokufinyelela kowamanqamu emqhudelwaneni webhola lomphebezo i-US Open.

src: I mutlangi wa Afrika-Dzonga wo sungula ku fikelela tifayinali letikulu eka vunghwazi bya thenisi ku sukela hi 1994.
tgt: Ungumdlali wokuqala ukufinyelela esigabeni sowamanqamu emqhudelwaneni omkhulu webhola lomphebezo kusukela ngowe-1994.

src: Hi na ku tshembha leswaku u ta ya emahlweni na ku humelela na ku hlohlotela lavantshwa na lava nga nyiko laha Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Asithandabuzi nakancane ukuthi uzoqhubeka nokwakhela phezu kwale mpumelelo emangalisayo ayizuzile futhi ngalokho afake ugqozi nofuqufuqu kubantu abasha baseNingizimu Afrika abanamakhono kwezemidlalo.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 27 Ndzati 2017, eUnion Buildings, ePitori.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu mhla zingama-27 kuMandulo 2017 e-Union Buildings, ePitoli.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Nhlengeletano ya Mani na mani ya Vun'we bya Matiko (UNGA).
tgt: Isigungu-Jikelele seNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UNGA).

src: Khabinete yi amukela mbulavulo wa Phuresidente Jacob Zuma eka Ntshamo wa Ntolovelo wa vu 72 wa UNGA eNew York, eAmerika wa ti 12 Ndzati 2017, ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge "Ku kongomisa eka Vanhu: Ku Hitekela ku Rhula na Vutomi byo antswa bya Hinkwavo eka Pulanete leyi nga Hlayiseka.".
tgt: IKhabinethi iyishayele ihlombe inkulumo kaMongameli Jacob Zuma ayethula eMhlanganweni Ojwayelekile wama-72 we-UNGA e-New York, kwelase-USA mhla ziyi-12 kuMandulo 2017, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Sigxila Kubantu: Silwela Ukuthula Nempilo Enhle Kubantu Bonke Emhlabeni Osimeme”.

src: Mikanelo a yi kongome eka swin'wana swakona, Swikongomelo swa Nhluvukiso leswi Tiyeke (SDG) ku cinca ka maxelo, ku rhula na timhaka ta nsirhelelo na ku cinciwa ka UN, ngopfu ngopfu ku cinciwa ka Huvo ya Vusirheleri ya UPhuresidente Zuma u tlhele a sayina Ntwanano wa ku Aleriwa ka Matlharhi ya Nyutliliya, leswi kombisaka ku ya emahlweni kA Afrika-Dzonga ku tinyiketa ka rona ku ya eku fikeleleni ka misava leyi pfumala xungeto lowu tisiwaka hi matlharhi ya nyutliliya na ku tiyisisa leswaku thekinoloji ya nyutliliya yi tirhisiwa hi xikongomelo xo tisa ku rhula ntsena.
tgt: Izingxoxo zabe zigxile, phakathi kokunye, kwiziNjongo Zentuthuko Esimeme (ama-SDG) ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu izindaba eziphathelene nokuthula nokuvikeleka kanye nezinguquko kuNhlangano Yezizwe, ikakhulukazi izinguquko eMkhandlwini Wezokuvikela Wenhlangano Yezizwe.

src: Khabinete yi nkhensa MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku va vatlangerile N'hweti ya Ndzhaka hi Ndzati na ku tlhela va vula hungu ra Phuresidente Zuma ra Siku ra Ndzhaka eka hinkwavo haha tikweni ku va va tikarhatela vun'we hi matimba eka ku humelela ka hina.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma wasayina futhi neSivumelwano Sokuvinjelwa Kwezikhali Zenuzi, okuyisenzo esibonisa ukuzibophezela okuqhubekayo kweNingizimu Afrika ekuqinisekiseni ukuqedwa ngokuphelele kobungozi bezikhali zenuzi emhlabeni futhi kuqinisekiswe nokuthi ubuchwepheshe benuzi busetshenziselwa ukufeza izinjongo zoxolo kuphela.

src: Tanihiloko tiko ri gimeta N'hweti ya Ndzhaka ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge "Lembe ra Oliver Reginald Tambo: Ku Tlangela Ndzhaka ya Ntshuxeko wa Hina", MaAfrika-Dzonga ya hlohloteriwa ku aka hi ku landzelela ku kholwa loku nga kona eka Vumbiwa na ku tiyisisa ku aka rixaka leri pfumalaka vusweti, ndlala, ku pfumaleka ka kaya na ku pfumaleka ka ku ringana.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma wasingatha futhi nomcimbi wesidlo sakusihlwa wokugubha iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa uMongameli waphambilini we-African National Congress, uMnu Oliver Reginald Tambo.

src: Hi ku hlohlotela moya we ndzhaka, Khabinete yi amukela ntwanano lowu sayiniweke exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Tanzania, lowu lavaka ku hlayisa matimu ya ku lwela ntshuxeko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababamba iqhaza emigubhweni yeNyanga Yamagugu, ngoMandulo, futhi igcizelela emyalezweni kaMongameli Zuma awethula ngoSuku Lwamagugu wokuthi bonke abantu bakuleli kumele bazabalazele ukuletha ubumbano olukhudlwana kuleli lizwe lethu elinabantu abahlukahlukene futhi abaphuma ezinhlakeni ezihlukahlukene.

src: Hi ku tlangela moya wa vun'we na ntirhisano exikarhi ka mavandla ya Ntshuxeko eAfrika na ku ta fikeleriwa ka ku akiwa ka muziyamu, layiburari na tiakhayivhi.
tgt: Njengoba leli lizwe seliphothula imigubho yeNyanga Yamagugu ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Unyaka ka-Oliver Reginald Tambo: Sigubha Amagugu Enkululeko Yethu”, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba bakhele phezu kwezimompilo ezisekelwa kakhulu wuMthethosisekelo wezwe futhi baqinise nemizamo yokwakha isizwe esingenabo ububha, esingenabo abantu abangenamakhaya futhi esingenayo inkinga yokungalingani kwabantu.

src: Afrika-Dzonga, ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Vupfhumba, Manana Tokozile Xasa, ri nghenelerile eka Siku ra Misava ra Vupfhumba (27 Ndzati 2017) na N'hweti ya Vupfhumba, ehansi ka Nhlokomhaka leyi nge "Vupfhumba lebyi Tiyeke - Xitirhi xa Nhluvukiso."
tgt: Ekugqugquzeleni umoya wokubungaza amagugu ezwe, iKhabhinethi isishayela ihlombe isivumelwano esisayinwe yiNingizimu Afrika ne-Tanzania, okuhloswe ngaso ukulondoloza umlando womzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Leswi swi tisa xivandla xa kahle ku seketela ku cinca eka pholisi, maendlelo ya bindzu na mahanyelo ya vatirhisi va vupfhumba, ku ya fikelela sekithara ya vupfhumba leyi tiyeke, leswi nga ta hoxa xandla ku yisa emahlweni hi matimba ku fikelela tiSDHi nkarhi wa Siku ra Vupfhumba ra Misava, matiko yo hambana na mfuwo va tlangela ntalo wa migingiriko ya miganga ku fana na ku yisiwa emahlweni ka tihakelo to hlawuleka na/kumbe ku anamisa mfikelelo ka miako, mfikelelo hi xitalo ka mahala ka mitanga na swirhapa, na ku burisana na lava khumbhekaka.
tgt: INhlangano Yezizwe ikugunyazile ukuqaliswa koMklamo Womgubho Womgwaqo Obheke Kuzimele-geqe kwelase-Afrika.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri humelerile eka ku seketela vupfhumba hi ku tirhisa migingiriko yo hambana eka miako yo koka mahlo yo fana na mitanga, malwandle ya mujeko wa wasi, na tindhawu leti nga pasisiwa hi misava ta ndzhaka.
tgt: Lo mklamo wumgubho womoya wobumbano nobambiswano phakathi kwezinhlangano zase-Afrika ezazilwela inkululeko futhi uzoholela ekwakhiweni kwesigcina-magugu, umtapo wolwazi kanye nesigcina-mlando.

src: Tanihi ndhawu ya vupfhumba, Afrika-Dzonga ri langutana na ku kula ka sekithara ya ku ngeteleleka ka vupfhumba ku kotisa ku koteka ka ku kula ka ikhonomi hi ku tirhisiwa ka leswi tiviwaka tanihi sekithara ya ikhonomi ya vupfhumba leyi taleriweke hi ndzhavuko.
tgt: Tokozile Xasa, yabamba iqhaza emgubhweni woSuku Lwezokuvakasha Emhlabeni, mhla zingama-27 kuMandulo 2017, futhi yabamba iqhaza nasemigubhweni yeNyanga Yezokuvakasha, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ezokuvakasha Ezisimeme – Ziyithuluzi Lokuletha Intuthuko”.

src: Leswi swi katsa vupfhumba bya matikoxikaya, vutshunguri, swi vurimi na mfuwo.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngethuba lokweseka ukulethwa kwezinguquko kwinqubomgomo, nokuguqula izindlela zokwenza ibhizinisi futhi kuguqulwe nendlela amakhasimende ezokuvakasha enza ngayo izinto, ukuze kulethwe ukusimama okukhudlwana impela emkhakheni wezokuvakasha, okuyinto engafaka isandla esikhulu ekufezweni kweziNjongo Zentuthuko Esimeme.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ntwanano wo hlamarisa wa tihakelo lowu fikeleriweke hi Holobye Rihanyo, Dok Aaron Motsoaledi, hi ku tirhisana na mihlangano yo hlaya ya matiko ya misava, ku hatlisisa ku va kona ka philisi yin'we leyi fikelelekaka ya ku dyiwa hi lava nga na HIKu ringanyetiwa leswaku ku hungutiwa ka nxavo ku ta hlayisa kwalomu ka R11,7 wa tibiliyoni eka malembe ya ntsevu lawa ya taka.
tgt: NgoSuku Lwezokuvakasha Emhlabeni amazwe ahlukahlukene, futhi okungamazwe alandela amasikompilo ahlukahlukene, abungaza ezokuvakasha ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene eziqondene nesifunda ngasinye, ezinjengokuhlinzekwa kwezaphulelo emalini yokungena ezikhungweni zamagugu ezithile ukuze kukhuliswe isibalo sabantu abathola ithuba lokuvakashela lezi zikhungo futhi/noma abantu bahlinzekwa ngethuba lokungena mahhala eziqiwini nasemapaki, futhi kwabanjwa nemicimbi ehlukahlukene yokubandakanywa kwababambiqhaza.

src: Leswi swi ta pfuna leswaku Arika-Dzonga ri nghenelerisa vavabyi vo tala eku dyeni ka mirhi.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isibonise impumelelo enkulu ekugqugquzeleni ezokuvakasha ngokusebenzisa izikhungo zayo ezihlukahlukene eziheha abavakashi, njengamapaki neziqiwi zakuleli, namabhishi ayo aklonyeliswe ngendondo yamabhishi ahlanzeke kakhulu kanye nezizinda zamagugu ezigunyazwe yizinhlangano zomhlaba.

src: Ntwanano wa tihakelo swi endla leswaku murhi wa Dolutegravir, lowu nga bumabumeriwa hi Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava wa Rihanyo, wu kota ku fikeleleka eka mimfumo leyi nga le hansi na le xikarhi ematikweni.
tgt: Njengoba umkhakha wezokuvakasha uqasha abasebenzi abaningi kangaka, lokho kuthathwa njengesikhali esikhulu sokulwisana nenkinga yokuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi kuleli.

src: Hi ku ya hi ntwanano wa tihakelo, Ndzawulo ya Rihanyo yi lava ku sungula ku nyika tiphilisi hi vunharhu bya tona bya swidzidziharisi, Tenofovir, Lamivudine na Dolutegravir hi Dzivamisoko 2018.
tgt: Njengezwe elithandwa kakhulu ngabavakashi, maningi amathuba okuba iNingizimu Afrika ikhulise imikhakha yayo ehlukahlukene yezokuvakasha, okuyinto ezowusimamisa kakhulu umnotho wakuleli ngokusebenzisa imikhakha yezokuvakasha enjengomkhakha wokuvakashelwa kwezindawo zasemakhaya, umkhakha wokuvakashela kuleli kwabantu bakwamanye amazwe bezothola usizo lokwelashwa, umkhakha wezokuvakasha ophathelene nezolimo kanye nomkhakha wezokuvakasha ophathelene namasiko.

src: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga lava ti nghenisaka eka swa masangu, ngopfu ngopfu vantshwa, ku ya emahlweni na rihanyo lerinene leri ku nga ndlela yo ya emahlweni no sivela na ku endla swa masangu hi ndlela leyi hlayisekeke hi ku nga ngheneleri, hi ku tshembheka na ku tirhisa khondhomo, na ku kamberiwa hi mikarhi na mikarhi eka HIRihanyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isishayela ihlombe isivumelwano esiyingqophamlando sentengo yemishanguzo yokudambisa isandulelangculazi esenziwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku pfuriwa ka tlhelo rintshwa ra Xibedlhele xa Cecilia Makiwane eMdantsane, eMonti.
tgt: Aaron Motsoaledi, ngokubambisana nezinhlangano zamazwe ngamazwe ezihlukahlukene, okuhloswe ngaso ukusheshisa ukutholakala kohlelo lokudambisa isandulelangculazi ngephilisi elilodwa elishibhile futhi eliphuzwa kanye kuphela ngosuku.

src: U riendzo lerinene ra ku fikelela ku simekiwa ka Ndzindzakhombo wa Rihanyo ra Rixaka leswi nga ta vuyerisa rihanyo lerinene, ngopfu ngopfu eka vaaki lava sweleke.
tgt: Kulinganiselwa ekutheni ukuncishiswa kwentengo yemishanguzo kuzokongela leli lizwe imali engafinyelela ku-R.7 wamabhiliyoni kule minyaka eyisithupha ezayo.

src: Xibedlhele lexi xa xiyimo xa le henhla i vuvekisi bya ku fikelela xivono xa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Tiko (NDP) na SDG ya rihanyo ra misava hikuya hi UXibedlhele xa mibedwa ya 526 xi seketeriwa hi sisiteme leyi nga ta yisa ehenhla eku phakeleni ka rihanyo ra kahle.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuba iNingizimu Afrika ikwazi ukufaka iziguli ezengeziwe ohlelweni lokwelashwa ngemishanguzo.

src: Xi tirhisa ndlandlamuxo wa thekinoloji ku hunguta nkarhi wa ku yima eka vavabyi, ku antswisa vukamberi na ku hatlisisa ku nghenelela ka rihanyo eka vavabyi.
tgt: Isivumelwano sentengo yemishanguzo sizokwenza ukuba umshanguzo i-Dolutegravir, onconywa kakhulu yiNhlangano Yezempilo Emhlabeni, utholakale ngentengo ephansi kulawo mazwe aneminotho esafufusa kanye neminotho emaphakathi ngobukhulu.

src: Loko ha ha vuyelerisa miako ya rihanyo ya vaaki, hi tlhela hi engetela swivandlanene eka vaaki ku antswisa vutomi bya vona hi ku tumbuluxa mitirho na nhluvukiso wa mabindzu ya le mugangeni lamatsongo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa labo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaya ocansini, ikakhulukazi intsha, ukuba baqhubeke nokunakekela izimpilo zabo ngokuqikelela ukuthi bayazisebenzisa izindlela zokuzivikela esifweni sengculazi, ngokuthi bazithibe bangayi ocansini, noma babe nomlingani oyedwa kuphela futhi bathembeke kuyena, basebenzise ikhondomu ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi bakwenze kube yinto eyinjwayelo ukuhlolelwa isandulelangculazi.

src: N'hweti ya Nhluvukiso wa Vaaki yi khomiwa lembe na lembe ku tsundzuka ku humelela loku nga endliwa hi tiko, eka ku fikelerisa mpfuno eka vaaki lava sweleke na lava va nga le khombyeni eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Leli yigxathu eliyingqophamlando eliphokophele ekuqalisweni koMshwalense Kazwelonke Wezempilo ozoholela ekuhlinzekweni kosizo lwezempilo olusezingeni eliphezulu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ehlwempu.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga va hlohloteriwa ku tirhisa n'hweti ya Nhlangula ku lemuka leswi nga endliwa na ku tinyikela loku endliweke ka vadyuhari eku fikeleleni ka ntshuxeko laha tikweni ra hina.
tgt: Lesi sibhedlela sikanokusho esisezingeni lomhlaba siwumklamo wokutshalwa kwezimali okuhloswe ngawo ukufeza inhloso-mbono yoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) kanye neziNjongo Zentuthuko Esimeme zeNhlangano Yezizwe ezibandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu emhlabeni bathola usizo lwezempilo olusezingeni elifanele.

src: I ntirho wa muaki wihi kumbe wihi, ku nga ri mfumo ntsena, ku nyika vuhlayiseki eka vadyuhari na mitlawa leyi nga le khombyeni.
tgt: Lesi sibhedlela, esinemibhede angama-526, sisekelwe wuhlelo oludidiyelwe okuhloswe ngalo ukukhulisa izinga lokuhlinzekwa kosizo lwezempilo.

src: Phurogireme ya mpfuno wa vaaki wa Mfumo wa Afrika-Dzonga wu akiwile ehenhla ka ku kholwa loku tiyeke leswaku mpfuno wa nsirhelelo wa vaaki i mfanelo ya nkoka naswona i ya nkoka eka ku vuyelerisa ndzhuti eka vaakatiko.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lusebenzisa izindlela zobuchwepheshe zesimanjemanje ukunciphisa isikhathi esichithwa yiziguli ngenkathi zisalindile emgqeni, nokwenza ngcono ukuhlonzwa kwezifo kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zihlinzekwa ngosizo lwezempilo ngokushesha.

src: Midende yi susa ku tikeriwa eka mamiliyoni ya mindyangu na ku tirha swin'we na mfumo ku tlakusa lava nga le khombyeni leswaku swiyimo swa vutomi hi ku tisa ndzhuti.
tgt: Lolu tshalo-mali lwengqalasizinda oludle ibhiliyoni lamarandi luzosekela ukuthuthukiswa komnotho wasemalokishini.

src: Khabinete yi navelela vadyondzi leswinene, ngopfu ngopfu lava nga ka matiriki, loko va ha lulamisela swikambelo swa mahelo ya lembe.
tgt: Njengoba sivuselela ingqalasizinda yezempilo, sikhulisa namathuba okuba imiphakathi yendawo yenze ngcono izimpilo zayo ngokuthi kuvulwe amathuba omsebenzi futhi kuhlinzekwe ngamathuba okuba abantu bakwazi ukusungula amabhizinisi ezindaweni abahlala kuzo.

src: Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya Masungulo (DBE) yi famba hi nkarhi eka ku sungula ka swikambelo swa ka matiriki hi ti 16 ta Nhlangula 2017 leswi nga ta tsariwa hi ku tlula 798 000 wa machudeni lawa ya nga tsarisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqhubeke nokulekelela ekuhlinzekweni kosizo kubantu abahlwempu, njengoba kungasensuku zatshwala kufike iNyanga Yokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ngoMfumfu.

src: DBE yi ta fikelerisa nseketelo wo engetela eka lava nga le ka matiriki hi sayiti ya ka inthanete endzhaku ka nkarhi wa ku dyondza, na hi maheleni ya vhiki na mikarhi ya ku wisa.
tgt: Umgubho weNyanga Yokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ubanjwa minyaka yonke ngenhloso yokukhumbula amagxathu amakhulu asethathwe yileli lizwe ekuhlinzekweni kwezibonelelo zompakathi kubantu abahlwempu futhi abadinga ukubhekelelwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mfumo wu gimetile ku humelela ka Vhiki ra Senthara ya Vukorhokeri ya Thusong ya Lembe na Lembe eka lembe leri, leyi humeleleke ku suka hi ti 18 ku fika hi ti 22 ta Ndzati 2017 ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: "Lembe ra OR Tambo - Ku Yisa Emahlweni mabindzu lamantsongo na lawa ya nga le xikarhi ni la ma kulu eka Tisentharata ta Vukorhokeri ta Thusong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukufisela bonke abantu asebekhulile bakuleli uSuku Lwabantu Asebekhulile olumnandi, njengoba lolu suku luzogujwa mhla lu-1 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Lexi i xiphemu xa N'hweti ya Vukorhokeri bya Vaaki na ku seketeriwa hi Phurogireme ya Thusong hi ku kombisa phurogireme ya ku fikelela yo famba famba ya nhlanganelo na ku tirha kahle ka yona eka swilaveko swa vaakitiko.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba basebenzise inyanga kaMfumfu ukuhlonipha nokukhumbula indima eyadlalwa ngabantu abadala kanye nokuzinikela kwabo okukhulu emzabalazweni wenkululeko yezwe lethu.

src: Tisenthara ta Vukorhokeri ta Thusong ti tisa vukorhokeri byo tala bya mfumo na vuxokoxoko ekusuhi na vanhu.
tgt: Kungumsebenzi wabo bonke abantu bakuleli, hhayi uhulumeni nje kuphela, ukunikeza abantu abadala kanye nalabo abahluphekayo ukunakekelwa okuthe xaxa.

src: Phurogireme yi fikelela kwalomu ka ntsevu wa mamiliyoni wa va vuyeriwa lembe rin'wana na rin'wana hi ku tirhisa phurogireme ya Ku fikelela yo famba famba leyi Nhlanganeleke, Vhiki ra Senthara ya Vukorhokerhi ya Thusong ya Lembe na lembe na Vufambisi bya Vuxokoxoko bya Mfumo na Vuhlanganisi (GCIS) eka xivandla.
tgt: Uhlelo lwezibonelelo zikahulumeni ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika lwakhelwe phezu kwenkolelo eqinile yokuthi izibonelelo zikahulumeni ziyilungelo lesintu eliyisisekelo futhi zisemqoka kakhulu ekubuyisweni kwesithunzi sezakhamuzi zakuleli.

src: Hi ku tirhisa phurogireme, mfumo wu ya emahlweni na ku lulamisa ku pfumaleka ka ku ringana ka khale hi ku tisa vukorhokeri bya risima ekusuhi na vaaki lava khale a va pfaleriwe ehandle eka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki ka nkoka.
tgt: Izibonelelomali zikahulumeni zihlinzeka ngosizo lwezimali emakhaya ayizigidi ngezigidi futhi, ngokusebenzisana nohulumeni, ziyabalekelela abantu abantulayo ukuba benze ngcono izimo abaphila ngaphansi kwazo ngesithunzi.

src: Tisenthara ta Vukorhokeri bya Thusong yi tlhela yi nyika vaaki matimba hi swikili leswi nga swa nkoka na vuleteri ku antswisa vutomi bya vona, hi ku tirhisa vuxaka lebyi nga kona na mfumo, swiyenge swin'wana swa mfumo na sekithara ya mabindzu.
tgt: Ahamba kahle kakhulu amalungiselelo oMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo (i-DBE) okuhlolwa kukamatikuletsheni okuzoqalwa mhla ziyi-16 kuMfumfu 2017, lapho abafundi ababhalisiwe abangaphezu kwezi-798 000 bezobhala khona izivivinyo zabo zokuphela konyaka.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela kombela vaaki ku ya emahlweni na ku tirhisa Tisenthara ta Vukorhokeri ta Thusong ku fikelela vukorhokeri bya nkoka byo fana na bya Timhaka ta Xikaya, Vatirhi, Ejensi ya Nsirhelelo wa Vaaki ya Afrika-Dzonga na Nkwama wa Tinghozi ta le Magondzweni.
tgt: I-DBE ihlinzeka ngokwesekwa okwengeziwe kubafundi bakamatikuletsheni njengoba beqhubeka nokufunda nokuzilungiselela ezikoleni zabo ntambama emva kokuphuma kwesikole, nangezimpelasonto nangamaholidi ezikole.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri seketela xitatimende xa Matsalanankulu wa UN, António Guterres, loyi a nga tshikilela mhaka ya vutihlamuleri bya Mfumo wa Myanmar ku fikelerisa nsirhelelo eka hinkwavo lava khumbhekaka, na ku tlhela va kombela tiejensi ta Vumunhu ku nyika mfikelelo eka vaaki lava lavaka mpfuno na nsirhelelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa abazali kanye nabalondolozi bezingane ukuba bahlinzeke abafundi ngakho konke ukwesekwa abakudingayo njengoba belungiselela ukuhlolwa kwabo.

src: Khabinete yi hlohlotela mihlangano hinkwayo ku herisa madzolonga na ku papalata ku ya emahlweni na ku xanisiwa ka vanhu na ku kombela leswaku xiyimo xa Tiko ra Rakhine ku va xilulamisiwa hi ku landzelela nawu.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yeNyanga Yophiko Lwezemisebenzi Kahulumeni futhi kwagqugquzela uhlelo lwe-Thusong ngokubonisa uhlelo oludidiyelwe lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezingomahambanendlwana futhi kwaboniswa nendlela olusebenza ngayo lolu hlelo ekubhekeleleni izidingo zezakhamuzi zakuleli.

src: Angola hi rin'wana ra leri Afrika-Dzonga ri nga na vuxaka lebyikulu bya bindzu eka tikonkulu ra Afrika na ku ya emahlweni ku kurisa vuxaka bya matiko ha vumbirhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngempicabadala yesimo senhlalo esingesihle neze esibhekene nabantu abawuhlanga lwama-Rohingya asebebalekile bashiya amakhaya abo kwelase-Myanmar.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo vafanele va alelana na vukhamba lebyi, lebyi xungetaka ku kula ka sekithara ya vupfhumba leyi ya ka yi kula.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa wonke amaqembu ukuba ayeke ukuzibandakanya ezenzweni zodlame ukuze kunqandwe usizi nokuhlupheka kwabantu okuqhubekayo njengamanje futhi iyanxusa ukuba sixazululwe ngokushesha isimo esingesihle neze esiqhubekayo njengamanje esifundazweni sase-Rakhine, ngokulandela izimiso nemigomo ebekwe ngumthetho.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi kombela Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga ku endla hinkwaswo leswi nga fanela ku khoma lava nga endla manyala lawa eka vukhamba bya vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo, njengoMongameli Zuma, ihalalisela izwe lase-Angola ngokubamba ukhetho olube yimpumelelo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku humesela ehandle na vuxokoxoko lebyi pfunaka vasindzisi va vulawuri bya nawu na ku kombela matimba hinkwawo ya nawu ku tirhisiwa eka lava kumiwaka va ri na nandzu.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma ubewuthamele umcimbi wokugcotshwa kukaMongameli João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço obubanjelwe e-Luanda ngoLwesibili mhla zingama-26 kuMandulo 2017.

src: Ku simekiwa ka buku ya nawu wa ndhavuko wa Bakoena Ba Mopeli.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ne-Angola ngamazwe anomlando ofanayo wokulwiswana nengcindezelo yokubuswa ngabezizwe kanye nobandlululo.

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka ku simekiwa ka buku, Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, tanihi goza rikulu leri nga fikeleriwa eka vurhangeri bya xintu eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Kusukela ngowe-1994, lawa mazwe amabili alokhu eqhubeke njalo nokukhulisa nokwelula ubambiswano oluqinile olukhona phakathi kwawo.

src: Holobye wa Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu, Tatana Des van Rooyen, na Vukosi bya Vuhosi Litsie III, Nhloko ya Vurhangeri bya Vuhosi bya Lesotho, vanghenelerile eka ntlangu lowu hi Musumbhunuku, 25 Ndzati 2017.
tgt: I-Angola ngelinye lamazwe ahwebelana neNingizimu Afrika kakhulu ezwekazini lase-Afrika futhi iyaqhubeka nokukhulisa nokwelula ubudlelwano bayo neNingizimu Afrika.

src: Buku leyi yi ta pfuna ku twisisa matimu ya Bakoena Ba Mopeli na ku cincana ka rixaka exitulwini xa vuhosi ku kota ku hlayisa matimu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasigxeka isigameko sakamuva sokuqolwa kwezivakashi zase-Netherlands ezilandelwe yilezi zigebengu ngenkathi ziphuma esikhumulweni sezindiza i-OR Tambo International Airport.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku cinciwa ka Maendlelo eka Vufambisi bya Mbangu na Nhluvukiso lowu Tiyeke wa SADC, hi Palamende.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kwebhukwana lomthetho wendabuko wesizwe sa-Bakoena Ba Mopeli.

src: Xikongomelo xa maendlelo i ku seketela ku tirhisiwa hi ndlela leyi tiyeke na vufambisi bya ku cincana ka mindzilikano ya mbangu, leswi ku nga ku tsakela ka swirho swa matiko ya SADAfrika-Dzonga, tanihi mutshamaxitulu wa SADC ku sukela hi Mhawuri 2019 ku fikela hi Mhawuri 2018 ri tinyikerile ku tiyisisa matimba ya muganga ku hlayisa mindzilikano ya switirhisiwa swa ntumbuluko na ku hlohlotela nhluvukiso lowu tiyeke exikarhi ka muganga wa SADLeswi swifambelana na NDP, leyi rhangisaka vun'we bya muganga wa SADC na ku tiyisisa ku tiya ka mbangu na ku ringanana ka ku cincana ka ku hunguteka ka moya wa thyaka eka ikhonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikushayela ihlombe ukwethulwa kwebhukwana loMthetho Wendabuko isihloko salo esithi: Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, njengoba lokhu kuyimpumelelo eyingqophamlando kwezobuholi bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Vun'we bya xinakulobye eka Khoniferense ya Vaholobye ya Ikhonomi ya Rihlaza.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezokwengamela Ngokubambisana Nezendabuko, uMnu.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhurhela Vun'we bya Migingiriko ya Khoniferense ya Ikhonomi ya Rihlaza ya Vaholobye hi Ndzati 2018.
tgt: Des van Rooyen, kanye neNgonyama u-Letsie III, iNhloko Yombuso wase-Lesotho, bebewuthamele lo mcimbi obubanjwe mhla zingama-25 kuMandulo 2017.

src: Xivandla lexi xi seketela matiko na miganga ku endla leswaku ku tiya ka tipholisi ta ikhonomi ya maendlelo swi va swa nkoka eka Ajenda ya 2030 ya Nhluvukiso wa ku Tiya.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokwengamela Ngokubambisana Nezendabuko waqala ukubhala umlando wamaKhosi NeziNdlovukazi eziyi-13 kusukela ngowezi-2011.

src: I phurogireme ya UN leyi lavaka ku tisa vun'we bya vutivi ku suka eka tiejensi ta UN ta ntlhanu leti ku nga, hi ku ya hi mavin ya tona Phurogireme ya Mbangu wa UN, Mihlangano ya Vatirhi ya Matiko ya misava Phurogireme ya Nhluvukiso ya UN, Nhlanganowa Nhluvukiso wa Tifeme ta UN na Vuleteri na Vulavisisi wa Nhlangano wa UEku rhurheleni ka Khoniferense ya Vaholobye swi ya yisa emahlweni ajenda, laha kaya na le ka tikonkulu ra Afrika, eka kula loku hlanganeleke eka ku amukela moya wa thyaka lowu nga wu ntsongo na ndlela leyi nga tiya ya ikhonomi ya maxelo.
tgt: Leli bhukwana lizolekelela abantu ukuba bawuqonde kahle umlando wesizwe sa-Bakoena Ba Mopeli kanye nokulandelana kwamakhosi aso ukuze kugcinwe umlando waleli lizwe.

src: Khabinete yi lemukisiwile hi mbhurisano wa Ndzawulo ya Mati na Nkululo lowu nga eku humeleleni na vavekisi.2 Ku kota ku tshamisekisa timhaka ta mafumelo eka Huvo ya Khabinete yi pasisile ku thoriwa ka Huvo ya Nkarhinyana loko Holobye a ha hatlisisa phurosese ya ku thoriwa ka Huvo leyi heleleke ya Mati ya Umngeni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukwamukelwa yiPhalamende ngokusemthethweni kweSivumelwano se-SADC sokuPhathwa Kwemvelo Ukuze Kulethwe Intuthuko Esimeme.

src: Khabinete yi enetekile hi ntirho wa Holobye lowu a ri ku wu endleni ku tshamisekisa Huvo ya Mati ya Umngeni.
tgt: Injongo yalesi sivumelwano wukugqugquzela ukusetshenziswa ngendlela esimeme kanye nokuphathwa kahle kwemvelo egxamalazele imingcele yamazwe e-SADC ahlukahlukene, okuyinto ezoba wusizo kakhulu emazweni e-SADINingizimu Afrika, njengoSihlalo we-SADC kusukela ngoNcwaba 2017 kuze kube nguNcwaba 2018, izibophezele ekuqiniseni imizamo yokonga nokuvikela imithombo yemvelo egxamalazele imingcele yamazwe esifunda se-SADC kanye nokugqugquzela intuthuko esimeme kulesi sifunda.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Nawumbisi wa ku Cinciwa ka ku Kamberiwa ka Misava leswaku ku nyikiwa mavonelo.
tgt: Lokhu kuyahambelana nohlelo lwe-NDP, olubeka eqhulwini ukuqiniswa kokudidiyelwa kwesifunda se-SADC nokuqinisekisa ukusimama kwemvelo nokuletha uguquko ngendlela efanele futhi elingene ukuze kuguqukelwe emnothweni okhiqiza intuthu encane kakhulu engcolisa umoya nemvelo.

src: Nawumbisi wa ku Cinciwa ka Nawu wa ku Kamberiwa ka Misava wa 1997 (Nawu wa 8 wa 1997).
tgt: INgqungquthela Yongqongqoshe Yobambiswano Lokuthatha Izinyathelo Zokuqinisekisa Umnotho Obhekelela Imvelo.

src: Ku cinciwa ku yisa emahlweni vutihlamuleri na mafumelo na ku fikelerisa ku thoriwa ka swirho swin'wana eka Huvo ya Vulawuri ya Vukamberi, ku kota ku yisa emahlweni vulawuri eka nkambelo wa misava eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukusingathwa kweNgqungquthela Yongqongqoshe Yobambiswano Lokuthatha Izinyathelo Zokuqinisekisa Umnotho Obhekelela Imvelo, ezobanjwa ngoMandulo 2018.

src: Nawumbisi wu tlhela wu lava ku lawula vukamberi bya misava ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ku tiyisisa Mulawurinkulu wa ku Kambela ku tirhisa vuangameri bya tiko na vufambisi eka xivumbeko xa misava, nkambelo wa xivumbeko xa misava, swa tindhawu na vukorhokeri bya vuxokoxoko bya misava.
tgt: Lesi sigcawu sisekela amazwe kanye nezifunda ukuba zenze ukusimama kwemvelo kube wumongo nomgogodla wezinqubomgomo nezinkambiso zomnotho ngenhloso yokuqhubekisela phambili i-Ajenda yowezi-2030 yeNtuthuko Esimeme.

src: Nawumbisi wu ringanyeta vun'we na ku ringanana ka swipimelo leswi lawulaka vilawuri na mafumelo ya mabindzu ya mfumo eka vuviki eka Holobye wa Sayense na Thekinoloji.
tgt: Lolu wuhlelo lweNhlangano Yezizwe oluzoqoqela ndawonye ubungoti obuvela ezimpikweni ezinhlanu zeNhlangano Yezizwe, okuwuHlelo Lwenhlangano Yezizwe Lwezemvelo iNhlangano Yezabasebenzi Yamazwe Ngamazwe uHlelo Lwentuthuko Lwenhlangano Yezizwe Uphiko Lwenhlangano Yezizwe Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni kanye neSikhungo Senhlangano Yezizwe Socwaningo Nokuqeqeshwa.

src: Leswi swi ta tiyisisa vun'we eka hinkwaswo swilaveko leswi lavekaka ki ringaneriwa na phurosese leyi faneleke ku landzeleriwa hi mabindzu ya mfumo loko swi ta eka mafumelo.
tgt: Ukusingathwa kwale Ngqungquthela Yongqongqoshe kuzoqhubekisela phambili i-ajenda, ngaphakathi kuleli lizwe kanye nasezwenikazi lase-Afrika, yokukhuliswa komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke ngokuthi kwamukelwe umgudu wezomnotho ogcizelela ukukhiqizwa kwentuthu encane kakhulu futhi ukwazi ukubhekana nesimo sezulu esiguquguqukayo futhi esinobunzima.

src: Khabinete yi kombela hikwavo ku tirhisana ku tiyisisa leswaku miako ya vutleketli bya tiko yi vuyerisa hinkwavo na ku hlohlotela vatirhisi ku teka vutihlamuleri na ku tirhisa milawu ya vuhlayiseki bya le magondzweni tanihi xiphemu xa vutomi bya vona bya masiku hinkwawo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yahlinzekwe ngolwazi futhi nangezingxoxo ezibanjwe nguMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuthuthwa Kwendle nabatshali-zimali.2 Ukuze kulethwe uzinzo ezindabeni zeBhodi eziphathelene nokuphatha nokwengamela, iKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukuqokwa kweBhodi Yesikhashana ngenkathi uNgqongqoshe esazama ukusheshisa inqubo yokuqokwa kweBhodi Yezamanzi YaseMngeni ezosebenza ngokugcwele.

src: Hi Ku tirhisana swin'we hi nga hunguta mafu ya le magondzweni.
tgt: IKhabinethi igculisekile ngomsebenzi owenziwa nguNgqongqoshe ekuletheni uzinzo kwiBhodi Yezamanzi YaseMngeni.

src: Vuvekisi eka sekithara ya vutleketli swi hlohlotela nhluvukiso na ku tumbuluxa mitirho tanihi Kungu ra Swiga swa Kaye ra Afrika-Dzonga, leri lavaka ku kurisa ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho leyi lavekaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa kweSichibiyelo Somthetho Wezokuhlolwa Nokuklanywa Komhlaba ukuze umphakathi uzwakalise imibono yawo.

src: Vuvekisi lebyi byi ta tiyisisa ku aka eka nhlanganelo wa vutleketli bya nhlanganelo wa vutleketli laha tikweni.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezokuhlolwa Nokuklanywa Komhlaba we-1997 (uMthetho we-8 we-1997).

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri ta rhurhela ntshamo wa Afrika-Dzonga-Zimbabwe eka Khomixini ya matiko ha vumbirhi (BNC).Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta rhurhela varingani va le Zimbabwe, Muchaviseki Phuresidente Robert Mugabe, loyi a nga ta va eAfrika-Dzonga ku sukela hi ti 03 Mhawuri 2017 eka ntshamo wa Vumbirhi wa BNC exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Zimbabwe.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zizocacisa amandla namagunya okuphendula nokwengamela futhi uhlinzekele nokuqokwa kwamalungu omphakathi athile njengamalungu eBhodi Yokulawulwa Komsebenzi Wokuhlola Nokuklama Umhlaba, ukuze kwenziwe ngcono ukulawulwa kokuhlolwa nokuklanywa komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Nwanano wa ku tumbuluxa NBNC wu sayiniwile hi 2015 Dzivamisoko na ku pfuriwa ximfumo hi Mhawuri 2016 eHarare, eZimbabwe.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose futhi nokulawula ukuhlolwa nokuklanywa komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika ngokunikeza uMhloli-Jikelele Womhlaba amandla okuqapha nokuphatha indlela okwenziwa ngayo umsebenzi wokuhlola nokuklama umhlaba mayelana nesimo somhlaba nokuguquka kwaso ngokuhamba kwesikhathi (i-geodetic), isimo somhlaba kubandakanya izinto ezakheke ngokwemvelo kanye nezakhiwo ezakhiwe ngabantu (i-topographic) kanye nemingcele ebonisa ukuklanywa nokuhlukaniswa komhlaba (i-cadastral), kubandakanya nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo eziphathelene nedatha yomhlaba (i-geospatial) kanye nolwazi oluphathelene nomhlaba ezweni lonkana.

src: Afrika-Dzonga na Zimbabwe va na vuxaka lebyi nga kahle bya xipolitiki, ikhonomi na vuxaka bya vaaki lebyi humaka eka matimu lawa ya fanaka lawa ya sukaka eka malembe ya kahle.
tgt: Umthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Imithetho Yezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe wezi-2017.

src: Khabinete yi yima na rixaka eka ku navelela Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, loyi a tiviwaka tanihi Manana wa Rixaka, siku ra ntsako ra ku velekiwa loko a khoma malembe ya 81 hi Ravumbirhi, 26 Ndzati 2017.
tgt: Njengoba inyanga kaMfumfu 2017 iwuphawu lweNyanga Yezokuthutha ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika phambili”, iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu bakuleli ukuba basebenzisane ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ingqalasizinda yezokuthutha yezwe iyabahlomulisa bonke abantu bakuleli futhi iKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ukuba basebenzise umgwaqo ngokucophelela futhi baqinisekise ukuthi nsuku zonke bakubeka eqhulwini ukuphepha emgwaqeni.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Banyana Banyana eka ku hlula ka vona eka Vunghwazi bya COSAFA bya Vamanana bya 2017 endzhaku ka loko va hlurile Zimbabwe hi 2-1 eka ntlangu wo gimeta eBulawayo.
tgt: Umcimbi kazwelonke wokwethulwa kwale nyanga uzobanjelwa enkundleni yezemidlalo i-Sinaba Stadium e-Daveyton ngaphansi koMkhandlu-dolobha wase-Ekurhuleni mhla zingama-29 kuMandulo 2017.

src: Banyana Banyana va tlakusa mujeko wa Afrika-Dzonga hi ku tinyungubyisa na leswaku matirhelo ya vona ya hlohlotela vantshwa na lava na nyiko eAfrika-Dzonga ku tirha hi ku hiteka.
tgt: Utshalo-mali olufakwa emkhakheni wezokuthutha lugqugquzela intuthuko nokuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi njengengxenye yoHlelo lweNingizimu Afrika Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, okuhloswe ngalo ukukhulisa umnotho kanye nokudala amathuba omsebenzi adingeka kakhulu kuleli.

src: Khabinete yi yima na Afrika-Dzonga eka ku engetela marito yi Chavelela eka Phuresidente Enrique Peña Nieto wa Matiko ya Vun'we bya Mexico na vanhu va le Mexico endzhaku ka khombo leri hlomulaka mbilu ra ku ninginika ka misava, tsunami na xidzedze, leswi nga va nga mafu ya 225 na ku onhiwa ka miako.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izosingatha isigcawu sesibili seKhomishana yeNingizimu Afrika neZimbabwe (i-BNC)UMongameli Jacob Zuma uzosingatha uzakwabo waseZimbabwe, uMongameli Robert Mugabe, ozovakashela eNingizimu Afrika mhla zi-3 kuMfumfu njengengxenye yoMhlangano Wesibili Wekhomishana yezwe laseNingizimu Afrika nelase-Zimbabwe (i-BNC).

src: Swirho leswi nga ta tirha eka Vulawuri bya ku Yisa Emahlweni:a. Tatana Sandile Bubele Siyaka (theme ya vumbirhi)b. Tatana Ntshengedzeni Anthony Michael Tshivhase (theme ya vumbirhi)c. Tatana Christopher Ewing (theme ya vumbirhi)d. Tatana Ebrahim Aboobaker Moolla (theme ya vumbirhi)e. Manana Nonzukiso Zukie Siyotula naf.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela nabo bonke abantu bakuleli ekufiseleni uMama u-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, odume ngelikaMama Wesizwe, umgubho wosuku lokuzalwa omnandi njengoba ehlanganise iminyaka yobudala engama-81 ngoLwesibili mhla zingama-26 kuMandulo 2017.

src: Manana Nocamagu Nomfundo Mbulawa.
tgt: UMama uMadikizela-Mandela ungomunye wezingqalabutho zaseNingizimu Afrika eziyintandokazi kubantu bakuleli futhi uhlonishwa kakhulu.

src: Valawuri lava nga ri ki eka Vulawuri eka Huvo ya Ndzindzakhombo ya Swikweleti swa Tinhundzu leti Rhumeriwaka swa SOC ya Afrika-Dzonga:a. Tatana Dhevendren Dharmalingam (Mutshamaxitulu)b. Manana Vuyelwa Matsiliza (thoriwa nakambe) nac.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyambonga ngegalelo lakhe emzabalazweni wenkululeko yakuleli eyatholakala kanzima futhi imfisela unyaka onezibusiso azowuchitha nabantu abathandayo nomndeni wakhe.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 18 Nhlangula 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu mhla ziyi-18 kuMfumfu 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Siku ra Ntshunxeko wa Swihangalasamahungu.
tgt: Usuku Lwenkululeko Yemithombo Yezindaba.

src: Khabinete yi hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga ku tsundzuka Siku ra Ntshunxeko wa Swihangalasamahungu hi Ravumune, 19 Nhlangula 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, nayo njengezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika, libungaza uSuku Lwenkululeko Yemithombo Yezindaba, ngoLwesine, mhla ziyi-19 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Swihangalasamahungu swi tirhile ntirho wa nkoka swonghasi eka ku lwisana na xihlawuhlawu, ku humesela erivaleni maxangu na tihanyi leti endliweke hi mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu.
tgt: Imithombo yezindaba yabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekulwisaneni nobandlululo, yavumbulula izigameko ezinyantisayo kanye nesihluku sikahulumeni wobandlululo.

src: Nan'waka ri fungha 40 wa malembe kusukela loko mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu wu yirisile maphephahungu yo seketela ncinco wa vaaki yo tanihi World, Weekend World na Voice.
tgt: Lo nyaka ungunyaka wama-40 selokhu uhulumeni wobandlululo amisa ukusebenza kwamaphephandaba ayenohlonze njenge-The World, i-The Weekend World kanye ne-The Voice.

src: Namuntlha, ntshunxeko wa swihangalasamahungu wu simekiwile hi ndlela yo tiya eka Vumbiwa ra Afrika-Dzonga naswona wu tama wa ha ri xihlawulekisi xa nkoka xa rixaka ra ka hina leri hluvukaka.
tgt: Namuhla, inkululeko yemithombo yezindaba iqukethwe kuMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika futhi iyisakhi esisemqoka ekuthuthukisweni kwezwe lakithi.

src: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi khutaza yi MaAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni va kondletela mfikelelo eka mahungu na ku tirhisa mfanelo ya ntshuxeko wa swihangalasamahungu hi ndlela ya vutihlamuleri ku pfuna ku aka Afrika-Dzonga ra hinkwavo leri nga na vun'we, leri nga yiki hi nghohe, leri nga yiki hi rimbewu, ra xidemokirasi na ku va leri humelelaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liqhubeka nokukhuthaza izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ziqhubeke nokugqugquzela ukutholakala kolwazi futhi zisebenzise ilungelo lenkululeko yemithombo yezindaba ebandakanya ukwakha iNingizimu Afrika ebumbene, engacwasi ngokwebala nangokobulili, ebuswa ngentando yeningi yabantu futhi enempumelelo.

src: Ikhonomi ya Malwandle.
tgt: Umnotho Wasolwandle.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Phuresidente Jacob Zuma eku nyikeni xiviko eka vakhumbheki eka nsimeko wa Operation Phakisa eka Ikhonomi ya Malwandle naswona yi rhamba vakhumbheki hikwavo ku ya emahlweni va tirhisana na mfumo ku humesa vuswikoti bya ikhonomi ya malwandle ya hina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lincoma uMongameli uJacob Zuma ngokwethulela ababambiqhaza umbiko mayelana nenqubekela phambili ngokuqaliswa kwe-Operation Phakisa: Umnotho Wasolwandle futhi linxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuthi baqhubeke nokubambisana nohulumeni ukuze kubonakale amathuba omnotho otholakala olwandle lwakithi.

src: Ikhonomi ya Malwandle se yi hoxile xandla hi kwalomu ka 4.4% eka Swimakiwa Hinkwaswo swa Tiko swa Afrika-Dzonga naswona xiviko xa Phuresidente eka vanghenisaxandla xi kombisa hi ndlela ya matimba matshalatshala ya nhlanganelo na nseketelo wa vatirhisani hinkwavo va mfumo lava tirhisaka vuswikoti lebyikulu.
tgt: Umnotho Wasolwandle sewube negalelo elingu-4.4% kuMkhiqizo WaseNingizimu Afrika Wonyaka Wonke (i-GDP) futhi umbiko kaMongameli oqondiswe kubabambiqhaza ubonakalise ukuzimisela okukhulu kanye nokwesekwa kwabo bonke ababambisene noHulumeni abathathe isinyathelo sokufinyelela emathubeni amakhulu.

src: Tiphurojeke ta Ikhonomi ya Malwandle kufika sweswi ti humesile R.6 wa tibiliyoni leti katsanisiweke eka vuvekisi kusuka eka mfumo na sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo, naswona ti tumbuluxile ku tlula 6 500 wa mitirho.
tgt: Imiklamo Yomnotho Wasolwandle ikwaze ukuvula amathuba otshalomali oludidiyele oluyizigidi ezingama-24.6 zamarandi ezivela kuhulumeni kanye nasezimbonini ezizimele, futhi idale imisebenzi engaphezu kwezi-6 500.

src: Vuvekisi lebyikulu eka Ikhonomi ya Malwandle, lebyi fambisiweke hi ku tirhisa swinavetisi swa mfumo, byi kongomisiwile eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa, ngopfungopfu mihlaluko, vumaki, vumakaswikwekwetsu, nkuriso wa swiharhi na swimilani swa le matini na mivalango ya xisayense eka sekitara ya oyili na gasi.
tgt: Utshalomali olukhulukazi eMnothweni Wasolwandle, olulawulwa ngokoxhaso oluvela kuhulumeni, labelwa ukuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda, ikakhulukazi amatheku, ukukhiqiza, ukwakha izikebhe, imvelo ephila olwandle kanye nocwaningo lwezesayensi emkhakheni wezamafutha kanye negesi.

src: Mfumo wu kunguhata ku tumbuluxa xitirhisiwa xa vumakelaswikwekwetsu xin'we lexikulu eka hinkwaswo edzongeni wa Afrika.
tgt: Uhulumeni uhlele ukusungula isikhungo esisodwa esikhulukazi sokwakha izikebhe eNingizimu ne-Afrika.

src: Phaka ya Vumakaswikwekwetsu ya KwaZulu-Natal eka Hlaluko ra Durban yi ta hlengeleta vuswikoti kusuka eka vuvekisi lebyintshwa, tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho.
tgt: Ipaki Lokwakhiwa Kwezikebhe KwaZulu-Natali Ethekwini lase-Durban lizovula amathuba otshalomali olusha, izimpahla ezithunyelwa kwamanye amazwe kanye namathuba omsebenzi.

src: Vuendzi bya mfumo ku ya eZambia.
tgt: Uhambo Olusemthethweni LwaseZambia.

src: Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo kusuku eka Vuendzi bya Mfumo bya Phuresidente Zuma ku ya eRhiphabuliki ra Zambia kusuka hi ti 12 kufika ti 13 Nhlangula 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela imiphumela evele Ohambweni Olusemthethweni lukaMongameli Zuma eRiphabhulikhi yaseZambia olwaqala mhla ziyi-12 kuya ku-13 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Min'wangulano exikarhi ka Phuresidente Zuma na ntangha yakwe hi ntirho ya Zambia Edgar Lungu yi tiyisile vuxaka lebyi nga kona bya xipolitiki, xiikhonomi na vuxaka bya mfuwo exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi, lebyi seketeriwaka hi vuxaka bya swa matimu byo tiya lebyi tumbulukeke kusuka emalembeni ya nyimpi ya ntshuxeko.
tgt: Izingxoxo ezabanjwa phakathi kukaMongameli Zuma nozakwabo waseZambia uMongameli Edgar Lungu ziqinise ubudlelwano obuhle bezombusazwe, ezomnotho kanye nezamasiko phakathi kwala mazwe amabili, obusekelwe ubudlelwano obuqinile bakudala obaqala ngeminyaka yomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Tiphuresidente letimbirhi ti pfurile ximfumo ndhawu ya OR Tambo National Heritage eChelstone, Lusaka, hi ku xixima vuhoxaxandla bya OR Tambo eka nyimpi ya ntshuxeko edzongeni wa Afrika.
tgt: Labo Mongameli Bamazwe bavule ngokusemthweni indawo yamagugu esizwe i-OR Tambo National Heritage Site eChelstone, eLusaka, behlonipha igalelo lika-OR Tambo emzabalazweni wenkululeko weningizimu ne-Afrika.

src: Zambia yi tama ya ha ri rin'wana ra vatirhisani va bindzu va le henhla va Afrika-Dzonga exifundzeni na le tikwenikulu.
tgt: IZambia isangelinye lamazwe abekwa eqhulwini kwezokuhwebelana neNingizimu Afrika esifundeni kanye nasezwenikazi.

src: Ntirhisano wa swa ikhonomi exikarhi xa Afrika-Dzonga na Zambia wu ya emahlweni wu kula, laha tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe ta Afrika-Dzonga ku ya eZambia ti endleke kwalomu ka R30 wa tibiliyoni hi lembe ra 2016.
tgt: Ukubambisana kwezomnotho phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika kanye neZambia kuyaqhubeka nokukhula, njengoba umkhiqizo iNingizimu Afrika ehwebela iZambia ngawo ulinganiselwa emalini eyizigidigidi ezingama-30 zamarandi ngowezi-2016.

src: Matiko lamambirhi ya tirhisana eka swiyenge swo hambanahambana, ku katsa mabindzu na vuvekisi, sayense na thekinoloji, vusirheleri, vurimi, mbangu, eneji na rihanyo.
tgt: La mazwe amabili asebenzisana emikhakheni enhlobonhlobo, okubandakanya ezohwebo notshalomali, ezesayensi nobuchwepheshe, ezokuvikela, ezolimo, ezemvelo, ezamandla kanye nezempilo.

src: Vuendzi byo tirha ku ya eNigeria.
tgt: Uhambo Olusemthethweni LwaseNigeria.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Phuresidente Zuma eka ku va a xiximiwile hi xifaniso na xitarata leswi thyiweke mavito ya yena eNigeria, hi nkarhi wa vuendzi byo tirha ku tiyisa vuxaka bya vaaki na ikhonomi na mitirhisano yin'wana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela uMongameli Zuma ngokuhlonishwa ngesichuse kanye nokuqanjwa komgwaqo ngegama lakhe eNigeria, ngesikhathi kunohambo olusemthethweni lokuqinisa ubudlelwano bezenhlalomnotho kanye nezinye izindlela zokusebenzisana.

src: Gavhenara wa Xifundzakulu xa Imo, Rochas Okorocha, u nyikile Phuresidente Zuma Sagwati ra Meriti ya Imo, sagwati ra le henhlahenhla ra Xifundzakulu leri nyikiwaka lava endleke ku hambana eka nhluvukiso wa le migangeni ya ka vona.
tgt: UNdunankulu Wesifundazwe i-Imo, uRochas Okoracha, uhloniphe uMongameli Zuma nge-Imo Merit Award, okuyindondo esezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu kulesi Sifundazwe, enikwa labo ababe negalelo elilethe uguquko ekuthuthukisweni kwemiphakathi yangakubo.

src: Nhlengeletano ya Huvo ya Vaholobye ya Indian Ocean Rim (IORA) ya vu Afrika-Dzonga ri sungule Vutshamaxitulu bya IORA eka nhlengeletano ya vu 17 leyi khomeriweke eDurban kusuka hi ti 14 kufika 18 Nhlangula 2017.
tgt: UMhlangano WoMkhandlu WoNgqongqoshe be-Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) we-1.

src: Nkongomelo wa Afrika-Dzonga wa nkarhi wa rona wa ku va ehofisini i “Ku Hlanganisa Vanhu va Afrika, Asia, Australasia na Middle East hi Ntirhisano lowu Antswisiweke wa ku Rhula, Ntshamiseko na Nhluvukiso lowu Yisekaka Emahlweni”.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ithathe isikhundla sokuba uSihlalo we-IORA emhlanganweni we-17 obanjelwe eDurban kusukela mhla ziyi-14 kuya kweziyi-18 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Khabinete yi vule nakambe ku tiboha ka yona hi vutshamaxitulu lebyi eka ntirhisano wa xifundza wo yisa emahlweni eka swiyenge swo tanihi ikhonomi ya malwandle ku nyika matimba eka ikhonomi wa vavasati ku tlakusa mabindzu lamatsongo, ya le xikarhi na lamatsongo swinene ku nyika matimba eka vantshwa, na ntirhisano eka swa tidyondzo, sayense na thekinoloji.
tgt: Isiqubulo seNingizimu Afrika ngehlandla layo sithi "Ukubumba Abantu Base-Afrika, e-Asia, e-Australasia kanye naseMiddle East Ngokuthuthukisa Ukusebenzisana Ngenhloso Yokuletha Ukuthula, Uzinzo kanye Nentuthuko Esimeme".

src: Tinhlengeletano ta lembe na lembe ta Nkwama wa Timali wa Matiko ya Misava (IMF) na Bangi ya Misava.
tgt: Imihlangano yaminyaka yonke yeSikhwama Sezimali Somhlaba Wonke (i-IMF) kanye neBhange Lomhlaba.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Holobye wa Timali, Tat.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, uMnu Malusi Gigaba, utshele iKhabhinethi emuva kokubamba iqhaza kweNingizimu Afrika emihlanganweni yaminyaka yonke ye-IMF neBhange Lomhlaba, eyabanjwa kusukela ngomhla ziyi-13 kuya kumhla ziyi-15 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Malusi Gigaba, hikwalaho ka vungheneri bya Afrika-Dzonga eka tinhlengeletano ta lembe na lembe ta Bangi ya Misava na IMF ya 2017, leti veke kona kusuka hi ti 13 kufika ti 15 Nhlangula 2017.
tgt: Imihlangano ihlinzeke ngethuba lokuhlola okuqhubekayo emhlabeni jikelele kwezentuthuko nokwendlalela izinhlelo zeNingizimu Afrika ngokwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ezenhlalomnotho, ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya wonke umuntu, ukudalwa kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokuqedwa kobubha.

src: Tinhlengeletano ti nyike xivandlanene xa ku hlela nhluvuko wa matiko eka timhaka ta nhluvukiso na ku tivisa mapfhumba ya rona Afrika-Dzonga eka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki, ku kula loku katsaka hinkwaswo, ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na ku hungutiwa ka vusweti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde laziswa ngomhlangano obanjwe uNgqongqoshe uGigaba nezinhlangano ezenza izilinganiso zeminotho yamazwe omhlaba kanye nabatshalimali ukugcizelela izinqubomgomo ezikhona eNingizimu Afrika kanye nendlela esetshenziselwa ukulungisa isimo sezezimali.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi hlamuseriwa ku ya emahlweni hi nhlengeletano leyi Holobye Gigaba a yi khomeke na tiejensi to pima swikweleti swa matiko lama tifumaka na vavekisi ku tiyisisa nakambe tipholisi na maendlelo ya nkarhi wa sweswi ya Afrika-Dzonga eka matikhomelo lamanene ya swa timali.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lanelisekile ngokuqinisekiswa kwabatshalimali ngezinhlelo zikahulumeni zokukhulisa umnotho kanye nokuzibophelela kukahulumeni ekudingideni izindaba zokuphatha ezinkampanini ezingaphansi kukahulumeni.

src: Khabinete ya eneriseka hi ku tiyisisa nakambe loku nyikiweke vavekisi eka makungu ya mfumo ya ku kurisa ikhonomi na ku tiboha ka mfumo ku tirhana na swiphiqo swa mfumo eka mavandla ya ka hina lama nga ehansi ka vun'wini bya mfumo.
tgt: Isitatimende seNqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS) sizokwethulwa ePhalamende, eKapa, mhla zingama-25 kuMfumfu futhi sizocacisa izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokusebenzisa imali eminyakeni emithathu ezayo.

src: Nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa.
tgt: Ukuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda.

src: Khabinete hi hoyozerile mpfuneto lowukulu eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa swa mfumo hi ku hundzisiwa ka ximfumo ka mabiloho manharhu eBotlokwa eLimpopo hi Phuresidente Zuma hi ti 17 Nhlangula 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lishayele ihlombe uxhaso olukhulu lokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda kahulumeni, ngokuvula kukaMongameli uZuma ngokusemthethweni amabhuloho amathathu eBotlokwa eLimpopo ngomhla ziyi-17 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Ejensi ya Magondzo ya Rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga yi akile mabuloho ya Botlokwa, lama nga na buloho rin'we ra gondzo na mabuloho mambirhi ya van'wamilenge eN1 exikarhi Polokwane na Makhado.
tgt: Inhlangano Yemigwaqo kaHulumeni eNingizimu Afrika (i-Sanral) yakhe amabhuloho aseBotlokwa, okubalwa kuwo elinye lamabhuloho asemgwaqweni kanye namabhuloho amabili abantu abahamba ngezinyawo ku-N1 phakathi kwePolokwane neMakhado.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku phurojeke leyi yi ta antswisa swinene swiyimo swa ku teka tendzo na vuhlayiseki bya vatirhisi va magondzo hinkwavo endhawini leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ayingabazi ukuthi lo mklamo uzozithuthukisa kakhulu izimo zezokuthutha kanye nezokuphepha kubo bonke abantu abasebenzisa umgwaqo kuleya ndawo.

src: Mabindzu lamatsongo na ya le xikarhi.
tgt: Amabhizinisi Amancane Nasafufusa.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo eka ku rhurhela Nkombiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo na ya le Xikarhi (SME) ya Matiko ya China, tanihileswi wu hoxaka xandla eka ku humesa makete wa China wa mabindzu lamatsongo na mabindzu ya nhlanganelo ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lincoma ukuthi uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane ngokuhlanganyela ekusingatheni umbukiso iChina International Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) Fair wakulo nyaka, njengoba uba negalelo ekuvuleleni amabhizinisi asafufusa kanye nemifelandawonye yaseNingizimu Afrika amathuba okuthi athengise imikhiqizo yawo ezweni lase-China.

src: Nkombiso wa SME wu le ku yeni emahlweni eGuangzhou, China kusuka hi ti 10 kufika ti 27 Nhlangula 2017.
tgt: Umbukiso we-SME uzoba seGuangzhou, eChina kusukela ngomhla ziyi-10 kuya kumhla zingama-27 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Mabindzu lamatsongo hi wona xivindzi xa ikhonomi ya hina na njhini ya ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho eAfrika-Dzonga, naswona ku nghenela ka hina eka nkombiso wa mabindzu ku tlakusile mfikelelo eka timakete na swivandlanene eka ku kurisa mabindzu.
tgt: Amabhizinisi amancane awumongo womnotho wethu futhi awumnyombo wokukhula komnotho kanye nokudalwa kwamathuba omsebenzi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukuzibandakanya kwethu embukisweni wohwebo kusinike amathuba okuthengisa imikhiqizo yethu kwamanye amazwe kanye nawokukhulisa amabhizinisi.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku leswi swi kombisa ku tiboha ka mfumo eka xikongomelo xa ku tlakusa na ku yisa emahlweni vubindzu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linesiqiniseko sokuthi lokhu kuveza ukuzibophelela kukahulumeni emgomweni wokukhuthaza nokuqhubekisa ukuqalwa kwamabhizinisi amasha.

src: Ku vekisa eka mabindzu lamatsongo swi ta pfuna tiko ku angula eka mitlhontlho ya ikhonomi ya vaaki ya sweswi.
tgt: Utshalomali emabhizinisini amancane luzosiza izwe lithole isisombululo ezingqinambeni ezikhona kwezenhlalomnotho.

src: Vupfhumba.
tgt: Ezokuvakasha.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Phurogireme ya Valanguteri va Vupfhumba ya Rixaka eSoweto, hi Ravumbirhi, 17 Nhlangula 2017, leri nga na xikongomelo xa ku tlakusa ntokoto wa vaendzi xikan'we na ku antswisa vuhlayiseki bya vapfhumba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukwethulwa koHlelo Lwabaqaphi Ababhekele Ezokuvakasha Kuzwelonke eSoweto, ngoLwesibili mhla zingama-17 kuMfumfu 2017, okuhloswe ngalo ukukhuthaza ukuthi izivakashi ziphathwe ngezandla ezifudumele kanye nokuphucula ukuphepha kwezivakashi.

src: Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba, hi ku tirhisana na Vulawuri bya Vupfhumba bya Gauteng, yi simekile pfhumba eXitarateni xa Vilakazi, lexi xi nga xitarata xi ri xoxe emisaveni lexi tinyungubyisaka hi vutshamo bya Vaxiximiwa va Sagwati ra Nobel vambirhi – Khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela na Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuvakasha, ngokubambisana noPhiko Oluphethe Ezokuvakasha eGauteng, wethule lolu hlelo Emgwaqweni uVilakazi, okuwuwo kuphela umgwaqo emhlabeni ozigqaja ngokuthi kwahlala kuwo izigayigayi ezimbili ezaklonyeliswa ngama-Nobel Peace Prize - owayenguMongameli uNelson Mandela kanye noMbhishophi Omkhulu Osele Esidla Umhlalaphansi uDesmond Tutu.

src: Pfhumba leri ri fambisana na swikongomelo swa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka (NDP) naswona ri na xikongomelo xa ku tumbuluxa mitirho ya 200 ya vantshwa, lava va nga ta leteriwa ku va valanguteri eka tindhawu ta vupfhumba ku ringana nkarhi wa 36 wa tin'hweti.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhambisana nemigomo yoHlelo Lwentuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) futhi luhlose ukudala amathuba omsebenzi abantu abasha abangama-200, abazoqeqeshelwa ukuba abaqaphi ezindaweni zokuvakasha isikhathi sezinyanga ezingama-36.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vini va mabindzu na miganga eGauteng ku tirha na valanguteri va vupfhumba ku antswisa vuhlayiseki bya vapfhumba na ku lawula vuswikoti bya ikhonomi kusuka eka xiyenge leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abanikazi bamabhizinisi kanye nemiphakathi eseGauteng ukuthi isebenzisane nabaqaphi ababhekele ezokuvakasha ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphepha kwezivakashi futhi kusetshenziswe amathuba ezomnotho angatholakala kule mboni.

src: Sayense na Thekinoloji.
tgt: Ezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe.

src: Khabinete yi amukela na ku hoyozela vativi va sayenselava va ngheneleke mbalango wa tithelesikopu wa Muako wa Thelesikopu ya Ntivotinyeleti wa Afrika-Dzonga (SAAO) na Thelesikopu Leyikulu ya Dzongeni wa Afrika (SALT).
tgt: IKhabinethi lamukela futhi lihalalisela ososayensi ababambe iqhaza emsebenzini wokusinga obekwenziwa ngesibonisikude (itheleskophu) Esikhungweni saseNingizimu Afrika Esicwaninga Ngomkhathi (i-SAAO) kanye neSibonisikude Esikhulukazi SaseNingizimu Ne-Afrika (i-SALT).

src: Leswi swi vangile ntirhisano wa matiko lowu nga si tshamaka wu va kona ku lavisisa masungulo ya vuthumbhi byo sungula bya gandlati ra giravhithi leri humesiweke hi tinyeleti timbirhi ta tinyutironi leti tlumbaneke.
tgt: Lokhu kuholele ekubambisaneni kwamazwe ahlukene okokuqala ngqa ngenhloso yokwenza ucwaningo ngemvelaphi yamagagasi okunqubuzana adalwa izinkanyezi ezincinyana ezimbili ezinqubuzanayo.

src: Nakambe ntlumbano lowu wu tlhele wu vanga mbhuluko wa khilonovha wa ku vonakala.
tgt: Ukunqubuzana kwadala ukuthi kube nokuqhuma kokukhanya okubizwa ngokuthi i-kilanova.

src: Khilonovha i xiendleko xa ntivotinyeleti lexi endlekaka eka sisiteme ya swilo swimbirhi loko tinyeleti ta tinyutironi timbirhi kumbe nyeleti ya nyutironi na nkele wa ntima swi pfangana.
tgt: I-kilanova iwukuqhuma okwenzeka lapho izinkanyezi ezincinyana ezimbili zijikelezana noma inkanyezi encinyane ilumbana ne-black hole.

src: Vuthumbhi lebyi byi fungha ku fika ka nkarhi lowuntshwa wa asitirofizikisi, xiendleko xa ntumbuluko wa misava na tinyeleti lexi voniweke eka ngulumelo wa nkokelamisaveni na ku vonakala.
tgt: Le miphumela ivule amasango amasha kwisayensi yezezinkanyezi, ngesigameko sokuqala sezinkanyezi esibonakele emagagasini okunqubuzana kanye nokukhanya.

src: SALT na tithelesikopu tin'wana ta SAAO ti nyikile switiviwa swo sungulasungula eka leswi swi vonakaka swi ri swiendleko swa asitirofizikisi leswi nga tshama swi dyondziwa.
tgt: I-SALT kanye nezinye izibonisikude ze-SAAO ezihlinzeke ngeminye yemininingo yokuqala yalokho osekuthathwa ngokuthi isigameko sesayensi yezezinkanyezi esesicwaningwe kakhulu kunangaphambilini.

src: SALT na SAAO ti le xikarhi ka yin'wana ya 70 ya miako ya thelesikopu leyi kumekaka ehansi na le mpfhukeni leyi hlanganeke na ku buluka wa lokukulu ka tinyeleti timbirhi ta nyutironi leti tlumbaneke, xikan'wekan'we endzhaku ka loko magandlati ya xoko ya giravhithi ya thumbhiwile hi Muako wa Thelesikopu wa Magandlati ya Giravhithi ya Nkatsano wa ku Vonakala ka Leyizara lowu kumekaka eUnited States na muthumbhi wa Virgo loyi a kumekaka eYuropa.
tgt: I-SALT ne-SAAO ngezinye zezikhungo ezingama-70 ezinezibosikude ezisemhlabeni nezisemkhathini ezabona lesi sibhicongo sokunqubuzana kwezinkanyezi ezincinyane ezimbili, okwenzeke emuva kokuba amagagasi okunqubuzana ebonakala esikhungweni esicwaninga ngomkhathi sase-United States, i-Laser Interfermeter Gravitational-Wave Observatory, kanye ne-Virgo ese-Europe.

src: Nkhuvu wa Misava wa Vantshwa na Swichudeni.
tgt: Umbukiso Womhlaba Wentsha kanye Nabafundi.

src: Russia yi le ku rhurheleni Nkhuvu wa Misava wa Vantshwa na Swichudeni wa 2017 kusuka hi ti 14 kufika 22 Nhlangula 2017, lowu ku nga ku ngheneleleni ka ku tlula 20 000 wa vantshwa vo huma eka 150 wa matiko.
tgt: IRussia isingethe uMbukiso Womhlaba Wentsha kanye Nabafundi wezi-2017 oqale ngomhla ziyi-14 kuya kwezingama-22 kuMfumfu 2017, ohanjelwe abantu abasha abangaphezu kwezi-20 000 basemazweni ayi-150.

src: Xikongomelo xa nkhuvu i ku tisa endhawini yin'we vantshwa va misava eka mhaka ya vululami, ku tiyisa vuxaka bya matiko, na nhluvukiso wa vuxaka bya le xikarhi ka tinxaka na bya le xikarhi ka mifuwo.
tgt: Inhloso yombukiso ukuhlanganisa abantu abasha basemhlabeni ngaphansi kombono wezobulungiswa, ukuqiniswa kobudlelwano bakumazwe ngamazwe, kanye nokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano kubantu bezinhlanga kanye namasiko ahlukene.

src: Nsirhelelo wa vana.
tgt: Ukuvikelwa kwabantwana.

src: Khabinete yi kombisile ku khumbeka hikwalaho ka swiviko swo vavisa swa vugevenga ehenhla ka vana, xin'wana lexa ha ku vaka kona ku nga ri khale ngopfu ku nga nxaniso wa swa masangu lowu ehleketeleriwaka wa ku tlula 80 wa vana va xikolo eka Xikolo xa le Hansi xa AB Xuma eOrlando, Soweto hi murindzi wo tsemakanyisa vana va xikolo gondzo.
tgt: IKhabinethi liveze ukukhathazeka kwalo kulandela imibiko ephazamisayo ngobugebengu obubhekiswe ezinganeni, njengoba kamuva nje kube nezinsolo zokunukubezwa ngokocansi kwabafundi abangaphezu kwama-80 basesikoleni samabanga aphansi i-AB Xuma e-Orlando, eSoweto wunogada wesikole.

src: Ndzawulo ya xifundzakulu ya hoyozeriwa eka n'wangulo wa xihatla hi ku susa, xikan'wekan'we, vufambisinkulu bya xikolo, ku tisiwa vakondleteri na ku simeka vulavisisi hi huvo leyi tiyimeleke.
tgt: Umnyango wasesifundazweni uncome ukusukuma ngokushesha okubonakele kususwa abaphathi besikole ngokuphazima kweso, ukuletha osonhlalakahle kanye nokuqalisa uphenyo oluqhutshwa uphiko oluzimele.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba miganga hinkwayo eAfrika-Dzonga ku tirhisana ku sirhelela vana hinkwavo eka muxaka wihi kumbe wihi wa khombo na nxaniso, na ku tirhisana na maphorisa ya muganga ku endla miganga yi tshama yi hlayisekile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa yonke imiphakathi yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ibambane ngezandla kuvikelwe izingane kunoma oluphi uhlobo lobugebengu nokuhlukunyezwa, futhi kubanjiswane namaphoyisa endawo ukuze kugcinwe imiphakathi yethu iphephile.

src: Swikambelo.
tgt: Ukuhlolwa Kwabafundi.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku swikambelo swa xikolo swa ku hela ka lembe swi ta ya emahlweni ku ri hava nkavanyeto endzhaku ka ku kombisa ku vilela ka ntshungu ka vhiki leri leyi loku a ku rhangeriwile hi Nhlangano wa Vadyondzisi wa Xidemokirasi wa Afrika-Dzonga (SADTU).
tgt: IKhabinethi likholwa ukuthi ukuhlolwa kokuphela konyaka kwezikole kuzoqhubeka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka kulandela umbhikisho omkhulu kuleli sonto obowuholwa inyunyana yothisha, i-South African Democratic Teacher's Union (i-SADTU).

src: SADTU yi nyikile memorandamu eka Holobye wa Dyondzo ya le Hansi, Man.
tgt: I-SADTU idlulisele uhlu lwezikhalo kuNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo, uNkk.

src: Angie Motshekga, loyi a tiboheke ku ololoxa swiphiqo swa swivilelo hi ku hatlisa hilaha swi kotekaka hakona.
tgt: Angie Motshekga, ozibophelele ekuxazululeni izinkinga ngokushesha.

src: I swa nkoka leswaku vakhumbheki hinkwavo va tirhisana ku tumbuluxa mbangu wo tirheka ku kotisa vadyondzi hi ndlela yo antswa ku kongomisa eka ku dyondza na swikambelo swa vona.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke ababambiqhaza basebenzisane ukuze kube nesimo esifanele abafundi ukuze bakwazi ukugxila ekufundeni nasekuhlolweni kokuphela konyaka.

src: Swidzedze.
tgt: Izimvula ezinamandla.

src: Khabinete yi komba nchavelelo wa le mbilwini eka varhandziwa va lavaya va lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya vona eka swidzedze leswa ha ku vaka kona eka swiphemu swin'wana swa tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa ukuzwelana kakhulu nalabo abashiywe izihlobo zabo ngesikhathi kunezimvula ezinamandla zakamuva kwezinye izindawo zezwe.

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi khensa vatinyiketi hinkwavo, mihlangano ya leyi nga na ku navela kun’we ya vaaki, miganga, vatirhi va mphalalo-mpfuno na swipanu swa Mafambiselo ya Mhangu eka ku pfuna volava va khumbekeke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinda libonga bonke abazinikele, izinhlangano zomphakathi, imiphakathi, abasebenzi abasiza ezimweni zomonakalo kanye namathimba Alawula Umonakalo ngokusiza labo abathintekile.

src: Holobye wa Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu, Tat.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wokwengamelo Ngokubambisana Nezendabuko, uMnu.

src: Des van Rooyen, eka xiyimo xa yena tanihi murhangeri wa Senthara ya Mafambiselo ya Mhangu ya Rixaka eAfrika-Dzonga, u endzerile tindhawu leti khumbekeke hi swidzedze na timpfula ta matimba eka Masipalankulu wa Doroba ra eThekwini eKwaZulu-Natal hi ti 13 Nhlangula 2017 na le ka Masipala wa Muganga wa Doroba ra Mogale eGauteng hi ti 16 Nhlangula 2017.Hikwalaho ka timpfula ta matimba na swidzedze leswi hlaseleke swiphemu swo tala swa tiko, 19 wa vutomi byi lahlekile na swona ku tlula 20 wa vanhu va vavisekile.
tgt: Des van Rooyen, esikhundleni sakhe njengenhloko yeSikhungo Sokulawulwa Komonakalo Kuzwelonke eNingizimu Afrika, uhambele izindawo ezikhahlamezwe izimvula ezinamandla kuMasipala Omkhulu waseThekwini KwaZulu-Natali ngomhla ziyi-13 kuMfumfu 2017 kanye nakuMasipala Wendawo iMogale City eGauteng mhla zingama-16 kuMfumfu 2017.

src: Nakambe Holobye van Rooyen u endzerile tindhawu ta leti ta ha ku humeleriwaka hi timhangu ePhilippi eKapa-Vupeladyambu laha tsevu wa swirho swa ndyangu, ku katsa na vana vanharhu, swi lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya swona hikwalaho ka ndzilo lowu mbumburheleke tiyindlu tinharhu ta mixaxa na vhengelexiphaza.
tgt: Lezi zimvula ezinamandla ezikhahlameze izindawo eziningi zezwe, zidlule nemiphefumulo yabantu abayi-19 futhi kwalimala abangama-20.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku sungula ka endlelo ra xitshunxo xa nkwetlembetano rin'wana ra Life Esidimeni tanihileswi swi nga ta va masungulo ya makumu eka mindyangu ya vavabyi lava loveke.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe van Rooyen uphinde wahambela izindawo zasePhilippi eNtshonalanga Kapa ezivelelwe umonakalo kamuva lapho amalungu omndeni ayisithupha okubandakanya izingane ezintathu, eshonile ngenxa yomlilo oqothule izindlu eziyimijondolo ezintathu kanye nesitolo esincane.

src: Khabinete yi humesa ntshembo hi vutalo eka Xandla xa Muavanyisinkulu xa Khoto ya Vumbiwa Dikgang Moseneke, loyi a fambisaka nandzu lowu naswona yi navelela hi ku tshembeka swirho swa mindyangu matimba tanihiloko swi vona leswi swi nga vaka swi ri xivangelo xo tika xa khomborifu leri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lazisa ukuqala kwenqubo yokuxazulula izimpikiswano ngokunye okwakungenzeka eLife Esidimeni njengalokho okungase kube ukuqala kokuphenduleka kwemibuzo emindenini eyashonelwa iziguli.

src: Vulavisisi lebyi a byi fanelangi ku pfuna ntsena eka ku tisa makumu eka mindyangu leyi khumbekaka kambe na ku tirha ku nyika tidyondzo eka mfumo hi ku angarhela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa ukumethemba ngaphandle kokunqikaza owayeyiPhini Lejaji Eliyinhloko LaseNkantolo YoMthethosisekelo uDikgang Moseneke, ongumehluleli kulolu daba futhi lifisela amalungu omndeni amandla njengoba ebuka kudingidwa lesi sehlo.

src: Mfumo wa tiboha ku nyika vukorhokeri bya risima eka MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzimisele ngokuhlinzeka ngezidingo eziseqophelweni eliphezulu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mukhuhlwana wa Tinyenyana.
tgt: Umkhuhlane Wezinkhukhu Nezinyoni, i-Avian Influenze.

src: Khabinete yi tshembisiwile leswaku Ndzawulo ya Vurimi, Swihlahla na swa Tinhlampfi (DAFF) yi le ku endleni vulanguteri bya nkarhi hinkwawo eka mapurasi ya tiko hinkwaro hi ku ringeta ku sivela ku hangalaka ka ntungu wa Mukhuhlwana wa Tinyenyana (HPAI) H5Ntshikelelo wa mukhuhlwana wa tinyenyana wu thumbiwile eka tinyenyana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liqinisekisiwe ukuthi uMnyango Wezolimo, Amahlathi kanye Nezokudoba (i-DAFF) wenza ucwaningo oluhambisanayo emapulazini asezweni lilonke ngenhloso yokugwema ukusabalala kokuqubuka komkhuhlane wezinkukhu nezinyoni, i-Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5Lo mkhuhlane ubonakele ezinyonini.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vaaki ku sukela ku khomakhoma tinyenyana to vabya na leti nga fa naswona va nga ringeti ku phamela tinyenyana ta nhova kambe va nga ha mangala tinyenyana leti ehleketeleriwaka ku va ti vabya eka vulawuri bya le ndhawini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa umphakathi ukuthi ugweme ukubamba izinkukhu nezinyoni ezigulayo noma ezifile futhi ungazami ukupha izinyoni zasendle ukudla kepha ubikele abaphethe uma kunezinkukhu nezinyoni osola ukuthi ziyagula.

src: Mihlaselo ehenhla ka Maphorisa.
tgt: Ukuhlaselwa kwamaphoyisa.

src: Khabinete yi sola nhlaselo ehenhla ka tsevu wa swirho swa Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga eVanderbijlpark eGauteng hi ti 10 Nhlangula 2017 hi vaakandhawu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligxeka ukuhlaselwa kwamaphoyisa ayisithupha angamalungu Ombutho Wamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) eVanderbijlpark eGauteng ngomhla ziyi-10 kuMfumfu 2017 ebulawa amalungu omphakathi.

src: Tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ti nyikiwile matimba ya ku sirhelela rixaka eka xiendlo xihi kumbe xihi xa vugevenga.
tgt: Izinhlangano eziphoqelela umthetho zijutshelwe ukuvikela umphakathi kunoma eziphi izenzo zobugebengu.

src: Hikokwalaho, a ku na ntsengo wa nhlundzuko wu nga nyikaka xivangelo eka munhu wihi kumbe wihi xa ku hlasela tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu.
tgt: Ngakho, alukho uhlobo lobungozi olunosetshenziswa njengesizathu sokuhlasela izinhlangano eziphoqelela umthetho.

src: Khabinete yi hlohlotela vaakandhawu lava ku tirhisana na maphorisa ku khoma swigevenga leswi na ku pfuna ku endla Afrika-Dzonga ri hlayiseka swinene eka hinkwavo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa amalungu omphakathi ukuthi asebenzisane namaphoyisa ukubamba izigebengu nokusiza ekwenzeni iNingizimu Afrika ibe ngephephile elungele bonke abantu.

src: Swiboho swa Khabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabinethi.

src: Nongonoko wa Tiyindlu ta Vaaki.
tgt: Uhlelo Lokubonelela Umphakathi Ngezindlu.

src: Khabinete yi tivisiwile hi mikumo na swibumabumelo swa Nkhumbho na Nkambelo wa Nsimeko wa Phurogireme ya Tiyindlu ta Vaaki na kungu ro antswisa, hi xikongomelo xa ku ololoxa tipheteni ta matshamelo ya xihlawuhlawu hi ku antswisa ndhawu ya matshamelo na mpfanganiso wa tiphurojeke ta tiyindlu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lachazelwa ngokutholakele kanye nezincomo eziqondene Nomthelela kanye Nokuhlolwa Kokuqaliswa Kohlelo Lokubonelela Umphakathi Ngezindlu kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukisa, ngenhloso yokuqeda ukuhlaliswa kwabantu ngokuqhelelana okwadalwa uhulumeni wobandlululo ngokuthuthukisa kokugqagqana kwezindawo kanye nokusondezwa ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni emiklamweni yokwakhiwa kwezindlu.

src: Phurogireme leyi yi nyika vutshamo bya rhente yo fikeleleka eka mindyangu ya malinghena ya le hansi na ya le xikarhi eka tindhawu laha swiyimo swa timakete nkarhi wun'wana a swi ta va siya ehandle kumbe ku avela tiyindlu leti nga ringanelangiki.
tgt: Uhlelo luhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala okuqashwa kuyo engambi eqolo yemindeni ehola kancane kanye nehola imali emaphakathi ezindaweni ebeyingase icwaseke kuyo ngenxa yezimo zokumba eqolo kwaleyo ndawo noma yabelwe izindlu ezingalungile.

src: Leyi i phurogiremeba yi ri roxe leyi yi susumetaka ku hakeriwa ka swikweleti yi tekelaka enhlokweni ku yiseka emhalweni ka swa timali ta nkarhi wo leha ka tiphurojeke na ku tumbuluxa ndzhendzeleko wa swa timali lowunene na vahiri lava hakelaka tirhente na mihlangano ya tiyindlu ta vaaki leyi hakelaka tirhente, swibalo, na tihakelo ta vukorhokeri eka timasipala.
tgt: Yilolu kuphela uhlelo olusebenzisa uxhaso oluyisikweletu lucubungule amaphrojekthi aqhubekisekayo ngokwezimali isikhathi eside futhi ludale ukungena nokuphuma kwemali okunozinzo njengoba iziqashi zizokhokha imali yokuqasha futhi izikhungo zokubonelela umphakathi ngezindlu zikhokhele izinsiza, intela kanye nezidingo-ngqangi zikamasipala.

src: Xiviko lexi xi pfuna tindzawulo leti faneleke eka ku antswisa ku ya emahlweni makungu ya tona ya matirhelo ya tindzawulo to hambanahambana.
tgt: Lo mbiko usiza iminyango efanele ukuthi iqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zayo zokusebenza ngokwahlukana kwayo.

src: Xiviko hi vutalo xi ta vekiwa eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo wa Matirhelo kun’we na Vulawuri (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Umbiko ogcwele uzofakwa kuwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezokuhlela, Ukuqapha kanye Nokuhlola (WEBTOKEN).

src: Vukorhokeri bya Vantshwa bya Rixaka (NYS).
tgt: Imisebenzi Yentsha Yakuzwelonke (i-NYS).

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Rimba ra Phurogireme ra NYS leri pfuxetiweke na ku antswisiwa tanihi xiphemu xa vantshwa tanihi vaakatiko lava gingiritekaka va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze Uhlaka Lohlelo lwe-NYS olubukeziwe noluthuthukisiwe njengengxenye yokuthuthukisa abantu abasha babe izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezishabashekayo.

src: NYS i mukotisi wa vantshwa eAfrika-Dzonga ku va vaakatiko lava gingiritekaka va tiko na ku hoxa xandla hi ndlela leyinene eka nhluvukiso wa tiko loko ku ri karhi ku fikeleriwa nhluvukiso wa munhu yena n'wini na wa xiphurofexinali.
tgt: I-NYS ivulela abantu abasha baseNingizimu Afrika ithuba lokuba amalungu asebenzayo ezweni futhi babe negalelo elihle ekuthuthukisweni kwezwe khona manjalo bezithuthukisa bona siqu nangokomsebenzi.

src: Leswi swi ta khumba vantshwa lava nghenelelaka eka migingiriko leyi vuyerisaka vaakandhawu va miganga loko ku ri karhi ku hluvukisiwa vuswikoti hi vukorhokeri na ku dyondza ku endlela leswaku swivandlanene swa vona swa ku nghena hi ndlela leyi humelelaka eka timakete ta vatirhi na ku va van'wamabindzu swi tiyisiwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukuthi abantu abasha bazibandakanye emisebenzini ezohlomulisa imiphakathi yasendaweni ibe ithuthukisa amakhono abo ngemisebenzi kanye nokufunda ukuze kwande amathuba abo okuthola imisebenzi nokuba abaqali bamabhizinisi ngempumelelo.

src: Foramu ya Afrika ya vu3 ya Vhiki ra Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi.
tgt: ISonto lesi-3 Lesithangami Se-Afrika Lokwengezela Imisebenzi Yokwelulelwa Kwezolimo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhurheriwa ka Foramu ya Afrika ya vu3 ya Vhiki ra Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi, leyi nga ta khomeriwa eKwaZulu-Natal kusuka hi ti 30 Nhlangula kufika ti3 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukusingathwa kweSonto lesi-3 Lesithangami Se-Afrika Lokwengezela Imisebenzi Yokwelulekwa Kwezolimo, esizobanjwa KwaZulu-Natali kusukela ngomhla zingama-30 kuMfumfu kuya kumhlaka 3 kuLwezi 2017.

src: Xiendleko lexi xi fambisana na NDP naswona xi kuma nsirhelelo wa swakudya tanihi ndlela ya ku tirhana na ntlhontlho xinharhu wa mpfumaleko wa mitirho, vusweti na nkandzingano.
tgt: Lo mbuthano uhambisana ne-NDP futhi uhlonza ukukhiqizwa kokudla okwanele njengendlela yokubhekana nenselele ehlukaniseke kathathu: ukusweleka kwamathuba omsebenzi, ububha kanye nokungalingani.

src: Nkongomelo i: “Ku tlakusa vurimi lebyi fambelanaka na maxelo: ku pfanganisa vantshwa, vavasati, na ncinco wa xidijitali”, naswona xiendleko lexi xi ta khomeriwa ehansi ka vurhangeri bya DAFF, hi ku tirhisana na Nhlangano wa Afrika-Dzonga wa Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vurimi na Foramu ya Afrika ya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi.
tgt: Isiqubulo sithi: "Ukukhuphula ezolimo ezihambisana nesimo sezulu: ukudidiyela intsha, abantu besifazane, kanye nokushintsa kwezobuchwepheshe", futhi umcimbi uzobanjwa ngaphansi kobuholi be-DAFF, ngokuhlanganyela noNhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika Yowelulwa Kwezolimo kanye neSigungu Se-Afrika Somisebenzi Yokwelulekwa Kwezolimo.

src: Netiweke leyi ya tikokulu ya Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vurimi na Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo (AEAS) eAfrika yi nyika pulatifomo ya ku dyondzisana na maendlelo lamantshwa exikarhi vaphakeri va AEAS eAfrika na le misaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Lezi zigungu zezwekazi zoKwandisa Ezolimo kanye Nemisebenzi Yokweluleka (i-AEAS) e-Afrika zivula inkundla yokufundisana kanye nokusungulwa kwamasu amasha phakathi kwabahlinzekeli be-AEAS kulo lonke lase-Afrika nasemhlabeni.

src: Nakambe NDP yi seketela vuantswisi eka nhluvukiso wa swikili na vuleteri eka sekitara ya vurimi, ku katsa na vuleteri bya swipanu leswintshwa swa vatirhi va mphakelo wa vuxokoxoko lava nga ta angula hi ndlela leyi vuyerisaka eka swidingo swa varimi va swipurasani.
tgt: I-NDP iphinde ilwele ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nokuqeqesha emkhakheni wezolimo, okubandakanya ukuqeqesha abasebenzi abasha bezokwengezela abazophumelela ekubhekaneni nezidingo zabalimi abasebenzela ukuziphilisa.

src: Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava.
tgt: Iqoqo Lamazwe Ahweba Ngewayini Emhlabeni.

src: Eka ku hoxa xandla ka ku susiwa ka swirhalanganyi swa , khabinete hi nyikiwile vuxokoxoko hi Vutshamaxitulu wa Afrika-Dzonga wa Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava kusuka hi Dzivamisoko 2017 kufika hi Mudyaxihi 2018.
tgt: Njengoba kususwe izithiyo kwezohwebo, iKhabhinethi laziswe ngesimo seNingizimu Afrika ekubeni uSihlalo weQoqo Lamazwe Ahweba Ngewayini Emhlabeni (i-WWTG) kusukela kuMbasa 2017 kuya kuNhlaba 2018.

src: Tanihi mutshamaxitulu, Afrika-Dzonga ri ta rhurhela nhlengeletano ya lembe na lembe ya Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava eKapa kusuka hi ti1 kufika hi ti3 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: Njengosihlalo, iNingizimu Afrika izosingatha umhlangano wonyaka we-WWTG eKapa kusukela ngomhla lu-1 kuya kumhla zi-3 kuLwezi 2017.

src: Ntlawa lowu wu na xikongomelo xa ku fambisa bindzu ra matiko eka vhinyo hi ku tirhisa ku avelana vuxokoxoko, nkanelo wa swiphiqo swa malawulelo na swiendlo swa nhlanganelo swa ku susiwa ka swirhalanganyi swa mabindzu.
tgt: Iqoqo lihlose ukulawula ukuhwebelana kwamazwe ngamazwe ngewayini ngokusebenzisa ukwabelana ngolwazi, ukudingidwa kwezinkinga ngemithetho elawula emazweni akhiqiza nahweba ngewayini kanye nezindlela ezihlanganisiwe zokususwa kwezithiyo kwezohwebo.

src: Vahumesi lava tumbulukaka na tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe ta vumaki bya vhinyo ya Afrika-Dzonga va vuyeriwa kusuka eka vungheneri bya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Abakhiqizi abasafufusa kanye nezinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika ezithengisela amazwe angaphandle iwayini bayahlomula ngokuzibandakanya kweNingizimu Afrika Lokhu kunegalelo Ohlelweni Olunaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye kanye ne-NDP, ehlose ukuvuselela ezolimo kanye nohlelo lokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo.

src: Leswi swi hoxa xandla eka Kungu ra Timhaka ta Kaye na NDP, leswi swi lavaka ku pfuxeta vurimi na nkhuluko wa nkoka wa ku phurosesiwa ka swirin'wa.
tgt: Emkhakheni wezewayini, inhloso ukwandisa indawo ngokukhiqizwa kwewayini, ukwesekela abakhiqizi abasafufusa kanye namazwe ekungagxilwa kuwo ukuze kukhuliswe isamba somkhiqizo wewayini othunyelwa ngaphandle.

src: Eka sekitara ya vhinyo, xikongomelo i ku engetela ndhawu leyi nga ehansi ka vuhumesi bya vhinyo, ku seketela vahumesi va mpimo lowutsongo na ku pakanisa timakete to karhi eka ku kula ka tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe.
tgt: UMhlangano Waminyaka Yonke wesi-5 Wenhlangano i-ID4AFRICIKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukusingatha kweNingizimu Afrika uMhlangano Waminyaka Yonke Wesi-5 we-ID4Africa ngowezi-2019.

src: Nhlengeletano ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 5 ya Nhlangano wa ID4AFRICKhabinete yi pasisile ku rhurhela ka Afrika-Dzonga ka Nhlengeletano ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 5 ya Nhlangano wa ID4AFRICA hi lembe ra 2019.
tgt: I-ID4Africa uyinhlangano ehlanganisa inqwaba yababambiqhaza ekhuthaza ukulandelwa kwendlela yezobuchwepheshe yokuhola ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlalomnotho yase-Afrika ngokusobala nangendlela ebonakalisa ukukhathala.

src: ID4Africa i vandla ra vakhumbhekinyingi leri tlakusaka ku amukeriwa ka nkavuciva na loku nga na vutihlamuleri ka vutitivisi bya xidijiti eka ku fambisiwa ka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vanhu.
tgt: Inhloso ngezingxoxo ukuthuthukisa indlela okubhaliswa ngayo abantu kanye nendlela imininingo yezibalo eqoqwa, ididiyelwe futhi icutshungulwe ngayo, okwenza ababhali bemithetho bakwazi ukuthola ulwazi olungathenjwa.

src: Mikanelo yi ta lava ku antswisa ndlela ya ntsariso wa vaaki na ku va switiviwa swa tinhlayohlayo ta nkoka swi hlengeletiwa, swi fambelanisiwa na ku xopaxopiwa, ku endliwa vuxokoxoko byo tshembeka byi kumeka eka vaendli va tipholisi.
tgt: Ukusingatha lo mhlangano kuzosiza iNingizimu Afrika ukuze ibone ezinye izimpokophelo ze-NDP futhi ziqwashise ngokubaluleka kweqhingasu lezindlela zokuhlonza iNingizimu Afrika njengezindlela zokuqopha zobuchwepheshe ezisetshenziselwa izincwadi zokuvakashela kwamanye amazwe (amaphasiphothi) kanye namakhadi awumazisi akhiwe ngendlela yobuchwepheshe.

src: Ku rhurhela khonferense leyi swi ta pfuna Afrika-Dzonga ku humelerisa swin'wana swa swikongomelo swa NDP na ku tumbuluxa vulemukisi bya nkoka wa swa maqhinga wa tisisiteme ta vutitivisi bya Afrika-Dzonga to tanihi sisiteme yo rhekoda hi nkarhi wolowo ya phasipoto na makhadi ya mapasi (ID) lama hlayekaka hi khomphyuta.
tgt: Kuzophinde kube negalelo elihle ekubizeleni amanye amazwe asesifundeni ukuthi abone okuzuzwayo ngamakhadi awumazisi akhiwe ngendlela yobuchwepheshe.

src: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta rixaka.
tgt: Izibalo zobugebengu zikazwelonke.

src: Khabinete yi nyikiwile vuxokoxoko hi tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta rixaka eka nkarhi wa kusuka ti1 Dzivamisoko 2016 kufika ti 31 Nyenyankulu 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi laziswe ngezibalo zobugebengu kuzwelonke zesikhathi esisukela kumhla lu-1 kuMbasa kuya kumhla zingama-31 kuNdasa 2017.

src: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta lembe na lembe ti ta kotisa mfumo ku veka tihlo eka mipakaniso ya ku lwisana na vugevenga, tanihilaha swi hlamuseriweke hakona eka Rimba ra swa Maqhinga ra Theme ya le Xikarhi ra 2014-2019.
tgt: Izibalo zobugebengu zaminyaka yonke zisiza uhulumeni akwazi ukuqapha imigomo esemqoka yokulwa nobugebengu, njengoba imiswe kuHlaka Lokusebenza Kwesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTSF) lowezi-2014-2019.

src: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ti tirhisiwa tanihi endlelo ro tsundzuxa nkarhi wa ha ri kona ku tiyisa mitirho yo sivela vugevenga na maqhinga ya tindzawulo to hambanahambana.
tgt: Izibalo zobugebengu zisetshenziswa njengendlela yokuqwashisa kusanesikhathi ukuze kuqiniswe izinhlelo zokuvikela ubugebengu kanye namaqhingasu eminyango eyahlukene.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku humesiwa ka xiviko hi Holobye wa Maphorisa, Tat.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukuthi uNgqongqoshe uFikile Mbalula akhiphe umbiko.

src: Fikile Mbalula.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Ku Tlangeriwa ka Malembexidzana ya OR Tambo.
tgt: Umgubho Weminyaka Eyikhulu kwazalwa u-OR Tambo.

src: Khabinete ya tsaka leswaku malulamiselo ya ku tlangeriwa ka malembexidzana ya ku velekiwa ka OR Tambo ya le ka xiyimo xa le henhla naswona yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku titoloveta hi ndlela leyi yisaka emahlweni ndzhaka ya nhenha ya Nyimpi, xiave lexi a xi tekeke eka ntshuxeko wa hina, na mikhuvanene ya yena leya ha hi letelaka ni namuntlha.
