tgt: Utshalomali.

src: Khabinete yi amukela vuvekisi bya R3 wa tibiliyoni ku suka eka Khamphani ya Mimovha ya Ford ku ya eka Feme ya le Silverton, ePitori, Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyaluthokozela utshalomali olungumabhiliyoni amarandi amathathu olufakwe yiNkampani Yezimoto yakwa-Ford esiKhungweni esakha izimoto sase-Silverton, ePitoli esifundazweni saseGauteng.

src: Vuvekisi lebyi byi ta vuyerisa hi ku tumbuluxa mitirho yo kongoma na yo ka yi nga kongomi hikokwalaho ka ku languteriwa ka ntlakuko wa andziso wa modele ya wona ya Ford Ranger.
tgt: Lolu tshalomali luzoholela ekutheni kudaleke amathuba omsebenzi kulesi Sikhungo nakwamanye amabhizisi esisebenzisana nawo njengoba kulindeleke ukuba ukhule umkhiqizo wohlobo lwemoto yale nkampani olubizwa nge-Ford Ranger.

src: Vuvekisi byolebyo byi tiyisisa ntirho lowu hi ya ka emahlweni hi wu endla tanihi mfumo eku kuriseni ka ikhonomi na le ku lulamiseni ka mitlhontlho ya vupfumalantirho.
tgt: Utshalomali olunjengalolu luwubufakazi bomsebenzi esilokhu siqhubekile nokuwenza njengohulumeni ngenhloso yokukhulisa umnotho kanye nokubhekana ngqo nezinselele zokuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Hi ku tirhisa xikimi xa xinavetisi xa mfumo xa R.8 wa tibiliyoni eka Phurogireme ya Nhluvukiso na Andziso wa vumaki bya Mimovha, R.5 wa tibiliyoni ta vuvekisi byo ka byi nga ri bya mfumo byi humesiwile.
tgt: Ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lukahulumeni oludle amabhiliyoni ayi-7.3 wamarandi lwemihlomulo yokukhuthaza utshalomali olubizwa ngoHlelo Lokukhiqizwa Kwezimoto Nokuthuthukiswa Komkhakha Wezimoto sekufake utshalomali olungamabhiliyoni angama-28.5 wamarandi oluvela kubatshalizimali abazimele.

src: Lebyi byi katsa xitiviso hi Toyota ku endla timodele ta vona tintshwa ta Toyota Hilux na Fortuner tanihi xiphemu xa vuvekisi bya R.1 wa tibiliyoni.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya nesimemezelo esenziwe yinkampani yakwa-Toyota sokwakhiwa kohlobo olusha lwe-Toyota Hilux ne-Fortuner njengengxenye yotshalomali olungamabhiliyoni ayi-6.1 wamarandi.

src: Nakambe, BMW yi kunguhata ku aka garaji yo lungisela mimovha ya ximanguva lawa ya R6 wa tibiliyoni.
tgt: Inkampani yakwa-BMW nayo ihlela ukwakha isikhungo sikanokusho sezingxenye zokwakha imizimba yezimoto esizodla imali engamarandi angamabhiliyoni ayisithupha.

src: Khamphani ya Matiko hinkwawo ya Mimovha ya le Beijing yi kunguhata ku vekisa R11 wa tibiliyoni eka feme ya vumaki bya mimovha eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Inkampani yezomoto i-Beijing Automobile International Corporation ihlela ukutshala imali engamabhiliyoni ayi-11 wamarandi esikhungweni esakha izimoto eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Nguva ya Xibalo ya 2017.
tgt: Isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela sowezi-2017.

src: Khabinete yi hundzisela ku khensa eka vahakeri va xibalo hinkwavo lava se va tlheriseke tifomo to hlela xikweleti xa vona xa xibalo ta lembe ra xibalo ra 2016/17.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabonga kakhulu kubo bonke abakhokhi bentela asebewathumelile amafomu abo entela onyaka wentela wezi-2016/17.

src: Mali leyi nga hlengeletiwa ku suka eka xibalo yi tiyisisa leswaku mfumo wu na vuswikoti byo nyika vukorhokeri lebyi laveka swinene na nseketelo wa vanhu eka timiliyoni ta MaAfrika-Dzonga lama pfumalaka.
tgt: Imali eyingenisonzuzo etholakele ekukhokhweni kwentela iyaqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni uba namandla okuhlinzeka ngezidingo nezinsizakalo zomphakathi kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abantulayo abayizigidi ngezigidi.

src: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa vahakeri va xibalo leswaku siku ro pfala ku rhumela i Ravuntlhanu 24 Hukuri 2017 na ku va khutaza ku rhumela tifomo to hlela xikweleti xa vona xa xibalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabakhumbuza abakhokhi bentela ukuthi usuku olungumnqamulajuqu wokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela nguLwesihlanu mhla zingama-24 kuLwezi 2017 futhi liyabakhuthaza ukuba bathumele amafomu abo entela.

src: Nhlengeletano yo Sungula ya laha Kaya ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi (LED) ya Rixaka.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yokuqala Kazwelonke Yezokuthuthukiswa Kweminotho Yohulumeni Bezindawo (i-LED).

src: Khabinete ya tsaka hi mivuyelo ya Nhlengeletano ya LED ya Rixaka leyi ya ha ku va ka kona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayithokozela kakhulu imiphumela yeNgqungquthela ye-LED ebanjwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule.

src: A yi khomiwile ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu, Tat.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yabanjwa ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNgqongqoshe Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana Nezindaba Zendabuko, uMnu Des van Rooyen kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane, uNkz Lindiwe Zulu.

src: Des van Rooyen na Holobye wa Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo, Man.
tgt: Yahlinzeka ngethuba lokwakhiwa kwe-ajenda entsha yezokuThuthukiswa Kweminotho Yohulumeni Bezindawo eNingizimu Afrika ngokuholwa yizinto ezibekwe eqhulwini oHlelweni Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).

src: Yi nyikile xivandlanene xo tumbuluxa ajenda yintshwa ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ku leteriwa hi swirhangana swa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka (NDP).
tgt: Imiphumela yale ngqungquthela ibandakanya nokwethulwa koMkhandlu wokuqala waseNingizimu Afrika Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho (i-EDCSA), okuhloswe ngawo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umkhakha wezomnotho usebenza ngobungoti nangobunyoninco.

src: Mivuyelo ya yona yi katsa ku simekiwa ka Huvo ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga (EDCSA) yo sungula, loku kongomisaka eka ku endla sekithara ya nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi yi va ya xiphurofexinali.
tgt: Njengomgwamanda wochwepheshe, i-EDCSA izolawula futhi iqaphe ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi abaningi balo mkhakha ababambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zentuthuko ezihlukahlukene.

src: Tanihi nhlangano wa xiphurofexini, EDCSA yi ta fambisa na ku landzelerisa matikhomelo ya xiphurofexini ya vatirhi vo tala lava nghenelelaka eka mapfhumba ya nhluvukiso wo hambana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuphawulile futhi nokwethulwa okuyingqophamlando kweViki Lomhlaba Jikelele Lezokusungulwa Nokuqhutshwa Komsebenzi Webhizinisi (i-GEW) elethulwe e-22 on Sloane, okuwuphiko lokuphenjwa nokusungulwa kwamabhizinisi, lapho uNgqongqoshe uZulu wabe esingethe khona ingqalabutho yezamabizinisi emhlabeni jikelele u-Sir Richard Branson.

src: Khamphasi i yo sungula ku pfuriwa hi Netiweke ya Vubindzunyingi bya Matiko hinkwawo.
tgt: Lolu phiko lungolokuqala ngqa oluvulwe yiNhlangano Yezokusungulwa Nokuqhutshwa Komsebenzi Webhizinisi Emhlabeni Jikelele (i-Global Entrepreneurship Network).

src: Yi nyika vukorhokeri bya nseketelo wa nkoka na ku kongoma eka van'wamabindzu eAfrika hinkwaro xikan'we na mfikelelo eka netiweke ya matiko hinkwawo ya valanguteri, vavekisi na mihlangano ya nseketelo ya van'wamabindzu.
tgt: Ihlinzeka ngqo ngezinsizakalo zokweseka osomabhizinisi futhi lubahlinzeke nangezinsizakalo ezitholakala nge-inthanethi kwi-Afrika yonkana futhi kusenjalo ihlinzeka nangethuba lokuxhumana nokusebenzisana nabaqeqeshi bezebhizinisi emhlabeni jikelele, kanye nabatshalizimali nezinhlangano ezeseka umsebenzi wokusungulwa nokuqhutshwa kwamabhizinisi.

src: Hi nkarhi wa GEW, kwalomu ka 10 wa timiliyoni ta vangheneleri va teke xiave eka mikhuvo, migingiriko na miphikizano ya 35 000 eka matiko yo tlula 165 emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Ngenkathi kubanjwe i-GEW, bayizigidi eziyi-10 ababambiqhaza abazibandakanya emicimbini, ezinhlelweni kanye nasemincintiswaneni eyizi-35 000 emazweni angaphezu kwe-165 emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Xiviko xa Khomixini ya Heher.
tgt: Umbiko Wekhomishana ka-Heher.

src: Khabinete yi xiyaxile ku humesiwa hi Musumbhunuku, 13 Hukuri 2017 ka Xiviko xa Khomixini ya Vulavisisi eka ku Koteka ka ku endla Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri yi va Mahala eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukukhishwa, ngoMsumbuluko mhla ziyi-13 kuLwezi 2017, koMbiko Wekhomishana Yophenyo Mayelana Nokuthi Kungalunga Yini Ukuhlinzekwa Mahhala Kwemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqeshwa eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku hlaya xiviko na switandzhaku swa xona eka tiko loko mfumo wa ha anakanyisisa swibumabumelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bawufakele izibuko lo mbiko kanye nemithelela yawo ezweni, ngenkathi uhulumeni esacubungula izincomo zawo.

src: Phuresidente u ta endla xitiviso xa xiviko hi ku famba ka nkarhi endzhaku ka ku langutisisiwa hi Komiti ya Vaholobye eka ku Hakelela Dyondzo ya le Henhla na hi Komiti ya swa xibalo ya Phuresidente.
tgt: UMongameli uzokwenza isimemezelo mayelana nalo mbiko ngokuhamba kwesikhathi emva kokuba sewucutshungulwe ngokuphelele yiKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene kanye neKomidi LikaMongameli Lezezimali.

src: Mfumo wu tshama wu tibohile ku ololoxa swirhalanganyi swa ku fikelela dyondzo ya le henhla, na ku langutela emahlweni ku hetisisa xintshuxo xa nkarhi wo leha xa ku hakelela dyondzo ya le henhla.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu ezimisele ukususa izithiyo nemigoqo evimbela ukufinyeleleka kwemfundo ephakeme, futhi uphokophele ekutholeni isixazululo esisimeme sokuxhaswa kwemfundo ephakeme ngezimali.

src: Dyandza.
tgt: Isomiso.

src: Xiyimo xa madamu sweswi etikweni xi tshama xi hi vilerisa tanihileswi ku nga na ku phya ko tala ku tlula mpfula.
tgt: Umthamo wamanzi akhona njengamanje emadanyini akuleli usalokhu uyinto ekhathazayo impela njengoba umhwamuko owenzekayo emadanyini ungaphezulu kwemvula esiyitholayo ezweni.

src: Mhaka ya leswaku Afrika-Dzonga a ri si kuma mpfula leyi ringaneke ku tatisa nakambe swihlovo swa mati swa hina ku fikela tilevhele leti ringaneleke swi vula leswaku tiko a ri si huma eka xiyimo xa dyandza.
tgt: Njengoba iNingizimu Afrika ingakayitholi imvula eyanele ezokhuphula umthamo wamanzi emadanyini ethu ukuze ufinyelele emazingeni agculisayo lokho kusho ukuthi izwe lethu alikaphumi neze esimweni esibi sokukhahlanyezwa yisomiso.

src: Ku vhumbiwa leswaku tiko ri ta kuma ntsena mpfula yo tala ku suka emasungulweni ya Sunguti 2018.
tgt: Izangoma zezulu zibikezela ukuthi leli lizwe liyoze liqale ngasekuqaleni kukaMasingana wezi-2018 ukuthola ingxenye enkulu yemvula okumele liyithole.

src: Khabinete yi navelela ku tiyisisa vaaki leswaku mfumo wa tiko, wa swifundzankulu na muganga, yi le ku tirhisaneni ku tiyisisa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga a ri heleriwi hi mati.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithanda ukuqinisekisa umphakathi ukuthi uhulumeni kazwelonke, kanye nohulumeni bezifundazwe nabezindawo basebenza ngokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ayiphelelwa ngamanzi.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza un'wana na un'wana ku teka xiave eku hlayiseni na le ku tirhiseni ka mati hi vutlharhi naswona hi matsanana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa umuntu wonke ukuba adlale indima yakhe ngokuthi awonge amanzi, awasebenzise ngobuhlakani futhi angawasaphazi.

src: Zimbabwe.
tgt: Eziphathelene nelizwe laseZimbabwe.

src: Khabinete yi seketela ku nghenelela hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma, eka ntirho wa yena tanihi Mutshamaxitulu wa Muganga wa Nhluvukiso wa Matiko ya le Dzongeni wa Afrika (SADC) hi ku angula eka xiyimo xa MaZimbabwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayeseka imizamo kaMongameli Jacob Zuma, esebenzisa isikhundla sakhe njengoSihlalo WeNhlangano Yokuthuthukiswa Kwamazwe aseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SADC) yokuxazulula impicabadala yesimo esimanzonzo esiqhubekayo njengamanje kwelaseZimbabwe.

src: U rhumerile Varhumiwa vo Hlawuleka, Holobye wa Vusirheleri na Khale ka Masocha, Man.
tgt: UMongameli usethumele iziThunywa Ezikhethekile kwelaseZimbabwe, okunguNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela Nomakadebona Bezempi, uNkz Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezobunhloli u-Adv Bongani Bongo.

src: Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula na Holobye wa Xiyenge xa Vuhlayiseki bya Tiko, Adv Bongani Bongo.
tgt: Lezi zithunywa kulindeleke ukuba zibambe umhlangano noMongameli Robert Mugabe kanye noMbutho Wezokuvikela waseZimbabwe.

src: Va ta hlangana na Phuresidente Robert Mugabe na Vuthu ra Vusirheleri ra le Zimbabye.
tgt: Emva kwalokho zizokwethula umbiko wazo phambi kuMongameli wase-Angola u-João Lourenço onguSihlalo Wophiko lwe-SADC Olwengamele Ezopolitiki, Ezokukuvikela, kanye Nezokuvikeleka.

src: Hofisi ya Phuresidente yi ta tivisa leswi ya ka emahlweni eka mhaka leyi.
tgt: IHhovisi likaMongameli lizoqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwakamuva mayelana nalolu daba.

src: Square Kilometre Array (SKA).
tgt: Isibonakude i-Square Kilometre Array (i-SKA).

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku humelela ka nhluvukiso wa vanhu na wa ikhonomi loku kumekeke ku suka eka vuvekisi lebyi a byi kongomiwile eka nhluvukiso wa vanhu eka rhijini ya SKA ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyazithokozela izimpumelelo kanye nemihlomulo yezomnotho neyezenhlalo yomphakathi okuzuzwe kutshalomali olugxile ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi esifundeni esakhelene nendawo okwakhiwe kuyona isibonakude se-SKA eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Miganga leyi nga kusuhi na ndhawu SKA yi ya emahlweni yi vuyeriwa hi tiphurojeke ta dyondzo na vuleteri to antswa, vuvekisi eka mabindzu lamatsongo na ku tlakuka ka swivandlanene swa mitirho.
tgt: Imiphakathi eyakhelene nendawo okwakhiwe kuyona i-SKA iyaqhubeka nokuhlomula ngokuthola imfundo engcono nemiklamo yokuqeqeshwa, ukutshalwa kwezimali emabhinisini amancane kanye nokukhula kwezinga lokuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji, ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Sayense na Thekinoloji, Man.
tgt: UMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe, ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNkz Naledi Pandor, uzosingatha uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza nokubandakanywa komphakathi ngenhloso yokugubha nokubungaza izimpumelelo zohlelo lwe-SKA nemiphakathi yase-Carnarvon namaphethelo, esifundazweni saseNyakatho Kapa kusukela mhla ziyi-16 kuze kube ngumhla ziyi-19 kuLwezi 2017.Izinqumo Zekhabhinethi.

src: Naledi Pandor, yi ta va na nongonoko wa ku nghenelela ka vaaki ku tlangela ku humelela na miganga ya le kusuhi na le Carnarvon, eKapa-N'walungu ku suka hi ti 16 ku fika hi ti 19 Hukuri 2017.Swibohonkulu swa Khabinete.
tgt: Imibiko yokusebenza yenqubekelaphambili eyenziwe yiminyango kahulumeni ngekota yesibili yowezi-2017/1.

src: Swiviko swa ku humelela swa kotara ya vumbirhi hi matirheloswa 2017/1.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlinzekwe ngolwazi mayelana nemibiko yokusebenza yenqubekelaphambili eyenziwe yiminyango kahulumeni ngekota yesibili yowezi-2017/18 (uNtulikazi kuya kuMandulo 2017) eyethulwe ngamaqoqwana eminyango kahulumeni womahlanu.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi swiviko swa ku humelela swa kotara ya vumbirhi hi matirhelo swa 2017/18 (Mawuwana ku fika Ndzati 2017) hi mitlawa hinkwayo ya ntlhanu.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yomsebenzi weKhabhinethi obanzi wokuqapha nokuhlola uHlelo Lokusebenza olususelwe oHlakeni Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTSF) lowezi-2014 kuya kowezi-2019.

src: Leswi swi vumba xiphemu xa nandzeleriso na nkambelo wo angarhela wa Khabinete wa Phurogireme ya Nghingiriko lowu kumekeke ku suka eka Rimba ra swa Maqhinga ra Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi (MTSF) wa 2014 ku fika 2019.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuhlela, Ukuqapha kanye Nokuhlola kanye namakomidi amaQoqwana Ongqongqoshe bazobamba izithangami zabezindaba lapho bezohlinzeka khona ngolwazi oluphathelene nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe okukhulunywa ngayo kule mibiko.

src: Ndzawulo ya Makunguhatelo, Kambisisa Matirhelo no Hlela na Tikomiti ta Tlawa wa Vaholobye va ta fambisa mbhurisano na vuhangalasi bya mahungu ku hlamusela hi xitalo ku humelela ka swiviko leswi.
tgt: Uphiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokuhlinzeka Ngolwazi (i-GCIS) luzolawula futhi luhole lezi zithangami zabezindaba futhi uhlelo lokubanjwa kwalezi zithangami luzoshicilelwa WEBTOKEN ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

src: GCIS yi ta fambisa mbhurisano na vuhangalasamahungunyingi na ku hangalasa xedulu eka WEBTOKEN hi ku famba ka nkarhi.
tgt: Ulwazi lwakamuva mayelana nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe ekuthungathweni nasekuhlonzweni kwamakheli abavoti.

src: Ku antswisiwa ka pfhumba ra makumelo ya kherefu na manyikelo ya tikherefu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko mayelana nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe ekufezekisweni komyalelo wesiNqumo Senkantolo Yomthethosisekelo wokuhlinzekwa kwamakheli aqondile emqulwini woluhlu lwabavoti.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi xiviko xa nhluvukiso eka masimekelo ya Maavanyiselo ya Khoto ya Vumbiwa ku nyika tikherefu eka rhijisitara ra vavhoti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuthokozele ukuthotshelwa ngokuphelele kwemibiko ekhishwa njalo emva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha ethunyelwa eNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo.

src: Khabinete yi tsakisiwile hi ku landzelela ko helela ka swiviko swa nhluvukiso swa le ndzhaku ka tin'hweti tin'wana na tin'wana ta tsevu leswi rhumeriweke eka Khoto ya Vumbiwa.
tgt: Kuze kube manje iKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele (i-IEC), ngokusebenzisana nezinye izikhungo zombuso, seyizuze impumelelo ecishe ibe ngama-75% ekuqoqweni kwamakheli abantu abafanele ukuvota.

src: Ku fikela sweswi Khomixini ya Nhlawulo yo Tiyimela (IEC), hi ku tirhisana na tiejensi tin'wana ta mfumo, yi kumile ku humelela ka kwalomu ka 75% eku hlengeleteni ka tikherefu ta lava va nga tshukaka va ri vavhoti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lahlinzekwa futhi nangolwazi mayelana nohlelo oluhlongozwayo lokuba i-SAPO ilekelele labo abangenawo amakheli aqondile endawo abahlala kuyona.

src: Khabinete yi tsakisiwile hi nhluvukiso na ku tirhisana loku endliweke hi SAPO, na IEC tiejensi tin'wana ta mfumo eku nyikeni ka phurojeke ya tikherefu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayithokozela impela inqubekelaphambili kanye nomsebenzi omuhle wokubambisana kwe-SAPO, i-IEC kanye nezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni emklamweni wokuhlonzwa nokunikezwa kwamakheli abavoti aqondile.

src: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi kombela volavo va nga si antswisaka tikherefu ta vona ku endla tano hi nkarhi lowu taka wa vhiki ra ntsariso wa vavhoti hi Nyenyankulu.
tgt: Futhi iKhabhinethi liyabanxusa labo abangakahlinzeki ngemininingwane yakamuva yamakheli abo ukuba benze njalo ngeviki elilandelayo lokubhaliswa kwabavoti elizobanjwa ngoNdasa 2018.Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Nhlengeletano ya vumune ya Khomixini ya Matikomambirhi ya Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana (BNC).
tgt: Isigcawu Sesine SeKhomishana Yobambiswano Phakathi KweNingizimu Afrika neBotswana (i-BNC).

src: Phuresidente Zuma u ta sungula riendzo ra ntirho ku nghenelela na ku rhangela Nhlengeletano ya Vumune ya Matikomambirhi ya Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana BNC leyi nga ta khomeriwa eGaborone, eBotswana hi Ravuntlhanu, 17 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzobamba uhambo olusemthethweni oluya eBotswana lapho ezoba ngomunye woSihlalo ababambisene besiGcawu Sesine SeKhomishana Yobambiswano Phakathi KweNingizimu Afrika neBotswana esizobanjelwa edolobheni laseGaborone, eBotswana ngoLwesihlanu, mhla ziyi-17 kuLwezi 2017.

src: Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana ya hlangana lembe na lembe eka levhele ya Tihloko ta Matiko eka rimba ra BNC ku xopaxopa ntirhisano wa matiko ha vumbirhi na ku kanela timhaka ta ntsakelo wo fana.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika neBotswana babamba umhlangano njalo ngonyaka ezingeni leziNhloko Zemibuso ngaphansi kohlaka lwe-BNC ukuzobuyekeza ubambiswano phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili futhi baxoxisane nangezindaba ezithinta lawa mazwe womabili.

src: Matiko lamambirhi ya tiphina hi vuxaka bya xinghana lebyi vumbiweke hi ku hlangana ka swa mfuwo na ku va kusuhi na ku kusuhi.
tgt: Lawa mazwe amabili anobudlelwane obuhle obususelwa kubudlelwane bezamasiko obukhona phakathi kwezakhamizi zalawa mazwe futhi obuqiniswa nawukuthi lawa mazwe angomakhelwane.

src: Ya tirhisana eka timhaka to talanyana leti katsaka, vutleketli, bindzu na vuvekisi, rihanyu, timhaka ta swa mbango sw. sw. Afrika-Dzonga hi rin'wana ra vatirhisani va bindzu lavakulu va Botswana, ku na tikhamphani to hlaya ta Afrika-Dzonga ti nga ri tingani leti tirhaka eka tiko rero.
tgt: Lawa mazwe asebenza ngokubambisana emikhakheni eminingana kubandakanya ezokuthutha, ezohwebo nokutshalwa kwezimali, ezempilo, izindaba zezemvelo, njll.

src: Riendzo ra Phuresidente wa Angola.
tgt: Uhambo Lokuvakashela kukaMongameli wase-Angolan kuleli.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u ta rhurhela Muchaviseki, Phuresidente wa Riphabliki ra Angola, João Lourenço, eka Riendzo ra Mfumo ra matimu eAfrika-Dzonga ku suka hi ti 23 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzosingatha uMongameli wase-Angola, uMhlonishwa u-João Lourenço, ohambweni lwakhe lokuvakashela kuleli oluyingqophamlando kusukela mhla zingama-23 kuLwezi 2017.

src: Leri ku ta va ku ri Riendzo ra Mfumo ra yena ro sungula etikweni ra hina endzhaku ka loko a vekiwile exitulwini.
tgt: Lolu hambo wuhambo lwakhe lokuqala ngqa lokuvakashela eNingizimu Afrika emva kokubekwa kwakhe esihlalweni sokuba nguMongameli wase-Angola.

src: Matiko lamambirhi ya na ku hlangana ka xinghana na ka matimu kusukela eka masiku ya ku lwela ntshuxeko loko Anglola ri rhurhele na ku seketela tinhenha ta ku lwela ntshuxeko ta Afrika-Dzonga eka tikamba to hambanahambana etikweni leriya.
tgt: Lawa mazwe amabili anobudlelwane obuhle obasungulwa kudala ngezinsuku zomzabalazo wenkululeko lapho izwe lase-Angola lakhoselisa futhi lasekela izishoshovu zomzabalazo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezinkanjini ezihlukahlukene ezweni lase-Angola.

src: Ntirhisano wa ikhonomi na bindzu exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi wu kurile swinene, ku fikela laha Afrika-Dzonga ri nga muringani wa bindzu wo rhanga wa Angola eka tikonkulu.
tgt: Selukhule kakhulu uhwebo nobambiswano phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili, kangangokuthi iNingizimu Afrika isiyizwe elikleliswe endaweni yokuqala kumazwe ahwebelana ne-Angola kuleli zwekazi.

src: Tikhamphani ta Afrika-Dzonga to tala ti le ku endleni ka bindzu eAngola eka tisekitara to hambanahambana ku katsa na vuako, migodi, tindlu, nxaviso xin'wexin'we, swakudya na swakunwa, tihotela na ku tiphina, vukorhokeri bya swa vutshunguri na byo banga.
tgt: Ziningi izinkampani zakuleli ezenza ibhizinisi e-Angola, emikhakheni ehlukahlukene kubandakanya umkhakha wezokwakha, ezolimo, ezezindlu, ezokuthengiswa kwempahla, ezokudla neziphuzo, ezamahhotela nokuvakasha, ezamabhange kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha.

src: Hi nkarhi wa riendzo ra yena, Phuresidente Lourençou u ta tlhela a fambisa Dyondzo hi Ravuntlhanu, 24 Hukuri 2017 eka Muako wa OR Tambo ePitori.
tgt: Ohambeni lwakhe kuleli, uMongameli Lourenço uzokwethula nesiFundo ngoLwesihlanu mhla ziyi-24 kuLwezi e-OR Tambo Building ePitoli.

src: Masiku ya 16 ya ku Lwisana na madzolonga.
tgt: Umkhankaso Wezinsuku Eziyi-16 Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane.

src: Khabinete yi hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo lawa ya teka goza ro lwa na ku xanisiwa ka vavasati na vana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela nabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu asebethathe isinqumo sokubhukula balwisane noxhashazwa kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na Madzolonga ehenhla ka Vavasati na Vana ri ta va kona exikarhi ka ti 25 Hukuri na 10 N'wendzamhala 2017.
tgt: Umkhankaso Wezinsuku Eziyi-16 Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane uzobanjwa kusukela mhla zingama-25 kuLwezi kuze kube ngumhla ziyi-10 kuZibandlela 2017.

src: Leri i lembe ra vu 19 ra pfhumba eAfrika-Dzonga naswona ri ta ya emahlweni ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Na Mina Ndzi Hlaye: Swin'we hi Yisa Emahlweni Afrika-Dzonga ro Pfumala Madzolonga”.
tgt: Lona ngunyaka we-19 kuqhutshwa lo mkhankaso eNingizimu Afrika futhi uzoqhubeka ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ngibale Nami: Sisonke Siqhubezela Phambili iNingizimu Afrika Engenalo Udlame”.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u ta simeka pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na madzolonga eKapa Vuxa hi Mugqivela, 25 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzokwethula umkhankaso Wezinsuku eziyi-16 Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane eMpumalanga Kapa ngoMgqibelo mhla ziyi-25 kuLwezi 2017.

src: Ri ta kongomisa eka ku yisiwa emahlweni ka ku sunguriwa ka n'wangulano wa Rixaka, leyi khutazaka vanhu ku vulavula hi mayelana na ntungu wa madzolonga ya ku ya hi rimbewu.
tgt: Umkhankaso uzogxila ekuqalisweni ngokuqhubekayo kweziNkulumo-mpendulwano Zikazwelonke, ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba baxoxisane ngesihlava sodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane.

src: Leswi swi ta landzeriwa hi Siku ra Vavanuna ra Matiko hinkwawo hi Sonto, 19 Hukuri 2017, leri rhambaka vavanuna ku tlanga xiphemu xa vona eku akeni muganga lowu hlayisekeke na vun'we bya vanhu.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwandulelwa wuSuku Lwabesilisa oluzogujwa ngeSonto, mhla ziyi-19 kuLwezi 2017, lapho kunxuswa khona amadoda ukuba adlale indima yawo ekwakheni umphakathi ophephile futhi obumbene.

src: Ndzawulo ya Vululami na Nhluvukiso wa Vumbiwa yi ta fambisa pfhumba ra rhadiyo ra muganga ra vumbirhi ehansi ka minongonoko ya A hi Vulavuleni ku Lulama, leri tisaka vukorhokeri bya mfumo eka vanhu hi ku nyika vayingiseri nkateko wo tihlanganisa na vaofisiri eka timhaka leti nga emahungwini.
tgt: UMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo uzoqhuba umkhankaso wesibili wochungechunge lomsakazo olubizwa ngokuthi: Let’s Talk Justice, okuwumkhankaso oletha izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kubantu ngokuhlinzeka abalaleli ngethuba lokuxhumana nokufakana imilomo nezikhulu zikahulumeni ngezindaba ezisematheni.

src: Ku simekiwa ka Khoto ya Milandzu ya swa Masangu hi nkarhi wa pfhumba ku ta tlhela ku tiyisisa mfikelelo wo antswa eka sisiteme ya vululami.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kweNkantolo Yamacala Ezocansi ngenkathi kuqhutshwa lo mkhankaso nakho kuzoqinisekisa ukufinyeleleka kangcono kohlelo lwezobulungiswa.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku hi ku tirhisana hi nga herisa ndzhendzheleko wa nxaniso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakholelwa ukuthi ngokusebenza ngokubambisana singasiqeda nya isihlava sokuxhashazwa kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Hi ku hlangana ka matshalatshala ya hina hi nga tirha ku sivela nxaniso loko hi karhi hi tiyisisa muganga lowu hlayisekeke eka vamanana na vana.
tgt: Ngokubambisana sonke singabhukula sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuvimbela ukuxhashazwa nokuhlukunyezwa futhi ngalokho siqinisekise ukuthi abesifazane nezingane baphila emphakathini ophephile.

src: Vanhu hinkwavo eAfrika-Dzonga va khutaziwa ku ambala rhibono yo basa tanihi mfungho wa ku tiboha ku herisa ntungu lowu ku suka emigangeni ya hina.
tgt: Bayanxuswa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bagqoke amaribhoni amhlophe njengophawu lokuzibophezela nokuthembisa ukuthi bazokwenza imizamo yokuqeda lesi sihlava emphakathini wethu.

src: Ku lunghiselela Siku ra AIDS ra Misava 2016.
tgt: Amalungiselelo Aphokophele oSukwini Lwengculazi Lomhlaba Jikelele.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vaaki hinkwavo ku nghenelela eka ku sunguriwa ka Ravuntlhanu ra Rhibono yo Tshuka loko ku nga si fika Siku ra AIDS ra Misava hi ti1 N'wendzamhala na ku ya fika emahelweni ya n'hweti yoleyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa bonke abantu emphakathini ukuba babambe iqhaza emkhankasweni wokugqoka amaRibhoni Abomvu njalo ngoLwesihlanu, ngenjoba siphokophele emgubhweni woSuku Lwengculazi (i-Aids) Lomhlaba Jikelele mhla lu-1 kuZibandlela, ozoqhubeka kuze kuphele inyanga kaZibandlela.

src: Ku ambala rhibono yo tshuka i mfungho wa vun'we na ku tiboha ku lwa na HIV na AIDSiku ra AIDS ra Misava i nkateko eka muganga wun'wana na wun'wana ku hlangana eka ku lwa na HIV, ku kombisa nseketelo eka vanhu lava hanyaka na HIV na ku tsundzuka lava hundzeke emisaveni.
tgt: Ukugqoka iribhoni ebomvu wuphawu lokuzwelana nokuzibophezela ekulwisaneni neGciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) ne-Aidsi.

src: Nkhuvo wa lembe leri wu ta endliwa ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Mfanelo ya Mina ku Tiva Xiyimo xa Mina, Nsivelo I Vutihlamuleri bya Mina”, lowu khomanaka na nkongomelo wa matiko hinkwawo: “Mfanelo eka Rihanyu”.
tgt: USuku Lwengculazi Lomhlaba Jikelele luhlinzeka ngethuba lokuba yonke imiphakathi ibumbane empini yokulwisana ne-HIV, futhi ikhombise ukweseka abantu abaphila ne-HIV futhi ikhumbule nalabo asebedlulile emhlabeni.

src: Leswi swi tiyisisa nsimeko wa Kungu ra swa Maqhinga ra HIV ya Rixaka ra Afrika-Dzonga, vuvabyi bya rifuva na Mavabyi ya Ntlulelo wa swa Masangu 2017 - 2022 (NSP), leswi ku nga phuphu ya nkoka eka nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga ku yisa eku fikeleleni nhlayiso wa rihanyu wa misava hinkwayo hilaha swi kombisiweke hakona eka NDP, leswi tlakusaka rixaka leri hanyeke kahle, ro tiya na ku va na ndzingano swinene.
tgt: Umcimbi walo nyaka uzobanjwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: Ilungelo Lami Lokwazi Isimo Sami Se-HIV, Ukuvimbela i-HIV Kungumsebenzi Wami”, okuyisiqubulo esixhumene nesomhlaba jikelele esithi: Ilungelo Lokuhlinzekwa Ngezinsizakalo Zezempilo”.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba miganga ku nghenela ku nghenelela eka Vhiki ro Kongomisa eka Imbizo ya Rixaka ya vu 7 leyi taka, leri ehleketeleriwaka ku va kona ku sukela hi ti 27 Hukuri ku ya fika hi ti3 N'wendzamhala 2017.
tgt: Lokhu kuqinisa ukuqaliswa koHlelo Lokusebenza lweNingizimu Afrika Lokulwisana ne-HIV, Isifo Sofuba (i-TB) kanye Nezifo Ezithathelwana Ngokocansi lowezi-2017 - 2022 (i-NSP), oluyinsika esemqoka kakhulu kwinqubekelaphambili yeNingizimu Afrika ephokophele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi bonke abantu bahlinzekwa ngosizo lwezempilo olusezingeni elifanele njengoba lokhu kubekwe ngokucacile ku-NDP, okuwuhlelo lukazwelonke olugqugquzela isizwe esingumqemane, esinamandla futhi esihlinzekwa ngezinsizakalo ngendlela elinganayo.

src: Ehansi ka vurhangeri bya GCIS, ndlela leyi yi tlakusa n’wangulano exikarhi ka Swirho swa Huvonkulu na miganga.
tgt: Ngaphansi kobuholi be-GCIS, lesi sigcawu sigqugquzela ukuxhumana ngenkuthalo phakathi kwamalungu esiGungu Seziphathimandla kanye nemiphakathi.

src: Yi ta va kona eka rimba ra malembe xidzana ya Oliver Reginald Tambo, loyi a seketeleke ndzingano wa rimbewu.
tgt: Iviki lalo nyaka lizokwenzeka onyakeni womgubho weminyaka eyikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-Oliver Reginald Tambo, isishoshovu esabe silwela ukulingana phakathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane.

src: Migingiriko yi kongomisiwe ku seketela pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na madzolonga.
tgt: Imicimbi nezinhlelo ezizokwenziwa ngaleli viki kuhloswe ngakho ukusekela umkhankaso wesiNsuku eziyi-16 Zokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane.

src: Mikhuvo yi ta vekiwa eka khalendara ya rixaka na ku averiwa eka webusayiti ya mfumo (WEBTOKEN).Milawumbisi.
tgt: Imininingwane yemicimbi ezobanjwa ngaleli viki izofakwa ohlwini lwezinto ezizokwenziwa yizwe bese ishicilelwa kwiwebhusayithi kahulumeni (WEBTOKEN).Imithethosivivinywa.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile nkandziyiso wa xitiviso hi ku ya hi xiyenge xa 74(5) xa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa kwesaziso esikhishwe ngokwesigaba 74(5) soMthethosisekelo WeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996.

src: Xikongomelo i ku sungula endlelo ro tihlanganisa ra xifundzankulu na ra rixaka hi swikongomelo swo endla ku cinca eka mindzilekana ya xifundzankulu hi mayelana na Masipala wa Muganga wa Matatiele eKapa-Vuxa na tindhawu tin'wana ta Ba Ga Mothibi eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu.
tgt: Inhloso yalokhu wukuqalisa inqubo yokubonisana kazwelonke kanye neyezifundazwe mayelana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinguquko ezenziwe emingceleni yezifundazwe eziphathelene noMasipala Wendawo WaseMatatiele eMpumalanga Kapa kanye nezindawo ezithile e-Ba Ga Mothibi esifundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Ntshuxeko lowu languteriweke wa mindzilekana ya swifundzankulu wu sukela eka miganga ya tindhawu leti ku vulavuriwaka hatona leyi lavaka ku rhurhisiwa ku ya eka swifundzankulu swa le kusuhi.
tgt: Ukuklanywa kabusha kwemingcele yezifundazwe kususelwa ezimfunweni zemiphakathi yalezi zindawo okukhulunywa ngazo lapha, eyanxusa ukuba isuswe ifakwe ezifundazweni ezingomakhelwane.

src: Mahungu.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Furwa tanihi tiko ro rhurhela leri tsakeriweke ra Khapu ya Misava ya Rhagibi na ku khensa vurhumiwa bya mfumo, lebyi a byi rhangeriwile hi Xandla xa Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa, Holobye wa Mitlangu na Vuhungasi Thulas Nxesi na Nhlangano wa Rhagibi wa Afrika-Dzonga, eka ntirho lowu va nga wu endla eku tlakuseni ka bidi ya Afrika-Dzonga ku va ri ta rhurhela ntlangu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuhalalisela izwe lase-France njengezwe eliqokelwe ukusingatha uMqhudelwano Wendebe Yomhlaba Yebhola Lombhoxo wezi-2023 futhi iyabonga kakhulu kwithimba likahulumeni elabe liholwa yiPhini LikaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa, uNgqongqoshe Wezemidlalo u-Thulas Nxesi kanye Nenhlangano Yebhola Lombhoxo yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARU), ngomsebenzi omuhle abawenzile ukugqugquzela nokusekela isiphakamiso seNingizimu Afrika sokusingatha lo mqhudelwano.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Holobye Pandor, loyi a nyikiweke sagwadi ra Mudyondzisi wa Xiyimo xa le henhla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuhalalisela uNgqongqoshe Pandor, oklonyeliswe ngeNdondo Kathisha Ovelele.

src: Sagwadi ri nyikiwile Holobye Phandor hi Chanselara wa Yunivhesiti ya Afrika-Dzonga, khale ka Phuresidente Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe wanikezwa le ndondo nguShansela WeNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-Unisa), uMongameli Waphambilini waseNingizimu Afrika uThabo Mbeki.

src: Sagwadi ra Mudyondzisi wa Xiyimo xa le henhla, rin'we ya mitlawa ya mune, ri amukela ku hoxa xandla ka mudyondzisi wa xiyimo xa le henhla wihi na wihi loyi a tirheke kahle swinene eka ku dyondzisa kumbe ku yisa ku dyondzisa emahlweni, ku dyondza, nhluvukiso wa vutshila na/kumbe ndzavisiso eka ndhawu ya yena ya vuswikoti.
tgt: INdondo Kathisha Ovelele, engomunye wemikhakha emine, ihlonipha igalelo likathisha ovelele osebenze ngobunyoninco obukhulu ekuqhubekiseleni phambili umsebenzi wokufundisa, ukufunda, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono noma nocwaningo emkhakheni wakhe.

src: Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela ntirho lowu endliweke hi Laborethari ya Dyondzo ya swa tinyeleti ya Afrika-Dzonga, leyi ku nga xiphemu xa Ndzavisiso wa Ndlela yo Angarhela ya Tipulanete ta ntlawa wa vativi va sayense lava lavaka ku kuma tipulanete hi mahlo ya ngati lava se va kumeke tipulanete tintshwa tinharhu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liwushayela ihlombe umsebenzi omuhle owenziwe yi-South African Astronomical Observatory, eyingxenye yombimbi lwabathungathi bonozungezilanga (amapulanethi) be-Wide Angle Search for Planets consortium asebekwazile ukuhlonza amapulanethi amasha amathathu.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela vangheneleri na vahluri va masagwadi ya Govan Mbeki ya 2017, lawa ya xiximaka lava nga eka sekithara ya vuako lava tirheke kahle eka mphakelo wa tindlu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabahalalisela labo abebebambe iqhaza kanye nalabo abadle umhlanganiso emcimbini wezi-2017 we-Govan Mbeki Awards, ohlonipha labo abavelele emkhakheni wezokwakha nokuhlinzekwa kwezindlu.

src: Masagwadi ya ta loko tiko ri ya emahlweni ku tlangela mphakelo wa tindlu ta ku tlula wa timiliyoni na mipfuno ku sukela hi Khabinete yi hundzisela ku khensa ka yona eka migingiriko ya vurhena hi vukorhokeri bya xihatla, vatimelandzilo na vatinyiketeri hinkwavo lava pfuneke eku tirhaneni na mindzilo ya sweswi eKapa-Vupeladyambu.
tgt: Lo mcimbi wezindondo ufike ngesikhathi lapho izwe liqhubeka nokubungaza ukuhlinzekwa kwezindlu nemixhaso engaphezu kuka-4.6 wezigidi kusukela ngowe-19.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile ro hetelela eka 2017 eUnion Buildings ePitori.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo wokugcina wezi-2017, e-Union Buildings ePitoli.

src: Swibohonkulu swa Khabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabinethi.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Sekithara ra Vupfhumba ra Rixaka (NTSS) 2016-2026 ku va ri simekiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kweQhingasu Likazwelonke Lomkhakha Wezokuvakasha (i-NTSS) lowezi-2016-2026.

src: NTSS yi yima hi tiphuphu ta maqhinga ta ntlhanu , ku nga ku maketa, ku fambisa mfikelelo wo olova eka vapfhumba, ku antswisa ntokoto wa vaendzi, mafambiselo ya tindhawu ta vuendzi na mivuyelo ya endleloangarhelo.
tgt: I-NTSS isekelwe ezinsikeni ezinhlanu ezikhethekile okusetshenzelwa phezu kwazo, okusho, ezokukhangisa, ukulawulwa kahle kwenqubo yokufinyelela kwabavakashi ezinhlelweni zokuvakasha, ukuphathwa kahle kwabavakashi nokwenziwa ngcono kwendlela abathokozela ngayo ukuvakasha kwabo, ukuphathwa nokulawulwa kahle kwezindawo ezivakashelwa ngabavakashi kanye nemihlomulo ebanzi yezokuvakasha.

src: Tsalwa hinkwaro ri kona eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba: WEBTOKEKhabinete yi pasisile rimba ra ku tumbuluxiwa ka Khamphani ya Netiweke ya Broadband ya Rixaka.
tgt: Umbhalo ophelele waleli qhingasu uyatholakala kuwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezokuvakasha ku: WEBTOKEIKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uhlaka lokusungulwa kweNkampani Kazwelonke Yohlelo Lwe-inthanethi Esheshayo.

src: Yi ta vumbiwa hi ku hlangana ka Sentech na Broadband Infraco.
tgt: Le nkampani izosungulwa ngokuthi kuhlanganiswe i-Sentech ne-Broadband Infraco.

src: Leswi swi ta fambisa ku sunguriwa ka swilo leswi nga ni vuxaka na ku fambisa hi ndlela yo hlanganela na ku tumbuluxa vurhangeri bya broadband ya rixaka.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza lula ukuqaliswa nokuqhutshwa ngendlela ehambelanayo kwaleyo misebenzi okudingeka ukuba yenziwe yilezi zikhungo ezimbili ngokubambisana, futhi lokhu kuzokwakha isikhungo sikazwelonke esingushampeni weze-inthanethi esheshayo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Xiviko xa ku Humelela xa Lembe na lembe xo Sungula eka ku Simekiwa ka Mpfapfarhuto wa tirhele wa Timfanelo ta Vanhu lava hanyaka na Vutsoniwa (WPRPD).
tgt: IKhabhinethi liwugunyazile uMbiko Wokuqala Wenqubekela Eseyenziwe Okhishwa Minyaka Yonke Wohlaka Lomthetho Odingidwayo Wamalungelo Abantu Abanokukhubazeka (i-WPRPD).

src: Xiviko xi angarhela nkarhi wa ku suka hi ti1 Sunguti ku fika hi ti 31 N'wendzamhala 2016.Xiviko xi nyika vuhleri bya xiyimo xa le henhla xa hilaha tindzawulo ta mfumo ti nga sungula ku nghenelerisa swileriso swa pholisi ya WPRPD eka makunguhatelo, mapimanyetelo, na mphakelo wa vukorhokeri na maendlelo ya ku vika ya tona.
tgt: Lo mbiko uqondene nesikhathi esisukela mhla lu-1 kuMasingana kuya kumhla zingama-31 kuZibandlela 2016.Uhlinzeka ngomphumela wokuhlola nokuhlaziya okusezingeni eliphezulu okubonisa ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni isihambe ibanga elingakanani ekuqiniseni imiyalelo yezinqubomgomo ze-WPRPD, ukuze ifakwe futhi isetshenziswe ngendlela ejulile ezinhlelweni zokuhlela zeminyango ehlukahlukene, ukwabiwa kwemali, ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingongqangi kanye nezinhlelo zokubika.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Rimba ra Maqhinga ya Pholisi ya Vatsoniwa eka Tidyondzo ta le Henhla na Maendlelo ya Vuleteri leswaku ku rhumeriwa swibumabumelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa koHlaka Olukhethekile Lwenqubomgomo Yokukhubazeka oluqondiswe Ohlelweni Lwemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha ukuze umphakathi uzwakalise imibono yawo.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi mivuyelo ya Nkambisiso wa Phurogireme ya ku Herisa Mathekisi loku nga endliwa ku suka hi Hukuri 2015 ku fika Ndzati 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko mayelana nemiphumela yokuBuyekezwa Kohlelo Lokuhlelwa Kabusha Kwemboni Yamatekisi okwenziwa kusukela ngoLwezi 2015 kuya kuMandulo 2016.

src: Phurogireme i xiphemu xo angarhela xa Qhinga ra Vutleketli bya Vaaki, leri lavaka ku fikelerisa sisiteme ya vuhlayiseki byo hlanganela na vutleketli lebyi pfunaka eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luyingxenye yeQhingasu Elibanzi Lezithuthi Zomphakathi, okuhloswe ngalo ukuhlinzeka eNingizimu Afrika ngohlelo lwezokuthutha oludidiyelwe, oluphephile futhi olusebenza kahle.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile tinhlengeletano to tala na ntirho wo tala wu fanele ku endliwa na tindzawulo leti nga fanela loko Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli ya Rixaka yi nga si sungula ku pfuxeta maendlelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi livumile ukuba kubanjwe ezinye izigcawu zokubonisana nababambiqhaza, futhi kusenomsebenzi okumele wenziwe ngokubambisana neminyango kahulumeni efanelekile ngaphambi kokuba uMnyango Kazwelonke Wezokuthutha uqalise ukusebenza kohlelo olusha olubuyekeziwe.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku humesiwa ku ya eka vaaki ka nkandziyiso wa vu 8 wa Swikombo swa Nhluvukiso swa (2016).
tgt: IKhabhinethi livumile ukuba zikhishelwe umphakathi iziNkomba Zentuthuko zehlandla lesi-8 (zowe-2016).

src: Xiviko xa Xikombo xa Nhluvukiso xi langutisa eka nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga ku sukela loko ku ri na xidemokirasi na ku landzelerisa ku simekiwa ka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka: Xivono xa Khabinete yi pasisile tindlela ta ku tiyisisa mafambiselo ya matikhomelo ya vatirhelamfumo loko swi ta eka vatirhi lava endlaka bindzu na marhavi ya mfumo.
tgt: Umbiko Wezinkomba Zentuthuko ugxile kwintuthuko yeNingizimu Afrika kusukela esikhathini sokufika kwentando yeningi labantu, futhi izinkomba zentuthuko zihlola futhi ziqaphe ukuqaliswa kweNhlosombono yowezi-2030 yoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).

src: Swi cinca Swinawana swa Vatirhelamfumo swa 2016, leswi alelaka vatirhelamfumo ku endla bindzu na Mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lizigunyazile izinyathelo zokuqinisa ukulawulwa kokuziphatha ngendlela efanele kwezisebenzi zikahulumeni, odabeni oluphathelene nezikhulu zikahulumeni ezenza ibhizinisi nezikhungo zikahulumeni.

src: Ku sukela hi ti1 Nyenyankulu, Nkwama wa Mfumo, hi ku seketeriwa hi Ndzawulo ya Vatirhelamfumo na Vulawuri (DPSA), va ta landzelerisa mitsariso yintshwa eka Nhlayisa-switiviwa ya Vaphakeri ya le Xikarhi eka Sisiteme ya Phesali.
tgt: Lokhu kuqalisa ukusebenza kweMithethonqubo Yomkhakha Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni yowezi-2016, enqabela abasebenzi bakahulumeni ukwenza ibhizinisi noMbuso.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Mafambiselo ya Matirhelo Yantshwa na Sisiteme ya Nhluvukiso wa Tinhloko ta Tindzawulo, leswi kombaka nkahoxeko ku hlangana exikarhi ka matirhelo ya munhu na matirhelo ya nhlangano.
tgt: Kusukela mhla lu-1 kuNdasa, Umnyango Wezezimali Kuzwelonke, ngokwesekwa wuMnyango Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo (i-DPSA), lizoqapha futhi liqhathanise imininingwane yabo bonke abahlinzeki bempahla nezinsizakalo abasha ababhalisa nge-inthanethi kwiSizindalwazi Sikazwelonke Sabahlinzeki Bempahla Nezinsizakalo (i-CSD) nemininingwane equkethwe oHlelweni lwe-Persal, okuwuhlelo lwemiholo yabasebenzi bakahulumeni.

src: Leswi swi ta sungula ku tirha hiti1 Dzivamisoko Khabinete yi pasisile ku sunguriwa na ku simekiwa ka Rimba ra Xikimi xa ku Thola Vatirhelamfumo lava Thwaseke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uHlelo Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Nokulawulwa Kwendlela Ezisebenza Ngayo iziNhloko Zeminyango Kahulumeni, okuwuhlelo olubonisa ngendlela enembayo ukuxhumana phakathi kwendlela asebenza ngayo umuntu ngamunye kanye nendlela osebenza ngayo umnyango kahulumeni wonkana.

src: Leswi swi vumba xiphemu xa phurogireme ya nhluvukiso eka Vatirhelamfumo ku kota ku koka rinoko eka mathwasana lawa ya nga na vuswikoti eka Vutirhelamfumo.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luzoqala ukusebenza kusukela mhla lu-1 kuMbasa IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukwethulwa nokuqaliswa koHlaka Lohlelo Lokuqashwa Kwabafundi Abasanda Kuphothula Iziqu Zemfundo Ephakeme Emkhakheni Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni.

src: Rimba ri katsa ku languta phesente ya ndzawulo yin'wana na yin'wana laha ku nga na swivandla swa mitirho ku kota thola mathwasana eka mitirho leyi kaleriwaka hi mathwasana.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo lokuthuthukisa oluqhutshwa ngaphakathi eMkhakheni Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni okuhloswe ngalo ukuheha abafundi abanamakhono abasanda kuphothula iziqu zabo zemfundo ephakeme, ukuze beze bazosebenzela uMkhakha Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni.

src: Holobye wa Vutirhelamfumo na Vulawuri u ta tlhela a xaxameta rimba leri na Phurogireme ya Vukorhokeri bya ku Thola Vantshwa.
tgt: Lolu hlaka luhlanganisa nokwabiwa kwephesenti elithile lezikhala zomsebenzi emnyangweni kahulumeni ngamunye okuzoqashwa kuzona abafundi abasanda kuphothula iziqu zabo zemfundo kuleyo mikhakha edinga amakhono ayivela kancane.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Switiviso leswi landzelaka eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswi fambelenaka na ku Kongomisa Swiboho swa Huvo eka Mindzilekano, leswi xikongomelo ku nga ku tlakusa mfikelelo eka vululami eka lava khale a va siyiwile ehandle na le ka matikoxikaya lawa a ya nga korhokeriwi hi ku ringanela.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo uzoqinisekisa futhi ukuthi lolu hlaka luhambisana kahle noHlelo Lokuqashwa Kwentsha.

src: Ku kongomisiwa swi le ka miganga ya majisitarata wa le Free State na le Kapa-N'walungu, na ku susuwa ka Miganga yin'wana ya Majisitarata ku suka eka Rhavi ra Gauteng ra Huvo ya le Henhla na ku ti veka ehansi ka ndzilekana wa Rhavi ra Huvo ya le Henhla ra N'walungu-Vupeladyambu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa kweZaziso ezilandelayo kuSomqulu Kahulumeni mayelana nokuHlelwa Kabusha Kobubanzi Begunya Lokusebenza Nokwengamela Kwezinkantolo, okuhloswe ngakho ukukhulisa izinga lokutholakala kobulungiswa kubantu ababencishwe amathuba phambilini kanye nasezindaweni ezisemakhaya ezingazitholi izinsizakalo zobulungiswa ngendlela efanele.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Swipimelo eka Milawu ya Vulamuri hi ku ya hi Nawu wa ku Sirhelela Vuvekisi, 2015 (Nawu wa 22 wa 2015).
tgt: Ukuhlelwa kabusha kwegunya lezinkantolo lokusebenza nokwengamela kuzokwenziwa kwizifunda-nkantolo ezithile eFreyistata naseNyakatho Kapa, futhi kuzokhishwa iziFunda-nkantolo ezithile ngaphansi koPhiko Lwenkantolo Ephakeme lwaseGauteng, zifakwe ngaphansi kwegunya lokusebenza nokwengamela loPhiko Lwenkantolo Ephakeme yaseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Swinawana swi fikelerisa muvekisi loyi a nga na mikanetano hi ku ya hi xiboho lexi tekiweke hi mfumo lexi khumbhaka vuvekisi, ku kombela Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki (dti) ku nghenelela hi tindlela leti kotekaka ta vulamuri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyigunyazile iMithethonqubo ephathelene Nemithetho Yokuxazululwa Kwemibango ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kotshalomali wezi-2015 (uMthetho wama-22 wezi-2015).

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hlangana na ku rhurheriwa ka tikhonferense leti landzelaka: Khonferense yo Tihlanganisa ya Phurogireme ya Nhluvukiso wa Vatirhi va Muganga va Rixaka ya 2018 hi DPSKhonferense ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 23 ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava ya Vachuchisi, leyi nga ta rhurheriwa hi Vulawuri bya Vachuchisi bya Rixaka eDurban hi Ndzati 2018.
tgt: Le mithethonqubo ihlinzekela ukuba umtshalimali ongagculisekile ngesinyathelo esithile esithathwe nguhulumeni, esinomthelela kutshalomali lwakhe, acele ukuba uMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni (i-dti) ungenelele ngenhloso yokuthi kuxoxiswane bese kutholakala isixazululo.

src: 2017 N’wangulano wa Xiyimo xa le Henhla xa Nhlangano wa Afrika (AU), lowu nga ta rhurheriwa hi DPSA ku sukela hi ti 6 ku fika hi ti 8 N'wendzamhala 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukubanjwa kwezingqungquthela ezilandelayo: INgqungquthela Kazwelonke Yokubonisana Nokuxoxisana Yabasebenzi Bezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi yowezi-2018 ezosingathwa yi-DPSINgqungquthela yama-23 Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yabashushisi Ebanjwa Minyaka Yonke, ezosingathwa wuPhiko Lwezokushushisa Lukazwelonke (i-NPA) eDurban ngoMandulo 2018.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile tidizayini na nhlengeleto wa ku tsundzuka na ku hangalasiwa ka mali ya nsimbhi leyi nga ta humesiwa hi 2018.Tidizayini ta mali ya nsimbhi, na ku tivisiwa ka tona, swi ta kandziyisiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo: 2018 ku hangalasiwa ka mali ya R5 ya tinsimbhi timbirhi (Lembexidzana ra Nelson Mandela)2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku ta nongonoko wa R1 (Mikolombyani ya Afrika-Dzonga, pheroto yi jovote futsu)2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku eka nongonoko mali ya nsimbi ya Nachura (Ku tlakuka ka dayinasoro - Archosauria)2018 2oz, 22 wa tikharete ta nsuku ta randi ya Kruger 2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku na silivhere yo vangama ya mali ya nongonoko wa mali ya Phurothiya (Vutomi bya Nhenha -Nelson Mandela)2018 wa silivhere yo vangama ya Harhi ya R2 na 2 ½ wa nongonoko wa Tiki (Vutumbuluxi bya Afrika-Dzonga - vukombisi bya xithekiniki hi Khomphyuta) na2018 silivhere yo vangama ya nongonoko lowu nga totiwa muhlovo (Tinyenyani na Swiluva swa Ntanga wa Swimilani wa Waterberg).Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.
tgt: Isithangami Somhlaba Wonke Sezesayensi sowezi-2021 okuhlelwa ukuba sibanjelwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mivuyelo ya Swimakiwa Hinkwaswo swa TikoKhabinete yi tsakile hi ku kula ka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi kuleke hi ku hlayiwa hi lembe hi 2% eka kotara ya vunharhu ya 2017, ku suka eka mpfuxeto wa le henhla wa 2.8% eka kotara ya vumbirhi.
tgt: Inkulumo-mpendulwano Esemazingeni Aphakeme Yenhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) yowezi-2017, ezosingathwa yi-DPSA kusukela mhla ziyisi-6 kuya kumhla ziyisi-8 kuZibandlela 20.IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukukhishwa kwamadizayini owezi-2018 ochungechunge lwezinhlamvu zemali eyisikhumbuzo sabaqoqi bezinhlamvu zemali kanye nezinhlamvu zemali ezizosetshenziswa nsukuzonke emphakathini.

src: Matirhelo lawa ya nga tiya lawa ku tlula lawa a ya languteriwile ya vile kona hi mhaka ya ku kula loku ya ka emahlweni eka sekithara ya vurimi, leyi nga hoxa xandla eka wa tiphesente eka ku kula hinkwako endzhaku ka 44.2% eka kotara hi kotara ya ku kula.
tgt: Amadizayini ezinhlamvu zemali kanye nokumenyezelwa kwawo ngokusemthethweni, kuzoshicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni: Uhlamvu lwe-Krugerrand lowezi-2018 olunesisindo esingama-awunsi amabili, olwakhiwe ngamakharethi egolide angama-22 Uhlamvu luka-R5 oluzosetshenziswa nsukuzonke emphakathini, lowezi-2018, olwakhiwe ngezinhlobo ezimbili zezakhi-mali ezisansimbi (Isikhumbuzo Sokuhlangana Kweminyaka Eyikhulu Kwazalwa u-Nelson Mandela) Uchungechunge lohlamvu luka-R1 lowezi-2018 olungamakharethi egolide angama-24 (Izilwane ezihuquzela ngesisu zaseNingizimu Afrika – ufudu olubizwa nge-parrot beaked padloper) Uchungechunge lohlamvu lwe-Natura lowezi-2018 olungamakharethi egolide angama-24 (Olubizwa nge-Rise of the dinosaurs – Archosauria) Uchungechunge lohlamvu lwe-Protea lowezi-2018 olungamakharethi egolide angama-24 futhi olutholakala nangesiliva soqobo (Impilo Yengqalabutho – u-Nelson Mandela) Uchungechunge lowezi-2018 lohlamvu lwe-Crown olungu-R2 olwakhiwe ngesiliva soqobo kanye noTiki 2 ½ (Izinto Eziqanjwe futhi Zasungulwa eNingizimu Afrika – Uhlelo Olukhethekile Lwama-eksireyi Abonisa Isimo Somzimba Wonkana (i-Computed Tomography)) kanyeNochungechunge lohlamvu lowezi-2018 olwakhiwe ngesiliva soqobo (Izinyoni Nezimbali zesiQiwu Semvelo sase-Waterberg).Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Matirhela ya kahle ya vurimi, laha hi nga vona tikotara tinharhu ta ku kula ka xiyimo xa le henhla, swi vile kona hi ntshovelo wa le henhla wa swirimiwa (yo fana na mavele) eka tindhawu ta mpfula ya ximumu na swirimiwa swa swo xavisiwa.
tgt: Imiphumela yeSamba soMkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP)IKhabhinethi liyakuthakasela impela ukukhula komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngama-2% ngekota yesithathu yonyaka wezi-2017, kusuka ekukhuleni okubuyekeziwe okukhushulelwe phezulu okungama-2.8% ngekota yesibili yonyaka.

src: Migodi na vutumbuluxi swi hoxile xandla eka kula loku nga rhikhodiwa, laha migodi na ku ceriwa ka maribye swi nga kula hi 6.6% na ku hoxa xandla hi 0.5% wa tipoyinti eka ku kula.
tgt: Lokhu kukhula komnotho okungaphezulu kwalokho obekulindelekile ikakhulukazi kungenxa yokukhula okunohlonze komkhakha wezolimo, ofake amaphuzu angu-0.9% ekukhuleni komnotho sekukonke, okubonisa ukukhula ngama-44.2% uma kuqhathaniswa nekota efanayo yonyaka odlule.

src: Sekithara ya gezi hi yona yi nga lahlekeriwa swinene, yi yile ehansi hi 5.5%.
tgt: Ukusebenza kahle komkhakha wezolimo, osekubonise ukukhula okunohlonze emakoteni onyaka amathathu elandelana, kungenxa yesivuno esiphakeme sezitshalo ezitshalwa emasimini angodeda ngendlale (njengommbila) esitholakale kulezo zindawo zakuleli ezithola imvula ehlobo futhi kubangelwe nayisivuno esihle semikhiqizo yezolimo etshalwa ezingadini (horticultural products).

src: Ku kula eka switirhisiwa swa le ndyangwini hi 2.6% swi vile kona hi mhaka ya ku xaviwa ka tinhundzu leti nga tiya, leti nga endla 1.6% wa tipoyinti ta ku kula ka 2.6%.
tgt: Umkhakha wezezimayini nowezokukhiqiza nayo isifakile isandla ekukhuleni komnotho, njengoba umkhakha wezezimayini nokumbiwa kwezinkwali ukhule ngama-6.6% futhi ufake amaphuzu angu-0.5 % ekukhuleni komnotho.

src: Ku kula ko tlula loku nga languteriwa na ku ya ehenhla ka mpfuxeto eka kotara ya vumbirhi ya mbuyelo swivula leswaku ku kula ku nga fika eka 0.9% hi 2017.Leswi swi le henhla hi 0.7% eka leswi a swi languteriwile hi nkarhi wa Xitatimende xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi.
tgt: Umkhakha kagesi yiwona mkhakha ongenzanga neze kahle, njengoba ufadalale ngama-5.5%.

src: Mfumo wu fanele ku tiyisisa leswaku matimba ya ku kula ku ya emahlweni ku tshama ku ri kona hi ku yisa emahlweni ku simeka tindlela ta 14 ta ku tlakusa ku tshemba leti yisaka ehenhla ku tshemba ka vatirhisi naswona ku nga vuyerisa ku tshemba ka mabindzu.
tgt: Ukukhula kwezinga lokuthengwa kwempahla emakhaya ngama-2.6% kubangelwe ikakhulukazi wukuthengwa kwempahla ehlala isikhathi eside, okuyinto efake amaphuzu angama-1.6% kulokhu kukhula okungama-2.6%.

src: InvestSA One-Stop ShopKhabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka InvestSA One-Stop Shop eKwazulu-Natal hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma tanihi xiphemu xa ku antswisa ku endla bindzu na Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ukukhula komnotho ngezinga eliphezudlwana kwalelo ebelilindelekile kanye nokubuyekezwa kwezilinganiso zokukhula komnotho zekota yesibili yonyaka kubonisa ukuthi ukukhula komnotho wakuleli kungafinyelela ku-0.9% ngowezi-2017.Lesi silinganiso sithanda ukuba phezudlwana kancane kunesilinganiso sika-0.7% esabikezelwa eSitatimendeni Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS).

src: Leyi lavaka ku endla leswaku ku va na mbangu wa kahle wa ku fikelerisa nkongomelo wa vuhlanganisi eka vavekisi ku kuma vukorhokeri hi ku hatlisisa tiphurojeke na ku hunguta vuyimayima loko u sungula bindzu.
tgt: Kudingeka ukuba uhulumeni aqinisekise ukuthi uyaqhubeka lo mfutho wokukhula komnotho ngokuthi aqhubeke nokusebenzisa izinyathelo eziyi-14 okuhloswe ngazo ukuthuthukisa ukwethenjwa komnotho wakuleli ngokwakhela phezu kokwethenjwa komnotho okuboniswa ngabathengi bakuleli, futhi ukuze kanjalo kubuyiswe nokwethenjwa komnotho wumkhakha wezamabhizinisi.

src: Vuxaka bya Afrika-Dzonga na AngolaKhabinete yi amukela ntwanano lowu nga sayiniwa hi nkarhi wa Riendzo ra Tiko hi Phuresidente wa Angola João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.
tgt: Isikhungo se-InvestSA Esihlinzeka Ngezinsizakalo Ezihlukahlukene Ngaphansi Kophahla OlulodwaIKhabhinethi likushayela ihlombe ukwethulwa kwesiKhungo se-InvestSA Esihlinzeka Ngezinsizakalo Ezihlukahlukene Ngaphansi Kophahla Olulodwa KwaZulu-Natali nguMongameli Jacob Zuma, njengengxenye yemizamo yokwenza ngcono inqubo yokwenza ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mitwanano leyi landzelaka yi sayiniwile: Memorandamu ya Ntwanano (MoU) eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka Khomixini ya Matiko hayambirhi ya va Phuresidente, MoU eka Ntirhisano eka Xiyenge xa Mbango, Nsimeko wa Swiletelo swa ku nga tirhisi vhisa, Maendlelo eka Ntirhisano wa Maphorisa na Ntwanano eka Mpfuno wa Vulawuri bya Milawu ya Timhaka ta Xibalo xa tinhundzu leti tlulaka mindzilekana.
tgt: Kuhloswe ngaso ukwakha isimo esikahle, ngokuhlinzeka ngesizinda esiyinhloko esisendaweni eyodwa lapho kuzoxhunywana khona nabatshalimali, futhi lapho bezothola khona zonke izinsizakalo abazidingayo, ngalokho-ke kusheshiswe ukuqaliswa kwemiklamo futhi kuncishiswe nokubambezeleka okubangelwa yimicikilisho nemidanti eminingi kahulumeni okudingeka ukube umuntu achushe kuyona uma efuna ukusungula ibhizinisi.

src: Samiti ya Vuntlhanu ya Nhlangano wa AU-Yuropo (EU).Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo ya vuntlhanu ya Samiti ya AU-ESamiti yi fikelerisile xivandlanene eka Afrika-Dzonga ku yisa emahlweni vuxaka bya xidipilomati na maqhinga ya ikhonomi hi ku burisana ko hambanahambana eka samiti na le ka mitlangu ya le tlhelo yo fana na Foramu ya Mabindzu na Vantshwa, leyi nga kongoma eka ku kula ka ikhonomi loku katsaka, ku thoriwa ka vantshwa na mabindzu.
tgt: Ubudlelwane phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-AngolaIKhabhinethi liyazamukela izivumelwano ezisayinwe ngenkathi uMongameli wase-Angola u-João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço evakashele eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ku xavisiwa ka mahlonga ya vapfhumba va MaAfrikaKhabinete yi hlangana na vaaki va matiko ya misava ku yirisa ku xavisiwa ka vapfhumba va MaAfrika eLibya tanihi mahlonga.
tgt: Kusayinwe lezi zivumelwano ezilandelayo: Isivumelwano Sokusebenzisana (i-MoU) ekusungulweni kweKhomishana YoMongameli Balawa Mazwe Amabili, i-MoU Yokubambisana Emkhakheni Wezemvelo, Imihlahlandlela yokuqalisa inqubo yokuqeda isidingo sokuba abavakashi balawa mazwe amabili bathole i-visa ngaphambi kokuvakashela e-Angola noma eNingizimu Afrika, Isivumelwano Sobambiswano Lwamaphoyisa Akulawa Mazwe Amabili kanye Nesivumelwano Sokulekelelana Ezindabeni Eziphathelene Nokungena Nokuphuma Kwempahla Nabantu Emingceleni Yalawa Mazwe Amabili.

src: Swiendlo leswi pfumalaka vumunhu a swi fambelani na milawu ya AU, na milawu yin'wana ya Afrika na matiko ya misava, ku katsa Tsalwa ra Timfanelo ra Afrika eka Timfanelo ta Vanhu na Vumunhu.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yesihlanu phakathi kwe-AU neNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Yurophu (i-EU)IKhabhinethi liyayamukela imiphumela yeNgqungquthela Yesihlanu ye-AU ne-ELe ngqungquthela ihlinzeke ngethuba lokuba iNingizimu Afrika yenze ngcono ubudlelwane bayo obukhethekile emkhakheni wezomnotho kanye nasemazingeni osomaqhinga, ngokubamba izingxoxo namazwe ahlukahlukene kule ngqungquthela kanye nasemicimbini ebibanjwe eceleni ngenkathi kuqhubeka le ngqungquthela, njengesiThangami Sezebhizinisi kanye neNgqungquthela Yentsha, okuyimicimbi ebigxile ekukhuleni komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke, ukuqashwa kwentsha kanye nokusungulwa kwamabhizinisi.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku tivisiwa ka valawuri lava nga ta vekiwa laha ku nghenaka na ku huma vanhu eTripoli eka vahlampfa na vapfhumba lava lavaka nsirhelelo wa matiko ya misava.
tgt: Ukuhweba ngezigqila ezingabafuduki bamazwe ase-AfrikaNjengamazwe omhlaba, iKhabhinethi nalo liyigxeka kakhulu imibiko yokuthengiswa kwabafuduki base-Afrika kwelase-Libya ngenhloso yokubenza izigqila.

src: Ntungu wa ListeriosisKhabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo ku endla leswi nga ringanela ku tisirhelela, ku fana na ku hlamba mavoko loko va nga si lulamisa swakudya na ku papalata swakudya swi mbisi kumbe leswi nga swekiwangiki, ku hunguta ku hangalaka ka listeriosis, loko vulavisisi bya ha ya emahlweni ku kuma laha xitsongwatsongwani xi humaka kona.
tgt: Ukubheduka kwesifo i-ListeriosisIKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke abantu ukuba baqaphele futhi bathathe izinyathelo zokuzivikela – njengokugeza izandla ngaphambi kokulungisa ukudla kanye nokugwema ukudla okungaphekiwe – ngenhloso yokunqanda ukusabalala kwe-Listeriosis, njengoba lusaqhubeka uphenyo mayelana nomthombo wegciwane elibangela lesi sifo.

src: Vuvabyi byi vangiwa hi xitsongwatsongwani lexi humaka emisaveni, ematini, eswimilannii na le ka switirhisiwa swa masi lama nga tengisiwangiki, naswona swi nga vanga matitwelo yo fana na ya mukhuhlwani lawa ya nga na nchuluko.
tgt: Lesi sifo sibangelwa yigciwane elitholakala emhlabathini, emanzini, ezitshalweni kanye nasemikhiqizweni yobisi engadlulanga enqubweni yokubulala amagciwane, futhi singaholela ekutheni umuntu abe nezimpawu zomkhuhlane ezihambisana nesifo sohudo.

src: Byi nga tshunguriwa kahle hi ku tirhisa swidzidziharisi, loko swi kumiwa hi xihatla.
tgt: Uma sitholakale kusenesikhathi, siyelapheka, ngokusebenzisa ozifozonke besilungu (ama-antibiotic).IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqhubeke nokusebenzisa amanzi ngokuwonga njengoba leli lizwe lisakhungethwe yisomiso esilokhu siqhubeke njalo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni na ku tirhisa mati kahle loko tiko ra ha ya emahlweni ri tokota dyandza.
tgt: Nakuba sisanda kuthola izimvula kuleli, umthamo wamanzi emadamini ethu ulokhu wehle njalo.

src: Hi nga languti timpfula leti ta ha ku va kona, mipimo ya madamu ya tiko ya ya ehansi.
tgt: Lokhu kubangelwa wukuphakama kwamazinga okushisa, futhi nemvula ayikaqali ukuna kahle ngokuqhubekayo.

src: Khabinete ya hlohloteleka hi ku ya emahlweni ka mivulavurisano na timasipala leti nga na swikweleti swa le henhla ku kuma xintshuxo eka xikweleti xa masipala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyazithokozela izingxoxo ezibonisa impumelelo nenqubekelaphambili, ezibandakanya omasipala abanezikweletu ezinkulu zamanzi, okuyizingxoxo okuhloswe ngazo ukuthola isixazululo mayelana nokukhokhwa lwezikweletu zomasipala.

src: Milawumbisi.
tgt: C.Mithethosivivinywa.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Milawumbisi leyi landzelaka ePalamende.
tgt: IKhabhinethi livumile ukuba ithunyelwe ePhalamende iMithethosivivinywa elandelayo.

src: Nawumbisi wa ku Cinca Mpfuno wa Vaaki wa 2017.Nawumbisi wu nyika mivuyelo leyi antswisiweke eka mudende wa vana lava nga swisiwana na vana lava nga sirheleriwangiki, ku katsa na volava va tshamaka emindyangwini leyi rhangeriweke hi vana.
tgt: Isichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wezibonelelo Zikahulumeni sowezi-2017.Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlinzeka ngemihlomulo engeziwe maqondana nesibonelelo sesondlo sezingane eziyizintandane kanye nezingane ezidinga ukubhekelelwa kangcono, kubandakanya nalezo ezihlala emakhaya aphethwe yizingane.

src: Nawumbisi wa Vaxavisi va Tinhundzu wa 2017Nawumbisi wu herisa Nawu wa Timhaka ta Tiejensi to Xavisa Tindlu, wa 1976 (Nawu wa 112 wa 1976).
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wabasebenzi Bomkhakha Wokuthengiswa Komhlaba Nezindlu wezi-2017Lo Mthethosivivinywa uphelisa ukusebenza komthetho okhona njengamanje, uMthetho Wezinkampani Ezithengisa futhi Ziqashise Ngomhlaba Nezindlu, we-1976 (uMthetho we-112 we-1976).

src: Wu endla leswaku ku va mbangu wa vulawuri ku yisa emahlweni migingiriko ya ikhonomi eka vumaki bya ku xavisa tindlu loko ku karhi ku tiyisisiwa ku lulamisa ku tisa ku cinca eka sekithara.
tgt: Futhi lo mthethosivivinywa uzokwakha isimo sokulawula esikahle, ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa umsebenzi wezomnotho oqhubekayo embonini yokuthengisa nokuqashisa ngomhlaba nezindlu, futhi kusenjalo uvumele ukuba kubhekwane ngqo nesidingo sokuqinisekisa ukulethwa koguquko kulo mkhakha.

src: Nawumbisi wa ku Ndzhundzhuluko wa Rimba ra Mathwaselo wa Rixaka wa 2016Nawumbisi wu tiyisisa Nawu wa Rimba ra Mathwaselo wa Rixaka lowu nga kona sweswi, 2008 (Nawu wa 67 wa 2008).
tgt: Isichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wohlaka Lukazwelonke Lweziqu Zemfundo sowezi-2016Lo Mthethosivivinywa uqinisa umthetho okhona njengamanje, uMthetho Wohlaka Lukazwelonke Lweziqu Zemfundo, wezi-2008 (uMthetho wama-67 wezi-2008).

src: Wu yirisa tindlela ta ku tirhana na timhaka ta vuxisi na ku veka switandzhaku eka munhu loyi a endlaka vuxisi eka mathwaselo ya yena kumbe mihlangano leyi nyikaka minhwaso leyi nga ri ki yona.
tgt: Futhi lo mthethosivivinywa wethula izinyathelo zokubhekana ngqo nenkinga yabantu abaqamba amanga ngeziqu zabo zemfundo futhi ubeka nezinyathelo abangathathelwa zona abantu abaqamba amanga ngeziqu zabo zemfundo noma izinhlangano ezikhipha iziqu-mbumbulu zemfundo.

src: Nawumbisi wa Milandzu ya Matiko ya Misava wa 2017Nawumbisi wu nyika rimba ra nawu lowu antswisiweke ku tirhana na milandzu ya matiko ya misava leyi endliwaka laha Afrika-Dzonga na ku tlula ndzilekana.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wamacala Amazwe Ngamazwe wezi-2017Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlinzeka ngohlaka lomthetho olwenziwe ngcono oluzobhekana ngqo namacala amazwe ngamazwe enziwe eNingizimu Afrika noma enziwe ngaphandle kwemingcele yaleli lizwe.

src: Wu tlhela wu nyika ku antswa eka nsirhelelo na vululami eka vatwisiwakuvava va vugevenga bya matiko ya misava.
tgt: Futhi uhlinzeka izisulu zamacala amazwe ngamazwe ngokuvikeleka nobulungiswa obenziwe ngcono.

src: Phuresidente Uhuru Kenyatta eka ku vekiwa ka yena tanihi Phuresidente wa Rhiphabuliki ra Kenya na ku va eka theme ya vumbirhi ya mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisele:.UMongameli Uhuru Kenyatta ngokugcotshwa kwakhe njengoMongameli wezwe laseKenya, osekuyihlandla lakhe lesibili lokuphatha uhulumeni wakhona.

src: Khabinete yi langutela ku ya emahlweni na ku aka vuxaka lebyi tiyeke lebyi matiko hayambirhi ya ti phinaka ha byona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyethemba ukuthi kuzoqhutshekwa nokwakhela phezu kobudlelwane obuqinile obukhona phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nezwe laseKenya.

src: Phuresidente Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa eka ku vekiwa ka yena tanihi Phuresidente wa Rhiphabuliki ra Zimbabwe.
tgt: UMongameli Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ngokugcotshwa kwakhe njengoMongameli waseZimbabwe.

src: Khabinete yi langutela ku ya emahlweni ka vuxaka lebyi tiyeke na Mfumo wa Zimbabwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyethemba ukuthi buzoqhubeka ubudlelwane bokusebenzana okuhle noHulumeni waseZimbabwe.

src: Mejara Seitebatso Pearl Block eka ku xiximiwa ka yena ku va a kuma Sagwadi ra Lembe ra Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava (UN) hi ku va a ri Gqweta ra Madzolonga ya ku ya hi Rimbewu eka Mavuthu.
tgt: U-Major Seitebatso Pearl Block ngokuklonyeliswa kwakhe ngendondo yeNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) Yeshoshozela Lonyaka Elilwela Izindaba Eziphathelene Nobulili.

src: Sagwadi leri ri tekela enhlokweni ku tinyikela na matimba ya munhu loyi a tisaka ku rhula na ku seketela milawu eka Xintshuxo xa Huvo ya Vusirheleri ya UN ya 1324, leyi kombelaka mavandla hinkwawo lawa ya lwaka ku sirhelela vavasati na vanhwanyana eka mixaniso ya swa masangu na madzolonga ya ku ya hi rimbewu.
tgt: Lo mklomelo uhlonipha ukuzimisela nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla komgcini-woxolo othile ekugqugquzeleni imigomo yeSinqumo Somkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka we-UN se-1325, esinxusa wonke amaqembu azibandakanye empini ukuba avikele abesifazane namantombazane ekuxhashazweni ngokocansi nasezenzweni zodlame oluqondiswe kwabesifazane.

src: Ladysmith Black Mambazo, lava va nga vayimelakulangwa va Masagwadi ya tiGrammy ya 2018.
tgt: I-Ladysmith Black Mambazo, ethole ukuphakanyiswa (nominations) okubili kulabo abagaqele iziNdondo Ze-Grammy zowezi-2018.

src: Ko sungula ku le ka xiyenge xa Alibamu ya Vunanga bya Matiko ya Misava bya Kahle hi Alibamu ya vona ya Shaka Zulu Revisited: 30th Anniversary Celebation, ya vumbirhi yi le ka Alibamu ya Vana ya Khale eka Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents around the World Masagwadi ya tiGrammy ya ta va kona hi ti 28 Sunguti 2018.
tgt: Ukuphakanyiswa kokuqala kusemkhakheni we-Alibhamu Evelele Emculweni Womhlaba Jikelele (i-Best World Music Album), nge-alibhamu yabo esihloko sithi-Shaka Zulu Revisited: 30th Anniversary Celebration, kanti ukuphakanyiswa kwesibili bakuthole emkhakheni we-Alibhamu Yezingane Evelele, nge-alibhamu yabo esihloko sithi-Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents around the World.

src: Chad Le Clos, ku va a vile muhlamberi wa xinuna wo sungula ku va a hlula hi ka mune eka Khapu ya Misava ya ku Hlambela ya FINA eka nongonoko wa swiyenge.
tgt: Umcimbi weziNdondo Ze-Grammy kulindeleke ukuba ubanjwe mhla zingama-28 kuMasingana 2018.U-Chad Le Clos, ngokuba wumbhukudi wokuqala ngqa emhlabeni onqobe izicoco ezine zochungechunge lweNdebe Yomhlaba Yokubhukuda ye-FINSiyaziqhenya ngale mpumelelo yakhe enkulu kangaka futhi siyethemba ukuthi uzoqhubeka nokumela iNingizimu Afrika ngobunyoninco obukhulu.

src: SuperSport United, ku va yi fikelerile ntlangu wo hetisela wa Confederation of African Football Confederetions Cup.
tgt: I-SuperSport United, ngokufinyelela kowamanqamu emqhudelwaneni we-Confederations Cup weNhlangano Yebhola Lezinyawo yase-Afrika (i-CAF).Uzime waseNingizimu Afrika, u-Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ngokunqoba isicoco sika-Miss Universe emqhudelwaneni wama-66 obubanjelwe e-United States of America esikhathini esifushane esedlule.

src: N’wambhuri wa Afrika-Dzonga, Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ku va hlurile eka N'wambhuri wa Matiko ya Misava eka Van’wambhuri wa vu 66 lowu a wu khomeriwe eAmerika.
tgt: UDkt Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, oklonyeliswe ngendondo ye-Lifetime Achievement Award yi-Women Political Leaders Global Forum.

src: Dr Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, loyi a nga nyikiwa sagwadi ra Lifetime Achievement hi Foramu ya Misava ya Varhangeri va Vamanana va Tipolitiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo kulaba abalandelayo:.Uhulumeni nabantu base-Egypt kulandela isigameko sokuhlasela kwabashokobezi esenzeke endlini yesonto lamaSulumani e-Sinai Peninsula lapho kushone khona abantu abangaphezu kwama-300 futhi kwalimala nabanye abaningi.

src: Khabinete yi rhumela marito yo chavelela eka:.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakugxeka lokhu kuhlaselwa okungenangqondo kwabantu abangenacala emphakathini.

src: Mfumo na vanhu va Egipta endzhaku ka mihlaselo ya vutherorisi eka yindlu yo khongela eSinai Peninsula leyi nga koxa vutomi bya vanhu va 300 na ku vavisa van'wanyana vo hlaya.
tgt: Uhulumeni nabantu base-Nigeria kulandela isigameko sokuzibulala komshokobezi ngebhomu esenzeke mhla zingama-21 kuLwezi 2017 lapho kushone khona abantu abangaphezu kwama-50 futhi kwalimala nabanye abaningi.

src: Khabinete yi alelana na mihlaselo leyi nga ri ki kahle eka vaaki lava pfumalaka nandzu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyagcizelela emgomweni walo ocacile futhi ongaguquki wokugxeka izenzo zobushokobezi kanye nazo zonke izenzo zokuvukelwa kombuso ezihambisana nodlame.

src: Mfumo na vanhu va Nigeria endzhaku ka munhu loyi a nga tidlaya hi bomo hi ti 21 Hukuri 2017 leyi nga dlaya vanhu va 50 na ku vavisa votala.
tgt: Umndeni nabangane bakaDkt Mochubela ‘Wesi’ Seekoe, umakadebona owayesishoshovu somzabalazo futhi phambilini owayeyiNxusa laseNingizimu Afrika ezweni lase-Russia.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi vula nakambe milawu ya yona na ku nga tipfinyingi hi ku alelana na vutherorisi na madzolonga ya vupfumeri lebyi alelaka byin'wana.
tgt: Ulisebenzele kahle kakhulu leli lizwe njengeNxusa lakuleli e-Russia futhi walisebenzela njengoSihlalo Wesikhungo Samandla Enuzi saseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ndyangu na vanghana va Dok Mochubela 'Wesi" Seekoe, nhenha ya mulwela ntshuxeko na khale ka muyimeri wa Afrika-Dzonga eka Federexini ya Rhaxiya.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma wamemezela ukuthi uzofihlwa ngoMngcwabo Okhethekile Kahulumeni Wesifundazwe.

src: U tirhele tiko hi ndlela ya xiyimo xa le henhla tanihi Muyimeri wa Afrika-Dzonga eRhaxiya na ku va Mutshamaxitulu wa Nhlangano wa Eneji ya Nyutliliya ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Umndeni nabangane bengqalabutho yoMzabalazo futhi owayeyisiboshwa e-Robben Island, uMnu Eddie Daniels, oshone esikhathini esifushane esedlule.

src: U ta tsundzukiwa hi ku tinyikela ka yena na vukorhokeri eka vanhu va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Uzokhunjulwa kakhulu ngokuzinikela kwakhe okukhulu kanye nokusebenzela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ndyangu na vanghana va khale ka Holobye wa Vusirheleri na Mavuthu, Manana Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, eka ku hundza emisaveni ka tata wakwe, Tatana Douglas Mapisa.
tgt: Umndeni nabangane bakaNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela Nomakadebona Bezempi, uNkz Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, oshonelwe wubaba wakhe uMnu Douglas Mapisa.

src: U hundzile emisaveni exibedlhele xa Cecilia Makiwane eEast London, eKapa-Vuxa a ri na malembe ya 96.Mitlangu leyi landzelaka.
tgt: Ushonele esibhedlela i-Cecilia Makiwane Hospital e-East London, eMpumalanga Kapa, eseneminyaka engama-96.E.

src: Malembe xidzana ya ku tsundzuka Nelson MandelaKhabinete yi hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga eka ku tsundzuka malembe ya mune ya ku hundza emisaveni ka khale ka Nelson Mandela hi ti 5 N'wendzamhala 2013.
tgt: Isikhumbuzo Seminyaka Eyikhulu Kwazalwa u-Nelson MandelaIKhabhinethi lihlanganyela nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika esikhumbuzweni seminyaka emine kwashona u-Nelson Mandela, mhla ziyisi-5 kuZibandlela 2013.

src: Hi 2018 tiko ri ta fungha malembexidzana ya vutomi bya Mandela laha MaAfrika-Dzonga ya hlohloteriwaka ku nghenela ntlangelo wa lembe hinkwaro loko ha ha tsundzuka un'wana wa vana va Afrika lonkulu.
tgt: Ngowezi-2018 leli lizwe lizogubha iminyaka eyikhulu yempilo kaMandela futhi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba babe yingxenye yemigubho ezoqhubeka unyaka wonke, njengoba sizobe sihlonipha enye yamadodana e-Afrika ayibeka induku ebandla.

src: Khabinete yi khensa MaAfrika-Dzonga ku va va nghenelerile eka ku tsundzuka ko hambanahambana ka mitlangu laha tikweni ka OR Tambo na ku tlhela hi langutela ku nghenelela ko tani loko ha ha tsundzuka nhenha ya hina na Phuresidente wo sungula loyi a nga hlawuriwa wa xidemokirasi, Madiba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyababonga bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokubamba kwabo iqhaza emicimbini yesikhumbuzo sika-OR Tambo eyabanjwa ezweni lonkana futhi liyethemba ukuthi abantu bazobamba iqhaza ngendlela efanayo ngenkathi sikhumbula ingqalabutho yethu, uMongameli wokuqala owakhethwa ngaphansi kwenqubo yentando yeningi labantu, uMadiba.

src: Nguva ya KhisimusiKabinete yi navelela MaAfrika-Dzonga nkarhi wa ntsako na nguva ya khisimusi ya vuhlayiseki.
tgt: Isikhathi Samaholide KakhisimusiIKhabhinethi lifisela bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika amaholide kaKhisimusi anentokozo futhi aphephile.

src: Hi kombela lava nga ta va va ri emagondzweni ku tiyisisa leswaku swifambo swa vona swi ringanerile ku va emagondzweni.
tgt: Siyabanxusa bonke labo abazohamba amabanga amade ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi izimoto zabo zisesimweni esikulungele ukuba semgwaqeni.

src: Vatirhisi va magondzo, vachayeri na vafambi hi milenge va fanele ku landzelela milawu ya le magondzweni.
tgt: Bonke abasebenzisi bomgwaqo, abashayeli kanye nabantu abahamba ngezinyawo, kumele bathobele imithetho yomgwaqo.

src: Holobye wa Vutleketli, Tatana Joe Maswanganyi u simekile pfhumba ra Arrive Alive eBela-Bela, eLimpopo hi ti 5 N'wendzamhala.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, uMnu Joe Maswanganyi, wethula umkhankaso we-Arrive Alive (Fika Uphephile) eBela-Bela, eLimpopo mhla ziyisi-5 kuZibandlela.

src: SAPS yi simeka pfhumba ra tiko hinkwaro ku va na nguva ya khisimusi yo hlayiseka na ku va na vutihlamuleri ku seketela SAPS hi ku landzelela nawu na matikhomelo lamanene.
tgt: Umbutho Wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) uzoqalisa umkhankaso ozoqhutshwa ezweni lonkana wokugqugquzela isikhathi samaholide kaKhisimusi esiphephile, futhi bonke abantu bakuleli banesibopho sokusekela i-SAPS ngokugcina umthetho nokuziphatha ngendlela esemthethweni.

src: Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya yi ta tivisa hi makungu ya 2017/18 ya mikarhi ya makhisimusi ya Afrika-Dzonga eka timhaka ta le mindzilekanini.
tgt: UMnyango Wezasekhaya uzomemezela izinhlelo zawo mayelana nesimo sokusebenza kwemingcele yaseNingizimu Afrika eziqondiswe esikhathini samaholide kaKhisimusi sowezi-2017/18.

src: Leswi i swa ku fambisa hi ku olova na mafambiselo ya kahle ya vanhu na tinhundzu ku nghena na ku huma laha Afrika-Dzonga hi nkarhi lowu wa mphesamphesa.
tgt: Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi luhamba kahle, ngaphandle kwezihibe, uhlelo lokuphuma nokungena kwabantu nempahla emingceleni yaseNingizimu Afrika ngalesi sikhathi esimatasa kakhulu.

src: Hi tlhela hi kombela vatswari na vahlayisi ku va va nga tshiki vana va nga ri na vulanguteri tanihilaha hi nga hi bohekaka ku va hlayisa.
tgt: Sithanda futhi nokunxusa abazali kanye nabalondolozi bezingane ukuba bangazishiyi zodwa izingane, ngoba phela kuwumsebenzi wethu ukunakekela izingane zethu.

src: Khabinete yi tsakile leswaku swikambelo swa ka Matiriki swi fambile ku ri hava swiwelo leswikulu na ku navelela tlilasi ya 2017 leswinene loko va ha yimele mivuyelo ya vona yo hetelela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakuthokozela impela ukuthi uhlelo lokuhlolwa kukaMatikuletsheni lwaqhubeka ngaphandle kwezinkinga ezinkulu futhi libafisela okuhle kodwa abafundi bakamatikuletsheni bowezi-2017 njengoba belinde imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwabo kokugcina.

src: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ya hi ku tiyisisiwa ka mithwaso na ku basisiwa loku faneleke.
tgt: F.AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikeziwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Manana Ilise Karg tanihi muyimeri wa dti eka Huvo ya Vutsundzuxi ya Rixaka eka Vundlandlamuxi.
tgt: Nkz Ilise Karg oqokwe njengommeleli we-dti eMkhandlwini Kazwelonke Wokweluleka Ezindabeni Eziphathelene Nokuqanjwa Nokusungulwa Kwezinhlelo Nezinto Ezintsha.

src: Huvo ya Valawuri va Nkwama wa ku Nyika matimba wa Rixaka:.Manana Nonkqubela Helen Maliza.Manana Lerato Cynthia Molefe.Manana Nthabiseng Mateboho Moleko.Tatana Ernest Kwinda na.
tgt: Amalungu eBhodi Labaphathiswa (Trustees) lesiKhwama Sikazwelonke Sokufukulwa Nokuhlonyiswa Kwabantu, (i-National Empowerment Fund):.Nkz Nonkqubela Helen Maliza.Nkz Lerato Cynthia Molefe.Nkz Nthabiseng Mateboho Moleko.Mnu Ernest Kwinda kanye.

tgt: noMnu Sipho Zikode (ongummeleli we-dti).Mnu Sandile Mkhize, oqokwe njengoMphathi Omkhulu (i-CEO) we-Magalies Water.

tgt: Mnu Wiseman Mkhize, oqokwe njengelungu leBhodi likaMlawuli Kazwelonke Wezamandla Kagesi waseNingizimu Afrika, (i-National Energy Regulator of South Africa).Mnu Phakamani Buthelezi, oqokwe njengo-CEO we-Overberg Water.

src: Tatana Wiseman Mkhize, tanihi xirho xa Huvo ya Vulawuri ya Eneji ya Rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga.

tgt: Nkz Brenda Sibeko, oqokwe njengePhini LikaMqondisi-Jikelele (u-DDG) wophiko lweziBonelelo Zomphakathi Ezibanzi (Comprehensive Social Security) eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi.
