src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, ti 10 Nhlangula 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-10 kuMfumfu 2018 e-Tuynhuys eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela loku tirhisekaka ko fana na ku tiyimisela ku xava swimakiwa leswi endliweke endzeni ka tiko, endlelo ro tika swinene ro tlakusa ku rhumela nhundzu ematikweni mambe, ku nghenelela eka migingiriko yo yisa swimakiwa swa vurimi eka vaxavi na nseketelo wa mabindzu lamatsongo na ya le xikarhi.
tgt: Umnotho kanye nomkhankaso wotshalomali.1 IKhabhinethi liyazamukela izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokungenelela eziphathekayo futhi ezinohlonze ezinjengokuzibophezela ekuthengeni imikhiqizo yakuleli, ukuqiniswa kakhudlwana kwemizamo yokukhulisa umthamo wempahla yakuleli ethunyelwa emazweni angaphandle, izinhlelo zokungenelela ochungechungeni lomsebenzi wokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo kanye nokweseka amabhizinisi asafufusa.

src: Switiviso leswi swi hume eka Samiti ya Mitirho ya masiku mambirhi leya ha ku vaka kona, leyi a yi khomeriwe ehansi ka Huvo ya Vatirhi na Nhluvukiso wa swa Ikhonomi ya Rixaka.
tgt: Lezi zimemezelo ziwumphumela weNgqungquthela Yemisebenzi ethathe izinsuku ezimbili ebibanjwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule, ebibizwe ngaphansi koMkhandlu Kazwelonke Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho kanye Nezabasebenzi (i-Nedlac).2 Umphumela weNgqungquthela Yemisebenzi ulandela isimemezelo soHlelo Lokuvuselela Nokugqugquzela Ukusimama Komnotho, oluhlose ukubuyisa nokuvuselela ukukhula komnotho futhi ludale namathuba omsebenzi adingeka kakhulu.

src: Mbuyelo wa Samiti ya Mitirho wu ta endzhaku ka ku tivisiwa ka Kungu ro Vuyisela na Nhlohlotelo wa swa Ikhonomi, leri lavaka ku tlherisela ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho leyi lavekaka swinene.
tgt: Usomqulu Wezimayini omusha – ophothulwe ngokubonisana nemboni yezimayini, abasebenzi, imiphakathi ethintekile kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza – icacisa izinto ezisemqoka kakhulu okumele zenziwe ukuze kulethwe ukukhula komnotho, ukusimama kanye noguquko.3 IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuthi bawucubungule futhi bazame ukuwuqonda uSomqulu Wezimayini ukuze uphothulwe futhi kulethwe uzinzo emkhakheni wezimayini.

src: Tsalwa ra milawu ya swa Migodi lerintshwa leri nga fikisiwa emakumu hi ku tihlanganisa na indhasitiri ya swa migodi, vatirhi, miganga leyi khumbekaka na vanhu lava nga na xiave van’wana – ri swi veka erivaleni nkoka wa ku kula, ku yisa emahlweni nkarhi wo leha na ncico.
tgt: Ihhovisi loMnyango Wezasekhaya lase-Kokstad kanye nokunikezwa kwamatayitela.1 NjengoMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa, iKhabhinethi nalo liyawuncoma impela uMnyango Wezasekhaya ngokuvula ngempumelelo ihhovisi lawo lase-Kokstad KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vanhu hinkwavo lava nga na xiave ku hlayisisa Tsalwa ra Milawu ya swa Migodi ku endlela leswaku ku fikisiwa emakumu na ku endla leswaku ku va na ntshamiseko eka sekitara ya swa migodi.
tgt: UMongameli wavula ngokusemthethweni leli hhovisi loMnyango Wezasekhaya njengengxenye yohlelo lukahulumeni lokwelula ukufinyelela kwezizinda zoMnyango Wezasekhaya ezihlinzeka ngezidingongqangi kubantu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nesasasa elikhulu eliboniswa yizakhamuzi zakuleli komazisi bekhadi kanye nezinye izincwadi.2 Ngaphezu kwalokho, uMongameli Ramaphosa wadlulisela amatayitela angaphezu kwama-443 ezandleni zabahlomuli boMklamo Wezindlu wase-Franklin.

src: Phuresidente u pfule hofisi ya Timhaka ta Xikaya tanihi xiphemu xa nongonoko wa mfumo wo ndlandlamuxa tindhawu to nyika vukorhokeri ta Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ku fikelela swilaveko swa vaaki swa mapasi ya makhadi na matsalwa man’wana.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo lokuvuselela ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi abahlomuli bathokozela imihlomulo ephelele yokuba ngabanikazi bezindlu futhi ukuze bakwazi nokufinyelela emakethe yomhlaba ehlelekile.3 IKhabhinethi lithanda futhi ukusebenzisa leli thuba ukukhuthaza izakhamuzi zakuleli ukuthi zihambe ziyolanda omazisi bazo ngokushesha emva kokuthola isaziso esibanxusa ukuthi beze bazobalanda.

src: Ku tatisela kwalaho, Phuresidente Ramaphosa u nyike ku tlula 443 wa mapapila ya vun’wini bya tindlu eka vavuyeriwa va Phurojeke ya swa Tindlu ya Franklin.
tgt: Ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni mayelana nokwabiwa kwamagagasi okusakaza ngomoya IKhabhinethi liyasamukela isivumelwano okufinyelelwe kusona mayelana nodaba olubandakanya isiMemo Sokufakwa Kwezicelo eziqondene nokwabiwa kwamagagasi okusakaza ngomoya afunwa kakhulu.

src: Lexi i xiphemu xa nongonoko wo tlherisela ku tiyisisa leswaku vavuyeriwa va kuma ku vuyeriwa hi ku hetiseka ko va vini va tindlu naswona va kota ku fikelela makete ya swa tindlu ya ximfumo.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka ukuqiniseka mayelana nezinqubomgomo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bolwazi nokuxhumana (i-ICT).

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi tirhisa xivandlanene lexi ku khutaza swinene vaakatiko ku ya teka mapasi ya vona hi xihatla loko va kume xitiviso xo ya teka.
tgt: Lesi sivumelwano sihambelana nekhwelo likaMongameli Ramaphosa lokuqaliswa kwenqubo yokwabiwa kwamalayisensi amagagasi okusakaza ngomoya afunwa kakhulu.3 Ngenhloso yokufaka isandla esithe xaxa ekuqalisweni kokusebenza koHlaka Lombiko Odingidwayo Wenqubomgomo Ye-ICT Edidiyelwe Kazwelonke, bonke abanentshisekelo bazonikezwa ithuba lokuhlinzeka uphiko ngemibono yabo ebhalwe phansi kuze kube ngumhla ziyisi-8 kuLwezi 2018 mayelana nenqubomgomo ehlongozwayo kanye nesiqondiso senqubomgomo.

src: Ntwanano lowu fikeleriweke hi mayelana na swihondzo.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kwale mifelandawonye kuwuphawu lokuqaliswa kokusebenza kwenqubomgomo yabadobi abancane.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ntwanano lowu fikeleriweke eka mhaka leyi khumbaka Xirhambo xo Endla Xikombelo xa maavelo ya swihondzo leswi laviwaka swinene.
tgt: Amalungelo okudoba anikeza abadobi bendawo isithunzi, njengoba bebedoba ngokungemthetho, kepha-ke manje sebevikelekile, futhi kungokokuqala ngqa ukuthi kwenzeke into enjalo kuleli.

src: Leswi swi nyika ku tshemba eka pholisi eka sekitara ya vuhlanganisi bya thekinoloji na mahungu (ICT).
tgt: Le miphakathi yabadobi abancane emibili ezohlomula kule nqubomgomo seyithole ukuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo mayelana nemifelandawonye futhi ilekeleliwe ukubhalisa imifelandawonye yayo ukuze ikwazi ukufaka izicelo zamalungelo okudoba isikhathi esiyiminyaka eyi-.

src: Ntwanano lowu fikeleriweke wu fambisana na xirhambo xa Phuresidente Ramaphosa xo ta na phurosese ya maavelo ya tilayisense ta swihondzo swa rhadiyo leti laviwaka swinene.
tgt: Isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela.1 IKhabhinethi liyabancoma abakhokhi bentela ababalelwa ezigidini ezintathu asebewathumelile amafomu abo entela, futhi abayisigamu kulaba bawathumele nge-inthanethi amafomu abo besebenzisa uhlelo lwe-eFiling.

src: Loko ku tlhela ku hoxiwa xandla eka matirhiselo ya Pholisi ya Mpfapfarhuto wa tirhele ya ICT leyi Pfanganisiweke ya Rixaka, mavandla lama nga na ku tsakela ya na ku fikela ti 8 Hukuri 2018 ku nyika mavonelo lama tsariweke hi mayelana na pholisi leyi ringanyetiweke na tlhelo leri pholisi yi ri tekaka eka mfumo.
tgt: Mhla zingama-31 kuMfumfu, siyavalwa isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela sowezi-2018 maqondana nabakhokhi bentela abathola ingenisomali evela emholweni kuphela kanye nabakhokhi bentela yesithutshana (okusho labo abathola ingenisomali ngale komholo, noma ingenisomali evela ebhizinisini) abaqoka ukuzihambisela amafomu abo mathupha egatsheni lesiKhungo Esiqoqa Intela saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS).

src: Khabinete yi amukela mabindzu lamatsongo yo sungula ya Afrika-Dzonga eka sekitara ya vunjoveri lama ku nga mabindzu ya le Port Nolloth na Hondeklipbaai eKapa-N’walungu, lama simekiweke hi Holobye wa Vurimi, Swihlahla na Vunjoveri, Tat Senzeni Zokwana.
tgt: Abakhokhi bentela yesithutshana abaqoka ukuthumela amafomu nge-eFiling bazonikezwa ithuba lokuthumela amafomu abo kuze kube ngumhla zingama-31 kuMasingana 20.2 Ukuqoqwa ngendlela efanele kwemali engenayo emgodlagodleni kahulumeni kuqinisekisa amandla aleli lizwe olulawula imali engenayo ngokuzimela futhi ukuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela aqukethe imininingwane efanelekile, ngesikhathi esibekiwe, kuyaqinisekisa ukuthi abakhokhi bentela bathathwa njengabantu abawuthobelayo umthetho wezentela.

src: Ku simekiwa ku fungha matirhiselo ya pholisi ya vunjoveri lebyitsongo.
tgt: Imali etholakala ngokukhokhwa kwentela ilekelela uhulumeni ukuze akwazi ukuxhasa ngezimali imiklamo yokuthunyelwa kwezidingongqangi kuleli kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalomnotho.

src: Timfanelo to njovela ti nyika xindzhuti eka vanjoveri va tinhlampfi va laha ndzeni ka tiko, lava a va njovela swi nga ri enawini, laha sweswi va sirheleriweke ro sungula.
tgt: Ukukhokhwa kwezibonelelomali zikahulumeni.1 IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko yiKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene: Elijutshwe Ukubhekana Nodaba Lwezibonelelomali Zikahulumeni, usihlalo walo okunguNgqongqoshe Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.

src: Miganga leyimbirhi ya swa vunjoveri lebyitsongo yi nga ta vuyeriwa kusuka eka pholisi leyi yi kume vuleteri bya masungulo hi mayelana na mabindzu naswona yi pfuniwe ku tsarisa mabindzu ya yona hi xikongomelo xo endla xikombelo xa timfanelo to njovela xa malembe ya Nguva ya xibalo.
tgt: Kusukela mhla lu-1 kuMfumfu 2018, bangaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-10 abahlomuli abakhokhelwe izibonelelomali zabo kusetshenziswa ezinye zalezi zikhungo ezilandelayo – iPosi laseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPO)/i-Postbank i-Grindrod Bank kanye nezitolo ezinjengo-Boxer, Shoprite, kanye no-Pick n Pay.2 Uhulumeni usekwazile ukufudukisa ngempumelelo umsebenzi wokukhokhwa kwezibonelelomali zikahulumeni usuka enkampanini yakwa-Cash Paymaster Services (i-CPS) ngokomyalelo wesiNqumo Senkantolo.

src: Khabinete yi bumabumela kwalomu ka timiliyoni tinharhu ta vahakeri va swibalo lava tlheriseke swibalo swa vona laha ku tlula hafu ya vona va tlheriseke hi ku tirhisa Inthanete.
tgt: Bonke abahlomuli abebekhokhelwa imali engukheshi ngu-CPS sebefudukisiwe futhi i-CPS seyazisiwe ngokuqedwa kwenkontileka yayo kusukela mhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 20.3 IKhabhinethi lidlulisa ukubonga kwalo ngomsebenzi wokuqapha omuhle kakhulu obuholwa yiThimba LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene lisekelwa yiThimba Elikhethekile LabaQondisi Jikelele Abanolwazi Olunzulu Emsebenzini Walo Mkhakha.

src: Ku hlengeletiwa ka xibalo hi ndlela ya kahle na vuswikoti swi tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ku yima kahle ka nkwama wa tiko, naswona ku tlherisiwa ka xibalo hi nkarhi na hi nkahoxeko swi tiyisisa leswaku vahakeri va xibalo va landzelelaka.
tgt: Liyawubonga futhi umsebenzi omuhle wezikhulu ezivela ku-SAPO, Inhlangano Yezimpesheni Nezibonelelo Zikahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika (i-Sassa) kanye noMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi OwezeNgqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi OwezokuHlela, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola Owezezimali Kuzwelonke uMbutho Wamaphoyisa waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) kanye Nophiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokuhlinzeka Ngolwazi (i-GCIS).4 IKhabhinethi liyababonga bonke abahlomuli bezibonelelomali zikahulumeni ngobambiswano lwabo abalubonisile kulesi sikhathi soguquko.

src: Mali leyi hlengeletiweke hi swibalo yi pfuna mfumo ku pfuna tiphurojeke ta mphakelo wa vukorhokeri ta tiko hi swa timali na minongonoko yin’wana ya nhluvukiso ikhonomi ya vanhu.
tgt: Imigubho yekhulu-nyaka lika-Albertina Sisulu IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko mayelana namalungiselelo omgubho wekhulu-nyaka likaMama u-Albertina Sisulu ozobanjwa ngenyanga azalwa ngayo, uMfumfu.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwe hi Komiti ya Vaholobye: Midende ya Vaakatiko leyi fambisiwaka hi Holobye Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.
tgt: UMama uSisulu wazalwa mhla zingama-21 kuMfumfu 1918, futhi usiHlalo WeKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene Ejutshwe Umsebenzi Wokuhlela Lo mgubho, uNgqongqoshe u-Jeff Radebe, ukhona lapha ukuzochaza kabanzi mayelana nemicimbi nemisebenzi ezokwenziwa ephathelene nomgubho wekhulu-nyaka likaMama u-Albertina Sisulu.

src: Kusukela hi ti1 Nhlangula 2018, ku tlula 10 wa timiliyoni ta vahori va midende va hakeriwile hi ku tirhisa yin’wana na yin’wana ya tipulatifomo leti – Poso ya Afrika-Dzonga (SAPO)/Postbank Bangi ya Grindrod xikan’we na mavhengele yo xavisa yo fana na Boxer, Shoprite na Pick n Pay.
tgt: Ukugwetshwa kukababa wase-Springs.1 IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukugwetshwa kwendoda enesihluku, edume ngeleNunu Esabekayo yase-Springs (i-Springs Monster).

src: Mfumo wu swi kotile ku rhurhisela ku hakeriwa ka midende ya vaakatiko ku suka eka Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) tanihilaha swi lerisiweke hakona hi Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.
tgt: Wagwetshwa iminyaka engama-35 ejele ngecala lokuzama ukubulala indodana yakhe, ukuhlukumeza, ukuhluleka ukunakekela izingane zakhe kanye nokusebenzisa futhi athengise izidakamizwa.

src: Vavuyeriwa va mali ya midende hinkwavo lavaa va hakeriwaka hi CPS va rhurhisiwile naswona CPS yi tivisiwile hi ku herisiwa ka kontiraka ya yona hi ti 30 Ndzati 2018.
tgt: Udlame oluqondiswe kwabesifazane lusalokhu luyinselele enkulu ezweni lethu, njengoba lokhu kubonakale ngokucacile esigamekweni sokudlwengulwa kwengane esencane esenzeke esikhathini esifushane esedlule esitolo sokudla sakwa-Dros e-Silverton.

src: Khabinete yi tata ku khensa ka yona eka ntirho wo langutela lowu tirhiweke kahle lowu a wu rhangeriwile hi Komiti ya Vaholobye lowu seketeriweke hi Ntlawa wa Ntirho wa Xithekiniki Vafambisijenerali.
tgt: Khabhinethi liyagcizelela ekhweleni eliqondiswe kwiziphathimandla eziqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ukuthi zenze konke okusemandleni azo ukushushisa abenzi balawa macala amabi kangaka.

src: Yi tlhela yi tata ku khensa ka yona eka ntirho wa vatirhi vo huma eka SAPO, Ejensi ya swa Midende ya Vaakatiko ya Afrika-Dzonga (Sassa) na, tindzawulo ta Nhluvukiso wa Vaaki Vukorhokeri bya Tiposo na Vuhlanganisi bya Tinqingho, Nkunguhato, Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo Vutameri bya Nkwama wa Tiko Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga na GCIKhabinete yi khensa vavuyeriwa va midende hinkwavo eka ntirhisano wa vona hi nkarhi wa ku cinca loku.
tgt: Imibhikisho yase-Westbury.1 IKhabhinethi liyazamukela izinyathelo zokungenelela e-Westbury ezithathwe nguNgqongqoshe uBheki Cele, eziyingxenye yeqhingasu elibanzi lokulwisana nesihlava sezidakamizwa kanye nodlame oluphathelene nemigulukudu kuleya ndawo.2 Izinyathelo zokungenelela zibandakanya ukutshalwa kwethimba lamaphoyisa akhethekile aqeqeshwe ngokujulile, adume “ngelamaBherethi”, kanye nokukhuliswa kwesibalo samaphoyisa aqaphile, ehla enyuka emphakathini, eqinisekisa ukuphepha komphakathi.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi malunghiselo yo tlangela lembexidzana ra Manana Albertina Sisulu loku nga ta va kona hi n’hweti ya ku velekiwa ka yena, nhlangula.
tgt: Ubugebengu IKhabhinethi liyazincoma impela izimpiko eziqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ngophenyo olunzulu olumkhakha-mningi ezilwenzile oluphathelene nezigameko zeziqhumane ezitholakale ezikhungweni ezinenxanxathela yezitolo, ezitolo ezinkulu ezidumile kanye nasezindlini zesonto lamaSulumane (ama-mosque), okuwuphenyo oseluholele ekuboshweni kwabasolwa abayi-19.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku gweviwa ka wanuna wa muxanisi loyi a tiviwa swinene tanihi Xihovori xa le Springs.
tgt: Abasolwa abathathu kulaba baboshelwe amacala aphathelene neziqhumane ezatholakala ezikhungweni ezihlukahlukene eThekwini, kubandakanya nendlu yesonto lamaSulumane e-Verulam.

src: U gweviwe kufikela eka malembe ya 35 ekhotsweni eka ku ringeta ku dlaya n’wana wa yena wa jaha, ku xanisa n’wana na ku tsan’wa, xikan’we na ku tirhisa na ku xavisa swidzidziharisi.
tgt: Bonke abasolwa kulindeleke ukuthi babekwe amacala, kubandakanya elokubulala, ukuzama ukubulala kanye nokwephula uMthetho Weziqhumane.2 IKhabhinethi liyabaqinisekisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ukulwisana nobugebengu kuyinto ebekwe eqhulwini futhi uhulumeni uzoqhubeka nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika baphila ngaphansi kwesimo esiphephile futhi esivikelekile.

src: Madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu ma ha ri ntlhontlho lowukulu emigangeni ya hina,tanihilaha swi tikombeke hakona hi mpfinyo lowu wa ha ku vaka kona wa n’wana lontsongo evhengeleni ro xavisa swakudya leswi swekiweke na ku dyela ra Dros eSilverton.
tgt: Ukuguqulwa kwegama lendawo: Makhanda IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukuguqulwa kwegama ledolobha i-Grahamstown, eMpumalanga Kapa, libizwe ngeMakhanda, ngenhloso yokuhlonipha umphrofethi, isazi senzululwazi kanye nomkhuzi wempi owalwisana nenqubo yokuqonelwa ngabezizwe.2 Lolu guquko luyingxenye esemqoka ohambweni lwentando yeningi labantu futhi luzolekelela ukuqinisa ubumbano lomphakathi futhi luzokwenza ukuthi abantu bakuleli bawuqonde futhi bawazise kakhudlwana umlando waleli lizwe, okungumlando wethu sonke.

src: Khabinete yi tshikelela xirhambo xa minhlangano ya nsindziso wa nawu ku tirha hi matimba swinene eka ku gweva vaendlamilandzu va vugevenga lebyi byo chavisa.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethiIKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uhlelo olubuyekeziwe lokuqaliswa koMklamo Wokufudukela Ekusakazeni Ngedijithali.

src: Yi tlhela yi rhamba hinkwerhu ka hina ku tirhisana eka ku herisa ku tluriwa ka timfanelo ta vana na swirho leswi nga sirhelelekangiki swinene swa vaakatiko va hina.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lusebenzisa indlela yokusebenza eqhutshwa yizimakethe noma izitolo ngokuthi kubanjiswane nomkhakha ozimele kanye nezimboni.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela ka Holobye wa Maphorisa Bheki Cele eWestbury, loku nga xiphemu xa qhinga ro angarhela ro lwisana na ntungu wa swidzidziharisi na madzolonga lama fambelanaka na mitlawa ya vugevenga eka ndhawu yoleyo.
tgt: Ngale ndlela yokusebenza, uhulumeni ngeke esazibandakanya ekuthengweni kwamabhokisana okudonsa isiginali kamabonakude (ama-set-top-boxes), ukugcinwa kwawo, kanye nokuthuthwa nokuxhunywa kwawo emakhaya.

src: Ku nghenelela ku katsa ku rhumeriwa ka Ntlawa wa Qhinga ro Angula (Tactical Response Team, va tlhela va tiveka tanihi Mabereta) na vukona bya maphorisa lebyi vonakaka swinene.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka iNingizimu Afrika ngethuba lokuqhubekela phambili ekuphothulweni kwalo mklamo wokufudukela ekusakazeni ngedijithali ngendlela ebandakanyayo, engambi eqolo futhi esebenza kahle, futhi kunciphisa nobungozi kuhulumeni.

src: Xa nkoka swinene, hi leswaku ku ta tlhela ku va na vulavisisi bya swihehlo swa vukungundzwana eka Xitichi xa Maphorisa xa le Westbury.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokhuphula inani lababukeli asebebukela umabonakude othola isiginali yedijithali lifinyelele emkhawulweni obekuhloswe ukufinyelela kuwona wama-85% futhi kuze kudlulele nangaphezulu kwalokho, njengoba kuphokophelwe ekucimeni wonke amasiginali okusakaza nge-analogi.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vaakatiko va le Westbury na vaaki hinkwavo ku tirhisana na maphorisa ku vona leswaku hi herisa migingiriko ya vugevenga, swidzidziharisi na mitlawa ya swigevenga eka tindhawu ta vona to hambanahambana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liwugunyazile uMbhalo Wemigomo Engumongo (i-Common Core Document) yeNingizimu Afrika, ozothunyelwa kwiNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN).

src: Khabinete yi bumabumela tiejensi to sindzisa ku landzeleriwa ka nawu eka ku endla vulavisisi bya xiyimo xa le henhla lebyi fambelanaka na timhangu ta le timolo, mavhengele yo xavisa na tikereke ta MaIslam lebyi nga endla leswaku ku khomiwa vaehleketeriwa va khumekaye.
tgt: Lo mbhalo uhlinzeka ngenqubekelaphambili equkethe ulwazi olujwayelekile olungamaqiniso futhi olunezibalomanani mayelana nokuthobela kweNingizimu Afrika izibopho ezihambisana nezivumelwano ze-UN eziyisishiyagalolunye ezasayinwa.

src: Khabinete yi tshembisa MaAfrika-Dzonga leswaku ku lwisana na vugevenga i xirhangana xa le henhla na leswaku mfumo wu ta ya emahlweni wu teka magoza lama faneleke ku vona leswaku ku na mbangu lowu hlayisekeke na ku sirheleleka eka vatshami hinkwavo va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawunxusa umphakathi ukuthi usebenzise izithuthi zomphakathi futhi uqalise ngenkuthalo ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphepha emgwaqeni, okuyinto okumele yenziwe unyaka wonke.

src: Ku cinca i xiphemu xa nkoka xa rendzo ra hina ra xidemokirasi naswona ku ta pfuneta ku tlakusa vun’we bya vaaki hi lakukulu na ku aka ku tlangela ko enta ka ku avelana ka matimu ya hinaSwiboho swa KhabineteKhabinete yi pasise modlolo wo korhokela lowu pfuxetiweke eka nsimeko wa Phurojeke ya Ndzhurho wa Vuhaxi byi ya eka Dijitali.
tgt: Masisebenziseni iNyanga Yezokuthutha ukugubha nokubuyisa isikompilo lokuthi abantu bagibelisane emotweni eyodwa uma beya emsebenzini esikhundleni sokuthi umuntu ngamunye azihambele ngemoto yakhe ukuze kuncishiswe isiminyaminya sezimoto emigwaqeni yakuleli.

src: Modlolo lowu wu amukela endlelo leri fambisiwaka hi makete/vuxavisi hi ku tirhisana swin’we na vutirhisani na sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo na indhasitiri.
tgt: Ukuphepha kusalokhu kuyinselele emgwaqeni yakuleli, futhi abashayeli kanye nabantu abahamba ngezinyawo kumele bayisebenzise ngokucophelela imigwaqo yomphakathi.

src: Hi endlelo leri, mfumo wu nge he khumbeki eka nkumo wa Xibokisana xa Vuhaxi bya Mahungu vuhlayiselanhundzu, ku tleketliwa na ku nghenisiwa ka switirhisiwa.
tgt: ImiyalezoAmazwi okuhalaliselaIsibonakude seNingizimu Afrika esisebenza ngamagagasi omoya, i-MeerKAT, sizoba yingxenye ye-Breakthrough Listen, okuwuhlelo lwamazwe ngamazwe lokucinga nokuthungatha izimpawu zezidalwa eziphilayo emkhathini.

src: Leswi swi nyika Afrika-Dzonga nhluvukiso wo ya emakumu ka phurojeke hi ndlela leyi nghenisaka hinkwavo, yo kala yi nga durhi na ku koteka, naswona sweswo swi hungutaka nxungeto eka mfumo.
tgt: Lokhu kubonisa ubuchwepheshe nengqalasizinda yakuleli ehlonishwa emhlabeni wonke jikelele.

src: Leswi swi ta susumeta ndzhurhiso wa ku vona ka dijitali ku ya eka 85% ya masungulo na ku yisa emahlweni, ku ya eka ku timiwa ka vuhaxi hinkwabyo bya analogo.
tgt: I-MeerKAT, okuyisibonakude seNingizimu Afrika esisebenza ngamagagasi omoya esinezindishi ezingama-64, esethulwa ngoNtulikazi kulo nyaka, yisibonakude esibukhali kunazo zonke izibonakude zohlobo olufanayo emhlabeni wonke jikelele.

src: Tsalwa ri nyika nhluvukiso lowu nga na mahungu ya ntolovelo, ya ntiyiso na ku va ya muxaka wa tinhlayo eka ku landzelela ka Afrika-Dzonga eka mfanelo leyi fambisanaka na ku sayiniwa na mitwanano ya kaye ya UN.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela ithimba labacwaningi abavela eNyuvesi yase-Wits abenze ukufakelwa kwesibindi okuyingqophamlando futhi okube yimpumelelo, ngenkathi bethatha ingxenye yesibindi kumama Onegciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) beyifaka kumntwana wakhe ongenayo i-HIIthimba lodokotela belibandakanya uSlz Jean Botha, Dkt Francesca Conradie, Dkt Harriet Etheredge, Dkt June Fabian kanye noSlz Caroline Tiemessen.

src: Swiendleko leswi takaXitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi (MTBPS)Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni u ta andlala Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi (MTBPS) hi Ravunharhu, 24 Nhlangula 2018, lexi nga ta humesela erivaleni cincacinco eka mpimanyeto wa rixaka ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ntshamiseko wa swa timali ta tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela abantu base-Equatorial Guinea emgubhweni wama-50 wenkululeko yabo.

src: A hi tirhiseni n’hweti leyi ku tlangela na ku vuyisa ntolovelo wo famba swin’we emimovheni loko hi ya entirhweni ku hunguta ntlimbano wa mimovha emagondzweni ya hina.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Molewa wazibonakalisa ngomsebenzi wakhe omuhle ezikhundleni eziningi abethweswe zona kanye nasemikhankasweni yobushoshovu abeyishabashekela, kusukela kwigalelo lakhe emzabalwazweni wenkululeko yethu kuya kubushoshovu bakhe bokulwela amalungelo abesifazane alinganayo ezweni lethu.

src: Vuhlayiseki bya gondzo emagondzweni ya hina byi tshama bya ha ri ntlhontlho, naswona vachayeri na van’wamilenge va fanele va tirhisa magondzo ya mani na mani hi vutihlamuleri.
tgt: Futhi ubeyisishabasheki sikazwelonke nesomhlaba wonke jikelele ebesilwela ukuphathwa kahle kwemvelo ukuze sibe nomhlaba osimeme oyothokozelwa yibo bonke abantu futhi bahlalisane kahle kuwona.

src: SwihungwanaVuhoyozeriThelesikopu ya rhadiyo ya Afrika-Dzonga, MeerKat yi ta joyina Breakthrough Listen, pfhumba ra matiko ya misava leri lavaka mikombeto ya vutomi bya vutlhari emisaveni.
tgt: Uhulumeni usethembisile ukuthi uzoleseka futhi alilekelele leliya lizwe, lapho kudingeke khona, futhi iKhabhinethi liyabancoma impela abahlinzeki bosizo abavela eNingizimu Afrika abayingxenye yemizamo yokulekelela nokuhlinzeka ngosizo esiqhingini sase-Indonesia, i-Sulawesi, esikhahlanyezwe wukuzamazama komhlaba kanye ne-tsunami.

src: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 24 Nhlangula 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangana walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-24 kuMfumfu 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa le Xikarhi ka Theme (MTBPS)1.1 Khabinete yi amukela MTBPS yo sungulasungula hi Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni, leyi simekiweke ehenhla ka nkholwo wo tiya leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi nga pfuxiwa hi vuntshwa.2 MTBPS ya 2018 yi kombisa swihlawuriwa swo tika swa ikhonomi na nkwama wa timali wa mfumo leswi langutaneke na mfumo eka malembe manharhu lama landzelaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela i-MTBPS yokuqala kaNgqongqoshe Wezezimali uTito Mboweni, ebesisuselwa enkolelweni enkulu yokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ingavuselelwa.

src: Ku kula ka ikhonomi ka 2018 ku pfuxetiwile kuya ehansi kusuka eka 1.5% kufika eka 0.7%, naswona mbangu wa misava hinkwayo wu ta tama wa ha ri na mitlhontlho eka tiikhonomi ta timakete leta ha tumbulukaka.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowezi-2018 icaphuna ubunzima uhulumeni abhekene nabo ezinqumweni okumele azithathe kwezomnotho kanye nakwimali kahulumeni eminyakeni emithathu ezayo.

src: MTBPS 2018 yi humelerisa xihlohloteri xa ku kula ka ikhonomi xa Phuresidente na pulani ya ku hlukela, leswi swi nga ta seketeriwa hi ntshamiseko wa nkwama wa timali wa mfumo na wa timali.3 Mfumo wu tama wa ha tibohile eka ku yiseka emahlweni ka swa nkwama wa timali wa mfumo, kambe ku vile na ku rheta kusukela loko ku andlariwile Mpimanyeto wa 2018 nan’waka.
tgt: Ukukhula kwezomnotho konyaka wezi-2018 kubuyekeziwe kwasuka ku-1.5% kwaya ku-0.7%, futhi isimo somhlaba jikelele siqhubeka nokuba nezingqinamba kwezomnotho emazweni asafufusa.

src: Mfumo wu tama wa ha tibohile ku tshamisekisa na ku hunguta xikweleti.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowezi-2018 iqalisa ukusimamisa kanye nohlelo lukahulumeni lokuvusesela nokugqugquzela ukusimama komnotho, oluzosekelwa uzinzo lwesikhwamamali sikahulumeni kanye nolwezimali.

src: Ehenhla ka xiyimo xa mbangu wo tika wa ikhonomi na nkwama wa timali wa mfumo, ku aviwa loku ringanyetiwaka ka xibalo ku ya emahlweni ku rhangise minongonoko yo tirhisa mali leyi seketelaka dyondzo ya masungulo, rihanyu, ku hanya kahle ka vaaki, mati, nkululo na vukorhokeri bya gezi.
tgt: Uhulumeni uqhubeka nokuzibophezela ekusimamiseni isikhawamamali sikahulumeni, kodwa kube nokuchezuka okuncane selokhu sethulwa kuSabelomali sowezi-2018 kuNhlolanja kulo nyaka.

src: Mpfuxeto wa misava.1 Khabinete yi amukela ntirho lowu fananaka wa minongonoko ya mpfuxeto wa misava na ntlheriso wa timfanelo lowu lulamisaka nkavululami wa karhi lowu nga hundza na ku pfuna ku kurisa ikhonomi.2 Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u rhangele ntirho wa ntlheriso wa timfanelo ta misava, laha kutlula 4 586 wa tihekitara ta misava ti nyikiweke muganga wa KwaMkhwanazi eEmpangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.3 Muganga wa KwaMkhwanazi wu ta tlhela wu kuma mipako ya le ndzhaku ka ku tshamisekisiwa na nseketelo lowu nga ta va pfuna ku fikisa eka mpimo wa le henhla rifuwo leri nga kotekaka ra misava leyi.
tgt: Njengoba kuncipha umthwalo osindayo kwezomnotho kanye nasesimweni sesikhwamamali sikahulumeni, ukwahlukaniswa kwengeniso okuphakanyiswayo kuyaqhubeka nokubeka eqhulwini izinhlelo zokusebenzisa imali emphakathini njengemfundo eyisisekelo, ezempilo, ezenhlalakahle, amanzi, ukuthuthwa kwendle kanye nezinsiza zikagesi.

src: Ku onheteriwa kwaloko ku tirha ku pfumata lava sweleke vukorhokeri lebyi dingiwaka swonghasi.2 Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku rhiya tihlo na ku tirhisana na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku endla leswaku lavaya va nga na vutihlamuleri va tihlamulela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukuqaliswa kwezinhlelo zoguquko nokubuyiselwa komhlaba eziqhutshwa ngokulinganayo eziqondene nemisebenzi nokungalungi kwesikhathi esedlule futhi lisiza ukukhulisa umnotho.

src: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi lemuka leswaku Ntlawa wa Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Nsirhelelo wu tirhana na mhaka leyi hilaha swi faneleke hakona.
tgt: UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa uhole umcimbi wokubuyiswa komhlaba, lapho kunikezelwe ngamahektha ayizi-4 586 omhlaba emphakathini waKwaMkhwanazi eMpangeni, KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Endlelo ra ku thoriwa ka Mulawuri wa Vuchuchisi bya Mfumo wa Vaaki (NDPP)5.1 Khabinete yi amukele endlelo lerintshwa ra ku thoriwa ka NDPPhuresidente Ramaphosa u thole Phanele yo Tsundzuxa ku kuma na ku endla tiinthavhiyu na vanhu lava nga na nkoka wa ku tekeriwa enhlokweni ku teka xiyimo xa Nhloko ya Vulawuri byo Chuchisa bya Rixaka.
tgt: Umphakathi waKwaMkhwanazi uzothola nezabelo ezilandela ukubuyiswa komhlaba kanye nokwesekwa okuzowusiza usebenzise yonke ingcebo ongase uyithole kulowa mhlaba.

src: Phanele leyi yi hlengeletane ro sungula vhiki reri naswona yi languteriwa ku rhumela mavito ya lava nghenisiweke eka nxaxamelo wo koma eka Phuresidente ku nga si hundza siku ra 7 N’wendzamhala Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.1 Khabinete yi burisanile hi Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa hi ku tirhisiwa, ku rimiwa na ku va na mbangi hi ntswatsi eka ku yi tirhisela swa le xihundleni swa yena n’wini na nhlohlotelo wa yona.
tgt: Lokhu kushintsha imiphakathi esebenzela ukuziphilisa ibambe iqhaza kwezohwebo futhi ibe ngabanikazi bamabhizinisi kuyo yonke imisebenzi evela kwezolimo kanye nengcebo engatholakala emhlabeni wabo.

src: Vaaki va komberiwa ku endla va tiva hi vuahluri lebyi tanihileswi ntirhiso wa mbangi endhawini ya mani na mani wu tshimbisiweke.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzinikele ekwesekeni ukusimamiswa kwamabhizinisi ezolimo aqubukayo, okubandakanya imisebenzi engama-262 ehambisana nokuguqulwa komhlaba ukuze kuhlomule intsha kanye nabantu besifazane kuzo zonke izifundazwe.

src: Khabinete yi le ku kumeni ka switsundzuxo eka mhaka leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulise ukukhathazeka ngokubhidlizwa kwengqalasizinda yezokuthutha.

src: Samiti ya Vuhlayiseki bya Swikolo.1 Khabinete yi amukela Samiti ya Vuhlayiseki bya Xikolo leya ha ku Khomiwaka ku nga ri khale leyi rhurheriweke ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Dyondzo ya Masungulo Angie Motshekga.
tgt: Lokhu kubukela phansi ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuhambiseni izinsiza emiphakathini eyayiphucwe amathuba ngaphambilini.

src: Vatswari na vahlayisi va khutaziwa ku seketela vadyondzi hi nkarhi lowu wa nkoka swonghasi eka rendzo ra vona ra tidyondzo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa amalungu omphakathi ukuthi aqaphele futhi asebenzisane nezinhlaka zomthetho ukuze labo abaphula umthetho babhekana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku tivisiwa ka Tindhawu leyi Sirheleriweke (tiMPA) ta 20 tanihi Oparexini Phakisa: Netiweke ya Vayimeri va tiMPA ta Ikhonomi ya swa Lwandle.
tgt: Inqubo yokuqokwa KukaMqondisi Wephiko Lwezokushushisa Kuzwelonke (i-NDPP) IKhabhinethi lamukele indlela entsha yokuqoka u-NDPUMongameli Ramaphosa uqoke Ithimba Labeluleki elizohlonza futhi libambe imposambuso nabantu abafanelekile ukuthi bangathatha isikhundla sokuba yiNhloko yoPhiko Lwezokushushisa Kuzwelonke (i-NPA).

src: Mbuyelo wa ku thoriwa ko engetela, exikarhi ka swin’wana, wu ta kotisa nhluvukiso lowu yaka emahlweni wa vupfhumba na ikhonomi na nkondletelo wa mfikelelo wa switirhisiwa leswi lawuriwaka hindlela leyi yisekaka emahlweni ya vunjoveri bya mpimo wa le hansi.
tgt: Ithimba lisebenze okokuqala kuleli sonto futhi kulindeleke ukuthi lithumele amagama abantu abakhethwe njengalabo abangase bafanelwe ukuthatha lesi sikhundla kuMongameli ngomhla ziyi-7 kuZibandlela 2018.

src: Swiyimo leswi ringanyetiwaka swi landzela mikanerisano na vakhomaxiave lava faneleke.
tgt: Isinqumo Senkantolo YoMthethosisekelo.1 IKhabhinethi lenze izethulo ngeSinqumo Senkantolo yoMthethosisekelo esiqondene nokusetshenziswa, ukulinywa nokuphathwa kwensangu ngabantu abadala ngasese bezisebenzisele ngokwabo kanye nomthelela wako.

src: TiMPA ti ta kandziyisiwa eka Gazate ya Mfumo.0 Khabinete yi pasise Nongonoko wa Matirhelo wa Rixaka (NAP) lowu Pfuxetiweke na ku va lowu Fambelanisiweke wa Afrika-Dzonga ku Herisa ku Endliwa ka Mananga, ku Hungutiwa ka Nono ka Misava na ku Hunguta Switandzhaku swa Dyandza (2018-2030).
tgt: Kucelwa ukuthi amalungu omphakathi azijwayeze lesi sinqumo njengoba ukusetshenziswa kwensangu emphakathini kungavumelekile.

src: NAP yi lava ku hoxa xandla eka nhlayiso na ntirhiso lowu yisekaka emahlweni wa misava ya hina na swipfuno swin’wana swa ntumbuluko.
tgt: Phezu kwalokho, lesi sinqumo asikuqedanga ukuba yicala kokudayiswa kwensangu.2 IKhabhinethi lazisa ukuthi lesi sinqumo sisebenza phakathi kweminye imithetho engase isebenze maqondana nokusebenzisa, ukuphatha kanye nokutshala insangu.

src: Khabinete yi pasise nkandziyiso wa Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Vana eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela iNgqungquthela Yezokuphepha Ezikoleni esanda kubanjwa ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo u-Angie Motshekga.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu lava ku tiyisa ntirhisano wa sisiteme ya nhlayiso wa vana na nsirhelelo hi ku tirhisa ntirhisano wa le xikarhi ka tindzawulo na le xikarhi ka tisekitara.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ihlanganise ababambiqhaza kwezemfundo nabazimele ukuthola izisombululo ngezinkinga zezokuphepha eziqondene nezikole ezweni kanye nokusungula indlela ebheke phambili yokwakha izimo eziphephile esikoleni.

src: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta angula eka Vuahluri bya Khoto ya le Henhla ya Gauteng N’walungu bya Hukuri 2017, laha eka byona Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu yi leriseke ku lulamisiwa na ku tivisiwa ka mihundzuluxo leyi faneleke ya Nawu wa Vana, 2005, (Nawu wa 38 wa 2005) hi mayelana na xitshunxo xa xinawu eka malawulelo ya sisiteme ya nhlayiso na vuwundli.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela izigameko zodlame ezehle ezikoleni ezithile, okubandakanya ukubulawa ngesihluku kukathisha oneminyaka engama-24, uMnu.

src: Khabinete yi pasise ku andlariwa ka Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Vukorhokeri bya Poso ePalamende.
tgt: Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, owabulawa ukugwazwa umfundi eRamotshere Secondary School eZeerust, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu humelerisa Papila ra Swibumabumelo swa Mfumo ra Pholisi ya ICT leyi Pfanganisiweke ya Rixaka leyi yi pasisiweke hi Khabinete hi Ndzati 2016.Mivuyelo leyi kunguhateriweke yi fanele ku va na Hofisi ya Poso ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi phikizanaka, leyi tirhisekaka na ku va leyi yisekaka emahlweni leyi yi nyikaka/humelerisaka vukorhokeri bya vanhu hinkwavo na mfikelelo xikan’we na ncinco wa sekitara ya poso.
tgt: Bonke ababambiqhaza bavuma ukuthi udlame jikelele, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni, alwamukelekile nhlobo nokuthi kudingeka kuqhutshekwe nokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole ziba yindawo ephephile kubafundi nothisha.

src: Samiti ya Ntlawa wa Makumembirhi (G20)Phuresidente Ramaphosa u rhambiwile hi Chanselara wa Xifederali wa Jarimani, Dkd Angela Merkel ku teka xiave eka Samiti ya Vuvekisi ya G20 –Mabindzu ya Jarimani na Matiko ya Ntwanano na Afrika (CwA), na Nhengeletano ya Mabindzu, leswi havumbirhi swi nga ta khomeriwa eBerlin, Jarimani hi siku ra 30 Nhlangula 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukunqunywa kweziNdawo Zasolwandle Ezivikelekile (ama-MPA) ezingama-20 njengengxenye yeNethiwekhi Emelwe yama-MPA ye-Operation Phakisa: Umnotho Wasolwandle.

src: Samiti ya Vuvekisi ya G20 yi ta tisa endhawini yin’we mabindzu ya Jarimani na Matiko ya CwA ku valanga swivandlanene swa vuvekisi ehansi ka rimba ra Xinakulobye xa Vavekisi va Jarimani va ta nyika tiphurojeke ta nkoka swinene leti nga ku endlekeni eka nkarhi wa sweswi eka Matiko ya CwA na ku valanga swivandlanene ku yisa emahlweni eka tikokulu.
tgt: Umhlomulo womsebenzi ongenzelwe, phakathi kokunye, uzovumela ukuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kwezokuvakasha okuqondene nezemvelo kanye nokukhuthazwa kokufinyelela ezinsizeni zabadobi abadobela ukuziphilisa eziphethwe ngendlela esimamisayo.

src: Phuresidente u ta ya eka samiti a ri eka xiyimo xa Mutshamaxitulukulobye wa Ntlawa wo Tsundzuxa wa Afrika wa G. Khomferense ya G20 eka CwA yi ta kongomisa eka tindlela leti G20, matiko ya Afrika na mihlangano ya nhluvukiso swi nga tirhisanaka hatona ku kondletela vuvekisi lebyi nga riki bya mfumo na vutekaxiave bya ikhonomi eka mifumo ya Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze uHlelo Lwemisebenzi Kazwelonke (i-NAP) Yesibili Olubuyekeziwe Noluhambisanayo lweNingizimu Afrika ukuNqanda Ukwanda Kwezindawo Eziwugwadule, Ukumoshakala Komhlaba kanye Nokungenelela kuMthelela Wesomiso (2018-2030).

src: Nhlengeletano leyi yi ta tlhela yi endla ntirho wo lulamisela eka xiyenge xa Samiti ya G20 eBuenos Aires, Argentina.
tgt: I-NAP ihlose ukuba nomthelela ekugcineni nasekusetshenzisweni ngendlela esimeme komhlaba wethu kanye nezinye izinsiza zemvelo.

src: Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa Xivijo ri ta nyika pulatifomo eka swirho swa Vurhangerinkulu bya Rixaka xikan’we na varhangeri va mfumo wa swifundzakulu na wa miganga ku endla tinhlengeletano ta miganga na Swivijo etikweni hinkwaro, hi nkarhi lowu, ku kombisa ntirho wa mfumo wa Rimba ra Maqhinga ra le Xikarhi ka Theme na ku angula eka timhaka leti boxiwaka hi vaakatiko, leswiMavhiki mambirhi ya vugingiriki ya ta va kona ehenhla ka xiyimo xa mitlangelo ya malembexidzana mifungho ya Nyimpi yo Lwela Ntshunxeka Manana Albertina Sisulu na Tatana Nelson Mandela, lava havumbirhi bya vona va kombisaka nkoka wa vutihlanganisi na n‘wangulano na miganga leyi va yi korhokeleke.
tgt: NgokweSiqephu 9 sesivumelwano, abathintekayo kumele basungule, balungise futhi baqalise i-NAP njengesakhi esibaluleke kakhulu sesu lokunqanda ukuqedwa kwamahlathi futhi kungenelelwe emtheleleni wesomiso.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozele Holobye wa swa Rihanyu, Dkd Aaron Motsoaledi, loyi a kumeke masagwati ya Kochon ya xiyimo xa le henhla mambirhi, eka nkhuvu wa masagwati lowu khomeriweke eThe Hague, Nethelands.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Oyisichibiyelo Wezingane kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze kutholakale izimvo zomphakathi.

src: Sagwati ro sungula ri le ka xiyimo xa munhu a ri yexe xa Holobye xa xiave xakwe na vurhangeri bya xipolitiki eka ku lwisana na rifuva (TB) emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinyo uhlose ukuqinisa ukudidiyelwa kohlelo lokunakekelwa nokuvikelwa kwezingane ngokuhlanganyela neminyango kanye nemikhakha ehlukahlukene.

src: Sagwati ra vumbirhi, leri Holobye a nga ta ri avelana na Muchavisekinkulu Nick Hebert, Xirho xa Palamende (MP) eUnited Kingdom, ri ta va eka xiyimo xa vona tanihi vatshamaxitulukulobye va Khokhasi ya TB ya Misava Hinkwayo ya tiMP to huma emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zilandela iSinqumo Senkantolo Ephakeme yaseNyakatho Gauteng sakuLwezi 2017, lapho uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi wayalelwa ukuthi ulungise futhi wethule izichibiyelo ezidingekayo zoMthetho Wezingane, wezi-2005 (uMthetho 38 wezi-2005) maqondana nesisombululo sezomthetho esiqondene nokuphathwa kohlelo lokukhuliswa kwezingane ngabantu abangazizali.

src: Sagwati ra Kochon ri ta nyikiwa lembe na lembe eka vanhu na/kumbe mihlangano leyi yi endleke vuhoxaxandla byo tivikana eka ku herisa TB ku nga va ematikweni ya ka vona kumbe emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lagunyaza ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinywa Oyisichibiyelo Wezinsizakalo Zeposi ePhalamende.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Masagwati ya ku Tekiwa ka Tendzo Emisaveni ya 2018 laha ku vhotiweke Afrika-Dzonga tanihi Ndhawu leyi Endzeriwaka leyi Rhangeke Emahlweni.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinyo uqalisa uMthetho Odingidwayo WeNqubomgomo Edidiyele Kuzwelonke Yolwazi Lwezobuchwepheshe Kwezokuxhumana (i-ICT) owagunyazwa iKhabhinethi kuMandulo 2016.Imiphumela okuphokophelwe kuyo wukuba yiPosi LaseNingizimu Afrika elinomsebenzi wokubhekana nomncintiswano, elisebenzayo nelisimeme futhielilawula yonke imisebenzi yeposi nengafinyelela kubo bonke abantu kanye nokuguqulwa komkhakha wezeposi.

src: Kapa, eKapa-Vupeladyambu yi kume xidlodlo xa Ndhawu leyi Endzeriwaka ya Mikhuvu na Swiendleko leyi Rhangeke Emahlweni ya Afrika.
tgt: UMthethosivivinyo uhlinzeka ngendlela yokunika imiphakathi yasemakhaya neqhuba izinqubo zesintu amakheli asemakhaya.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku rhanga emahlweni ka filimi ya laha tikweni leyi thyiweke Nommer 37 hi muendli wa tifilimi Joshua Bradley eUnited States hi siku ra 2 Hukuri 2018.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yotshalomali Lomhlaba Jikelele YaseNingizimu AfrikaNgoLwesihlanu, mhla zingama-26 kuMfumfu 2018, uMongameli Ramaphosa uzosingatha iNgqungquthela Yotshalomali Yokuqala eNingizimu Afrika eSandton Convention Centre eGoli.

src: Xitsakisi xa vugevenga leyi endleriweke eCape Flats yi nyikiwile timali hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki hi ku tirhisa xikimi xa yona xa Swihlohloteri swa Vaendli va Tifilimi va Vantima lava ha Tumbulukaka va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yokuhlanganiswa kwemisebenzi yokuheha nokukhulisa umnotho wethu.

src: Leswi swi ta hoxa xandla eka ku koka vuvekisi byo kongoma bya matiko mambe eka indasitiri ya tifilimi ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Phezu kwalokho, amanxusa amane kwezotshalomali aqokwe uMongameli azokwethula umbiko engqungqutheleni ngenqubekela phambili asebe nayo.

src: Khabinete yi tikatse na Phuresidente Ramaphosa eka ku hundzisa ku tsana na michavelelo:19.1 eka ku lova ka kutlula 27 wa vanhu, eka nghozi ya swipandzamananganyingi eka N1 N’walungu eLimpopo.
tgt: Ingqungquthela Yotshalomali ye-G20 izohlanganisa amabhizinisi ase-German namazwe e-CwA ukuhlola amathuba otshalomali ngaphansi kohlaka lokuHlanganyela kwe-G20 ne-Afrika.

src: Vatirhisi va magondzo va khutaziwa ku va na vukheta emagondzweni ya hina na ku tiyisisa leswaku va landzelela milawu ya gondzo hi mikarhi hinkwayo.2 eka ku lova ka mfungho wa Nyimpi yo Lwela Ntshunxeko, Manana Agnes Msimang.
tgt: Abatshalimali base-German bazokwethula imisebenzi eyaziwa ngayo eqhutshwa emaZweni ama-CwA futhi kubhekwe namanye amathuba ezwenikazi.

src: Manana Msimang a ri mugingirikeli wa rimbewu loyi a tinyiketeleke tlhelo Xandla xa Phuresidente ya Ligi ya Vamanana ya African National Congress.
tgt: UMongameli uzohambela ingqungquthela esikhundleni sakhe njengoSihlalo Obambisene Nomunye eThimbeni lase-Afrika Lokweluleka i-G. Ingqungquthela ye-G20 nge-CwA izogxila endleleni i-G20, amazwe ase-Afrika nezikhungo zentuthuko angabambisana ngayo ukukhuthaza utshalomali lomkhakha ozimele kanye nokubamba iqhaza kwezomnotho zamazwe ase-Afrika.

src: A ri exikarhi vavasati va ntsandzavahlayi lava va hlohloteleke miganga ya ka vona eAfrika-Dzonga hinkwayo ku lwisana na sisiteme ya xihlawuhlawu.
tgt: Lo mhlangano uzophinde wenze umsebenzi wokulungiselela lo mkhakha iNgqungquthela ye-G20 ezoba se-Buenos Aires, e-Argentina.

src: Ntirho wa nkosi wu ta sungula hi 08:00 eOur Lady of Cedars Catholic Church eWoodmead, Joni.3 eka ku lova ka nghwazi ya Nyimpi yo Lwela Ntshunxeko tlhelo muamukeri wa Risiva ra Rixaka ra Mendi eka Xitiyanhlana xa Silivhere, Ttn Eric “Stalin” Mtshali.4 eka ku lova ka nghwazi ya ANC Moss Chikane.
tgt: Isonto Lokugxila Ezimbizweni Kuzwelonke Amalungu Eziphathimandla (iKhabhinethi) azobamba iqhaza Esontweni lesi-9 Lokugxila Ezimbizweni Kuzwelonke loPhiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokuhlinzeka Ngolwazi (i-GCIS) ngaphansi kombuso wentando yeningi labantu owavotelwa ngowezi-2014, elizobanjwa kusukela mhla ziyi-12 kuya kumhla zingama-25 kuLwezi 2018.

src: Hi 2005, u thoriwile tanihi Muyimeri wa Tiko wa Afrika-Dzonga eka Jarimani.5 eka vanhu Sweden xikan’we na ndyangu wa Mnn Lisbet Palme, 87, loyi a hundzeke emisaveni.
tgt: Isonto Lokugxila Ezimbizweni lizohlinzekela Iziphathimandla Kuzwelonke kanye nabaholi bezifundazwe nabakahulumeni wasekhaya ngenkundla yokubamba imihlangano yomphakathi kanye neZimbizo ezweni lonke, ngalesi sikhathi, ukubonakalisa ukuqalisa kukahulumeni uHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTSF) lwezi-2014-2019 nokubhekana nezinkinga eziphakanyiswe izakhamizi, ezinomthelela kwezokuphepha, ukukhula kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi.

src: Mnn Palme i noni ya khale ka Holobyenkulu Olof Palme loyi a dlaweke hi 1986 naswona loyi Phuresidente Ramaphosa a n’wi hlamuseleke tanihi munghana wa “Afrika-Dzonga”.
tgt: Amasonto amabili okubamba iqhaza azongena lapho kuphela imibungazo yeminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa Izishoshovu zomzabalazo uMama Albertina Sisulu noTata Nelson Mandela, okwakuyibantu ababebeka phambili ukuvama kokubonisana nokuxhumana nemiphakathi ababesebenza kuyo.

src: Khabinete yi hlengeletane hi Ravunharhu, 7 Hukuri 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-7 kuLwezi 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Samiti ya swa Timhaka ta Madzolonga lama Simekiweke eka Rimbewu na ku Dlayiwa ka Vavasati leyi rhangeriweke hi Phuresidente.
tgt: INgqungquthela KaMongameli Yodlame Olubhekiswe Kubantu Bobulili Obuthile Nokubulawa Kwabantu Besifazane IKhabhinethi lamukela izingxoxo ezibe nempumelelo ezibanjwe eNgqungqutheleni KaMongameli Yodlame Olubhekiswe Kubantu Bobulili Obuthile Nokubulawa Kwabantu Besifazane ngomhla woku-1 kuya kolwe-2 kuLwezi.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku jekanekisana loku nga va na ku humelela ka Samiti ya swa Timhaka ta Madzolonga lama Simekiweke ekaRimbewu na ku Dlayiwa ka Vavasati leyi rhangeriweke hi Phuresidente leyi a yi khomiwe hi siku ra 01 na 02 Hukuri.
tgt: INgqungquthela iqinisekise ukuthi ukuphuthuma kokuphoqa ukuvumelana ngezindlela zokubhekana nenkinga yodlame olubhekiswe kwabobulili obuthile, ukucwaswa kwabantu besifazane kanye nokungalingani ngokobulili.

src: Samiti leyi yi tiyisisile xihatla xa ku fikeleriwa ka ntwanano wa ku tirhana na xiphiqo xa madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu, xihlawuhlawu ehenhla ka vaxisati na ku nga ringani ka rimbewu.
tgt: UHulumeni uvume ukubuyekeza izinhlelo zikazwelonke ukuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabobulili obuthile kanye nokuthuthukiswa koHlelo Lomsebenzi LukaZwelonke ngodlame olubhekiswe kwabobulili obuthile.

src: Mfumo wu twananile ku endla nkambisiso wa makungu ya rixaka ku herisa madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu na nhluvukiso wa Kungu ra Matirhelo ra Rixaka hi mayelana na madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu.
tgt: Uzibophezele ekusebenzisaneni nabo bonke ababambiqhaza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi siwehlisa kakhulu amazinga odlame olubhekiswe kwabobulili obuthile (i-GBV) - size sibuqede nya.

src: Wu ya emahlweni wa ha tiyimisele ku tirhisana na vanhu hinkwavo lava nga na xiave ku vona leswaku hi hunguta tilevhele ta madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu hi lakukulu, naswona emakumu hi ma herisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa zonke izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi zisebenzisane ukuze kushintshwe izindlela zokucabanga, izinqubo kanye nezikhungo ukuze kuqedwe udlame olubhekiswe kubantu besifazane.

src: Vuvekisi.
tgt: Utshalomali.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Khomferense ya swa Vuvekisi leyi nga va na ku humelela leyi veke kona hi Nhlangula eSandton, eJoni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela iNgqungquthela Yotshalomali ebe nempumelelo ebanjwe kuMfumfu e-Sandton, eGoli.

src: Khomferense ya swa Vuvekisi yi olovisele Afrika-Dzonga ku hlengeleta kutlula R290 wa tibiliyoni ta ku tiboha ku vekisa loku humaka eka tisekitara to hambana ta ikhonomi.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yotshalomali yenze iNingizimu Afrika yakwazi ukwethenjiswa ngemali ezizigidigidi ezingama-290 zamarandi yotshalomali yimikhakha ehlukahlukene kwezomnotho.

src: Leswi swi tatisa eka ku tshembisa loku tlulaka R400 wa tibiliyoni loku amukeriweke hi nkarhi wa pfhumba ro vekisa leri a ri huma eka vurhumiwa byo hlawuleka na lebyi humaka eka matiko yo hambana hi nkarhi wa tendzo ta mfumo.
tgt: Lokhu kwengeza phezu kwemali ezizigidigidi ezingaphezu kwama-400 amarandi iNingizimu Afrika eyethenjiswe ngayo emkhankasweni wotshalomali owaqhutshwa amanxusa akhethekile otshalomali kanye namazwe anhlobonhlobo ngesikhathi ehanjelwe wuhulumeni.

src: Khomferense a yi endzeriwile hi kutlula 1000 wa varhumiwa, lava a va huma eka matiko yo tlula Moya wa yona a wu nyanyula swinene, naswona tiko ra ka hina ri kombise swivandlanene swa vuvekisi na mapfhumba ya tipholisi lawa ma pfunaka ku tumbuluxa mbangu wa vuvekisi lowu nga na xinghana.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela ihanjelwe amanxusa angaphezu kwezi-1 000, ayephuma emazweni angaphezu kwama-35.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela xipanu lexi tirheke eka Khomferense, naswona yi langutela ku amukela swiviko swa vuxokoxoko lebyintshwa swa nkarhi na nkarhi hi mayelana na matirhisele ya vutiboheleri lebyi endliweke.
tgt: Umoya wawumuhle, nezwe labonakalisa amathuba amasha otshalomali kanye nezinhlelo zezinqubomgomo ezisiza ukwakha indawo elungele utshalomali oluhle.

src: Loko Afrika-Dzonga na Afrika hinkwayo yi ya emahlweni no kurisa ikhonomi ya tikokulu, Khabinete yi tlhela yi amukela Foramu ya swa Vuvekisi ya Afrika yo sungula leyi sweswi yi nga eku humeleleni kufikela hi siku ra vu9 Hukuri, eJoni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela ithimba elisebenze kule Ngqungquthela futhi likulangazelele ukuthola imibiko ngokuqhubekayo njalo maqondana nokufezekisa izethembiso.

src: Foramu ya swa Vuvekisi ya Afrika a yi rhambiwile hi Bangi ya Nhluvukiso ya Afrika.
tgt: Njengoba iNingizimu Afrika ne-Afrika iqhubekela phambili ekukhuliseni umnotho wezwekazi, iKhabhinethi liphinda lamukela iNgqungquthela Yotshalomali yase-Afrika yokuqala, esiqhubekayo esizophela mhla ziyi-9 kuLwezi, eGoli.

src: Yi kongomise ku aka ehenhla ka ku humelela loku nga kona sweswi hi ku hlanganisa vavekisi lava humaka eka mfumo na lava humaka eka mihlangano leyi nga riki ya mfumo ku pfula gondzo rintshwa eka Tikonklu ra Afrika hinkwaro.
tgt: Ingqungquthela Yotshalomali yase-Afrika yasungulwa yiBhange Lentuthuko Lase-Afrika (i-African Development Bank).

src: Khomferense ya G20 ya Afrika leyi ya ha ku khomiwaka yi tlhela yi hlohlotela ku kula ka swivandlanene swa hina hi ku tirhisa ku vutiboheleri byo hambanahambana lebyi tlakusaka vuvekisi lebyi nga riki bya mfumo na ku nghenelela eka swa ikhonomi ka mifumo ya Afrika tanihi xiphemu xa Ntwanano hi Pfhumba ra Afrika.
tgt: Ngayo kuhloswe ukuba nempumelelo yamanje ngokuhlanganisa uhulumeni kanye notshalomali lwemikhakha ezimele ukuze kuqalwe indlela entsha yokukhula yeZwekazi lase-Afrika lilonke.

src: Ntwanano hi Pfhumba ra Afrika wu fambisiwa xikan’we hi Afrika-Dzonga na Jarimani hi ku tirhisa Ntlawa wo Tsundzuxa wa Afrika.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-G20 nge-Afrika esanda kubanjwa iqhubeka nokuxhasa amathuba okukhula ngezivumelwano ezinhlobonhlobo ezikhuthaza utshalomali lomkhakha ozimele kanye nokubamba iqhaza kwezomnotho emazweni ase-Afrika njengengxenye yeSivumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA).

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela Phaka ya Tifeme ya Phuthaditjhaba ya R50 wa timiliyoni leya ha ku simekiwaka eFree State leyi nga ta tlakusa ku tumbuluxiwa ka tifeme no tlakusa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na ku kula emigangeni eka xifundzakulu lexiya.
tgt: Isihlalo se-CwA sibanjwe ngokubambisana yiNingizimu Afrika ne-Germany ngaphansi kweThimba lase-Afrika Lokweluleka i-IKhabhinethi lamukele nokwethulwa kwemboni i-Phuthaditjhaba Industrial Park, ebize izigidi ezingama-50 zamarandi, kamuva eFreyistata ezokhuthaza imisebenzi yezimboni futhi yandise ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi nokukhula kuleso sifundazwe.

src: Khabinete ya ha tshemba leswaku ku nghenelela loku ekuheteleleni ku ta sungula ku hunguta mitlhontlho ya ku pfumaleka ka mitirho leyi nga langutana na tiko, hi ku tisa moya wo tshemba na ntshembo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linesiqiniseko sokuthi umphumela walo msebenzi kuzoba wukunciphisa izinselele zokushoda kwamathuba omsebenzi izwe elibhekene nawo, ngokuvuselela ithemba.

src: Ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa Kwamathuba Omsebenzi.

src: Mfumo wu tlakusa matshalatshala yo tumbuluxela vantshwa na MaAfrika-Dzonga hi ku angarhela mitirho yo tala, lama kongomiseke eka tiikhonomi ta le malokixini na le matikoxikaya, na mabindzu ya vavasati na vantshwa lava va talaka ku rhwala mpingu wa mitiyiso ya ikhonomi leyi tlhontlhaka.
tgt: Uhulumeni unyuse amasokisi kwezokwakhelwa kwabantu abasha kanye nezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika imisebenzi, kugxilwe emnothweni wasemalokishini nowasezindaweni zasemakhaya, kanye namabhizinisi abantu besifazane nentsha okuyibo abavame ukuthwala umthwalo wezinselele eziqondene nezomnotho.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku mpako wa magoza yo pfuxeta ikhonomi, lawa ma nga ta nghenisa R50 wa timiliyoni eka tisekitara ta nkoka to fana na ta swa vurimi, swimakiwakulu swa vaaki, tiikhonomi ta le malokixini na le matikoxikaya, wu ta nyika nhlohlotelo lowu faneleke wa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na mpfuxeto wa ikhonomi leyi nga hetaka nkarhi wo leha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lethemba ukuthi uhlelo lwezindlela zokungenelela, ezizofaka izigidigigi ezingama-50 zamarandi emikhakheni ebalulekile njengezolimo, ingqalasizinda yomphakathi, umnotho wasemalokishini nowasezindaweni zasemakhaya, okuzohlinzeka ngamathuba okwakha imisebenzi nokuvuselela umnotho ngendlela egcinekayo.

src: Leswi swi tatisela eka mivuyelo leyi tirhisekaka ya Samiti ya swa Mitirho laha mfumo, mabindzu na vatirhi va tiboheke ku: xava swimakiwa swa laha ndzeni ka tiko ku tirhisa maendlelo yo tikarhata swinene yo tlakusa nxaviselo-vambe ku nghenelela eka ku hangalasiwa ka swimakiwa swa vurimi no seketela mabindzu lamatsongo na ya le xikarhi ku tlakusa mitirho.
tgt: Lokhu kwengeza phezu kwemiphumela yeNgqungquthela Yemisebenzi lapho uhulumeni, amabhizinisi nabasebenzi izibophezele ekwenzeni okulandelayo: ukuthenga imikhiqizo yakuleli ukusebenzisa indlela enamandla ukwandisa impahla ethengiselwa amanye amazwe ukungenelela ohlelweni lwezolimo kusukela ekuqaleni komsebenzi kuya ekuthengiseni ngemikhiqizo yezolimo kanye nokwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane naphakathi nendawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ezemisebenzi.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku ku nghenelela loku i ka nkoka eka ku ololoxa leswi kumiweke eka Ndzavisiso wa swa Nhlayokulu ya Vatirhi wa Kotara hi Kotara eka kotara ya vunharhu ya 2018, lowu kombiseke leswaku ku kula eka ku thoriwa xikan’we na ku tlakuka ka nhlayo ya vanhu lava nga tirhiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likholwa wukuthi lezi zinhlelo zokungenelela zibalulekile ukubhekana nokutholakele Ocwaningweni Lwezemisebenzi Lwekota lwangekota yesithathu yowezi-2018, olukhombise ukukhula kwezemisebenzi kanye nokwanda kwesibalo sabantu abangasebenzi.

src: Eka nkarhi wa tin’hweti tinharhu, mitirho ya 92 000 yo tatisela yi tumbuluxiwile.
tgt: Esikhathini sezinyanga ezintathu, iyizi-92 000 imisebenzi eyakhiwe.

src: Hambiswiritano, hikwalaho ka vanhu lava lavaka mintirho va kwalomu ka 131 000 lava a va hele ntamu eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza va tlhele va nghena eka makete wa vatirhi eka kotare leyi, mpimo wa mpfumaleko wa ntirho na wona wu tlakuke hi wa poyinti ya tiphesente wu ya eka wa tiphesente.
tgt: Nokho, ngenxa 'yabafunimsebenzi ababelahle ithemba' bangaphambilini abayizi-131 000 ababuyele ekufuneni umsebenzi, izinga lokusweleka kwemisebenzi nalo likhuphuke nge-0.3% laya kuma-27.5%.

src: Hi ku ya hi Tinhlayonhlayo ta Afrika-Dzonga, ku kula ka ku thoriwa ku ve kona eka vukorhokeri bya swa mabindzu, mabindzu na vuaki, loko ku lahlekeriwa hi mitirho ku ve kona eka swa migodi, vumaki, vutleketli na le mitini.
tgt: Ngokwesikhungo Sezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA) imisebenzi yande emkhakheni wezohwebo lwamabhizinisi nezokwakha, yaphela emkhakheni wezokuvukuza, wezokukhiqiza, wezokuthutha kanye nemizi.

src: Ku thoriwa eka sekitara ya ximfumo ku tsongaharile, kasi mitirho eka sekithara leyi nga riki ya mfumo yi kurile.
tgt: Sehlile isibalo sabantu abasebenza emkhakheni okusetshenzwa ngokugcwele kuyo, sakhuphuka emkhakheni okusetshenziswa kuwo ngokungagcwele.

src: Anivhesari ya vu20 ya Nawu wa Mphikizano Khabinete yi lemuka leswaku Nawu wa Mphikizano wu fikelele lembe ra vu20 kusukela loko wu sungule ku tirha hi 1998.
tgt: Ukugubha Iminyaka engama-20 yoMthetho Wezokuncintisana IKhabhinethi lazisa ukuthi uMthetho Wezokuncintisana sewufinyelele onyakeni wama-20 waqala ukusebenza kuMfumfu 1998.

src: Eka malembe ya 20 lama nga hundza, vulawuri bya mphikizano byi ve na ku humelela lokukulu swinene eka ku lwisana na ku twanana ku tlakusa minxavo ka vamaki na vaxavisi, matirhiselo yo biha ya ku va lava xaveriwaka ngopfu emakete na ku sirheleriwa ka ku tsakela ka vaaki loko ku va na ku hlangana.
tgt: Esikhathini seminyaka engama-20, izikhulu zezokuncintisana zibone impumelelo enkulu ekulweni nogombela kwesabo abanyusa intengo abangahambisani nokuncintisana, ukusetshenziswa ngokungafanele kwamandla ezinkampani ezinkulu kanye nokuvikelwa komphakathi ngesikhathi kuhlangana amabhizinisi.

src: Mfumo wu nyike kutlula R8 wa tibiliyoni ta mixupulo eka tikhamphani leti tluleke Nawu lowu.
tgt: Izikhulu zezokuncintisana zikhiphele izinkampani eziphula uMthetho izijeziso ezingaphezu kwezigididi eziyi-8 zamarandi.

src: Ndzawulo ya swa Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi, hi ku tirhisa magoza lama nga eka Nawu wa Mphikizano, yi endle ku tlula R5 wa tibiliyoni ta nkwama wo hlawuleka ku tlakusa mabindzu lamatsongo, vahangalasi va swimakiwa na ku nghena ka van’wamapurasi va vantima eka ikhonomikulu.
tgt: Ihhovisi likaNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho, ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezikuMthetho Wezokuncintisana, lakhe isikhwama esikhethekile sokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane, abahlinzeki bakuleli kanye nokungena kwabalimi abayibantu abansundu ohlelweni lomnotho, esinemali engaphezu kwezigidigidi eziyi-5 zamarandi.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela valawuri va mphikizano eka ntirho lowu va wu tirheke ku pfulela vanhu lavantshwa lava khumbekaka ikhonomi no tlakusa ku endliwa ka mabindzu na mphikizano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela izikhulu zezokuncintisana ngomsebenzi owenziwe kwezomnotho kubabambiqhaza abasha nokukhuthaza ukusungulwa kwamabhizinisi amasha nokuncintisana.

src: Nhlengeletano ya vu18 ya Khansele ya Vaholobye ya Indian Ocean Rim Association.
tgt: Umhlangano woMkhandlu woNgqongqoshe (i-COM) we-18 wenhlangano i-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA).

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Ndzawulo ya Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano ku va yi rhurhele Nhlengeletano ya vu18 ya Khansele ya Vaholobye (COM) ya Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) leyi nga va na ku humelela leyi a yi khomeriwe eDurban, eKwaZulu-Natal hi siku ra 02 Hukuri 2018 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Ku Vumba Vun’we bya Vanhu va Afrika, Asia, Australasia na Middle East hi ntirhisano lowu antswisiweke kuma ku Rhula, Ntshamiseko na Nhluvukiso lowu Yisekaka Emahlweni”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela uMnyango Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Nokubambisana ngokusingatha uMhlangano woMkhandlu woNgqongqoshe (i-COM) we-18 wenhlangano i-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA) owabanjwa eDurban, KwaZulu-Natali ngomhla we-02 kuLwezi 2018 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: Ukuhlanganisa Abantu base-Afrika, e-Asia, e-Australasia nase-Middle East ngokubambisana okunzulu ukuze kube Nokuthula, Uzinzo Nentuthuko Esimeme".

src: Wun’wana wa mivuyelo ya nhlengeletano ya IORA ya vu18 a ku ri Xihlambanyo xo Hlawuleka hi ku xixima Phuresidente Nelson Mandela loyi a nga un’wana wa vasunguri va IORLeswi swi endle leswaku ku tumbuluxiwa “nongonoko wa ntirhodyondzo wa ‘Va na Ndzhaka’ wa IORA Nelson Mandela” lowu languteriweke ku simekiwa ximfumo hi Mawuwani 2019.
tgt: Omunye wemiphumela yomhlangano we-18 we-IORA kwaba Isimemezelo Esikhethekile sokuhlonipha uMongameli Nelson Mandela ophinde abe ngumsunguli we-IORLokhu kuholele ekusungulweni “koHlelo Lokufundela Umsebenzi Usemsebenzini i-IORA Nelson Mandela 'Yiba Wukhondolo”” okulindeleke ukuthi lwethulwe ngokusemthethweni kuNtulikazi 2019.

src: Pfhumba leri ri kongomise eka ku nyika vantshwa va IORA matimba na vuswikoti bya ntokoto wa ntirho eka swiyenge swa vona swo hambana swa dyondzo.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuthuthukisa nokuhlomisa abantu abasha baku-IORA ngamathuba okusebenza emkhakheni abawufundele.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Yuniti yo Lwisana na Vugevenga bya Mitlawa leyi ya ha ku simekiwaka eHanover Park eKapa-Vupeladyambu hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Ukulwa Nobugebengu IKhabhinethi lamukela ukwethulwa, kwakamuva, koPhiko Olulwisana Namaqembu Ezigelekeqe e-Hanover Park, eNtshonalanga Kapa, wuMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Ku nghenelela loku engeteriweke hi mfumo loku ku ta pfuna swinene eka ku tirhana kahle ka ku lwisana na vugevenga bya mitlawa na vugevenga lebyi fambelanaka na swidzidziharisi lebyi hlaselaka vaakitiko.
tgt: Lokhu kwengezele ekungeneleleni kukahulumeni kuzoba nomsebenzi omkhulu ekubhekaneni ngendlela enzulu nenkinga yamaqembu ezigelekeqe kanye nobugebengu obuhambisana nezidakamizwa obukhungethe imiphakathi.

src: Yuniti leyi yi na swirho leswi leteriweke eka ku tirhana na swiyimo swa nxungeto wa le henhla tanihileswi swi humaka eka Tactical Response Team, va tlhela va tiveka tanihi Mabereta, maphorisa lama tirhaka ntirho wo hlawuleka xikan’we na yuniti yo nghenelela ya tiko hinkwaro.
tgt: Lolu phiko lunamalungu aqeqeshelwe ukubhekana nezimo ezinobungozi obukhulu njengoba evela emaphikweni okubhekana nezimo ngobuchule (amaBherethi), ithimba lokubhekana nemisebenzi ekhethekile (i-special task force) kanye nophiko lwezokungenelela kuzwelonke (i-national intervention unit).

src: Eka ku lava ku lwisana na vugevenga, ku nghenelela loku rhangeriweke hi mfumo ngopfungopfu ku yise ku nghenelela loku nga ta yisiwa etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: Emshikashikeni wokulwa nobugebengu, le ndlela yokungenelela eholwa nguhulumeni izokwethulwa ezweni lonke.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vaakitiko ku tirhisana na tiejensi to sindzisa nawu ku hlayisa vuhlayiseki na nsirhelelo leswi nga swa nkoka eka ku hluvukisa muganga wun’wana na wun’wana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa imiphakathi ukuthi isebenzisane nezinhlangano zomthetho ukugcina ukuphepha nokuvikeleka okubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kube nentuthuko emiphakathini.

src: Ya ha tiyimisele eka ku vona leswaku vaakatiko va hlayisekile no titwa va hlayisekile eka tindhawu leti va tshamaka eka tona.
tgt: Lisazinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi imiphakathi iphephile futhi izizwela iphephile ezindaweni ehlala kuzo.

src: Khabinete yi khensa vabari eka ku va va yise tifomo ta vona ta xibalo ta lembe na lembe hi xihatla eka nguva ya xibalo ya 2017/18 leyi nga pfala hi siku ra 31 Nhlangula 2018.
tgt: Isikhathi Sokuqoqwa Kwentela IKhabhinethi libonga bonke abakhokhintela ngokuthumela imibhalo yokuqoqwa kwentela kwaminyaka yonke yesikhathi sokuqoqwa kwentela ngowezi-2017/18, esivalwe ngomhla zingama-31 kuMfumfu 2018.

src: Mali ya tiko leyi hlengeletiweke hi swibalo yi tshama ya ha ri xihlovokulu xa timali lexi xi endlaka leswaku mfumo wu nyika vaakitiko vukorhokeri.
tgt: Imali eqoqiwe ngentela isawumthombo wesikhwama esiqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni angahlinzeka umphakathi ngemisebenzi.

src: Xikimi xa Mpfuneto wa Swichudeni hi swa Timali xa Rixaka (NSFAS).
tgt: Isikimu Sikazwelonke Sokusiza Abafundi Ngezimali (i-NFSAS).

src: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa vadyondzi hinkwavo lava lavaka ku endla swikombelo eka Xikimu xa Mpfuneto wa Swichudeni hi swa Timali xa Rixaka (NSFAS) ku kuma mpfuneto wa swa timali hi 2019 leswaku ku endliwa ka swikombelo hi ku tirhisa inthanete swi pfala hi siku ra 30 Hukuri 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likhumbuza bonke abafundi abafuna ukufaka izicelo Esikimini Sikazwelonke Sokusiza Abafundi Ngezimali (i-NFSAS) ngosizo lwezimali ngowezi-2019 ukuthi izicelo ezifakwa nge-inthanethi zivalwa ngomhla zingama-30 kuLwezi 2018.

src: Hi siku ra 01 Ndzati 2018, swikombelo swi pfuleriwile eka swichudeni leswi fikelelaka leswi navelaka ku yisa tidyondzo ta swona emahlweni hi 2019 eka khoso leyi pfumeleriweke eka yunivhesiti ya mani na mani kumbe kholichi ya Dyondzo na Vuleteri ya swa Vuthekiniki na Mitirho ya Mavoko (TVET) yihi kumbe yihi eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ngomhla lu-1 kuMandulo 2018, izicelo zavulelwa abafundi abafanelekile abafisa ukuqhuba izifundo zabo ngowezi-2019 ezifundweni ezigunyaziwe kunoma eyiphi inyuvesi kahulumeni noma ekolishi Lokufundela Umsebenzi Wezobuchwepheshe Bezandla Nokuqeqeshwa (i-TVET) eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Swichudeni swi hlohloteriwa swinene ku yisa swikombelo hi ku tirhisa inthanete kumbe swi endzela senthara ya Ejensi ya Nhluvukiso wa Vantshwa ya Rixaka (NYDA) ku nga se fika siku ro pfala.
tgt: Abafundi bakhuthazwa kakhulu ukuthi bethule izicelo nge-inthanethi noma baye emahhovisi eNhlangano Kazwelonke Yokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha (i-NYDA) ngaphambi kosuku lokuvala.

src: Swiboho swa Khabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethi.

src: Khabinete yi pasise Rimba ra Maqhinga ro landzelerisiwa ka mitsakelo ya ikhonomi ya xiqhinga ematikweni ya misava ra Afrika-Dzonga tanihiloko ri fambelana na mabindzu, vuvekisi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka tifeme.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze Uhlaka Lohlelosu ukuze kuqhutshwe izintshisekelo ezingokohlelosu zeNingizimu Afrika emhlabeni jikelele njengoba liqondene nezohwebo, utshalomali kanye nezimboni.

src: Qhinga leri ri kongomise ku vona leswaku ku tirhisana ka matiko ya misava ku tirhela swilaveko swa pholisi ya laha ndzeni ka tiko ku fana no herisa vusweti, ku pfumaleka ka mitirho na ku pfumala ku ringanana.
tgt: Lolu hlelosu luhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukubonisana namanye amazwe kuwusizo kuzinqubomgomo ezibalulekile zasezweni ezinjengokuqedwa kobumpofu, ukungabibikho kwemisebenzi kanye nokungalingani.

src: Qhinga leri ri seketela leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi landzelerisa ku hlanganisiwa ka nhluvuko eAfrika hinkwayo loku seketeriwaka hi vuvekisi lebyi rhangeriweke hi qhinga no aka vuxaka bya xiqhinga ku yisa ajenda ya yona emahlweni.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lukhuthaza ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibe nentshisekelo yokudidiyela ezentuthuko e-Afrika iyonke ngokwesekwa wuhlelosu oluholwa wutshalomali nokwakha ombimbi ngokohlelosu ukuqhuba umsebenzi wayo.

src: Ri tlhela ri hlanganisa vuxaka bya yona bya mabindzu na na vuvekisi na matiko lama hluvukeke naswona ri landzelerisa vuvekisi bya le ndzeni, ku hundzisiwa ka swikili na thekinoloji na nxaviselavambe lowu nga na nkoka.
tgt: Luphinde luqinise ubudlelwane bezohwebo kanye nobezotshalomali namazwe asethuthukile futhi luhehe utshalomali olungena ngaphakathi ezweni, ukudluliswa kwamakhono nobuchwepheshe kanye nezimpahla ezithengiselwa amazwe angaphandle ezinenzuzo eningi.

src: Khabinete yi pasise ku cinciwanyana ka muholo wa lembe na lembe wa ku durha ka swilo eka swirho swa Khomixini ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukukhushulwa komholo wonyaka wamalungu eKhomishana Yamalungelo Esintu yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAHRC).

src: Nawu wa Khomixini ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya Afrika-Dzonga wa 2013 wu vula leswaku muholo, mali ya swipfuno na swipimelo swa le ntirhweni swin’wana swi fanele swi bohiwa hi Phuresidente hi ku tirhisana na Khabinete na Holobye wa swa Timali.
tgt: UMthetho WeKhomishana Yamalungelo Esintu yaseNingizimu Afrika, wezi-2013 uhlinzeka ngokuthi umholo, isibonelelo sezindleko kanye neminye imigomo nemibandela yehhovisi inqunywa nguMongameli ngokubonisana neKhabhinethi noNgqongqoshe Wezezimali.

src: Swiendleko leswa ha taka.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Nhlangano wa swa Timhaka ta Vatirhi wa Matiko ya MisavaKhomixini ya Matiko ya Misava ya Levhele ya le Henhla ya swa Timhaka ta Vumundzuku bya Ntirho ya Nhlangano wa Vatirhi wa Matiko ya Misava (ILO) yi ta khoma nhlengeletano ya yona yo hetelela kusukela hi 15 kufikela hi 17 Hukuri 2018.
tgt: Inhlangano Yemisebenzi Yamazwe Ngamanzwe (i-ILO)IKhomishana Yomhlaba Jikelele Esezingeni Eliphezulu eqondene neMisebenzi Yakusasa yeNhlangano Yemisebenzi Yamazwe Ngamazwe (i-ILO) izobamba umhlangano wokugcina wayo we-15 kuya ku-17 kuLwezi 2018.

src: Khomixini yi fambisiwa xikan’we hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa na ntangha ya yena hi ntirho Stefan Lofven wa le Sweden.
tgt: Osihlalo bale Khomishana nguMongomeli uCyril Ramaphosa nozakwabo wase-Sweden uStefan Löfven.

src: Khomixini ya Matiko ya Misava ya Levhele ya le Henhla, leyi tumbuluxiweke hi ILO hi 2017, yi nyikiwe ntirho wo kambela ku cinca ka xihatla emitirhweni, ku kuma mitlhontlho ya nkoka na leswi swi faneleke ku endliwa ku endla vumundzuku bya ntirho byi va lebyinene no antswa.
tgt: Ikhomishana Yomhlaba Jikelele Esezingeni Eliphezulu, ehlelwe yi-ILO ngowezi-2017, ibhekene nomsebenzi wokuhlola izinguquko ezisheshayo eziqhubeka emisebenzini, ohlonza izinselele ezisemqoka kanye nalokho okumele kwenziwe ukwenza ikusasa lomsebenzi libe ngcono futhi lilingane.

src: Ntirho wa Khomixini ya Matiko ya Misava wu fambelanisa nkongomiso wa mfumo eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho ya kahle no va kona nkarhi wo leha na matshalatshala yo vona leswaku vantshwa va MaAfrika-Dzonga va na swikili leswi faneleke ku endlela ku humelela emitirhweni leyi cincacincaka.
tgt: Umsebenzi weKhomisana Yomhlaba Jikelele uhambisana nokugxila kukahulumeni ekwakheni imisebenzi efanele negcinekayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika iba namakhono adingekayo ukuphumelela emkhakheni wezemisebenzi oshintshashintshayo.

src: Nkombiso wa swixaviwa leswi humaka ematikweni ya misava wa le China (CIIE)Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela ka Afrika-Dzonga tanihi tiko leri nga muyeni wo xiximeka eka Nkombiso wa Swixaviwa leswi Humaka Ematikweni Mambe wa Matiko ya Misava wa le China (CIIE) eShanghai.
tgt: Umbukiso i-China International Import Expo (i-CIIE)IKhabhinethi lamukela ukubamba iqhaza kweNingizimu Afrika njengezwe eliyisimenywa esihloniphekile embukisweni i-China International Import Expo (CIIE) obanjelwe e-Shanghai.

src: Holobye wa Mabindzu na Vumaki, Rob Davies, u rhangela vurhumiwa bya mihlangano ya 27 ya le Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezezimboni u-Rob Davies, uhola ithimba lezinhlangano ezingama-27 zaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Vurhumiwa byi pfuniwa hi swa timali hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki hi ku tirhisa Xikimi xa Vumaketi bya Swixavisela-vambe na Mpfuneto wa swa Vuvekisi (EMIA).Ku nghenelela ka Afrika-Dzonga ku pfuneta tiko hi ndlela yo antswa ku tlakusa vuswikoti bya rona eka swa bindzu na vuvekisi, naswona hi langutele vakombisi lava nga ta nghenelela vo huma eka tisekitara leti katsaka ku phurosesiwa ka swa vurimi, tintangu na dzovo, vuinjiniyere, tikhemikali to endla petirolo, swiphemu swa switimela, swa vusirheleri xikan’we na thekinoloji ya swa vuxokoxoko na vuhlanganisi laha va nga vuya ekaya tioda to xava.
tgt: Lezi zinhlangano zixhaswe wuMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni ngosizo loHlelo i-Export Marketing and Investment Assistance (i-EMIA) Scheme.

src: Eka mhaka ya Nkombiso, Afrika-Dzonga yi rhurhele nhlengeletano ya swa vuvekisi leyi a yi kongomise eka swivandlanene leswi nga kona eka sekitara ya swa vuendli.
tgt: Ukubamba iqhaza kweNingizimu Afrika kubeka izwe esimweni esingcono sokuthuthukisa amandla ayo kwezohwebo notshalomali futhi silangazelele ukubona izinkampani ezibukisa kulo mbukiso wemikhakha enhlobonhlobo, ebandakanya umkhakha wezenqubo yokuqhutshwa kwemisebenzi yezolimo, owezicathulo kanye nesikhumba, owezobunjiniyela, owezamakhemikhali kaphethilomu, owezingxenye zezitimela, owezokuvikela, kanye nowezolwazi kwezobuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana (i-ICT), abuya ekhaya nama-oda okuthenga.

src: Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa ImbizoMavhiki mambirhi lama nga ta landzela ya ku gingirika ka mfumo ma ta fungha Vhiki ra Nkongomisa wa Imbizo ya Rixaka ya vu9, leyi kondleteriwaka hi Sisiteme ya swa Vuhlanganisi na Mahungu ya Mfumo (GCIS).
tgt: Usaqhubeka uMbukiso, iNingizimu Afrika iphinde yasingatha umhlangano wezotshalomali ogxile emathubeni asemkhakheni wezokukhiqiza.

src: Swirho swa Vurhangerinkulu bya Rixaka xikan’we na varhangeri mifumo ya swifundzankulu na mifumo ya miganga va ta ya eka tinhlengeletano ta vaakitiko na Imbizo etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: Isonto Lokugxila Ezimbizweni KuzwelonkeAmasonto amabili azayo okusebenza kukahulumeni azoba yiSonto le-9 Lokugxila Ezimbizweni Kuzwelonke, elilawulwa uPhiko Lohlelo LukaHulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokudluliswa Kolwazi (i-GCIS).

src: Nongonoko wu ta eka WEBTOKEN eka nkarhi wo sukela hi siku ra 12 kufikela 25 Hukuri 2018.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lwesikhathi esizoqala ngomhla we-12 kuya kumhla zingama-25 kuLwezi 2018 luzoshicilelwa ku-www.

src: Michavelelo.
tgt: gov.

src: Ndzilo wu koxe vutomi bya Nico Heyns loyi a ri muhahisi wa xihahampfhukaphatsa wa “Working on Fire”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithi 'dudu' emindenini nezihlobo zabo bonke abashone kuchunguchunge lwemililo ebeyiku-Garden Route nezindawo ezizungeze leyo ndawo, kanye nabaseMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela ku tekiwa goza ra xihatla ka vatimeri va ndzilo na vatirhi van’wana vo lawula timhangu hi ku tirhisana na Masocha ya le Moyeni ya Afrika-Dzonga na “Working on Fire” lava tirheke hi nkhinkhi ku ponisa vutomi bya vanhu no lawula ndzilo.
tgt: Lo mlilo udlule nomphefumulo ka-Nico Heynes, owayengumshayelibhanoyi we-Working on Fire.

src: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela eka mfumo na vanhu va le Indonesia endzhaku ka ku wa ka xihahampfhuka lexi xi koxeke vutomi bya vanhu va 189 endzhaku ko va xi suke entsindza wa Indonesia, Jakarta.
tgt: Uphinde waholela ekushoneni kwabanye abantu abayizishiyagalolunye kanye nokuthutha kwabantu abalinganiselwa kuzi-2000.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela ku hlawuriwa ka Afrika-Dzonga hi nseketelo lowukulu ku tirha eka Khansele ya Nhlangano wa Vuhlanganisi bya Tiqingho ya Matiko ya Misava (ITU) hi Musumbunuku, 05 Hukuri 2018 eka Khomferense ya Vayimelatiko ya ITU eDubai.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lincoma ukungenelela kwezicishamlilo kanye nezikhulu zezokulawulwa komonakalo, zibambisene noMbutho Wamasosha Asemoyeni WaseNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-Working on Fire abasebenze ngokuzikhandla ukuhlenga izimpilo nokulawula umlilo.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela Nkulukumba Mandla Mchunu wa Vulawuri bya Vuhlanganisi lebyi Tiyimelaka bya Afrika-Dzonga (Icasa) loyi a hlawuriweke ku tirha eka Bodo ya Swinawana swa Rhadiyo eka ITU xikan’we na Manana Doreen Bogdan-Martin eka ku hlawuriwa ka yena tanihi Mufambisi wa Byuro ya Nhluvukiso wa Vuhlanganisi bya Tinqingho no va waxisati wo sungula ku va xiphemu xa vufambisinkulu bya ITU k sukela loko yi tumbuluxiwile hi 1865.Afrika-Dzonga ya tinyungubyisa hi ku tshemba loku yi nyikiwaka kona hi matiko man’wana ku tirha eka mihlangano ya le henhla ya ITU eka malembe ya mune lama landzelaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulise amazwi enduduzo kuHulumeni kanye nabantu base-Indonesia kulandela ukuphahlazeka kwebhanoyi elidlule nemiphefumulo yabantu abayi-189 emuva kokusuka kunkabadolobha yase-Indonesia, eJakarta.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela Rhiphabuliki yXidemokirasi xa Federali ya Ethiopia eka ku va yi hlawule phuresidente wa wansati wo sungula, Muchaviseki Sahle-Work Zewde loyi sweswi a nga phuresidente wa wansati a ri yexe eka tikokulu ra Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela iNingizimu Afrika ngokukhethwa ngokwesekwa ukuthi isebenze ngaphansi koMkhandlu weNhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yengqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana (i-ITU) ngoMsombuluko, ngomhla wesi-5 kuLwezi 2018 ngesikhathi sePlenipotentiary Conference ye-ITU e-Dubai.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo va le Cameroon ku tirhisana leswaku va ta fikelela xitshunxo lexi nga na ku rhula hi ku tirhisa phurosese yo vulavurisana leyi katsaka vanhu hinkwavo.
tgt: Mandla Mchunu weSikhungo Esizimele esibhekelele ezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika (i-Icasa) okhethwe ukusebenzela iBhodi Lokulawula Imisebe ye-ITU kanye noNksz.

src: Khabinete yi langutele ku tiyisisa vuxaka bya matiko lamambirhi bya swa tipolitiki, swa ikhonomi na swa mabindzu exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Cameroon.
tgt: Doreen Bogdan-Martin ngokukhethwa kwakhe njengoMqondisi weSikhungo Sokuthuthukisa Ingqalasizinga Yezokuxhumana, futhi ongowesifazane wokuqala ukuba ngomunye wabaphathi abakhulu be-ITU selokhu yasungulwa ngowe-1865.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela vanhu va Brazil eka ku va va ve na nhlawulo lowu nga na ku humelela lowu nga endla muyimelakulangwa wa Phuresidente ya Federative Republic of Brazil, H. Jair Bolsonaro a va Phuresidente wa Brazil loyi a landzelaka.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ithotshiswe wukwethenjwa ngamanye amazwe ukuthi ubeyingxenye yabaphathi abakhulu be-ITU eminyakeni emine ezayo.

src: Khabinete yi navelela miganga va Mahindu hinkwayo eAfrika-Dzonga leyi tlangelaka Diwali kumbe Deepavali.
tgt: Sizosebenzisa lezi zikhundla ukuqhuba uhlelo lwezentuthuko nokwakha umphakathi onolwazi esikhathini sobuchwepheshe besimanje.

src: Lexi i xiendleko xa vukhongeri lexi xi tlangelaka ku hlula ka vunene eka vubihi, vutivi na vutlhari eka nkalavutivi xikan’we na ku hlula ka ku vonakala eka munyama.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela ne-Federal Democratic Republic of Ethopia ngokukhetha umongameli wabo wesifazane wokuqala, uMhlonishwa uSahle-Work Zewde, okunguye kuphela omongameli wesifazane ezwenikazi lase-Afrika.

src: Ku vonakala ko kwetsima a ku katekise Afrika-Dzonga hi ku rhula, ntsako, ku humelela na ku hetiseka loko hi endla ntirho wa hina wo tiyisisa ku hanyisana na vun’we eka ku hambana ka tiko ra ka hina hi swa mfuwo na vukhongeri.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izoqhubeka nokuqinisa ubudlelwano bayo nezwe lase-Ethopia emikhakheni eminingi ebandakanya ezohwebo, ezepolikiti nobudlelwano kwezomnotho.

src: Ku thoriwa nakambe ka Manana Nomfundo Maseti tanihi Xirho xa Mulawuri xa Nkarhi Hinkwawo lexi nga na vutihlamuleri byo lawula Gasi leyi Fambisiwaka hi Tipompo, ku tirha eka Bodo ya NERSVanhu lava landzelaka va thoriwile eka Khansele ya Mbangu lowu Akiweke:a. Absalom Mosabeni Molobe (Mutshamaxitulu)b. Manana Maphefo K Mogodi (Xandla xa Mutshamaxitulu)c. Manana Zandile Yvonne Mathed.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela abantu base-Brazil ngokubamba ukhetho ngempumelelo olubeke ukhethelwe ukuba nguMongameli we-Federative Republic of Brazil, uMhlonishwa u-Jair Bolsonaro njengoMongameli wase-Brazil omusha.
