src: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 21 Hukuri 2018, eTuynhuys, Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-21 kuLwezi 2018 e-Tuynhuys eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Vuvekisi.
tgt: Utshalomali.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Foramu ya Vuvekisi ya Afrika leyi simekiweke yi famba kahle leyi khomiweke kusuka hi siku ra 7 kufika 9 Hukuri 2018 eSandton Convention Centre eGauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawamukela uMhlangano Wotshalomali Wokuqala wase-Afrika obeyimpumelelo, obubanjwe kusukela mhla ziyisi-7 kuya kumhla ziyisi-9 kuLwezi e-Sandton Convention Centre eGauteng.

src: Mifumo ya Afrika na mabindzu, mihlangano ya swa timali ya matiko ya misava na vatirhisani va nhluvukiso van'wana va kongomise eka ku endla Afrika yi va rirhangu ra matiko ya misava leri landzelaka eka vuvekisi.
tgt: Ohulumeni base-Afrika nabezamabhizinisi, izikhungo zezimali zamazwe ngamazwe kanye nabanye okubanjisenwe nabo kwezentuthuko bagxile ekwenzeni i-Afrika ibe yizwekazi elilandelayo elithuthukayo futhi eliphuma phambili kwezotshalomali emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Eku pfaleni ka khomferense 45 wa mitwanano, leyi nga na nkoka wa US$32 wa tibiliyoni, ku ngheniwile eka yona ku vuyerisa tikokulu.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ivalwe sekunezivumelwano ezingama-45, ezilinganiselwa kuzigidigigi ezingama-32 zamadola aseMelika, ezenziwe ukuze kuzuze leli zwekazi.

src: Eka sweswo, Afrika-Dzonga yi ta vuyeriwa kusuka eka US$6.8 wa tibiliyoni eka vuvekisi.
tgt: Kuleyo mali, iNingizimu Afrika izozuza ngotshalomali lwezigidigidi eziyi-6.8 zamadola aseMelika.

src: Samiti ya Yuniyoni ya Afrika (AU).
tgt: Ingqungquthela yeNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU).

src: Khabinete yi khutaziwa hi mikanerisano eka Samiti ya AU leyi khomeriweke eAddis Ababa, Ethiopia hi siku ra 17 na 18 Hukuri 2018, laha Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa a tekeke xiave.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likhuthazekile ngezingxoxo ezinohlonze ezibanjwe eNgqungqutheleni ye-AU ebeyibanjelwe e-Addis Ababa, kwelase-Ethopia mhla ziyi-17 nomhla ziyi-18 kuLwezi 2018, lapho uMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa ebebambe khona iqhaza.

src: Nhlengeletano leyo ka yi nga Tolovelakangi eka tiphurosese ta mpfuxeto leti yaka emahlweni leti a ti kunguhateriwile ku tumbuluxa AU leyi tirhaka kahle, leyi nga tlangisiki swipfuno na ku va leyi nyikiweke matimba hi vuntshwa leyi kotaka ku fikelela swirhangana swa tikokulu na swikongomelokulu leswi hlamuseriweke eka Ajenda 2063, leswi swi nga rimba ra maqhinga eka ncinco wa vaaki na ikhonomi wa Afrika eka 50 wa malembe lama taka.
tgt: Lo Mhlangano Okhethekile udingide izindaba eziphathelene nezinqubo zezinguquko eziqhubekayo okuhloswe ukuthi zisungule i-AU enempumelelo, esebenza kahle futhi enomfutho omusha, ekwaziyo ukufinyelela kulokho okuyimigomo eseqhulwini kanye nezinjongo zezwekazi njengoba kubekwe ngokucacile ku-Ajenda 2063, okuwuhlaka olungokweqhingasu loguquko kwezenhlalomnotho e-Afrika eminyakeni engama-50 ezayo.

src: Mpfuxeto wa AU i phurosese leyi yaka emahlweni, laha swin'wana swa swibumabumelo swa yona se swi tirhisiweke, ngopfungopfu hi ku fambelana na vutiboheleri bya ku va na mifumo leyi nga swirho swa AU yi byarha vun'wini lebyikulu bya ku nyika timali eka nhlangano lowu.
tgt: Ukulethwa koguquko ku-AU kuyinqubo eqhubekayo, futhi ezinye zezincomo zayo seziqalisiwe, ikakhulukazi maqondana nokuzibophezela ekutheni amazwe angamalungu e-AU kube yiwo afaka uxhasomali olukhulu enhlanganweni.

src: Matiko yo tala ya ya emahlweni ya sayina Ntwanano wa Mabindzu ya Nkaswipimelo ya Tikokulu ra Afrika ku tiyisisa leswaku Tikokulu ri humelerisa ntwanano wa mabindzu ya nkaswipimelo ya tikokulu hinkwaro.
tgt: Amazwe amaningi ayaqhubeka nokusayina Isivumelwano Sohwebo Olungenamikhawulo Ezwenikazi Lase-Afrika ukuqinisekisa ukuthi Izwekazi lithokozela isivumelwano sohwebo olungenamikhawulo ezwenikazi lonkana.

src: Khabinete ya tsaka hi mbuyelo lowunene wa Samiti ya Afrika-Dzonga – EU ya vu7 leyi khomiweke hi siku ra 15 Hukuri eBelgiu.
tgt: Ukusebenzisana Ngokweqhingasu neNhlangano Yamazwe aseYurophu (i-EU).IKhabhinethi liyawuthokozela impela umphumela omuhle weNgqungquthela yesikhombisa phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-EU eyabanjwa mhla ziyi-15 kuLwezi kwelase-Belgium.

src: m Mivuyelo na vutiboheleri lebyi endliweke eka samiti ku aka ehenhla ka pfhumba leri nga si tshama ri vakona ku veka ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho exikarhi ka ajenda ya rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Imiphumela nezibophezelo ezenziwa engqungqutheleni zakhela phezu komkhankaso wethu oyingqayizivele wokubeka ukukhula komnotho nokwakhiwa kwemisebenzi emnyombweni wohlelo lukazwelonke lweNingizimu Afrika.

src: Afrika-Dzonga i tiko ra Afrika ri ri roxe naswona hi rin'wana ra matiko ya 10 emisaveni hinkwayo leri nga na Xinakulobye xa Xiqhinga na EEU i mutirhisani wo bindzurisa lonkulu wa Afrika-Dzonga naswona i muvekisi wa matiko mambe lonkulu tanihi biloko, leyi yimelaka 73.7% ta switoko hikwaswo swa Vuvekisi byo Kongoma bya Matiko Mambe etikweni.
tgt: Emazweni ase-Afrika, yiNingizimu Afrika kuphela esebenzisana ne-EU futhi ingenye yamazwe ayi-10 emhlabeni jikelele anobudlelwano ngokweqhingasu ne-EI-EU ngumlingane wezohwebo omkhulu kunabo bonke abalingane beNingizimu Afrika, futhi ingumtshalimali omkhulukazi njengombimbi lwamazwe, njengoba utshalomali olungena ngqo kuleli oluvela kule Nhlangano Yamazwe aseYurophu lulinganiselwa kuma-73.7% otshalomali oluphelele olungena ngqo kuleli oluvela emazweni angaphandle.

src: Phuresidente Ramaphosa vhiki reri u rhurhele Phuresidente xa Rhiphabuliki ya Xifederali ya Jarimani, Ttn Frank-Walter Steinmeier, eka Vuendzeri bya Mfumo eka Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa, kuleli sonto, usingathe uMongameli waseRiphabhulikhi yase-Germany, uMnu.

src: Jarimani hi yin'wana ya vavekisi va matiko mambe lavakulu eAfrika-Dzonga, leyi nga na kutlula 6000 wa tikhamphani ta Jarimani leti nga na marhavu kumbe vuhumesi etikweni, yi hlayisa kwalomu ka 100 000 wa mitirho.
tgt: Frank-Walter Steinmeier, Ohambweni Lombuso obeluqonde eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Vuendzeri lebya Mfumo byi vange ku sayiniwa ka mitwanano ya mabindzu na vuvekisi exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi, naswona byi kotise varhangeri havambirhi ku kanela hi swiphiqo swa matikonyingi na ku tirhisana swinene tanihi swirho leswi nga riki swa nkarhi hinkwawo swa Khansele ya Nsirhelelo ya Vun'we bya Tinxaka (UN) ku ringana theme ya malembe mambirhi kusuka hi 2019 kufika hi Mpfuxeto wa misava.
tgt: Uhambo Lombuso lokuvakashela kukaMongameli wase-Germany kuleli luholele ekusayinweni kwezivumelwano zohwebo notshalomali phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili, futhi kwanika bobabili abaholi ithuba lokubonisana ngezinkinga ezinhlobonhlobo nokuthi babambisane kakhudlwana njengamalungu asebenza ngokungagcwele eMkhandlwini Wezokuvikela weNhlangano Yamazwe (i-UN) isikhathi seminyaka emibili kusukela ngowezi-2019 kuya kowezi-20.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Komiti ya Nkambisiso wa Vumbiwa ya Nhlanganelo ya Palamende yi amukele xiviko xa yona lexi xi seketelaka ku hundzuluxiwa ka Xiyenge xa 25 xa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukuthi iKomidi lasePhalamende Lokubuyekeza uMthethosisekelo Elididiyele liwamukelile umbiko walo ovuna ukubuyekezwa kweSigaba 25 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996.

src: Hundzuluxo lowu wu ta endla swi koteka eka Mfumo ku teka vun'wini bya misava ku ri hava ndziriso ku vuyerisa vaaki.
tgt: Lesi sichibiyelo sinikeza uMbuso amandla okuthatha umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo ukuze uhlomule umphakathi.

src: Xiviko xa komiti xi languteriwa ku andlariwa eka Huvo ya Rixaka eka njhekajekisano.
tgt: Umbiko wekomidi kulindeleke ukuthi wethulwe eSigungwini Sikazwelonke, ePhalamende, ukuze kube nenkulumompikiswano ngalokhu.

src: Phurosese yo tinhlanganisa na vaaki yi endle mihlangano yo tala yi rhumela swibumabumelo eka Nawumbisi lowu naswona tinhlengeletano to twa miehleketo ya vaaki ti khomiwile eka swifundzakulu swa hinkwaswo.
tgt: Inqubo yokubonisana nomphakathi yaholela ekutheni izinhlangano ezihlukahlukene zithole ithuba lokwenza izethulo mayelana noMthethosivivinywa futhi kwabanjwa izimbizo zokulalela izimvo zomphakathi kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakuleli eziyisishiyagalolunye.

src: Vumbiwa kufika sweswi ri hundzuluxiwile ka 17 hi phurosese yo tihlanganisa na ku katsa vanhu hinkwavo.
tgt: Kuze kube manje uMthethosisekelo usuchitshiyelwe amahlandla ayi-17 ngokulandela inqubo yokubonisana nokubandakanya abathintekayo.

src: Mfumo wu tshama wa ha tibohe eka endlelo ra mpfuxeto wa misava lowu nga na vutihlamuleri leri nga ta vuyerisa munhu un'wana na un'wana.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu ezibophezele enqubweni yezinguquko kwezomhlaba eqhutshwa ngendlela efanele ezohlomulisa bonke abantu.

src: Khabinete ya tiyisisa leswaku mfumo wu xixima mfumo wa nawu naswona, hi mikarhi hinkwayo, wu ta endla hi ku fambisana na Vumbiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyagcizelela ukuthi uhulumeni uyawuhlonipha umthetho futhi, ngaso sonke isikhathi, izinyathelo nezenzo zakhe zihambisana noMthethosisekelo.

src: Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.
tgt: Isinqumo Senkantolo YoMthethosisekelo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa leyi boheke leswaku Nawu wa Swicelwa na Nhluvukiso wa Swipfuno swa Oyilimbisi, 2020 (Nawu wa 28 wa 2002) lowu wu fumaka ku nyikiwa ka timfanelo ta vucelamigodi, wu fanele ku hlayiwa swin'we na Nawu wa Nsirhelelo wa Timfanelo ta Misava leti nga riki ta Ximfumo, 1996 (Nawu wa 31 wa 1996), lowu wu sirhelelaka timfanelo ta misava leti nga sirhelelekangiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyasamukela isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ethathe isinqumo sokuthi uMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezimbiwa Nemikhiqizo Kaphethilomu, wezi-2002 (uMthetho wama-28 wezi-2002) olawula ukukhishwa kwamalungelo okumba izimbiwa, kumele ufundwe uhambisane noMthetho Wesikhashana Wokuvikelwa Kwamalungelo Omhlaba Osetshenziswa Ngokungahlelekile, we-1996 (uMthetho wama-31 we-1996), ovikela amalungelo omhlaba abantu ababuthaka abadinga ukubhekelelwa nokuvikelwa kakhudlwana.

src: Vuhluri bya muganga wa Lesetlheng eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu wu komba masungulo ya timfanelo ta misava leti vanhu lava a va tshikeleriwile emikarhini leyi nga hundza va Afrika-Dzonga a va pfumatiwile tona eka tinxaka to hlaya.
tgt: Lokhu kunqoba komphakathi waseLesetlheng eNyakatho Ntshonalanga kubonakalisa ukuqala kokwamukelwa nokuhlonishwa ngokusemthethweni kwamalungelo omhlaba owaphucwa izizukulwane ngezizukulwane zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababephila ngaphansi kwengcindezelo esikhathini esedlule.

src: Laha vucelamigodi byi hlohlotela eka matshamelo, mindyangu na miganga, vanhu lava khumbekaka hi ku kongoma hi vucelamigodi va fanele ku pfumela ku cinca kwihi kumbe kwihi loku khumbaka timfanelo ta vona ta misava.
tgt: Lapho umsebenzi wezimayini unomthelela ekuhlalisweni kwabantu, imindeni nemiphakathi, okuyibona abathinteka ngqo ngenxa yezimayini kumele banikeze imvume yabo kuqala mayelana nanoma yiluphi ushintsho oluthinta amalungelo abo omhlaba.

src: Mivuyelo ya oditi.
tgt: Imiphumela Yocwaningomabhuku.

src: Khabinete yi amukela na ku hoyozela tindzawulo na mavandla ya mfumo lama yaka emahlweni hindlela yo fanana ya ku kuma mivuyelo ya oditi yo basa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayamukela futhi liyayihalalisela iminyango nezikhungo zikahulumeni eziqhubekayo nokuthola imiphumela yocwaningomabhuku engenagcobho.

src: Leswi swi ta endzhaku ka ku humesiwa hi Oditara-Jenerala (AG) Kimi Makwetu ka Xiviko xa Oditi ya Malawulelo ya Timali ta Mfumo xa lembeximali ra 2017/18.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela ukukhishwa koMbiko Wocwaningomabhuku Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zikahulumeni wonyaka wezimali wezi-2017/18, okhishwe nguMcwaningimabhuku Jikelele (u-AG) u-Kimi Makwetu.

src: Hambisiwiritano Khabinete yi vilerisiwa hi xiviko lexi xi kombaka ku ya ehansi ko angarhela eka mivuyelo ya oditi ya tindzawulo tin'wana ta mfumo wa rixaka na wa swifundzakulu na mavandla ya tona.
tgt: Nokho iKhabhinethi likhathazekile ngombiko obonakalisa ukwehla kwemiphumela yocwaningomabhuku isiyonke kweminye iminyango nezikhungo zikahulumeni kuzwelonke nasezifundazweni.

src: Ku sayiniwa ku va nawu ka Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Oditi ya Mfumo hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa, leswi swi nga ta tiyisa ntirho wa Hofisi ya AG, swi ta pfuna ku endla va tihlamulela lava va yaka emahlweni na ku tsan'wa rimba ra mfumo.
tgt: Ukusayinwa kube wumthetho koMthethosivivinywa Oyisichibiyelo Socwaningomabhuku loMphakathi nguMongameli Ramaphosa, okuzoqinisa umsebenzi weHhovisi lika-AG, kuzosiza ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi bayaphendula ngezenzo zabo labo abaqhubekayo nokungalugqizi qakala uhlaka lwenkambiso yokuphatha lukahulumeni.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza tindzawulo na mavandla hinkwawo ku tirha hi miphalalo yo lulamisa eka swiphiqo hinkwaswo leswi funghiweke hi AG na ku veka ndzima tihlo nkarhi na nkarhi ku tirhana na swiphiqo ku nga si fika ndzhendzeleko wa oditi ya nkarhi lowu taka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likhuthaza yonke iminyango nezikhungo zikahulumeni ukuthi baqhamuke nezindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga ezihlonzwe ngu-AG nokuqapha inqubekela phambili njalo ukuze kulungiswe lezo zinkinga ezikhona zokungahambisi ngendlela ngaphambi kokuba kube nocwaningomabhuku olulandelayo.

src: Vuhlayiseki na Nsirhelelo.
tgt: Ezokuphepha Nokuvikeleka.

src: Khabinete ya tiboha ku seketela Pfhumba ra Nguva ya Makhisimusi yo Hlayiseka ya Rixaka leyi simekiweke hi Holobye wa Maphorisa Bheki Cele ehansi ka nkongomelo wa “Operation Quiet Storm”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lethembisa ukweseka uMkhankaso Kazwelonke Wezokuphepha Ngesikhathi SaKhisimusi owethulwa uNgqongqoshe Wamaphoyisa uBheki Cele ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi "i-Operation Quiet Storm".

src: Pfhumba leri ri kongomisa eka ku endla Afrika-Dzonga yi va ndhawu yo hlayiseka tanihiloko hi tshinelela nguva ya tiholideyi ta ku hela ka lembe.
tgt: Lo mkhankaso uhlose ukwenza iNingizimu Afrika ibe yindawo ephephile njengoba sibheke ekupheleni konyaka nasesikhathini samaholide.

src: Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa bya Afrika-Dzonga byi ta endla mitirho etikweni hinkwaro edorobeni rin'wana na rin'wana, emugangeni na le lokixini kufikela ku hela ka Sunguti 2019.
tgt: Umbutho Wamaphoyisa AseNingizimu Afrika uzoqhuba imikhankaso yokuqinisekisa ukuhlonishwa nokuthotshelwa komthetho kuwo wonke amadolobha akuleli, nasezindaweni zasemakhaya kanye nasemalokishini kuze kuphele uMasingana 2019.

src: Va ta kongomisa eka maphorisa lama vonakalaka, loko ku ri karhi ku endliwa mitirho ya vulemukisi na nsivelo wa vugevenga byo hlawuleka.
tgt: Bazogxila ekutheni amaphoyisa abonakale ndawozonke, ebe enza umsebenzi okhethekile wokuqwashisa nokuvikela ubugebengu.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo eAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni va tirhisana na maphorisa eka ku endla miganga yi tshama yi hlayisekile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi baqhubeke nokusebenzisana namaphoyisa ukugcina imiphakathi yethu iphephile.

src: Vatswari na vahlayisi va xinawu na vona va tsundzuxiwa ku va xa xalamuka swinene eka ku hlayisa vana va vona hi nkarhi wa nguva ya makhisimusi leyi nga eku teni.
tgt: Abazali nabalondolozi bezingane bayelulekwa ukuthi baqikelele kakhulu ekubhasobheni nokunakekela izingane zabo ngalesi sikhathi esizayo sikaKhisimusi.

src: Nakambe Khabinete ya tiboha ku seketela pfhumba ra Vuhlayiseki bya le Magondzweni bya Nguva ya Makhisimusi, leri simekiweke hi Holobye wa Vutleketli, Dkd Blade Nzimande, eLimpopo hi ku hela ka vhiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa nokuthi kwesekwe uMkhankaso Wezokuphepha Emgwaqweni Ngesikhathi SikaKhisimusi sowezi-218, owethulwe uNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, uDkt.

src: Nsimeko lowu wu kotlana na Samiti ya Vuhlayiseki bya le Magondzweni ya masiku mambirhi ya lembe na lembe na Siku ra ku Tsundzuka ra Misava ra UN ra lava weriweke hi khombo ra mitlumbano ya le magondzweni.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kwalo mkhankaso kuhambisana neNgqungquthela Yezokuphepha Emgwaqweni yezinsuku ezimbili yaminyaka yonke kanye noSuku Lomhlaba Lwe-UN Lokukhumbula izisulu zezingozi zomgwaqo.

src: Swi ta vuyerisa ku hanya kahle ka hina leswaku hinkwerhu hi tirha xiphemu eka ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na nguva ya makhisimusi leyi hlayisekeke hi ku chayela hindlela ya vutihlamuleri na ku landzelela milawu ya gondzo.
tgt: Kuyosisiza impela ukudlala eyethu indima ekuqinisekiseni ukuphepha ngalesi sikhathi sikaKhisimusi ngokushayela ngokuqikelela nokuhlonipha imithetho yomgwaqo.

src: Biloho ra Maputo-Catembe.
tgt: Ibhuloho iMaputo-Catembe.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela vainjhiniyara va Afrika-Dzonga lava khumbekeke eka nhluvukiso lowu nga wa nkoka eka matimu wa biloho ro cinkinya ro leha kutlula hinkwawo eAfrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela onjiniyela baseNingizimu Afrika ababandakanyeka emsebenzini wokwakha ibhuloho eliyingqophamlando elisekelwe ngamakhebula alenga phezulu emoyeni, elide kunawo wonke e-Afrika.

src: Biloho ra Maputo-Catembe ri akiwile hi Khamphanikulu ya Magondzo na Mabiloho ya Chayina naswona ri khomanisa Maputo eMozambique na KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Ibhuloho iMaputo-Catembe lakhiwa yinkampani i-China Road and Bridge Corporation futhi lixhumanisa iMaputo eMozambique neKwaZulu-Natali.

src: Phuresidente wa Mozambique, Ttn Filipe Nyusi, u pfule ximfumo Biloho ra Maputo-Catembe ro leha tikhilomitara tinharhu, leri ri akiweke hi mune wa malembe hi ndhurho wa US$785 wa timiliyoni.
tgt: UMongameli waseMozambique, uMnu Filipe Nyusi, walivula ngokusemthethweni leli bhuloho iMaputo-Catembe elingamakhilomitha amathathu ubude, elakhiwe iminyaka emine ngenani lezigidi ezingama-785 zamadola aseMelika.

src: Nhluvukiso lowu wu ta hlohlotela mabindzu na vupfhumba exikarhi ka Mozambique na Afrika-Dzonga hi nkarhi wa ku tekiwa ka rendzo exikarhi ka Maputo kuya eka Hlaluko wa Kosi endzilakanini wa Ribuwu ra le Vuhumadyambu ra KwaZulu-Natal lowu hunguteke hindlela ya xiyimo xa le henhla kusuka eka tsevu wa tiawara kufika eka 90 wa timinete.
tgt: Leli bhuloho lizosimamisa futhi likhuthaze ukuhwebelana nezokuvakasha phakathi kweMozambique neNingizimu Afrika njengoba isikhathi sokuhamba phakathi kweMaputo neKosi Bay esemngceleni woGu oluseMpumalanga yeKwaZulu-Natali sizoncipha kakhulu sisuka emahoreni ayisithupa sibe yimizuzu engama-90 nje kuphela.

src: Swiboho swa Khabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethi.

src: Nongonoko wa Vhiki ro Nyika Vuxokoxoko bya Matirhelo.
tgt: ISonto Lokwethulwa Kwemibiko Yohlelo Lokusebenza.

src: Khabinete yi nyike vuxokoxoko eka swiviko swa tindzima eka mivuyelo ya swirhangana eka nkarhi lowu sungulaka hi 1 Dzivamisoko 2018 kufika hi 30 Ndzati 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linikwe imibiko yenqubekela phambili eyenziwe ekufezekiseni imiphumela eseqhulwini yesikhathi esiqale mhla lu-1 kuMbasa 2018 kuya kumhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 2018.

src: Tindzawulo leti tirhaka exikarhi ka swikatsa leswi ku simeka 14 wa mivuyelo leya swirhangana ti ya emahlweni ti fikelela swiphakeriwa swa tona vini.
tgt: IMinyango esebenza ngaphansi kwamaqoqwana ahlukahlukene asungulelwe ukuqalisa imiphumela eseqhulwini eyi-14 iyaqhubeka nokuphumelela emisebenzini okumele ihlinzeke ngayo ngokwahlukana kwayo.

src: Mivuyelo leyi yi huma eka Rimba ra Maqhinga ra le Xikarhi ka Theme na kusuka eka Xivono xa 2030 xa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka.
tgt: Le miphumela isuselwa oHlakeni Lwesu Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi lowezi-2014-2019 neNhlosombono yowezi-2013 yoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xa goza leri lavekaka ku tirhana na mitlhontlho leyi khumbaka nsimeko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi selizigunyazile izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kubhekanwe nezinselele ezithinta ukuqaliswa kwemisebenzi.

src: Swiviko leswi swi kandziyisiwle eka webusayiti ya DPME (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Imibiko ishicilelwe kuwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wokuqapha Nezokuhlolwa Komsebenzi (i-DPME) ku: WEBTOKEN Uhlelo Lokukhiqizwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezimoto (i-APDP).

src: Nongonoko wa Vuhumesi na Nhluvukiso wa Swipandzamananga (APDP).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwelulwa kwe-APDP kusukela ngokwezi-2021 kuya kowezi-2035 ngezichibiyelo zokweseka uHlelongqangi Lwezimoto lwase-Ningizimu Afrika (i-SAAM).

src: SAAM yi kongomisa eka swiyenge swa tsevu: Ku tirhisiwa hindlela leyi vuyerisaka makete wa le tikweni Nhluvukiso wa makete wa Xifundza Nhluvukiso wa swimakiwakulu ncinco wa vumaki, na nhluvukiso wa thekinoloji na swikili leswi fambelanaka.
tgt: I-SAAM igxile emikhakheni eyisithupha: Ukusetshenziwa kakhulu futhi ngendlela enenzuzo kwezimakethe zakuleli Ukuthuthukiswa kwezimakethe zasesifundeni Ukwenza umsebenzi wokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo ngaphakathi kuleli Ukuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda Ukuletha uguquko ezimbonini, Nezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono okuhambisana nakho.

src: Mihundzuluxo leyi exikarhi ka swin'wana yi lava ku hlohlotela tilevhele ta le henhla ta ku engeteriwa ka nkoka wa laha tikweni ku tumbuluxa swivandlanene swa mitirho yo engetela.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zihlose phakathi kokunye ukukhuthaza amazinga aphezulu okulungiswa kwemikhiqizo ngaphakathi kuleli ukuze kudaleke amanye amathuba omsebenzi angeziwe.

src: Vulanguteri na nkambelo wa nongonoko lowu na swiendleko swa vumaki leswi fambelanaka swa antswisiwa ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ndzima eka xivono na swikongomelo swa SAAHolobye wa Mabindzu na Vumaki, Dkd Rob Davies, u ta nyika vuxokoxoko eka swihangalasamahungu hi mihundzuluxo leyi hi Ravuntlhanu, 23 Hukuri 2018.Milawumbisi.
tgt: Ukuqapha nokuhlolwa kohlelo kanye nezimo ezihambisana nemboni kuyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa ukuqinisekisa inqubekela phambili ekufezekisweni kwenhlosombono nezinjongo ze-SAAUNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni, uDkt.

src: Khabinete yi pasise Nawumbisi wa Hakelo yo Engetela ya Oditi ya Mfumo wa 2018 (Public Audit Excess Fee Bill of 2018) leswaku wu andlariwa ePalamende.
tgt: Rob Davies, uzokhuluma nabemithombo yezindaba ngalezi zichibiyelo ngoLwesihlanu, zingama-23 kuLwezi 2018.IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu lulamisela Oditara-Jenerala ku teka goza ro lulamisa ku tiyisisa leswaku milahleko leyi Mfumo wu hlanganaka na yona, laha swi kotekaka, yi vuyisiwa na ku kongomisa mihambuko yo tivikana leyi ehleketeleriwaka yo karhi eka vulavisisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wenhlawulo Ephathelene Nezimali Ezimoshiwe Ezihlonzwe Wucwaningomabhuku lukaHulumeni (Public Audit Excess Fee Bill of 2018) ozokwethulwa ePhalamende.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu ya emahlweni ku lava ku nyika matimba eka AG ku tirha ntirho wa oditi ya matiko ya misava a ku endla tioditi ta matirhelo, na ku fambelanisa milulamiselo ya mafumelo ya AG eka maendlelo lamanene ya nkarhi wa sweswi.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlinzekela ukuthi uMncwaningimabhuku Jikelele athathe izinyathelo zokulungisa isimo ezifanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi, lapho kunokwenzeka, ziyabuyiswa izimali zoMbuso ezimoshiwe nezisetshenziswe ngendlela engafanele futhi kudluliselwe izinsolo zokukhwabanisa kulezo zikhungo ezinamandla namagunya okuphenya ngalokhu.

src: 100 #WomenOfFortitudeEndzhaku ka nkarhi wa ku boxiwa ka mavito, 100 #WomenOfFortitude yi ta pfuriwa eUnion Buildings ePitori hi siku ra 22 Hukuri 2018.

src: Komiti ya le Xikarhi ka Tindzawulo eka Malembexidzana ya Nelson Mandela na Malembexidzana ya Albertina Sisulu yi tivise hi siku ra 11 Nhlangula 2018 pfhumba ra #WomenOfFortitude tanihi un'wana wa migingiriko ya Malembexidzana ya Manana Sisulu.
tgt: IKomidi loNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene Elijutshwe Umsebenzi Wokulawula Nokuqhuba Imicimbi Yemigubho Yekhulunyaka Lika-Nelson Mandela kanye neKhulunyaka lika-Albertina Sisulu lamemezela umkhakhanso we-#WomenOfFortitude, mhla ziyi-11 kuMfumfu 2018, njengomunye wemicimbi yomgubho weKhulunyaka likaMama uSisulu.

src: Pfhumba ra #WomenOfFortitude i nhlangano wa 100 ra vavasati ra ku hlohlotela mbulavurisano wa hilaha vavasati namuntlha va nga yisaka emahlweni ndzhaka ya Manana Sisulu.
tgt: Umkhankaso i-#WomenOfFortitude wumkhankaso wabesimame abayi-100 abazoqhuba ingxoxo mayelana nokuthi abesifazane banamuhla bangalugcina futhi baluqhubekise kanjani ukhondolo lukaMama uSisulu.

src: 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana na Madzolonga yo ya hi Rimbewu (GBV)Ndzawulo ya Vamanana yi le ku kondleteleni na ku katsakanya khalendara ya swiendleko ya mfumo eka Pfhumba ra 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana na GBV kusuka hi siku ra 25 Hukuri kufika 10 N'wendzamhala 2018.
tgt: Izinsuku eziyi-16 Zokulwisana nodlame olubhekiswe Kubantu Bobulili Obuthile (i-GBV)UMnyango Wezabesifazane ulawula futhi uhlela imicimbi kahulumeni yoMkhankaso Wezinsuku eziyi-16 Zokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane ozobanjwa kusukela ngomhla zingama-25 kuLwezi kuze kube ngumhla ziyi-10 kuZibandlela 2018.

src: Swirho swa Vurhangerinkulu bya Rixaka xikan'we na varhangeri va swifundzakulu na va miganga va ta endla swiendleko swo kongomana na photifoliyo/sekitara etikweni hinkwaro hi mapfhumba ya ku vulavurisana na miganga.

src: Minongonoko ya mfumo leyi koxometiweke yi nga hlahluviwa kusuka eka from WEBTOKEN Khabinete yi hlohlotela maAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku tirhisa pulatifomo leyi na ku teka xiave eka xiendleko xa mfumo lexi nga ekusuhi na vona.
tgt: Imininingwane ngezinhlelo zikahulumeni iyatholakala WEBTOKEN IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi basebenzise leli thuba ukubamba iqhaza kuleyo micimbi kahulumeni ezobanjwela ezindaweni eziseduze nabo.

src: Vaakatiko lava nga na ku tsakela kun'we na mihlangano ya vavasati yin'wana yi khutaziwa ku tata tikhalendera ta yona hi swiendleko swa nkarhi lowu.
tgt: Izinhlangano zomphakathi kanye zinye izinhlangano zabantu besifazane ziyakhuthazwa ukuthi zigcwalise amakhalenda azo ngemicimbi yalesi sikhathi.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo va khutaziwa ku tirhisana ku tekela enhlokweni xirhambo eka #HearMeToo, hi ku yingisela mpingu wa vavasati, kutani va teka goza ku herisa maxangu ya mixaka hinkayo ya madzolonga ehenhla ka vavasati.
tgt: Bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayanxuswa ukuthi basebenzisane ngenhloso yokusabela esimemweni somkhankaso othi #HearMeToo, ngokulalela isikhalo sabesifazane, nokuthatha izinyathelo zokuqeda isihlava sazo zonke izinhlobo zodlame olubhekiswe kubantu besifazane.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela tinghwazi ta mitlangu hinkwato leti endlaka Afrika-Dzonga yi tinyungubyisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela amaqhawe ezemidlalo akuleli andizisela ifulegi laseNingizimu Afrika phezulu.

src: Mifikelelo ya lavaya va tirheke kahle swinene etimbaleni ta vona ta mitlangu, yi amukeriwile eka nkhuvu wa Masagwati ya mitlangu wa 2018 lowu wa ha ku vaka kona ku nga ri khale.
tgt: Impumelelo yalabo abasebenze ngendlela encomekayo emidlalweni abayidlalayo, yahlonishwa emcimbini wakamuva Wemiklomelo Yabadlali Abavelele.

src: Caster Semenya wa Afrika-Dzonga u amukele misuku yimbirhi hi ku wina sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Lembe leri rhandziwaka ngopfu swin'we na Sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xisati wa Lembe.
tgt: U-Caster Semenya waseNingizimu Afrika wahlabana ngezindondo zegolide ezimbili, njengoba aklonyeliswa ngendondo yesiHlabani Sezemidlalo Sonyaka kanye neNdondo yoMdlali Wesifazane Wonyaka.

src: Muhlamberi wa xiyimo xa le henhla wa Afrika-Dzonga Chad le Clos u wine Sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xinuna wa Lembe.
tgt: Iqhawe lezokubhukuda laseNingizimu Afrika u-Chad le Clos wahlabana ngeNdondo yoMdlali Wesilisa Wonyaka.

src: Ndodomzi Ntutu u wine Sagwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xinuna wa Lembe loyi a nga na Vutsoniwa.
tgt: UNdodomzi Ntutu wahlabana ngeNdondo yoMdlali Onokukhubazeka Wesilisa Wonyaka.

src: Anrune Liebenberg u wine Sgwati ra N'wamitlangu wa Xisati wa Lembe loyi a nga na Vutsoniwa.
tgt: U-Anrune Liebenberg wahlabana ngeNdondo Yomdlali Onokukhubazeka Wesifazane Wonyaka.

src: Banyana Banyana u wine Sagwati ra Xipanu xa Lembe ra xiyimo xa le henhla.
tgt: IBanyana Banyana yahlabana ngeNdondo Yeqembu Lonyaka, okuyindondo engaconsi phansi futhi ehlonishwa kakhulu.

src: Banyana Banyana yi wine meche wa yona wo sungula na Nigeria eka Khapi ya Tinxaka ya Vavasati ya 2018 (AFCON).
tgt: IBanyana Banyana inqobile emdlalweni wayo lapho beyibhekene khona ne-Nigeria eMqhudelwaneni Wabesifazane Kanobhutshuzwayo Wendebe Yamazwe Ase-Afrika (i-AFCON) wezi-2018.

src: Bafana Bafana yi tlange ku ringana hi 1-1 eka meche wo hundzela emahlweni wa AFCON na Nigeria.
tgt: IBafana Bafana idlale ngokulingana ngegoli elilodwa ngapha nangapha ngenkathi ibhekene ne-Nigeria emdlalweni wokuhlungela umqhudelwano we-AFCOIqembu LeNingizimu Afrika Lebhola Lombhoxo linconyiwe ngendlela elidlala ngayo futhi lafiselwa okuhle kodwa emdlalweni walo olandelayo lapho lizobhekana khona ne-Wales mhla zingama-24 kuLwezi 2018.

src: Xipanu xa Rhagabi xa Afrika-Dzonga xa hoyozeriwa eka matirhelo ya xona naswona hi va navelela leswinene eka meche wa xona lowu taka na Wales hi siku ra 24 Hukuri 2018.Khabinete yi kombela maAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni va seketela vatlangi va xinuna na va xisati va tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi baqhubeke nokweseka abadlali bakuleli besifazane nabesilisa.

src: Holobye wa Sayense na Thekinoloji Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, loyi vito ra yena ri boxiweke ku tirha eka Khansele ya Forau ya Ikhonomi ya Matiko ya Misava eka Ncinco wa Tifeme wa Vumune, lowu vumbiwaka hi mfumo vaaki lava nga na ku tsakela kun'we na swidyondzeki.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe WezeSayensi Nobuchwepheshe uMmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, oqokelwe ukuthi abe yingxenye yophiko loMkhandlu Wesigungu Sezomnotho Emhlababeni oqondene noGuquko Lwezimboni Lwesine, okuwumkhandlu ohlanganisa ohulumeni, izinhlangano zomphakathi kanye nezifundiswa.

src: Leswi swi ta pfuna matiko emisaveni hinkwayo ku angula na ku tirhisa hindlela leyi vuyerisaka swivandlanene leswi tisiwaka hi Ncinco wa Tifeme wa Vumune.
tgt: Lokhu kuzosiza amazwe emhlabeni jikelele akwazi ukusabela nokusebenzisa amathuba ahlinzekwa wuGuquko Lwezimboni Lwesine.

src: Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni eka ku thoriwa ka yena eka Bodo ya Valawulathirasiti ya Nkwama wa ku Rhula wa Misava, lowu wu nga ta nyika timali eka migingiriko ya xidipulomati yo lamula no sivela, swilaveko swa vuswikoti bya mihlangano, na mitirho yo seketela ku rhula eAfrika.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali uTito Mboweni ngokuqokelwa kwakhe eBhodini Labaphathiswa beSikhwama Sezokuthula se-AU, elizoxhasa ngezimali izinhlelo zokulamula nokuvimbela ukungqubuzana kwamazwe, izidingo zezikhungo ukuze zikwazi ukusebenza, kanye nemisebenzi yokweseka ukuthula e-Afrika.

src: Tanihi xirho xa Bodo ya Vulawulathirasiti, Holobye Mboweni u ta hoxa xandla eka nkhomano wa xiqhinga na mafumelo lama antswisweke, na vuangameri bya swa timali na mafambiselo bya Nkwama wa ku Rhula.
tgt: Njengelungu leBhodi Labaphathiswa, uNgqongqoshe uMboweni uzoba negalelo ekusebenzisaneni kwamazwe ngendlela ehambelanayo nasekuthuthukiseni ukuphatha, ukuqapha ezezimali nezokuphatha eSikhwameni Sezokuthula.

src: Ku thoriwa ka valawulathirasiti va Nkwama wa ku Rhula wa AU i gozakulu eka nsimeko wa ku nyikiwa ka timali ka ajenda ya AU, leswi swi nga xiphemu xa phurosese ya mpfuxeto wa mihlangano leyi yaka emahlweni.
tgt: Ukuqokwa kwabaphathiswa beSikhwama Zezokuthula se-AU kuyisinyathelo esisemqoka ekuqalisweni kokuxhaswa kohlelo lwe-AU, oluyingxenye yezinqubo eziqhubekayo zokuvuselela nokuletha uguquko ngaphakathi ezikhungweni ze-AUNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nezokuqeqesha uNaledi Pandor, ozohlonishwa ngendondo i-French National Order of Legion of Honour ngoLwesihlanu, mhla zingama-30 kuLwezi 2018.

src: Holobye wa Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri Naledi Pandor, loyi a nga ta tlhomiwa Risiva ra Rixaka ra Furwa ra Sagwati ra Vuthu ra Nxiximo hi Ravuntlhanu, 30 Hukuri 2018.
tgt: Le ndondo iwuphawu lokuhlonipha amangwevu nemisebenzi yakhe emihle futhi emangazayo ayenze empilweni yakhe yonke kanye nemizamo yokucathulisa nokuqhubezela ukusebenzisana phakathi kwe-France neNingizimu Afrika emkhakheni wezeSayensi Nobuchwepheshe.

src: Sagwati leri ri tekela enhlokweni mifikelelo na mitirho ya yena leyi nga erivaleni ya vutomi hinkwabyo eka ku kondletela na ku yisa emahlweni ntirhisano exikarhi ka Furwa na Afrika-Dzonga eka xiyenge xa Sayense na Thekinoloji.
tgt: Lo mcimbi uzobanjelwa endlini yeNxusa lase-France elizinze eNingizimu Afrika ePitoli.
