tgt: Ukuhalalisa IKhabhinethi lihalalisela futhi lifisela okuhle laba abalandelayo: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, uMnu Enoch Godongwana, oklonyeliswe ngendondo i-African Banker 2023 Finance Minister of the Year Award e-Sharm El Sheikh, e-Egypt ngoLwesithathu, mhla wama-24 kuNhlaba 2023 ngemizamo yakhe onyakeni owedlule wokuphatha umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika kwisimo esimazombezombe somhlaba nesalapha ekhaya.

src: Tatana Zakes Mda, mutsari wa tinovhele wa laha Afrika-Dzonga na Profesa Tshilidzi Marwala, khale ka Xandla xa Chaselara na Nhloko ya Univhesiti ya Johannesburg, lava nga langiwa eka masagwadi ya Tintlhari ya 2023.
tgt: Lo mklomelo ubonga ukuthi uNgqongqoshe wasebenzisa inqubomgomo yezimali ukusheshisa utshalomali kumkhakha wezamandla avuselelekayo.

src: Tatana Mda na Profesa Marwala va langiwile exikarhi ka vanhu 19 lava humeleke va MaAfrika lava nga humelela swinene eka swiyenge swo hambanahambana.
tgt: U-Hana Gammon, umbhali waseNingizimu Afrika oneminyaka engama-20 ubudala ngokuhlomula umklomelo we-2023 Commonwealth Short Story Prize, esifundeni sase-Afrika nobe ngomncane kunabobonke emlandweni ukuhlomula lo mklomelo.

src: Ku chavelela Khabinete yi kombisile ku chavelela eka ndyangu na vanghana va: Muyimeri wa tiko eka Rhiphabliki ra Algeria, Tatana Billy Masetlha, loyi a tirheleke Afrika-Dzonga eka swiyimo swo hambanahambana swa mfumo, ku katsa ku tirha tanihi Mulawurinkulu wa vukorhokeri bya vunhlori.
tgt: Iqembu Lebhola Lombhoxo ama-Stormers ngokufinyelela kowamanqamu kwimidlalo ye-United Rugby Championship.

src: A nghenelerile hi vuenti eka Nyimpi yo lwela ntshunxeko wa Afrika-Dzonga, ku katsa na ku va xirho xa Umkhonto we Sizwe.
tgt: Ama-Stormers azotholana phezulu neqembu i-Irish Musters enkundleni i-Cape Town Stadium ngoMgqibelo, mhla wama-27 kuNhlaba 2023.

src: Swibumabumelo swa Khomixini ya Vuavanyisi ya Vulavisisi eka Swihehlo swa ku Tekiwa ka Vulawuri bya Mfumo hi Swiyenge swa le Tlhelo, Vukungundzwana na Vumbabva eka Sekitara ya Mfumo, ku katsa na Swiyenge swa Mfumo.
tgt: Izincomo zeKhomishini Yokwahlulela Ephenya Ngezinsolo Zokuthunjwa Kwamandla Ombuso, iNkohlakalo Nokukhwabanisa eMkhakheni kaHulumeni, kubandakanya neZinhlaka Zombuso.

src: Namuntlha, 22 Khotavuxika 2023, i lembe kwatsa kusukela loko Hofisi ya Phuresidente yi kume xiviko xo hetelela xa Khomixini ya Vuavanyisi ya Vulavisisi eka Swihehlo swa ku Tekiwa ka Vulawuri bya Mfumo hi Swiyenge swa le Tlhelo, Vukungundzwana na Vumbabva eka Sekitara ya Mfumo, ku katsa na Swiyenge swa Mfumo.
tgt: Namuhla, mhla wama-22 kuNhlangulana 2023, sekungunyaka selokhu uMongameli athola umbiko wokugcina weKhomishini Yokwahlulela Ephenya Ngezinsolo Zokuthunjwa Kwamandla Ombuso, iNkohlakalo Nokukhwabanisa eMkhakheni KaHulumeni, kubandakanya neZinhlaka Zombuso.

src: Hi nhlangula 2022, Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u rhumele ePalamende kungu ra mfumo ra nsimeko wa swibumabumelo swa Khomixini leyi.
tgt: NgoMfumfu wezi-2022, uMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa wahambisa ePhalamende uhlelo lukahulumeni lokuqaliswa kwezincomo zeKhomishini.

src: Khabinete yi fanele ku kuma xiviko xa ndzima leyi khatsiweke hi mayelana na nsimeko wa swibumabumelo swa Khomixini leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi kufanele lithole umbiko ochaza ngenqubekelaphambili mayelana nokuqaliswa kwezincomo zeKhomishini.

src: Ntwanano wa Matiko ya Misava wa Ximfumo na Furwa ku engetela vuswikoti bya Yuniti yo Lavisisa yo Hlawuleka (SIU).
tgt: ISivumelwano ne-France sokuthuthukisa ikhono loPhiko Olukhethekile Oluphenya Izenzo Zobugebengu (i-SIU).

src: Afrika-Dzonga, leyi yimeriweke hi Holobye wa Vululami na Vukorhokeri bya Makhotso, Ttn Ronald Lamola na Furwa, leyi yimeriweke hi Holobye wa Yuropa na Timhaka ta Matiko Mambe, Mhn Catherine Colonna, ma sayinile ntwanano wa matiko ya misava wa ximfumo wa ntirhisano lowu wu nga ta engetela vuswikoti bya SINtirhisano lowu wu ta nyika vuswikoti eka SIU hi mayelana na vulavisisi bya le ka inthanete, vugevenga bya timali na swikili swo xopaxopa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika, ngokumelwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo, uMnu Ronald Lamola kanye nezwe lase-France, yona emelwe nguNgqongqoshe wase-Europe Nezindaba Zangaphandle, uNks Catherine Colonna, basayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisana esizothuthukisa ikhono le-SILokhu kusebenzisana kuphinde kucijise i-SIU ngezokuvundulula ubufakazi ngobuchwepheshe, ubugebengu obuhlobene nezezimali kanye namakhono okuhlaziya.

src: Xinakulobye xi ta vanga ku tumbuluxiwa ka Akhademi yo Lwisana na Vukungundzwana ePitori.
tgt: Lokhu kubambisana kuzoholela ekusungulweni kweSikhungo Esizofundisa Ngokulwa Nenkohlakalo ePitoli.

src: Akhademi leyi yi ta korhokela swirho swa SIU, na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu na to lwisana na vukungundzwana tin'wana leti ti kumekaka eka matiko lama nga swirho ya Muganga wa Nhluvukiso wa Dzongeni wa Afrika, matiko lama a ma ri ehansi ka Britain na lama a ma nga ri ehansi ka Britain.
tgt: Lesi sikhungo sizosiza amalungu e-SIU, amanye ama-ejensi ezomthetho nokulwa nenkohlakalo ayingxenye yamaZwe Asathuthuka aseNingizimu ye-Afrika, amazwe angozimele geqe kanye namazwe ancike kwamanye.

src: Vuswikoti lebyintshwa byi ta tlhela byi tiyisa vuswikoti bya tiko ku angula eka timhaka leti tumbulukaka ku suka eka ka Khomixini ya ku Tekiwa ka Vulawuri hi Swiyenge swa le Tlhelo.
tgt: La makhono amasha azophinde aqinise ikhono lezwe lokubhekana nezinkinga ezivumbuka kwiKhomishini Ephenya Ngokuthunjwa Kwamandla Ombuso.

src: Rendzo ro Tirha ra Nhlanganelo hi Vaholobyenkulu va Netherlands na Denmark.
tgt: Ukuhanjelwa nguNgqongqoshe wase-Netherlands nowase-Denmark.

src: Khabinete yi amukele mivulavurisano exikarhi Phuresidente Ramaphosa, Holobyenkulu Mark Rutte wa Netherlands na Holobyenkulu Mette Frederiksen wa Denmark, hi nkarhi wa rendzo ra ntirho ra nhlanganelo ePitori vhiki reri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele izingxoxo phakathi kukaMongameli u-Ramaphosa, uNgqonqgoshe u-Mark Rutte wase-Netherlands kanye noNgqongqoshe u-Mette Frederiksen wase-Denmark, ngesikhathi bobabili bevakashele ngokomsebenzi ePitoli kuleli viki.

src: Rendzo lero tirha ra nhlanganelo a ri ri ro sungula ra muxaka wa rona etikweni ra ka hina.
tgt: Lokhu kuvakasha koNgqongqoshe ngasikhathi sinye kube yingqophamlando kuleli lizwe lethu.

src: Vuxaka bya xiikhonomi exikarhi ka matiko lamanharhu i nkombiso wa siku ra namuntlha wa vuxaka leyi ku nga kahle byi ri kona exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na matiko ya Yuniyoni ya Yuropa lamambirhi lama ma nyikeke nseketelo wo tivikana eka mihlangano ya ntshunxeko ya Afrika-Dzonga na nyimpi ehenhla ka mafumeloxihlawuhlawu.
tgt: Ubudlelwane bezomnotho phakathi kwala mazwe amathathu buyizithelo zanamuhla zobudlelwane besikhathi eside phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika kanye namazwe amabili e-European Union abonise ukweseka izinyathelo zokulwela inkululeko eNingizimu Afrika kanye nokulwa nohulumeni wobandlululo.

src: Hi nkarhi wa rendzo lero tirha, Afrika-Dzonga yi sayine Memorandamu ya Ntwanano hi mayelana na ntirhisano eka ndzima ya swinakulobye hayidirojeni na eneji swa rihlaza.
tgt: Ngesikhathi salolu hambo, iNingizimu Afrika isayine iZivumelwane zokusebenzisana emkhakheni wehayidrojini ehlanzekile kanye nokusebenzisana kwezamandla nala mazwe amabili.

src: Tikhamphani na mihlangano kusuka eka matiko lamanharhu swi endle switiviso swa vuvekisi na swinakulobye, ku katsa na vutiboheleri bya biliyoni yin'we ya Dolara ya United States eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka Nkwama wa SA-H2 ku hlengeleta vuvekisi bya hayidirojeni ya rihlaza.
tgt: Izinkampani nezikhungo zala mazwe amathathu zenze izimemezelo zotshalomali nezokusebenzisana, kubandakanya isithembiso sesigidigidi esisodwa samaDola aseMelika sokusungulwa kweSikhwama se-SA-H2 esizonxenxa utshalomali lwehayidrojini ehlanzekile.

src: Nkwama wa Switirhisiwakulu swa Mfumo swa Mati na Eneji: Invest International yi kunguhata ku tumbuluxa nkwama wa mpako wa ku nyikiwa ka timali lowu twananiweke wa 300 ya timiliyoni ta Tiyuro na malimpfuneto ya 1000 ra timiliyoni ta Tiyuro leti ti nga ta pfuneta Afrika-Dzonga eka mphakelo wa switirhisiwakulu swa mati na eneji.
tgt: ISikhwama Sengqalasizinda Yomphakathi Yamanzi Nezamandla: I-Invest International ihlose ukusungula isikhwama soxhaso sezigidi ezingama-300 zama-Euro kanye nezibonelelo zezigidi eziyi-100 zama-Euro ezizosiza iNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ikwazi ukwethula ingqalasizinda yamanzi neyezamandla.

src: Mixini wa ku Rhula wa Afrika Khabinete yi amukele ku nyikiwa vuxokoxoko hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa hi mayelana na Mixini wa ku Rhula wa Afrika wo ya eUkraine na Federexini ya Russia lowu eka wona Phuresidente a tekeke xiaveswin'we na varhangeri na vayimeri va mifumo ya Senegal, Comoros, Zambia, Egypt, Congo-Brazzaville, na Uganda.
tgt: UMsebenzi Wokuletha Ukuthula e-Afrika IKhabhinethi lamukele umbiko kaMongameli u-Ramaphosa ngoMsebenzi wakamuva-nje Wokuletha Ukuthula e-Afrika phakathi kwezwe lase-Ukraine nelase-Russia lapho uMengameli abe yingxenye kanye nabanye abaholi nalabo abamele ohulumeni base-Senegal, e-Comoros, e-Zambia, e-Egypt, e-Congo-Brazzaville, kanye ne-Uganda.

src: Mixini wu tiyise xiyimo lexi nga na milawu xa Afrika-Dzonga xa ku teki rihlanguti na vutiboheleri bya tiko eka xitshunxo xa ku rhula xa ntlimbo lowu.
tgt: UMsebenzi lo ugcizelela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika imile ngokungathathi hlangothi kanye nokuzinikela kwezwe kwizisombululo zokuthula kule ngxabano.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Phuresidente Volodymyr Zelensky wa Ukraine na Phuresidente Vladimir Putin wa Federexini ya Russia va amukele pfhumba ra ku rhula ra Afrika naswona va tibohe eka ku vulavurisana ku yisa emahlweni na varhangeri va le Afrika hi mayelana na timhaka leti boxiweke eka xitshunxo xa ku rhula xa ntlimbo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukuthi uMongameli u-Volodymyr Zelensky wase-Ukraine kanye noMongameli wase-Russia bawamukelile umzamo we-Afrika wokuletha ukuthula futhi bathembisa ukuqhubeka nezingxoxo nabaholi base-Afrika ngezindaba eziphakanyisiwe ezizoholela kwizisombululo ezinokuthula kule ngxabano.

src: Mixini lowu wu tshikelele xidingo xa ku hungutiwa ka ntlimbo ku pfumelela mikanerisano ku sungula hi xihatla, ku vuyisiwa ka vana lava tekiweke eUkraine, ku humesiwa ka vabohiwa va nyimpi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka tindlela ku olovisa mpfuneto wa vanhu swinene.
tgt: Lo Msebenzi ugcizelele isidingo sokwehlisa amaphaphu kule ngxabano ukuze izingxoxo zizokwazi ukuqala ngokuphuthuma, kubuyiswe abantwana abathathwa e-Ukraine, kukhululwe iziboshwa zempi futhi kusungulwe imigudu yokwenza lula ukuthi kutholakale usizo lokusiza abantu.

src: Khabinete yi amukele ku khensa loku hundzisiweke hi varhangeri va misava hinkwayo ka nkoka wa Pfhumba ra ku Rhula ra Varhangeri va le Afrika eka ku kuma xitshunxo xa ntlimbo lowu tanihilaha ku paluxiweke hakona hi Vaholobyenkulu va Denmark na Netherlands, xikan'we na Holobye wa Matiko Mambe wa Furwa, exikarhi ka van'wana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likwamukele ukubonga okwedluliswe ngabaholi bamazwe omhlaba ngalo Mzamo Wabaholi base-Afrika Wokuthula wokuthola isisombululo esinokuthula kule ngxabano njengokusho koNgqongqoshe base-Denmark nase-Netherlands, kanjalo noNgqongqoshe Wezindaba Zangaphandle e-France, phakathi kwabanye.

src: Endzhaku ka mixini wa ku rhula, Afrika-Dzonga yi ta teka xiave eka Samiti ya Yuniyoni ya Afrika-Russia eMoscow hi Mawuwana, laha matlhelo ya yona, mfumo wa hina wu nga ta tlhela wu teka xivandlanene lexi ku vulavurisana ku ya emahlweni na Russia hi mayelana na timhaka leti Tiphuresidente letimbirhi ti tiboheke ku ti tekela enhlokweni.
tgt: Kulandela umsebenzi wokuletha ukuthula, iNingizimu Afrika izobamba iqhaza kwiNgqungquthela Yamazwe ase-Afrika ne-Russia ezoba se-Moscow ngoNtulikazi, nokuyilapho uhulumeni wethu azophinde asebenzise ithuba lokuphinde axoxisane ne-Russia mayelana nezindaba labo Mongameli ababili abazidingidile ukuphuma nesinqumo.

src: Mutsundzuxi wa Nsirhelelo wa Rixaka wa Phuresidente Ramaphosa, yena Phrf Fholisani Sydney Mufamadi, u ta ya eka Samiti ya ku Rhula, leyi rhambiweke hi Phuresidente Zelenksy, leyi yi nga ta va kona eCopenhagen, Denmark, hi Mhawuri.
tgt: UMeluleki Wezokuvikeleka kuZwelonke kaMongameli u-Ramaphosa, uSlz Fholisani Sydney Mufamadi, uzothamela iNgqungquthela Yokuthula, ezobe iphethwe kuMongameli u-Zelenksy, ezoba se-Copenhagen, e-Denmark, ngoNcwaba.

src: Hi mayelana na xihahampfhuka lexi tleketleke vatirhi va nsirhelelo wa phuresidente va le Afrika-Dzonga na vayimeri va swihangalasamahungu ku ya ePoland endleleni ya vona yo kongoma eUkraine na Russia, Khabinete yi lemuke swiendleko leswi a swi fanele ku va swi nga humelelangi leswi swi humeleleke loko xihahampfhuka lexi xi phatsama eWarsaw, Poland.
tgt: Mayelana nendiza ebithwele abasebenzi abaqaphe uMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nabamele abezindaba ebiya e-Poland yabe seyindlulela e-Ukraine nase-Russia, iKhabhinethi lizwile ngokwenzekile okungekuhle ngesikhathi le ndiza ihlala e-Warsaw, e-Poland.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Ndzawulo ya Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano yi ta khoma nkanelo hi mayelana na mhaka leyi hi ku tirhisa maendlelo na tindlela swa xidipulomati leswi faneleke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lizwile ukuthi uMnyango Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Nokubambisana uzoba nezingxoxo ngalolu daba ngokulandela izindlela kanye nemigudu efanele yobunxusa.

src: Timhaka ta mabindzu.
tgt: Ezohwebo.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke tinhlayo ta mabindzu ta sweswinyana tanihilaha ti andlariweke hakona hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu, vumaki na Mphikizano leti kombeke leswaku tinhundzu ta Afrika-Dzonga leti rhumeriwaka eChina ti fike eka US$33 wa tibiliyoni hi 2022, hi kambirhi kutlula levhele ya mutirhisani wo bindzurisa lonkulu kutlula hinkwavo, Jarimani.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lizibonile izibalo zohwebo zakamuva njengoba bezethulwa nguMnyango Wezohwebo, Izimboni Nokuncintisana nezibonise ukuthi impahla yaseNingizimu Afrika ethunyelwa e-China ifinyelele kwizigidigidi ezingama-$33 ngowezi-2022, okwedlule ngamazinga amabili umlingani wethu esihwebelana naye, okuyi-Germany.

src: Hi ku angarhela, mabindzu ya Afrika-Dzonga-China ya tlakuke hi 30% kusuka eka US$44 wa tibiliyoni hi 2018 kufika eka US$57wa tibiliyoni hi kuhela ka 2022.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ukuhwebelana phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-China kunyuke ngama-30% kusuka kwizigidigidi ezingama-$44 kuya kwizigidigidi ezingama-$57 ngokuphela kwezi-2022.

src: Kusukela 2018 kufikela 2022, mipimo ya ku kula ya lembe na lembe ya nhlayoxikarhi ya 10% (tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe) na 4.5% (tinhundzu leti xaviweke ematikweni) yi tsarisiwile.
tgt: Kusuka kowezi-2018 kuya kowezi-2022, isilinganisomvama samanani otshalomali lonyaka sama-10% (impahla ephumayo) kanye nama-4.5% (impahla engenayo) saqoshwa phansi.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi hlayisa misalo ya mabindzu leyikulu eka ntlhanu wa malembe.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika yahweba ngokweqile kuleyo minyaka emihlanu.

src: Khabinete yi amukele ntwanano lowu wu nga ta endla leswaku Mozambique yi amukela Afrika-Dzonga hi 100 wa timegawati (MW) ta gezi endzeni ka tin'hweti tinharhu (3) leti landzelaka xikan'wekan'we loko ku sayiniwa Ntwanano wa ku Xaviwa ka Gezi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele isivumelwano esithi i-Mozambique izothumelela iNingizimu Afrika ugesi ongama-100 megawatts (MW) ezinyangeni ezintathu (3) ezizayo emva kokusayinwa kweSivumelwano Sokuthenga Ugesi.

src: Tin'hweti tinharhu kufika eka 12 leti landzelaka ti ta endla leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi xava kusuka eka matiko mambe kufika eka 1 000 MW ta gezi kusuka eMozambique.
tgt: Ezinyangeni ezintathu kuya kweziyi-12 ezizayo sizobona iNingizimu Afrika ithenga ugesi ongafinyelela kwi-1 000 MW e-Mozambique.

src: Khabinete yi yile emahlweni yi amukela antswiso lowu yaka emahlweni eka ntalo wa ku endliwa ka gezi Eskom lowu wu tiyisiseke leswaku nhlangano wo phakela miganga gezi wu tsarisa 60% ta Xiphemu xa Vukona bya Eneji.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela inqubekelaphambili eqhubekayo ekusebenzeni kwesiphehlimandla sakwa-Eskom esesiqinisekise ukuthi lesi sikhungo sinoGesi Otholakalayo ongama-60%.

src: Khabinete yi hundzise ku khensa ka yona eka vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga eka vuhoxaxandla bya n'wina eka ku hunguta ku laviwa ka gezi, leswi swi hoxekeke xandla eka Eskom ku va yi kota ku hlayisa switeji swa le hansi swa ku tirhisiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa ukubonga kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngegalelo abalifakile ekwehliseni ukufuneka kukagesi, nokufake isandla ekutheni u-Eskom akwazi ukugcina amazinga aphansi okucima ugesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: Ku hlayisa gezi i vutihlamuleri lebyi avelaniwaka naswona i goza leri hinkwerhu ka hina hi vuyeriwaka kusuka eka rona.
tgt: Ukonga ugesi kungumsebenzi wethu sonke futhi sonke siyazuza ngokwenze njalo.

src: Khabinete yi hundzise ku khensa eka munyikelo eAfrika-Dzonga hi Rhiphabuliki ya Vanhu ya China ya xilamulelamhangu na switirhisiwa swo endla gezi swa mpimo lowutsongo leswi nga na nkoka R167 wa timiliyoni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulise ukubonga ngomnikelo onikelelwe abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ovela eRiphabhulikhi yase-China wezimo eziphuthumayo kanye nemishini emincane yokuphehla ugesi yenani lezigidi ezingama-R167.

src: Kungu ra ku rhumeriwa ka vatirhi ri le ku hluvukisiwa ku tiyisisa leswaku ku na switirhisiwa leswi nyikeriweke swa vekeriwa eka switirhisiwa swa mfumo leyi ekuheteleleni hi yi nga ta humesiwa eka ku tirhisiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana.
tgt: Uhlelo lokwaba lo mnikelo luyasungulwa ukuze kuzoqinisekiswa ukuthi imishini enikeliwe ifakwa ezikhungweni zomphakathi lezo ezingezukucinyelwa ugesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: Ntirho wa ku hundzisiwa ka ximfumo wu ta va kona xikan'wekan'we loko tinhundzu ti pasisiwile hi vulawuri va xibalo va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Umcimbi wokudluliswa ngokusemthethweni uzokwenziwa ngokushesha uma impahla isidlulile futhi yaphasiswa yiziphathimandla zomnyango wempahla eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mati Khabinete yi kume nkatsakanyo wa miangulo hi Ndzawulo ya Mati na Nkululo ya mitlhontlho ya mati ya nkululo etikweni.
tgt: Amanzi IKhabhinethi licubungule izimpendulo zoMnyango Wamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle ngezinselele zamanzi nokuthuthwa kwendle kuleli lizwe.

src: Nkatsakanyo lowu wu kombisile ku hatlisisiwa ka tiphurojeke swipfuno swa mati ya le henhla leti eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza ti tokotiweke tanihi:7.
tgt: Lokhu kubuyekeza kugqamise ukusheshiswa kwemiklamo yemithombo yamanzi obekubhekenwe nayo efana nalena:7.

src: Vuaki bya Xiyimo xa 2 xa R40 wa tibiliyoni xa Phurojeke ya mati ya Lesotho Highlands leyi yi nga ta tirhela Gauteng na swifundzakulu leswi rhendzeleke.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kweSigaba sesi-2 somklamo wezigidigidi ezingama-R40 i-Lesotho Highlands Water Project ezophakela i-Gauteng nezifundazwe ezakhelene nayo.

src: Ntirho wu ta hetiwa hi Xiyimo xa 2A xa R4 wa tibiliyoni xa Phurojeke yo Engetela Mati ya Mokolo Crocodile eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu eLimpopo.
tgt: ISigaba sesi-2A somklamo wezigidigidi ezi-R4 i-Mokolo Crocodile Water Augmentation Project eNyakatho Ntshonalanga naseLimpopo.

src: Mali yi le ku hlengeletiweni eka xiyimo xin'wana lexi vuaki byi nga ta sunguriwa hi Mudyaxihi 2024, ku ri na ku hetisiwa loku kunguhateriweke ku va hi Eka xinakulobye exikarhi ka mfumo na sekitara ya vucelamigodi, vuaki byi le ku endlekeni eka phurojeke ya Nhluvukiso wa Swipfuno swa Mati swa Nambu wa Olifants ya R24 wa tibiliyoni eLimpopo, ku ri na ku hetiwa loku languteriwaka hi Eka xinakulobye xo fana hi migodi leyi nga eKapa-N'walungu, vuaki byi ta sungula endzhakunyana ka lembe leri eka phurojeke ya Vaal Gamagara ya R10 ra tibiliyoni laha ku hetiwa na kona ku languteriwaka kwalomuya ka Vuaki byi sungule n'hweti yaleyi, Khotavuxika 2023, eka Phurojeke yo Engetela Mati ya Groot Letaba eLimpopo, leyi yi khumbaka ku tlakusiwa ka Damu Tzaneen.
tgt: Kuqoqwa izimali zesinye isigaba lapho ukwakha kuzoqala ngoNhlaba wezi-2024, nokuhlelwe ukuthi kuphothulwe ngowezi-2030.

src: Ntirho eka phurojeke leyi wu ta hetiwa hi EKapa-Vupeladyambu, vuaki byi ta sungula hi 2024 eka Xikimi xo Engetela xa Voëlvlei xa R1,2 wa tibiliyoni, laha ku hetiwa ku languteriwa hi 2026.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisana phakathi kukahulumeni nomkhakha wezimayini, ukwakha kuyaqhubeka kumklamo wezigidigidi ezingama-R24 i-Olifants River Water Resource Development Project eLimpopo, nokulindeleke ukuthi uphothulwe ngowezi-2030.

src: Tiphurojeke leti ti hlayisa mphakelo wa mati eka rixaka naswona eka phurosese leyi magidi ya vanhu ya ta thoriwa, mabindzu lama rhendzeleke tindhawu ta vuaki ti ta vuyeriwa hi ku tekiwa ka vatirhi na van'watikontiraka , naswona switirhisiwakulu leswi antswisiweke swi ta vuyerisa tiikhonomi ta le tindhawini letiya.
tgt: Kokunye ukubambisana okufanayo nezimayini eNyakatho Kapa, ukwakha kuzoqala makhathaleni kulo nyaka kumklamo wezigidigidi ezi-R10 i-Vaal Gamagara lapho ukuphothulwa kwawo nakho kulindeleke ngowezi-2023.

src: Khabinete yi amukele xinakulobye exikarhi ka Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Vutumbuluxi na IThemba LABS, leyi nga endla leswaku ku pfuriwa SAIF, xitirhisiwa xa xiyimo xa misava lexi xi angulaka eka ntlhontlho lowu kulaka wa mfukuzana tanihi xin'wana xa swivangelo swa rifu.
tgt: Ukwakha kuqale kule nyanga, uNhlangulana wezi-2023, kumklamo wezigidi ezingama-R500 i-Groot Letaba Water Augmentation eLimpopo, obandakanya ukukhushulwa kwedamu i-Tzaneen Dam.

src: Eka nkarhi wa sweswi kwalomu ka 5 000 wa vavabyi va le Afrika-Dzonga hi lembe va vuyeriwa kusuka eka mphakelo lowu, naswona swi languteriwile leswaku tinhlayo leti ti nga tlakukaka hi xiphemu xa ntlhanu kufika eka nkombo, ku ri na ntlakuko eka vuswikoti bya vuhumesi hi SAIF na vukona bya ntlawa wuntshwa wa tiayisothopi.
tgt: ENtshonalanga Kapa, ukwakha kuzoqala ngowezi-2024 kumklamo wesigidigidi esi-R.2 i-Voëlvlei Augmentation Scheme, nokulindeleke ukuthi uphothulwe ngowezi-2026.

src: Ku pasisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo Bangi ya Poso leyi nga na Vutihlamuleri Khabinete yi amukele ku pasisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa Bangi ya Poso leyi nga na Vutihlamuleri hi Palamende (havumbirhi bya Huvo ya Rixaka na Huvo ya Rixaka ya Swifundzakulu), leswi pfulaka ndlela ya ku nyikiwa ka layisense ya bangi ya mfumo.
tgt: Le miklamo iqinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwamanzi esizweni futhi uma uqhubeka izinkulungwane zabantu zizoqashwa, amabhizinisi aseduze nendawo yesakhiwo azozuza ngenxa yabasebenzi nosonkontileka, kanti nengqalasizinda ethuthukisiwe izoletha inzuzo emnothweni wendawo.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu tirhana na mixungeto leyi eka nkarhi wa sweswi yi fambelanisiwaka na xivumbeko xa nkarhi wa sweswi xa Bangi ya Poso, hi ku hundzuluxa vun'wini na xivumbeko xo vika ku tumbuluxa khamphani yo lawula yintshwa ya Bangi ya Poso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele ukusebenzisana phakathi koMnyango Wesayensi Nokuqamba Kabusha kanye ne-IThemba LABS, okuholele ekuvulweni kwe-SAIF, okuyisikhungo esisezingeni lomhlaba esibhekene nenselele ekhulayo yesifo somdlavuza njengenye yezimbangela zokufa ezihamba phambili.

src: Khabinete yi ta rindzela Phuresidente ku sayina tanihi nawu lowu wu nga ta pfumelela ntsariso wa Bangi ya Poso tanihi Khamphani yo Lawula Bangi.
tgt: Isikhungo sizokwenza ucwaningo oluseqophelweni eliphezulu kanye nokuqeqesha kanjalo nokunyusa umthamo womkhiqizo wama-radioisotope.

src: Khabinete yi amukele nsimeko wa Bazi ro Fambafamba na Miganga ra Mitirho ya Mfumo ra ximanguvalawa hi Tindzawulo ta Dyondzo ya Masungulo, Dyondzo ya le Henhla, Sayense na Vutumbuluxi, na Mitirho na Vatirhi, eka ku tirhisana na nongoloko wa Dyondzo ya Vutholeki ya Yuniyoni ya Yuropa.
tgt: Ukuphasiswa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela iBhange Leposi IKhabhinethi lamukele ukuphasiswa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela iBhange Leposi yiPhalamende (yiSigungu Sikazwelonke kanye noMkhandlu Kazwelonke Wezifundazwe), ophendla indlela yokukhishwa kwemvume yebhange lombuso.

src: Mabazi lama swivandlanene ma ta teka tendzo eka tindhawu leti tshameleke ekule ku pfuna vadyondzi na valavi va mitirho hi ndlela ya vona ku thoriwa hi mitamu na vuswikoti bya munhu lebyi pananaka eka mitirhovutomi leyi nga tshukaka yi va kona na swivandlanene swa mitirho.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa ubhekana nobungozi okwamanje obuhlobene nokwakhekha kweBhange Leposi, ngokuchibiyela ubunikazi kanye nabaphathi ukuze kuzosungulwa inkampani entsha yeBhange Leposi.

src: Khabinete yi yile emahlweni yi amukela mapfhumba hi Ndzawulo hi Vurimi, Antswiso wa Misava na Nhluvukiso wa Matikoxikaya ku seketela vantshwa ku teka xiave eka sekitara ya vurimi eka mpfuxeto wa tindhawu ta nhlanganelo wa vaakandhawu to tanihi bindzu ra nhlanganelo ra le xikolweni xa le hansi xa Marapyane-Bakgatla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lizolinda uMongameli ukuthi asayine umthethosivivinywa ube ngumthetho lokho okuzovumela ukubhaliswa kweBhange Leposi njenge-Bank Controlling Company.

src: Ku Tirha eka Nongoloko wa Ndzilo Khabinete yi losa 400 ya vatimelandzilo va le Afrika-Dzonga lava rhumeriweke eCanada ku pfuneta ku ponisa vutomi, makaya, mabindzu na nhova eka Xifundzakulu xa Alberta xa Canada.
tgt: IKhabhinethi libonge abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuba yingxenye yemigubho yoSuku Lwentsha mhla we-16 kuNhlangulana 2023 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: "Sisheshisa ukukhululwa komnotho wentsha ukuze izoba nekusasa elisimeme".

src: Ku rhumeriwa ka vatirhi ka 2023 i angulo eka xikombelo xa xihatla ku suka eka Senthara ya Ndzilo wa Swihlahla ya le Xikarhi ka Tiejensi ya Canada.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele ukwethulwa kweBhasi Elingumahambanendlwana Lemisebenzi Yomphakathi eliseqophelweni eliphezulu nguMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo, iMfundo Ephakeme, Isayensi Nokuqamba Kabusha, kanye noMnyango Wezemisebenzi, ngokubambisana nohlelo lwe-European Union's Education for Employability.

src: Ntirhisano lowa vuntlhanu exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Canada i vumbhoni bya vuxaka lebyo tiya exikarhi ka matiko ma ka hina lamambirhi naswona vuhoxaxandla bya Afrika-Dzonga ku hoxa xandla eka ku hlayisa mbangu wa xiviri, swi nga ri na mhaka leswaku i xiphemu xihi xa misava lexi hlaseriwaka hi mixungeto ya mbangu.
tgt: La mabhasi alethe amathuba ahambela izindawo ezikude ukusiza abafundi kanye nalabo abafuna umsebenzi ukuthi bakwazi ukubona lapho benamakhono khona kanye namandla emisebenzini ethile nakumathuba omsebenzi.

src: Mitlangu ya Ximumu ya Misava ya Tiolimpiki yo Hlawuleka Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga xi ya emahlweni xi endla tiko ri tinyungubyisa eka Mitlangu ya Ximumu ya Misava ya Tiolimpiki yo Hlawuleka ya 2023 eBerlin, Jarimani, kusuka 17 kufika 25 Khotavuxika 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela imizamo yoMnyango Wezolimo, Izinguquko Zomhlaba Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya yokweseka intsha ukuthi ikwazi ukubamba iqhaza emkhakheni wezolimo nasekuvuselelweni kwezindawo abahlala kuzona ezifana nenhlangano i-Marapyane-Bakgatla.

src: Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga xi vumbiwa hi 64 wa switsutsumi na 21 wa vadzaberi lava va phikizanaka na 7 000 ya switsutsumi kusuka eka 180 wa matiko.
tgt: Le nhlangano isisungule imisebenzi engaphezu kwe-100 ezindaweni zangakubo futhi le ntsha ingabalimi bokusanhlamvu nobhekilanga.

src: Swiboho swa Khabinete Ku Amukeriwa ka Afrika-Dzonga ka Milawu ya Luxembourg ya Ntwanano wa Mitsakelo ya Matiko ya Misava eka Switirhisiwa swo Fambafamba hi mayelana na Timhaka leti Kongomanaka na Matorokisi Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Milawu ya Swiporo swa Luxembourg ePalamende leswaku xi amukeriwa.
tgt: Umsebenzi Wohlelo Lokucisha Umlilo IKhabhinethi lithulela isigqoko izicimamlilo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingama-400 ezithunyelwe e-Canada ukuyosiza ngokusindisa izimpilo, amakhaya, amabhizinisi nezitshalo eSifundazweni sase-Canada i-Alberta.

src: Milawu ya Swiporo ya Luxembourg yi kondletela ku kula ka ikhonomi hi ku tiyisa sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo leyi nyikaka timali eka indasitiri ya swiporo.
tgt: Loku kuthunyelwa kwezicimamlilo ngowezi-2023 kungukuphendula isicelo esiphuthumayo seSikhungo Esilwa Nomlilo Wequbula e-Canada.

src: Milawu ya Swiporo ya Luxembourg i mbuyelo wa ku humelela ka Ntwanano wa Kapa hi mayelana na Mitsakelo ya Matiko ya Misava eka Switirhisiwa swo Fambafamba leyi khomiweke hi 2007.
tgt: Lokhu kusebenzisana kwehlandla lesihlanu phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Canada kungubufakazi bobudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwala mazwe womabili kanye negalelo leNingizimu Afrika ekugcineni imvelo yethu, kungakhathalekile ukuthi yiyiphi ingxenye yomhlaba ethintwe ngukukhahlamezeka kwemvelo.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi sayine milawu leyi hi 2022, tanihi xikombo xa hilaha tiko ri tiyimiseleke hakona hi mayelana na antswiso wa swiporo.
tgt: IMidlalo Yomhlaba YaseHlobo yama-Olympics IQembu laseNingizimu Afrika liyaqhubeka nokundizisela phezulu ifulegi kwiMidlalo Yomhlaba YaseHlobo yama-Olympics yangowezi-2023 e-Berlin, e-Germany, kusuka mhla we-17 kuya mhla wama-25 kuNhlangulana 2023.

src: Ku thoriwa Ku thoriwa hinkwako ku fanele ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mithwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.
tgt: IQembu laseNingizimu Afrika liqukethe abasubathi abangama-64 nabaqeqeshi abangama-21 abaqhudelana nabasubathi abayizi-7 000 abaphuma emazweni ayi-180.

src: Ttn Sandile Psychology Mkhize tanihi Muofisirinkulu wa Vurhangerinkulu wa Magalies Water (ku engeteriwa ka kontiraka).
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi ISiqinisekiso seNingizimu Afrika Ngenqubo ye-Luxembourg yoMhlangano Omayelana Nalokho Okufunwa Ngamazwe Omhlaba kwiMishini Ehambayo Eqondene Nezinqola Zesitimela IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukulethwa kweNqubo Yezitimela ye-Luxembourg ePhalamende ukuze iqinisekiswe.

src: Nawumbisi lowu katsaka goza ro sivela vukati byo tanihi vukati bya vana na lebyi byi endliwaka ku ri hava vandla lerin'wana.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Osahlongozwa Wezemishado wezi-2022 IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Osahlongozwa Wezemishado wezi-2022 ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Nawumbisi wa Ejensi ya Switirhisiwakulu swa Swipfuno swa Mati ya Rixaka (NWRIA) wa 2022.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa ungumphumela woMthetho Odingidwayo Wezemishado eNingizimu Afrika, owagunyazwa yiKhabhinethi ngoNdasa wezi-2022.

src: Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Nawumbisi wa NWRIA wa mpfapfarhuto ePalamende.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa unika amandla uMnyango Wezasekhaya ukuthi usungule uMthetho Wezemishado owodwa wezwe.

src: Nawumbisi lowu ringanyeta ku simekiwa ka NWRIA leswaku yi va na vutihlamuleri bya nkunguhato, ku nyika timali na nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwakulu swa mati swa tiko leri.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imishado yenzeka ngendlela elandela izimiso zokulingana, ukungacwasi kanye nokugcina isithunzi somuntu njengoba kusho uMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika wangowezi-1996.

src: Ejensi leyi yi fanele ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na mphakelo wo yiseka emahlweni, wo ringanana na ku va wo tshembeka wa mati hi ku fambisana na miboheko leyi nga eka vumbiwa ya mfikelelo wa mati na ku sirhelela mbangu lowu nga na rihanyo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo uvumela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezakhamuzi ezikuleli lizwe ababobonke ubulili, kanjalo nenkolo namasiko, ukuthi bashade ngokomthetho ngokuhambisana nezimiso zomthethosisekelo.

src: Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wo Dlaya Vukati 2023 Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wo Dlaya Vukati wa mpfapfarhuto wa 2023 ePalamende.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa we-Ejensi Kazwelonke Yengqalasizinda Yomthombo Wamanzi (i-NWRIA) wezi-2022.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati, 1979 (Nawu wa 70 wa 1979) ku endlela ku lulamisela tindlela ta ku sirhelela nhlayiseko wa swihlangi kumbe va na lava hlayisiwaka va tswariweke eka vukati bya Ximuzilamu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukulethwa koMthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo we-NWRIA ePhalamende.

src: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi tlhela yi lulamisela ku phakeriwa hi vuntshwa ka rifuwo loko ku n'okisiwa vukati bya Ximuzilamu ku lulamisela ku tekeriwa mivuyelo ya ndzhaka ya vukati bya Ximuzilamu.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlongoza ukubekwa kwe-NWRIA ukuthi kube yiyona ebhekele ukuhlelwa, ukuxhasa ngezimali kanye nokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi kuleli lizwe.

src: Khoto yi kume leswaku xiyenge xa Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati wu hambana na vumbiwa hi mhaka ya leswaku wu endla xihlawuhlawu lexi nga riki lexinene ehenhla ka vana va vatswari lava tekaneke na vatswari lava nga tekanangiki.
tgt: I-ejensi izoqinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwamanzi okusimeme, okulinganayo nokuthembekile ngokuhambisana nezibopho zomthethosisekelo wokuthola amanzi kanye nesimondawo esiphephile esinempilo.

src: Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa Nkwama wa Mpfuxeto wa Afrika na Ntirhisano wa Matiko ya Misava (ARF) Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa nkandziyiso wa Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa mpfapfarhuto wa ARF leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.
tgt: Izokwakheka njengeNhlangano Kahulumeni ngaphansi kweSheduli yesi-2 yoMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zikahulumeni, we-1999 (Umthetho woku-1 we-1999).

src: Xikongomelo xa Nawumbisi lowu i ku hundzuluxa Nawu wa ARF (Nawu wa 51 wa 2000).
tgt: I-ejensi izothatha imisebenzi okuyimanje yenziwa yi-Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority.

src: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta tlhela yi vula leswaku ARF sweswi yi ta vitani Ejensi ya Swinakulobye bya Nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Isehlukaniso Somshado wezi-2023 IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukulethwa koMthethosivivinywa osahlongozwa Wokuchibiyela Isehlukaniso Somshado wezi-2023 ePhalamende.

src: Ejensi leyi yi ta tirha tanihi xitirho ku lawula, ku seketela na ku humelerisa ntirhisano na mpfuneto wa nhluvukiso lowu fikaka emakumu wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wesehlukaniso Somshado, wangowe-1979 (Umthetho wama-70 we-1979) ukuze uzohlinzeka ngezindlela zokuvikela inhlalakahle yabantwana abancane noma abantwana abondliwayo abazalwe emshadweni wenkolo yamaSulumane.

src: ARF yi tlhela yi va na nkoka eka Afrika-Dzonga tanihileswi yi antswisaka ntirhisano exikarhi ka tiko ra ka hina na matiko man'wana, ngopfungopfu matiko ma le Afrika, hikwalaho ka nkondletelo wa xidemokirasi, mafumelo lamanene, nsivelo na xitshunxo xa ntlimbo, nhluvukiso na mpfanganiso wa vanhu na ikhonomi mpfuneto wa vanhu na nhluvukiso wa swipfuno swa ximunhu.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela iSikhwama Sokuvuselelwa Kwe-Afrika Nokubambisana Kwamazwe Omhlaba (i-ARF) IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa oluhlaka wokuchibiyela i-ARF ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Hi n'hweti leyi, vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga va tlangela vutomi bya khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela, ndzhaka ya yena naswona va teka goza ku pfuna ku cinca vaakandhawu va ka hina leswaku va antswa, va pfanganisa matshalatshala ku hoxa xandla eka ku lwisana na vusweti na nkandzingano.2 Khabinete yi hlohlotela vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku tirhisa n'hweti leyi ku endla swin'wana leswi swi nga ta endla ku hambana emigangeni ya ka vona na ku tiyisisa leswaku hi aka Afrika-Dzonga leyi voniweke hi tatana wa hina wo simeka.
tgt: I-ejensi izosebenza njengendlela yokuphatha, ukweseka nokulawula ukuthuthukiswa nokusizwa kweNingizimu Afrika.

src: 2 Samiti ya Ntwanano wo Nyika Timali wa Misava Hinkwayo wuntshwa.1 Phuresidente Ramaphosa hi siku ra 22 na 23 Khotavuxika 2023, u ta teka xiave eka samiti ya ntwanano a ku nyika timali wa misava hinkwayo eFurwa.
tgt: I-ARF ibaluleke kakhulu ekugqugquzeleni izinto ezibalulekile neziligugu zezwe laseNingizimu Afrika, uKuvuselelwa Kwe-Afrika kanye nokwakhiwa komhlaba ongcono wawo wonke umuntu.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi ta tirhana na timhakakulu to tanihi antswiso wa mihlangano ya timali ta nhluvukiso ya matikonyingi, xirilo xa swikweleti, ku nyika timali ka vutumbuluxi, swibalo swa matiko ya misava ma timfanelo to tihumesa to hlawuleka.3 Khomferense ya Khansele ya Vuyimeri ya Vadyondzi (RCL)3.1 Khomferense ya RCL yi ta rhambiwa hi siku ra 29 na 30 Khotavuxika 2023 eYunivhesiti ya Pitori hi xikongomelo xa ku aka na ku tiyisa xiave xa tiRCL eswikolweni.2 Khomferense ya nan'waka yi ta kongomisa eka ku havexerisa vadyondzi, ku kumiwa ka swidingo swa vadyondzi na ku antswisa matirhelo ya tiRCLeyi i pulatifomo ya nkoka ya ku hluvukisa vurhangeri bya nkarhi lowu taka bya tiko leri.4 2023 Thonamente ya Khapi ya Misava ya Netibolo.1 Kha ri na 36 wa Masiku ku ya eka Khapi ya Misava ya Netibolo ya 2023 leyi yi nga ta va kona eCape Town International Convention Centre kusuka 28 Mawuwana kufika 6 Mhawuri 2023, Khabinete yi khense vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga hinkwavo eka ku amukela ka Vumunhu ka malwandla eka vanhu lava endzeke eka rendzo ra Thirofi ya Khapi ya Misava etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: I-ARF iphinde ibaluleke eNingizimu Afrika njengoba ithuthukisa ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezwe lethu namanye amazwe, ikakhulukazi amazwe ase-Afrika, ngokugqugquzela intando yeningi labantu, ukubusa ngendlela efanele, ukugwema nokuxazulula ingxabano, ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho nokuhlangana, ukusiza abantu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi.

src: Rendzo lera thirofi ri vumba xiphemu xa migingiriko yo yisa eka ntlangu wo pfula.
tgt: Ezakamuva ngokukhethwa elinye ihlandla kweNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ibe iLungu loMkhandlu we-International Civil Aviation Organisation IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukukhethwa elinye ihlandla kweNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ibe iLungu loMkhandlu we-International Civil Aviation Organisation Imicimbi Ezayo1 INyanga kaMandela.1 INingizimu Afrika kanye nomhlaba wonke, ngoNtulikazi bazobungaza iNyanga kaMandela ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “ISimo Sezulu, Ukudla kanye Nobumbano”.

src: Rendzo lera thirofi ri sungule eKwaZulu-Natal naswona ri ta nghena hi le Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Limpopo, N'walungu-Vupeladyambu, Free State, Kapa-N'walungu na Kapa Vupeladyambu.
tgt: Ngale nyanga, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babungaza impilo kaMongameli waphambilini u-Nelson Mandela, ifa lakhe kanye nokuthatha igxathu lokusiza ngoguquko emiphakathini yethu ngokuhlanganisa imizamo ezoba negalelo ekulweni nobubha nokungalingani.

src: Rendzo leri ri ta gimeta eKapa-Vupeladyambu tanihi xifundza lexi rhurhelaka, ku nga si sungula thonamente leyi hi siku ra 28 Mawuwana 2023.5 Banyana Banyana va suka ku ya eka Khapi ya Misava ya FIFA ya Vavasati.1 Hi ku yimela rixaka, Khabinete yi navelele leswinene eka xipano xa bolo ya milenge ya vavasati ya rixaka, Banyana Banyana, tanihiloko xi ri eku lulamiseleni ku suka hi Ravuntlhanu 23 Khotavuxika 2023, kuya eka Khapi ya Misava ya FIFA ya Vavasati leyi yi nga ta khomeriwa eAustralia na le New Zealand hi Mawuwana.2 Matirhelo ya xipano eka tithonamente to hambanahambana ma tisile nkongomiso wa miehleketo wa misava hinkwayo eka nhluvukiso wa ntlangu wa vavasati eAfrika-Dzonga, tanihi xiphemu xa vutihavexerisi byo angarhela havexeriso wa rixaka wa vavasati etikweni.
tgt: 2 INgqungquthela yeSivumelwano Somhlaba Sezimali esisha.1 UMongameli u-Ramaphosa ngomhla wama-22 nama-23 kuNhlangulana 2023, uzoba yingxenye yengqungquthela yesivumelwano somhlaba sezimali esisha e-France.

src: VuhoyozeriKhabinete yi hundzise vuhoyozeri bya yona na ku navelela leswinene eka: Vatlangi va thenisi va tiwhilichere va le Afrika-Dzonga Donald Ramphadi na Kgothatso Montjane lava va humeleleke tanihi tinghwazi ta Grand Slam eka swiavo swo vona hi ku hambana eka thonamente ya Roland Garros yo xiximeka eFurwa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izokhuluma ngezinkinga ezihamba phambili ezifana nezinguquko ezikhungweni zezimali zokuthuthukisa zamazwe amaningi, isimo esibi sezikweletu, uxhaso-mali lwamaqhinga amasha, intela yomhlaba kanye namalungelo okuhoxa.

src: Vahluri hinkwavo va Matsambu ya Comrade ya 2023 na switsutsumi leswi swi teke xiave eka matsambukulu yo rhelela kusuka ePietermaritzburg kufika Durban.
tgt: 3 INgqungquthela yoMkhandlu Omele Abafundi (i-RCL)3.1 INgqungquthela ye-RCL izobanjwa mhla wama-29 nama-30 kuNhlangulana 2023 eNyuvesi yasePitoli ngenhloso yokwakha nokuqinisa indima edlalwa i-RCL ezikoleni.

src: Hi hoyozela Tete Dijana na Gerda Steyn kungari eka ku hlula ntsena misayano ya vavanuna na ya vavasati hi ku hambana ka vona, kambe na ku tlhela va tshova tirhekodo to rhelela eka havumbirhi bya misiyano ya vavanuna na ya vavasati.
tgt: Ingqungquthela yakulo nyaka izogxila ekuhlomiseni abafundi, ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izidingo zabafundi kanye nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwama-RCLena yinkundla ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni abaholi bakusasa bezwe.

src: Ku vuriwa ko hlawuleka ku tlhela ku hlayiseriwa mutshami wa le Limpopo Tatana Johannes Mosehla loyi, eka malembe ya 81 hi vukhale, a veke munhu wa khale kutlula hinkwavo ku heta Comrades.
tgt: 4 IMidlalo Yendebe Yomhlaba Yebhola Lomnqakiswano yezi-20.1 Njengoba kusele Izinsuku ezingama-36 ukuthi kuqale iMidlalo Yendebe Yomhlaba Yebhola Lomnqakiswano yezi-2023 ezoba se-Cape Town International Convention Centre kusuka mhla wama-28 kuNtulikazi kuya mhla wesi-6 kuNcwaba 2023, iKhabhinethi libonge bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngoBuntu ababubonisile kwamukelwa ithimba ebelihamba libukisa ngeNdebe Yomhlaba ezweni lonkana.

src: Hi N'hweti ya Vantshwa, vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga va malembe hinkwawo hi vukhale va nga dyondza nkoka na ku vuyeriwa hi hanyelo leri nga na rihanyo kusuka eka mudyuhari lonkulu swonghasi.
tgt: Uhambo lokuzungeleza kwendebe luyingxenye yemigubho eyandulela umdlalo wokuqala wokuvula.

src: Mhn P Khoza loyi a hlawuriweke tanihi Phuresidente wa Huvo ya ICAO ya 42 leyi yi veke kona kusuka 27 Ndzati ku fika 7 Nhlangula eMontreal, Canada Michavelelo Khabinete yi hundzise michavelelo ya yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va: Xirho xa Palamende, Mhn Tina Joemat-Pettersson, loyi a ri Mutshamaxitulu wa Komiti ya Photifoliyo ya Huvo ya Rixaka hi mayelana na Maphorisa, naswona loyi eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza a tirha tanihi Holobye wa Vurimi, Swihlahla, na Tinhlampfi na Holobye wa Eneji.
tgt: Uhambo lokuzungeleza kwendebe lwaqala KwaZulu-Natali kanti luzoqhubeka lubheke e-Gauteng, eMpumalanga, eLimpopo, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga, eFreyistata, eNyakatho Kapa naseMpumalanga Kapa.

src: IMiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni Ezamandla IKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubela yoMba wokuFumaneka koMbane kwa-Eskom, ngoku isondele kuma-70%.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele inqubekelaphambili oHlelweni Lokutholakala Kukagesi luka-Eskom, okuyimanje usondele kuma-70%.

src: Malunga neemegawathi ezingama-400 (i-MW) zongezwe kuthungelwano lombane kwaye ugcino olucwangcisiweyo luye lwaphucuka ngethutyana elifutshane.
tgt: Ugesi olinganiselwa kuma-400 megawatts (MW) usufakiwe kwisizinda sikagesi kanti nokunakekelwa kwaso okuhleliwe kubengcono kakhulu esikhathini esifushane.

src: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi yaqaphela ukuba isigqibo seGosa leSizwe elijonge ukuCoceka koMoya leSebe lezaMahlathi, ezokuLoba kunye nokusiNgqongileyo sokunika u-Eskom elinye ithuba lokuhlangabezana neMithetho yokuKhutshelwa kweGesi eMoyeni kwiSikhululo soMbane iKusile eMpumalanga, ngokulawulwa yimiqathango engqongqo ethile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lasiphawula isinqumo seSikhulu Esibhekele Ukuhlanzeka Komoya Kuzwelonke soMnyango Wezamahlathi, Ezokudoba Nemvelo sokuvumela u-Eskom ukuthi ahlehlise isikhathi sokuhlangabezana noBuncane beMithetho Yezimiso Zokukhishwa Kwegesi Emoyeni eSiteshini Sikagesi saseKusile eMpumalanga, ngokulandela imibandela ethile eqinile.

src: Oku kuhlehliswa kuza kuvumela u-Eskom ukuba aqhube nokulungisa isakhelo esonakele ngomhla wama-23 kweyeDwarha 2022.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlehliswa kwesikhathi kuzovumela u-Eskom ukuthi alungise umbhoshongo owamosheka mhla wama-23 kuMfumfu 2022.

src: Iziko lombane liza kwakha kwakhona izakhelo zexeshana ezintathu ekulindeleke ukuba zibuyisele i-2 100 MW yombane kuthungelwano lombane lwesizwe kunye nokunciphisa ukucinywa kombane ngamanqanaba amabini.
tgt: Le nkampani kagesi izophinde yakhe imibhoshongo yesikhashana emithathu okulindeleke ukuthi ibuyise ugesi oyizi-2 100 MW kwisizinda sikagesi sikazwelonke iphinde inciphise ukucinywa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga ngezigaba ezimbili.

src: IKhabhinethi iphinde yagxininisa ukuba urhulumente uzibophelele kwiNguqu yezaMandla (i-JET) kwaye uzimisele ukuthomalalisa ifuthe lokutshintsha kwemozulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligcizelele ukuthi uhulumeni uzinikele oHlelweni Lokuguqukela Kugesi Onganukubezi Imvelo (i-JET) futhi umagange ukunciphisa umthelela wokuguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: I-JET, eyasekwa ngonyaka wama-2020, ijolise ekuphumezeni ukukhutshwa kwekhabhoni "ye-Net Zero" ngonyaka wama-2050.
tgt: I-JET, eyasungulwa ngowezi-2020, ihlose ukuzuza isigaba esibizwa nge-“Net Zero” lapho kungekho ikhabhoni engcolisa imvelo ngowezi-2050.

src: IKhabhinethi ibulela abemi boMzantsi Afrika abaqhubekayo nokusebenzisa umbane ngononophelo, ngakumbi ngamaxesha aphezulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi libonge abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaqhubeka nokusebenzisa ugesi ngokuwonga, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi lapho usetshenziswa khona kakhulu.

src: Iinzame zethu zamandla ezidityanisiweyo ziye zanceda ukuzisa amanqanaba asezantsi okucinywa kombane.
tgt: Imizamo yethu ehlangene kagesi isize ukwehlisa izigaba zokucinywa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: IKhabhinethi kwakhona yamkela ukuzibophelela okwenziwe kwiNgqungquthela yesiVumelwano esiTsha seMali yeHlabathi eyayibanjelwe e-Paris, eFransi ukususela kumhla wama-22 ukuya kowama-23 kweyeSilimela 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela izethembiso ezenziwe kwiNgqungquthela yeSivumelwano Somhlaba Esisha Sezimali ebibanjwe e-Paris, e-France kusuka mhla wama-22 kuya mhla wama-23 kuNhlangulana 2023.

src: UMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa wayizimasa lo ngqungquthela, eyayijolise ekwakheni ikontraki entsha phakathi koMntla kunye noMzantsi ukunceda ukushukuxa imiba yokutshintsha kwemozulu, uphuhliso kunye netyala.
tgt: UMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa wethamele le ngqungquthela, obekuhloswe ngayo ukwakha isivumelwano esisha sokusebenzisana phakathi kweNyakatho neNingizimu lokho okuzosiza ukuxazulula izinkinga zokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu, intuthuko nezikweletu.

src: Iimeko ezimandla zemozulu.
tgt: Isimo sezulu esibi.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise umbulelo kumaqela oLawulo lweNtlekele kwiPhondo ngokukhawulezisa ekuncedeni uluntu oluchatshazelwe zizikhukula kutsha nje KwaZulu-Natala naseMntla Koloni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lizwakalise ukubonga kumathimba eZifundazwe Alawula Inhlekelele ngokusukuma ngokushesha ekusizeni imiphakathi ethintwe izikhukhula zakamuva KwaZulu-Natali naseNyakatho Kapa.

src: Sonke sibuhlungu ngokusweleka kwabantu KwaZulu-Natala, kwaye sivakalisa uvelwano kwiintsapho nezihlobo zabo bathe baphulukana nobomi babo.
tgt: Sidumele kakhulu ngokushona kwabantu KwaZulu-Natali, futhi sidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini nakubangani balabo abashonile.

src: Iziseko ezingundoqo zeendlela, unikezelo lombane, iinkqubo zogutyulo lwelindle kunye nezindlu kwiindawo ezichaphazelekayo KwaZulu-Natala zonakaliswe kakhulu ngelixa iindlela kwezinye iindawo zoMntla Koloni ziye zonakala.
tgt: Ingqalasizinda yomgwaqo, ukuthunyelwa kukagesi, izitamukoko zendle kanye nezindlu ezindaweni ezithintekile KwaZulu-Natali zimosheke kakhulu ngesikhathi lapho imigwaqo kwezinye izingxenye zeNyakatho Kapa ibhodlokile.

src: Urhulumente kunye nemibutho yoncedo iyaqhubeka nokubonelela ngoncedo olukhawulezileyo kuluntu oluchaphazelekileyo KwaZulu-Natala, kuquka iipasile zokutya, iingubo zokulala, iingubo zeplasitiki kunye neebhokisi zikaxakeka.
tgt: Uhulumeni nezinhlangano ezisiza abantu bayaqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokusiza imiphakathi ethintekile KwaZulu-Natali, kubandakanya izijumba zokudla, izingubo zokulala, izinto zokuvala ezingamapulasitiki kanye namabhokisi osizo lokuqala.

src: U-Eskom kunye namasebe ombane kamasipala nawo avuliwe ukuze kubuyiselwe umbane kwiindawo ezichaphazelekayo.
tgt: U-Eskom neminyango kamasipala kagesi nabo sebesukumile ukuze bezobuyisela ugesi ezindaweni ezithintekile.

src: Ngexesha leengxoxo ezisemthethweni ezidibeneyo, isiVumelwano sokuSebenzisana kuMmandla weHaydrojini Engenabungozi kokusiNgqongileyo satyikitywa phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Netherlands, ngelixa isivumelwano phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Denmark malunga neNtsebenziswano yoPhuhliso enxulumene neNkqubo yeNtsebenziswano yezaMandla yonyaka wama-2017 salungiswa.
tgt: Mette Frederiksen oluqinise ubudlelwane neNingizimu Afrika nala mazwe amabili emikhakheni yekhabhoni ephansi, ugesi ovuselelekayo kanye noHlelo Lokuguqukela Kugesi Onganukubezi Imvelo (i-JET).

src: Imbizo kaMongameli yeNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweZithili yaKwaZulu-Natala (i-DDM) UMongameli Ramaphosa, edibene neenkokheli eziphuma kuwo omathathu amanqanaba oburhulumente (kuzwelonke, kwiphondo nakwingingqi), bathabathe iMbizo kaMongameli yesiXhenxe ye-DDM yoLawulo lweSithandathu ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-30 kweyeSilimela 2023 kuMasipala weSithili uThukela KwaZulu-Natala.
tgt: Lolu hambo luphinde lahehela iqoqo labatshalizimali eNingizimu Afrika ukuqinisa amazinga aphezulu okusebenzisana kanye nobudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwaleli lizwe kanye nalaba balingani ababili ababalulekile base-Europe.

src: Iinkokheli zikarhulumente zisebenzise eli thuba ukunxibelelana nabahlali ngemingeni yonikezelo lweenkonzo kunye nezicwangciso zophuhliso lwesithili.
tgt: Ngesikhathi sezingxoxo phakathi kwala mazwe, iSivumelwane Sokusebenzisana eMkhakheni Wehayidrojini Ehlanzekile sasayinwa phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Netherlands, ngesikhathi isivumelwane phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Denmark mayelana Nokubambisana Ngentuthuko ethinta uHlelo Lokubambisana Kwezamandla sangowezi-2017 sachitshiyelwa.

src: IKhabhinethi icele abahlali ukuba badlale indima ebonakalayo ekumiseleni ikamva loluntu lwabo ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo ye-DDM yeeMbizo zikaMongameli.
tgt: IMbizo kaMongameli yoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezifunda (i-DDM) KwaZulu-Natali UMongameli u-Ramaphosa, ngokuhlanganyela nabanye abaholi abaphuma kuzona zontathu izinhlaka zikahulumeni (kuzwelonke, esifundazweni nakohulumeni basekhaya), baqhube iMbizo kaMongameli ye-DDM yeSikhombisa kuHulumeni Wehlandla leSithupha ngoLwesihlanu, mhla wama-30 kuNhlangulana 2023 kuMasipala Wesifunda sasoThukela KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Bonke abemi bayabongozwa ukuba badlale indima kuphuhliso loluntu lwabo ngokuba ngabemi abakhutheleyo.
tgt: Abaholi bakahulumeni basebenzise leli thuba ukuxoxisana nabahlali mayelana nezinselele zokulethwa kwezidingongqangi kanye nezinhlelo zentuthuko kulesi sifunda.

src: Uqoqosho IKhabhinethi icinge ngeeNkcukacha-manani zeKota zamva nje ezikhutshwe liZiko leeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika (i-Stats SA) ezibonise ukuhla kwengqesho kumacandelo ahlukeneyo kunye neenzuzo kwamanye.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licele abahlali ukuthi badlale indima ebonakalayo ekwakheni ikusasa lemiphakathi yabo ngokuthi babe yingxenye yohlelo lweMbizo kaMongameli ye-DDZonke izakhamuzi ziyanxuswa ukuba zidlale indima entuthukweni yemiphakathi yazo ngokuba izakhamuzi ezizibandakanyayo kokwenzekayo.

src: Nangona ukukhula kuhleli kuthotyiwe, uqoqosho lwethu oluzinzileyo luyaqhubeka nokudala imisebenzi, nangona lungekho ngesantya esisifunayo.
tgt: Ngokusebenza ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuthi sithole izinkinga futhi sikwazi ukususa imigoqo evimbele ukulethwa okudidiyelwe kwezidingongqangi.

src: Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, malunga nama-800 000 emisebenzi yexeshana elifutshane, ingakumbi elungiselelwe ulutsha, edalwe kwimimandla ebalulekileyo, kwezemfundo, uphuhliso lwabantwana abaselula nokhuseleko loluntu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi libhekisise iZibalo Zabasebenzi Zekota zakamuva ezakhishwa ngabeZibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA) ezibonise ukwehla kwezibalo zemisebenzi emikhakheni eyehlukahlukene kanye nokunyuka kweminye.

src: Le nkqubo iqinisekise ukuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika abaninzi abasesichengeni bathatha inxaxheba kumsebenzi onentsingiselo kwaye bafumana umvuzo ozinzileyo.
tgt: Yize ukunyuka kulokhu kumile, umnotho wethu oqinile uyaqhubeka nokusungula imisebenzi, yize kungenzeki ngezinga esilifunayo.

src: Le nkqubo iza kuseka amathuba eeprojekthi eziya kuqalisa amaphulo ehaydrojini kwiindawo zokuhlala ngenjongo yokukhulisa uqoqosho nokudalwa kwemisebenzi.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luqinisekise ukuthi abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika ababuthakathaka baba yingxenye yalo msebenzi obalulekile futhi bathola imali engenayo enganqamuki.

src: IKhabhinethi iluqaphele uTyelelo loMsebenzi lukaMongameli u-Ramaphosa oluya kwiNgqungquthela yeSibhozo yeeNtloko zeMibuso nooRhulumente ye-SACU ebibanjelwe eBukhosini baseSwatini ngoLwesine, umhla wama-29 kweyeSilimela 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yamukela isimemezelo esihlanganisile senhloso yokusungula uPhiko Lwabasebenzi beHayidrojini baseNingizimu Afrika naseJalimane, esasayinwa nguNgqongqoshe weHhovisi likaMongameli obhekelele uGesi, uDkt.

src: I-SACU eyasekwa ngo-1910, yeyona Manyano yezoRhwebo endala ehlabathini.
tgt: Kgosientsho Ramokgopa kanye nePhini likaShansela laseJalimane u-Robert Habeck.

src: Le ngqungquthela yaxoxa yaza yanikezela ngohlaziyo ngobume bokuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga se-SACU sonyaka wama-2022 ukuya kowama-2027.
tgt: Lolu phiko lwabasebenzi luzobheka ukuthi imakethe yehayidrojini ehlanzekile isungulwa futhi ithuthukiswa kanjani, kanjalo nokusungula amathuba okuqhuba ibhizinisi phakathi kwala mazwe amabili.

src: IsiCwangciso-qhinga se-SACU samkelwa ngenyanga yeSilimela ngonyaka wama-2022 njengomgaqo wokwenza nzulu ukudityaniswa kommandla kuManyano yezoRhwebo kunye nokwakha ubudlelwane obuluqilima phakathi kwamazwe amahlanu angamalungu kwakunye nokusebenzisa amathuba aveliswe ngukuRhwebelana koMmandla we-Afrika okungaHlawulisi iRhafu.
tgt: Ihayidrojini ehlanzekile ikhiqizwa ngamandla avuselelekayo kanti futhi ikhipha ikhabhoni ephansi ukwedlula ihayidrojini yakuqala.

src: Ukwembiwa kwemigodi IKhabhinethi inenkxalabo ngomkhwa wokwembiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kwaye urhulumente uthatha amanyathelo okuwuphelisa esebenzisa i-National Coordination and Strategic Management Team (i-NCSMT).
tgt: Uhulumeni usevele usungule izinhlelo ze-Hydrogen Valley, okulindeleke ukuthi iqhube isuka eLimpopo, idlulele eGoli, ize iyofika eThekwini.

src: I-NCSMT ijonge ukulungelelanisa iinzame zikarhulumente zokulwa nokwembiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nokurhweba ngezimbiwa zexabiso.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luzosungula amathuba emiklamo ezoqalisa izinhlelo zehayidrojini ezikhungweni ngenhloso yokuqinisa ukukhula komnotho kanye nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi.

src: IGqiza laBaphathiswa eliSebenzayo lithe latyalwa e-Diepsloot e- Gauteng ukuze lisebenze neenkokheli zabahlali ukulungisa imiba ebaxhalabisayo.
tgt: UHlelo Lokusebenza lwe-SACU lwamukelwa ngowezi-2022 njengomhlahlandlela wokuqinisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezifunda ezikuNyonyana Yabathengi kanye nokuqinisa amaxhama phakathi kwamazwe amahlanu angamalungu kanjalo nokusebenzisa amathuba athulwe iNkundla Yokuhwebelana Kwamazwe ase-Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi icele abahlali base-Diepsloot kunye nezinye iindawo ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente, ooceba basekuhlaleni kunye namapolisa ukusombulula imiba efana nolwaphulo-mthetho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likhathazekile ngalaba abasebenza ezimayini ngokungemthetho futhi uhulumeni uthatha izinyathelo zokukuqeda nya ngokusebenzisa i-National Coordination and Strategic Management Team (i-NCSMT).

src: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi UYilo lwesiCwangciso soTyalo-mali seLizwe (i-CIS) IKhabhinethi iluvumile uyilo loMzantsi Afrika lwe-CIS ukuba luphunyezwe.
tgt: I-NCSMT ihlose ukuhlanganisa imizamo kahulumeni yokuqeda ukusebenza ezimayini ngokungemthetho kanye nokushushumbiswa kwezinsimbi eziyigugu.

src: I-CIS, eyapapashwa ngonyaka wama-2022 ukuze uluntu luhlomle ngalo, ifuna ukubeka eli lizwe njengendawo ephambili ekhethwayo yotyalo-mali e-Afrika ngokunyusa umgangatho wotyalo-mali oluthe ngqo lwangaphandle nolwasekhaya.
tgt: Ukumbiwa ezimayini ngokungemthetho kwezinsimbi eziyigugu kuthunaza umnotho wethu, kanti kunomthelela ongemuhle kwezokuphepha nezempilo emiphakathini eseduzane nezimayini.

src: Sibonelela ngeendlela zotyalo-mali ukutsala amashishini amancinci, aphakathi kunye nasakhasayo kwiphulo lohlumo loqoqosho, ngakumbi ukutshintshela kuqoqosho olungenabungozi kokusingqongileyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licele umphakathi wase-Diepsloot kanye nezinye izindawo ukuthi basebenzisane nohulumeni, amakhansela endawo kanye namaphoyisa ukuxazulula izinkinga ezifana nobugebengu.

src: Esi sicwangciso silungelelaniswe neenjongo zesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe malunga nenguqu kwezoqoqosho kunye nesiCwangciso seZiseko ezinguNdoqo seSizwe sonyaka wama-2050 esamkelwe kutshanje.
tgt: I-CIS, eyashicilelwa ngowezi-2022 ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngayo, ihlose ukubeka izwe njengendawo ehamba phambili yotshalomali ezwenikazini i-Afrika ngokusebenzisa utshalomali oluvela kwamanye amazwe kanye nolwakuleli lizwe.

src: Amaphondo esizwe kunye noomasipala bawo abambaxa aza kuba sembindini ekuqhubeni esi sicwangciso, esiya kuthi rhoqo silungelelaniswe kwimeko yezoqoqosho eguqukayo.
tgt: Leli qhingasu lisekelwe phezu kotshalomali oluseqhulwini lwezwe kanye nezinhloso zokuthuthukiswa komnotho ezifana nokwenyusa amathuba emisebenzi, ukunciphisa inhlupheko, kanye nokweseka ukuguqukela kumnotho wekhabhoni ephansi nokutholakala kukagesi.

src: Ingxelo yelizwe yesithathu phantsi kwesiVumelwano seZizwe ngezizwe esichasene neNtuthumbo kunye nezinye iiNkohlakalo kunye neMpatho engenabuntu okanye iSohlwayo (i-CAT).
tgt: Lihlinzeka ngezindlela zokutshala imali ezizoheha amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi ukuthi aphokophelele ekukhuleni komnotho, ikakhulukazi umnotho onganukubezi imvelo.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa kwengxelo yesithathu ye-CAT yoMzantsi Afrika kuNobhala-Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN).
tgt: Iqhingasu leli liphinde lithinte izivumelwano zamazwe amaningi, ezezifunda neziphakathi kwamazwe amabili ezasayinwa yiNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ingxelo ichaza amanyathelo athathwa nguMzantsi Afrika ukuthintela ukungcungcuthekiswa kunye nokuphathwa kakubi kwabemi.
tgt: Iqhingasu lihambisana nezinjongo zoHlelo Lwentuthuko Kazwelonke ezinguqukweni zomnotho kanye noHlelo Lwengqalasizinda Kazwelonke lowezi-2050 olusanda kwamukelwa.

src: Ngokuhambelana neNqaku le-17 loMthetho wokuZiphatha ongaNyanzelisiyo (i-Optional Protocol) kwi-CAT, enye yezibophelelo ezinyanzeliswe kumaQela kaRhulumente kukuseka iindlela zasekhaya zokuthintela intuthumbo eyaziwa ngokuba yiNkqubo yoThintelo yeSizwe.
tgt: Umbiko wesithathu wezwe ngaphansi kweSivumelwano Samazwe Ngamazwe sokulwisana nokuHlukunyezwa neSihluku kanye Nokuphathwa Ngolunya noma Ukuphathwa noma Ukujeziswa ngendlela Eyehlisa Isithunzi (i-CAT).

src: Kule minyaka ingama-29 idlulileyo, urhulumente wentando yesininzi eMzantsi Afrika uye wayisusa imithetho namaziko amadala ocalu-calulo, wakha amaziko amatsha entando yesininzi, waza wasungula imithetho esekelwe kumalungelo omgaqo-siseko kunye nenkululeko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi seligunyaze ukulethwa kuNobhala-Jikelele Wezizwe Ezibumbene (i-UN) umbiko wesithathu weNingizimu Afrika we-CALo mbiko ucacisa izinyathelo iNingizimu Afrika ezithathayo ukunqanda ukuhlukunyezwa nokuphathwa ngesihluku kwezakhamuzi.

src: Uluntu luyakwazi ukuxela izityholo zokungcungcuthekiswa kunye nempatho-mbi kwiCandelo loPhando lwaMapolisa eliZimeleyo ukuze ziphandwe.
tgt: NgokweSahluko se-17 soMthetho Olandelwayo we-CAT, esinye sezibopho esibekelwe amaqembu Ombuso ukusungula izindlela emazweni awo zokunqanda ukuhlukunyezwa nokuphathwa ngesihluku ezaziwa ngokuthi iNdlela Kazwelonke Yokugwema Isimo.

src: Kwakhona uMzantsi Afrika ukwaneKomishoni yamaLungelo oLuntu esebenza kakuhle, iziko lesizwe elimiselwe ukuxhasa intando yesininzi yomgaqo-siseko.
tgt: Eminyakeni eyedlule engama-29, uhulumeni wentando yeningi labantu eNingizimu Afrika wasusa imithetho nezikhungo ezindala zobandlululo, wakha izikhungo ezintsha zikahulumeni wentando yeningi labantu ezesekwe phezu kwamalungelo nenkululeko ekumthethosisekelo.

src: Izikhundla Zonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.
tgt: Amalungu omphakathi ayakwazi ukubika ngqo ngezinsolo zokuhlukunyezwa nokuphathwa ngesihluku kuPhiko Oluzimele Oluphenya Amaphoyisa ukuze kuzophenywa.

src: UNks Ntomboxolo Mbengashe njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba (i-CEO) yeBhanki yePosi yoMzantsi Afrika ixesha leminyaka emihlanu.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iphinde ibe neKhomishini Yamalungelo Abantu esebenza kahle kakhulu, okuyisikhungo sikazwelonke esasungulelwa ukweseka intando yeningi labantu yomthethosisekelo.

src: UMnu Sibusiso Bukhosini njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba ye-Isimangaliso Wetland Park Authority (uqeshiwe kwakhona).UNks Tamlyn Bouwer njengeGosa eliPhethe i-Ofisi yeMali yeBhunga leSizwe lokuBhalisa abaKhi bezindlu.
tgt: Ntomboxolo Mbengashe esikhundleni sokuba nguMphathi Omkhulu (i-CEO) weBhange Leposi laseNingizimu Afrika isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu.

src: D IMithetho eYilwayo.
tgt: Mnu.

src: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo wonyaka wama-2023 weeNkampani IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkampani wonyaka wama-2023 ukuze uqwalaselwe.
tgt: Sibusiso Bukhosini esikhundleni sokuba i-CEO ye-Isimangaliso Wetland Park Authority (uphinde wabekwa).

src: UMthetho oYilwayo wonyaka wama-2022 wokuBeka esweni, iNkxaso kunye namaNgenelelo kuRhulumente (i-IMSI) IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koyilo loMthetho oYilwayo we-IMSI wonyaka wama-2022 ukuze uluntu luveze izimvo zalo.
tgt: Daphne Yandiswa Morudu esikhundleni sokuba i-DDG: kuPhiko lwe-South African National Statistics System kuMnyango Wezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika.

src: ICandelo le-100 lixhobisa urhulumente ukuba angenelele ukuba iphondo liyasilela ukuhlangabezana nezibophelelo zalo zolawulo nonikezelo lweenkonzo ngelixa iCandelo le-139 lixhobisa isigqeba sephondo esinolawulo oluphezulu ukuba singenelele ukuba umasipala akalufezi uxanduva ngokoMgaqo-siseko okanye ngokomthetho.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Ohlongozwayo Wezinkampani wezi-2023 IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukulethwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela ohlongozwayo wezi-2023 ukuze ucutshungulwe.

src: UMthetho oYilwayo we-IMSI waziswa njengesixhobo sokulawula ukujongana nemingeni ekunyanzeliseni iCandelo le-139, ukubeka iliso novavanyo, kunye nefuthe longenelelo.
tgt: Izethulo eziqukethwe kulo Mthethosivivinywa zihlose ukunciphisa umthwalo wokulawula nokuphatha kubanikazi bamabhizinisi futhi zizokwenyusa ukuheheka kweNingizimu Afrika kulabo abangaba abatshalizimali.

src: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uya kulawula ukuphunyezwa kweCandelo le-139 loMgaqo-siseko, kuquka neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo.
tgt: Izichibiyelo eziningi bekungezobuchwepheshe, futhi bezibheke kakhulu ukuhambelanisa nokucacisa izindaba zokuphatha.

src: Uza kubonelela ngenkxaso ekujoliswe kuyo koomasipala abafuna uncedo, kwaye ukwabonelela ngokubeka iliso koomasipala ukuze bafezekise izibophelelo zabo zolawulo ngokoMgaqo-siseko okanye ngokomthetho.
tgt: Enye yezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini kulo hulumeni wentando yeningi labantu ngukusungulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi kanti lokhu ngeke kufezeke uma izindlela ezilula zokwenza ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika zishaywa indiva.

src: Phakathi komhla woku-1 kunye nowe-7 kweyeKhala 2023, abahlawuli berhafu baza kwaziswa nge-SMS okan nge-imeyile ukuba bakhethelwe ukufumana uvavanyo oluzenzekelayo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa wangaphakathi Kuhulumeni Wokuqapha, Ukweseka Nezingenelelo (i-IMSI) wangowezi-2022 IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa osahlongozwa we-IMSI wezi-2022 ukuze umphakathi uzophawula ngawo.

src: Ukuba uthe wayifumana i-SMS, inyathelo elilandelayo lakho liya kuba kukuhlola uvavanyo oluzenzekelayo kwi-MobiApp yakwa-SARS okanye kwi-eFiling.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uzosetshenziswa njengesisombululo sezinselele eziningi ezivele lapho uhulumeni eqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwesahluko se-100 nese-139 soMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika wangowe-1996 ngesikhathi ephoqelekile ukwenza njalo ngenxa yokuhluleka kwezinhlaka ezithile zikahulumeni.

src: Ukungeniswa kwangethuba nangokuchanekileyo kweengxelo zerhafu kuqinisekisa ukuba abahlawuli berhafu bahlala bethobela umthetho, kwaye kunceda urhulumente ukuba anikezele ngeenkonzo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika nokukhulisa uqoqosho.
tgt: ISahluko se-100 sinika uhulumeni amandla okungenelela uma isifundazwe sehluleka ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zaso zokuphatha nokuletha izidingongqangi ngesikhathi lapho iSahluko se-139 sona sinika amandla iziphathimandla zesifundazwe ukuthi zingenelele uma umasipala ungafezi izibopho zawo njengokusho koMthethosisekelo noma komthetho.

src: INdebe yeHlabathi yabaseTyhini ye-FIFA yowama-2023 IBanyana Banyana, iiNtshatsheli ze-Afrika ezilawulayo, kunye neqhayiya lesizwe, iza kuthwala amathemba namaphupha oMzantsi Afrika xa ithatha inxaxheba kwiNdebe yeHlabathi yabaseTyhini ye-FIFA yowama-2023 e-New Zealand nase-Australia ukusuka ngomhla wama-20 kweyeKhala ukuya kowama-20 kweyeThupha 2023.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa we-IMSI wethulwa njengethuluzi lokulawula ukuze kuzoxazululwa izinselele zokuqaliswa kweSahluko se-139, ukuqapha nokuhlolisisa, kanye nomphumela wezingenelelo.

src: IKhabhinethi ibanqwenelela okuhle kodwa njengoko bekwiphulo lokufuna udumo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uzolawula ukuqaliswa kweSahluko se-139 soMthethosisekelo, kubandakanya nezinqubo ezifanele.

src: UMzantsi Afrika unabo inyathelo ngalinye, kwaye sijonge phambili kubo ukuba benze imbali entsha kunye nokukhuthaza izizukulwana ezizayo.
tgt: Uzoseka ngqo omasipala abadinga usizo, futhi uqaphe omasipala ukuthi bayazifeza izibopho zabo ezinqala njengokusho koMthethosisekelo noma komthetho.

src: INdebe yeHlabathi yeBhola yoMnyazi yowama-2023 Kwezi ntsuku zimbalwa zizayo, amehlo ehlabathi lezemidlalo aza kujonga eKapa, eMzantsi Afrika, xa kuqalwa iNdebe yeHlabathi yeBhola yoMnyazi yowama-2023 ukusuka ngomhla wama-28 kweyeKhala ukuya kowe-6 kweyeThupha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi isikhathi sokukhokha intela sizovulwa ngoLwesihlanu, mhla wesi-7 kuNtulikazi 2023 kanti sizoqhubeka kuze kube ngumhla wama-23 kuMfumfu 2023.

src: IKhabhinethi imemelela wonke umntu kweli lizwe ukuba axhase amantombazana ethu njengoko ezama ukwenza imbali ngokuphumelela igolide e-Afrika.
tgt: Abakhokhintela bayagqugquzelwa ukuthi bakhokhe intela yabo ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lwe-eFiling noma nge-MobiApp yoPhiko Lwemalingeniso Eqoqwayo LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS).

src: Imiyalezo Amazwi okuvuyisana IKhabhinethi ithumela amazwi okuvuyisana kunye neminqweno emihle kwaba balandelayo:IYunivesithi yoMzantsi Afrika ngokufikelela kwinqanaba elibalulekileyo leminyaka eli-150 yokugqwesa kwimfundo ephakamileyo, nokuba lelona ziko likhulu nelona lidala kwi-Afrika ekuMazantsi ye-Sahara elizinikele kwimfundo esemgangathweni nakwihlabathi liphela.
tgt: Inqubo yokukhokhwa kwentela seyilula kakhulu manje futhi no-SARS uzoqhubeka nenqubo yokuzenzela kulo nyaka.

src: UMnu Edward Kieswetter, uMkomishinala wakwa-SARS, emva kokuchongwa kwakhe njengosihlalo woMbutho woRhwebo weHlabathi kunye nokuba ngummi woMzantsi Afrika wesibini ukuba ngusihlalo walo mbutho.
tgt: Phakathi womhla lu-1 nomhla ziyisi-7 kuNtulikazi 2023, abakhokhintela bayaziswa nge-SMS noma nge-imeyili uma bekhethiwe ukuthi bafakwe ohlelweni oluzenzekelayo lokukhokhela intela.

src: UMmeli Pansy Tlakula ekunyulweni kwakhona kwakhe kwiKomiti yeZizwe eziManyeneyo yokupheliswa kocalu-calulo ngokobuhlanga.
tgt: Uma uthola i-SMS, isinyathelo esilandelayo okumele usithathe ngukubuyekeza lokhu kuhlolwa okuzenzekelayo kwi-MobiApp ye-SARS noma ku-eFiling.

src: South African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) Western Cape taxi strike Cabinet was briefed about the ongoing impasse between SANTACO Western Cape and the City of Cape Town, which has escalated into a violent strike as a result of the impounding of taxi vehicles by the City of Cape Town.
tgt: Isiteleka soMkhandlu Kazwelonke Wamatekisi eNingizimu Afrika (i-SANTACO) eNtshonalanga Kapa IKhabhinethi lazisiwe ngesimo esesifike kwangqingetshe esiqhubekayo phakathi kwe-SANTACO eNtshonalanga Kapa kanye noMasipala weDolobha laseKapa, esidlondlobale saze sayofinyelela esitelekeni esinodlame nokube ngumphumela wokuboshwa kwamatekisi nguMasipala weDolobha laseKapa.

src: Cabinet condemns the violence and anarchy in Cape Town and has called on SANTACO to ensure that its protest action is peaceful and does not interfere with the rights of others.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyalugxeka udlame nesiphithiphithi eDolobheni laseKapa futhi licela i-SANTACO ukuthi iqinisekise ukuthi iziteleka zayo zenzeka ngokuthula futhi aziphazamisi amalungelo abanye abantu.

src: In this regard, we have noted that there were no violent incidents in the last 48-hours.
tgt: Mayelana nalokhu, kuyaphawuleka ukuthi akubange kusaba khona ezinye izigameko zodlame emahoreni angama-48 edlule.

src: However, members of the South African Police Service and other law-enforcement agencies have been directed to ensue violent situation is under control to allow residents safe movement to school, work and their normal daily activities.
tgt: Noma kunjalo, amalungu oPhiko Lwamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika namanye ama-ejensi ezomthetho aseyalelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isimo sodlame siyalawuleka ukuze abahlali bezohamba ngokuphepha uma beya ezikoleni, emsebenzini kanye nokwenza imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke.

src: Cabinet was also briefed about the City of Cape Town’s imposing of taxi operating conditions which are at variance with both the National Road Traffic, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996) and the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009), which regulate the traffic offences and applicable penalties, including the impounding of vehicles.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde laziswa ngokuphoqwa kwezimo zokusebenza kwamatekisi nguMasipala weDolobha laseKapa ezingahambisani nayo yomibili imithetho okunguMthetho Wezemigwaqo Kazwelonke, we-1996 (uMthetho wama-93 we-1996) kanye noMthetho Kazwelonke Wezokuthutha Ngezithuthi Zomgwaqo, wezi-2009 (uMthetho wesi-5 wezi-2009), okuyiyona elawula amacala ezemigwaqo kanye nezinhlawulo ezifanele, kubandakanya nokuboshwa kwezimoto.

src: Cabinet has directed the Minister of Transport, Ms Sindisiwe Chikunga, to ensure that any taxi operating conditions that contradicts the laws of the Republic are removed.
tgt: Sindisiwe Chikunga, ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi noma yiziphi izimo zokusebenza kwamatekisi eziphikisana nemithetho yaseNingizimu Afrika ziyasuswa.

src: Fight against illegal mining.
tgt: Ukulwisana nokumbiwa kwezimayini okungekho emthethweni.

src: Cabinet welcomed the deployment of a special police unit, which is supported by the military, in Riverlea, Johannesburg, to deal with illegal mining in the area.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likwamukele ukuthunyelwa kophiko olukhethekile lwamaphoyisa, okwesekwa nawumkhosi wezempi, e-Riverlea, eGoli, ukuze luzobhekana nokumbiwa kwezimayini ngokungekho emthethweni kule ndawo.

src: In addition, Cabinet commended the arrest of over 194 suspects over illegal mining activities and directed law-enforcement agencies to urgently clamp down on this and other serious crimes in the country.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokhu, iKhabhinethi lincome ukuboshwa kwabasolwa abangaphezu kwe-194 ngokumba izimayini ngokungekho emthethweni futhi yayalela ama-ejensi ezomthetho ukuthi aqede nya ngokushesha ngalobu bugebengu kanye nobunye obuhamba phambili kuleli lizwe.

src: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) has committed to close all derelict open shafts and mine holes in Riverlea by the end of September 2023, whilst finalising plans to close other derelict open shafts and mining holes across the country.
tgt: UMnyango Wezezimbiwa Nezamandla (i-DMRE) izinikele ekuvaleni yonke imigudu nemigodi evulekile engasasebenzi e-Riverlea ngokuphela kukaMandulo wezi-2023, ngesikhathi iphothula izinhlelo zokuvala eminye imigudu nemigodi yezimayini evulekile engasasebenzi ezweni lonkana.

src: The security situation in Niger.
tgt: Isimo sezokuvikeleka e-Niger.

src: Cabinet has noted the impact the security situation in Niger is having on air-travel between South Africa/Southern Africa and Western Europe, with negative implications for business and individuals alike and the airline industry that is just starting to recover from the devastating ravages of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liwuphawulile umphumela odalwa yisimo sezokuvikeleka e-Niger ekuhambeni kwezindiza phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika noma eNingizimu ye-Afrika neNtshonalanga ye-Europe, nokuyimiphumela engemihle emabhizinisini kanjalo nakubantu kanye nasembonini yezezindiza eqeda kuqala ukuvuka esimeni esibi sobhubhane lweSifo Segciwane le-Corona sangowe-2019 (i-COVID-19).

src: Cabinet reiterated government’s condemnation of the coup in Niger and the call for the speedy restoration of a democratic order, and also noted the initiative to restore normality under the Economic Community of West African States.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligcizelele ukungahambisani nhlobo kukahulumeni nezenzo zokuketula umbuso e-Niger laphinda lanxusa ukubuyiselwa ngokushesha kokuthula kwentando yeningi labantu, laphinde layiphawula imizamo yokubuyisela isimo kwesijwayelekile ngaphansi kweNyonyana Yamazwe aseNtshonalanga ye-Afrika Alwela Umnotho.

src: Russia-Africa Summit.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa was amongst other African leaders who attended the Second Russia-Africa Summit, in St Petersburg in the Russian Federation on 27 and 28 July 2023.
tgt: UMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa ubephakathi kwabanye abaholi base-Afrika abebethamele iNgqungquthela Yesibili ye-Russia ne-Afrika, e-St Petersburg e-Russia ngomhla wama-27 nomhla wama-28 kuNtulikazi 2023.

src: This summit adopted the Russia-Africa Partnership Forum Action Plan which focuses on strengthening cooperation in areas of politics and security, economics, humanitarian matters, and interests of mutual benefit and prosperity.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yamukele uHlelo loBudlelwano Bokusebenzisana phakathi kwe-Russia ne-Afrika olugxile ekuqiniseni ukusebenzisana emikhakheni yezepolitiki nokuvikeleka, ezomnotho, izindaba zokusiza abantu, kanye nemisebenzi ezohlomulisa zonke izinhlangothi kanye nomnotho.

src: On the sidelines of the summit, African Heads of State and Government who are part of the African Peace Initiative on the conflict between Russia and Ukraine held follow-up talks with President Vladimir Putin on the previously discussed confidence-building measures that will create conditions for a negotiated settlement to ending the war.
tgt: Ngale kwengqungquthela, iZinhloko Zombuso noHulumeni base-Afrika ababeyingxenye yeZingxoxo Zokuzama Ukuletha Ukuthula e-Afrika kwingxabano phakathi kwe-Russia ne-Ukraine baqhubeke nokulumana indlebe noMongameli u-Vladimir Putin ngemizamo yokwakha ukuzithemba okwakuxoxisanwe ngayo phambilini ezokwakha izimo zokuthola isisombululo sokuqeda impi.

src: Presidents Ramaphosa and Putin also held a bilateral meeting and discussed opportunities to increase trade between the two countries, and for the Russian Federation to increase investments in South Africa.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa no-Putin baphinde baba nomhlangano wabo njengamazwe amabili badingida amathuba okunyusa ukuhwebelana phakathi kwala mazwe womabili, nokuthi izwe lase-Russia linyuse utshalomali eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Cabinet was apprised that it is all systems go in terms of South Africa’s readiness to host the 15th BRICS Summit in Johannesburg from 22 to 24 August 2023.
tgt: Sekume Ngomumo Ukusingatha Ingqungquthela ye-BRICIKhabhinethi livumile ukuthi zonke izinto zime ngomumo ngokuthi iNingizimu Afrika isingathe iNgqungquthela ye-15 ye-BRICS eGoli kusuka mhla wama-22 kuya mhla wama-24 kuNcwaba 2023.

src: The last of the BRICS Ministerial meetings – the BRICS Ministers of Agriculture Meeting – is currently underway, while the Ministerial Meetings of Foreign Affairs, Security, Trade, Industry, Education, Science, Labour, Communications, Health, and Urbanisation Forum have concluded their reports for the Leaders’ Summit.
tgt: Umhlangano wokugcina woNgqongqoshe be-BRICS – uMhlangano Wezolimo woNgqongqoshe be-BRICS – uyaqhubeka, ngesikhathi iMihlangano yoNgqongqoshe Bezindaba Zangaphandle, Ezokuvikeleka, Ezohwebo, Izimboni, Ezemfundo, Isayensi, Ezabasebenzi, Ezokuxhumana, Ezempilo, kanye neForamu Yezokufudukela Emadolobheni isiyiphothulile imibiko yayo yeNgqungquthela Yabaholi.

src: The BRICS Outreach programmes for various sectors and communities have also been concluded.
tgt: Izinhlelo Zomphakathi ze-BRICS zemikhakha eyahlukahlukene nemiphakathi nazo seziphothuliwe.

src: These engagements provided governments, organisations, experts and academics from the BRICS nations an opportunity to discuss issues of mutual interest that will enable informed decision-making during the BRICS Summit.
tgt: Lezi zingxoxo zinike ohulumeni, izinhlangano, ochwepheshe nezifundiswa eziphuma emazweni ayingxenye ye-BRICS ithuba lokuxoxisana ngezindaba ezithinta la mazwe ezingaholela ekuthathweni kwezinqumo eziphusile ngesikhathi seNgqungquthela ye-BRICUBuyekezo Lweminyaka Eyishumi loHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kukazwelonke (i-NDP).

src: Cabinet welcomed the Ten-Year Review of the NDP by the National Planning Commission that pointed out that the economy remained structured in a manner that does not serve the interests of all South Africans, which is a major reason behind increasing levels of poverty and inequality.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele uBuyekezo Lweminyaka Eyishumi lwe-NDP olwenziwe iKhomishini Yezinhlelo Zikazwelonke olubonise ukuthi umnotho ubusalokhu wakheke ngendlela engahlangabezani nezidingo zabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, okuyisona sizathu esikhulu esenza kunyuke amazinga obubha nokungalingani.

src: Government remains committed to restructuring and transforming the economy to serve the interests of all South Africans.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu ezinikele ekwakheni kabusha nasekuguquleni umnotho ukuze usebenzele izidingo zabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: The 25th July marked the First Anniversary since President Ramaphosa announced the Energy Action Plan.
tgt: Ezamandla Umhla wama-25 kuNtulikazi kuzobe kuphela uNyaka Wokuqala selokhu uMongameli u-Ramaphosa amemezela uHlelo Lokusebenza Lwezamandla.

src: Cabinet welcomed the progress made to date to implement the Energy Action Plan, which continues to register an improvement in the Energy Availability Factor and improvement in the stages of load-shedding.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele inqubekelaphambili eyenziwe kuze kube manje ekuqalisweni koHlelo Lokusebenza Lwezamandla, oluqhubekayo nokwenza kangcono ekuTholakaleni Kukagesi kanye nesimo esingcono ezigabeni zokucinywa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: Tourism Cabinet is pleased that the Tourism statistics for June 2023 show that our tourism sector is slowly but surely recovering from the devastating effects of the COVID-19 pandemic.
tgt: Ezokuvakasha IKhabhinethi likuthokozele ukuthi izibalo zeZokuvakasha zangoNhlangulana wezi-2023 zibonisa ukuthi umkhakha wethu wezokuvakasha kancane kancane uyavuka kwimithelela emibi yobhubhane lwe-COVID-19.

src: The June 2023 statistics from Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) show that the volume of arrivals, departures and travellers in transit increased for both South African residents and foreign travellers between June 2022 and June 2023.
tgt: Izibalo zangoNhlangulana wezi-2023 ezibuya kuMnyango Wezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA) zibonisa ukuthi umthamo wabafikayo, abaphumayo nabavakashi ukhuphukile kubahlali baseNingizimu Afrika nabavakashi abaphuma emazweni angaphandle phakathi kukaNhlangulana wezi-2022 noNhlangulana wezi-2023.

src: Economy Cabinet welcomed Stats SA’s report of a drop in consumer inflation from per cent in May to per cent in June 2023, which is the largest decline since May 2020.
tgt: Umnotho IKhabhinethi lamukele umbiko we-Stats SA wokwehla kwamandla emali kubathengi kusuka kumaphesenti ayisi-6.3 ngoNhlaba kwaya kumaphesenti ayisi-5.4 ngoNhlangulana wezi-2023, okungukwehla okukhulu kusuka ngoNhlaba wezi-2020.

src: This drop shows the resilience of our economy, which has been further buoyed by the South Africa Reserve Bank’s decision to leave the repo rate unchanged at 8.25 per cent.
